jobs.title: Senior Executive Assistant – Chief People Officer, People Center
jobs.description:
Come join one of America’s fastest-growing insurance companies. Since 1848, National Life Group has aimed to keep our promises, providing families with stability in good times and in bad. Throughout that history, we have provided peace of mind to those families as they plan their futures.

Our mission extends beyond the insurance and annuities policies that we offer. We strive to make the world a better place through our grants from our charitable foundation, paid volunteer time for our employees, environmentally sustainable and healthy workplaces, and events that promote the work of nonprofits in our own backyard.

We foster a collaborative environment with opportunities for growth and encourage our associates to live our values: Do good. Be good. Make good.

Please note that we do not offer visa sponsorship for this position.

Role Summary

The Senior Executive Assistant to the Chief People Officer (CPO) serves as a trusted partner to the CPO, enabling the effective operation of the People Center through exceptional executive support, proactive planning, disciplined follow-through, and strong judgment. The role combines sophisticated calendar and communications management with project coordination, Board and committee support, event and meeting logistics, vendor administration, and the careful handling of highly confidential information. Success requires the ability to anticipate needs, understand organizational context, manage competing priorities, connect the right people and resources at the right time, identify issues, recommend solutions, and help advance People Center priorities.

This position works across the People Center and throughout National Life Group, partnering with leaders, administrative professionals, associates, new hires, vendors, and other stakeholders to keep information moving and commitments on track.

This position currently offers an onsite work schedule, with the expectation that you will be in the office four (4) days per week during onsite core days.  Our current onsite core days are Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday.  The work schedule type and core days are subject to change with advance notification and manager discretion.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Executive support and calendar management

• Provide high-level executive support to the CPO and targeted administrative support to People Center leadership, creating and maintaining a system of documentation that enhances productivity and eliminates redundancy

• Manage the day-to-day administrative affairs of the CPO, anticipating needs and proactively bringing together the right people and resources to address issues

• Provide sophisticated calendar management: prioritize inquiries and requests, troubleshoot conflicts with little guidance, and make judgments and recommendations that keep the day running smoothly

• Exercise independent judgment on behalf of the CPO, understanding when to act independently, when to consult, and when to escalate; identify issues and recommend solutions based on an understanding of priorities and organizational context

• Maintain a disciplined system for tracking decisions, commitments, action items, and key deliverables, following up with owners to ensure timely completion

Communications and information flow

• Facilitate communication across the organization to accelerate response times and keep messages moving; triage and draft replies to email, and communicate People Center strategy clearly and accurately

• Work collaboratively with other administrative professionals to request and assemble information, format and proofread business documents, and support internal and external communications, using judgement based on priorities, audience and level of detail

• Prepare the CPO for meetings and decisions by coordinating executive-ready briefing materials, agendas, pre-reads, talking points, background information, and other materials

• Build and maintain effective working relationship across the People Center, executive leadership, administrative professionals and external stakeholders, using discretion and diplomacy to facilitate communication and advance priorities

• Communicate People Center priorities and messages clearly, accurately, and with appropriate context

Board and committee support

• Support the CPO's preparation for Board and committee meetings, including materials deadlines, document assembly, distribution, and pre-meeting logistics

• Coordinate with the Corporate Secretary's office and other executive assistants on Board calendars and cycles

• Handle board and committee information with a high degree of discretion and attention to confidentiality

Travel, expense, and vendor administration

• Coordinate domestic travel, including itineraries, ground transportation, and on-site logistics

• Prepare and reconcile expense reports and corporate card activity in line with company policy

• Process invoices and purchase orders, and support vendor onboarding, contract routing, and renewal tracking for People Center partners

• Support the annual People Center budgeting process and ongoing financial management, including coordinating budget inputs, tracking actual spend again budget, maintaining forecasts, and identifying variances or items requiring leadership attention

Projects and program coordination

• Partner with the CPO on strategic and operational projects by establishing objectives, clarifying priorities into actionable plans, managing timelines, tracking deliverables, and maintaining momentum through disciplined execution

• Create status reports and tracking mechanisms to ensure objectives are achieved through a detailed approach to execution

• Identify opportunities to simplify recurring People Center workflows through process improvement, technology, automation, and approved AI-enabled solutions

• Participate on special projects and transformation teams as needed to meet business goals

Events and meeting logistics

• Plan and execute People Center meetings, offsites, leadership sessions, and recognition and associate events across both campuses

• Manage hybrid meeting logistics, including room and AV setup, virtual facilitation support, catering, and materials

Confidentiality and information handling

• Handle highly sensitive information with discretion, including associate relations matters, compensation and performance data, organizational changes, and pre-announcement information

• Follow company policies on data privacy, records retention, and the handling of material non-public information

• Exercise high-level interpersonal skills, poise, tact, and diplomacy when managing sensitive and confidential situations

General

• Other duties as assigned by the CPO

Minimum Qualifications

• Minimum of 8 years of high-level executive support experience with a demonstrated record of success

• Bachelor’s degree in business or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience

• Demonstrated judgment and discretion in handling sensitive and confidential information

• Exceptional organizational skills, with the ability to perform and prioritize multiple tasks seamlessly and with excellent attention to detail

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to draft on behalf of a senior leader

• Demonstrated ability to create, edit, and format polished executive-level presentations, reports, meeting materials, and communications

• Proficiency across Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, SharePoint), video conferencing platforms, and e-signature tools, plus the demonstrated ability to rapidly learn new company-specific systems

• Familiarity with expense and travel management systems, and with project tracking tools (Concur, Deem, Docusign, etc.) as well as employee records and other systems containing confidential workforce data

• A customer-centric mindset grounded in servant leadership principles, with the ability to build trusted relationships, understand business priorities, influence without formal authority, and prioritize the success of the team over personal success

• Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, establish priorities, and meet deadlines while juggling competing demands

• Ability to pass a background check

Preferred Qualifications

• 3-5 years of experience in financial services or a comparable regulated industry

• Experience supporting a C-suite executive, including Board or committee preparation

• Experience supporting HR or people function, with familiarity handling associate data

• Demonstrated use of AI tools within documented workflows to improve speed or quality of work

• Experience coordinating across multiple sites or time zones

• Certified Administrative Professional (CAP) certification

Working Conditions and Essential Functions

• Full-time, based on our Montpelier, VT campus with required on-site presence Monday through Thursday. This is an on-site expectation, not a preference, given the confidential and in-person nature of the support this role provides.

• Occasional flexibility outside standard business hours during peak periods such as board weeks, open enrollment, and other major associate events

• Occasional travel to the Addison, TX campus

• Prolonged periods working at a computer; ability to move about the campus to support meetings and events

AI Proficiency Expectations:

At National Life Group, we view AI as an enabler of human potential. We use AI to help us work smarter, serve more clients, and keep our promises, while remaining in a relationship-driven business where our people are our greatest strength.

All applicants are expected to:

• Leverage approved AI tools, where appropriate, to improve the efficiency, quality, and impact of their work.

• Stay curious and open to new AI-enabled ways of working.

• Exercise sound judgment by reviewing and validating AI-generated content.

• Maintain accountability for the accuracy, quality, fairness, and integrity of work products by adhering to National Life's AI guiding principles.

• Use AI responsibly and in accordance with company policies related to confidentiality, data privacy, security, compliance, retention, and intellectual property.

Core Competencies

Service Focus - Demonstrates a client centric focus for satisfying one’s external and/or internal customers; establishes and maintains effective relationships with customers and gains their trust and respect.

Decision Making - Makes sense of complex information, critically evaluates, and creates solutions.

Results Oriented - Sets performance and personal goals; Driven to meet or exceed goals and objectives.

Plans and Aligns - Plans and prioritizes work to meet commitments aligned with organizational goals; Aligns people and skills to tasks and assignments; Evaluates results of work.

Demonstrates Learning Agility - Enhances skills and knowledge through continuous learning; Focuses on personal results by establishing stretch goals; Seeks feedback and changes accordingly.

Establishes Relationships - Builds partnerships with others to instill trust, collaborate, and meet shared objectives.

Communicates Effectively - Actively listens, conveys messages to meet different audience needs, and remains open to new ideas and opinions.

Fosters Diversity - Values diversity and difference in thought, experience, and perspective; Promotes an environment that embraces diversity, equity, and inclusion; Supports equal and fair treatment for all.

Benefits

• Your benefits start day one and are flexible and customizable to your and your family’s specific needs. Check out the BENEFITS of a Career at National Life!

Base Pay Range.  The base pay range for this position is the range National Life reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for the position taking into account the wide variety of factors, including: prior experience and job-related knowledge; education, training and certificates; current business needs; and market factors.  The final salary or hourly wages offered may be outside of this range based on other reasons and individual circumstances.

Additional Compensation and Benefits. The total compensation package for this position may also include a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as vacation, sick time, and parental leave), dependent on the position offered. The successful candidate may also be eligible to participate in National Life’s discretionary annual incentive programs, subject to the rules governing such programs. If hired, the employee will be in an "at-will position" and National Life reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation or benefit program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, company or individual department/team performance, and market factors.

National Life is accepting applications for this role on an ongoing basis and the role remains open until filled.

Hourly Pay Range

$34—$50 USD

At EquipmentShare, we’re not just filling a role — we’re assembling the best team on the planet to build something that’s never been built before. We’re on a mission to transform an industry that’s been stuck in the past by empowering contractors and communities through innovative technology, real-time support, and a team that truly cares.

Why EquipmentShare?

Because we do things differently — and we think you’ll feel it from day one. We’re a people-first company powered by cutting-edge technology. That means our proprietary T3 platform doesn’t just run our business — it also makes your job easier, safer, and more connected. Whether you’re behind the wheel, under the hood, leading a branch, or closing deals — tech supports you, and you drive us forward.

We’re a team of problem-solvers, go-getters, and builders. And we’re looking for teammates who take pride in doing meaningful work and want to be part of building something special.

Perks & Benefits

You want to be part of a team that’s not just changing an industry for the sake of change — we’re transforming it to make it safer, more secure, and more productive. jobs.title: Communications Manager
jobs.description:
We're looking for someone who thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced global environment and brings a combination of curiosity, empathy, creativity and business acumen. The ideal candidate is energized by working with people, building meaningful relationships and partnering across cultures, functions and geographies. They embrace new ideas, lead with kindness, value diverse perspectives and are passionate about creating meaningful communication experiences that help employees feel connected, informed and inspired.

As an Internal Communication Manager, you will help connect employees to our strategy, priorities, culture and business objectives through compelling, impactful and measurable communications. This role is responsible for developing and executing strategic communication plans that help employees understand not only what the organization is focused on, but also how their work contributes to overall success.

As a member of the Communication team, you will serve as a trusted advisor to senior leaders and executives, providing strategic counsel, messaging guidance and communication support for organizational priorities, business transformations, leadership visibility initiatives and employee engagement efforts.

Success in this role requires a blend of strategic thinking, executive influence, storytelling expertise, change management capability and digital and AI fluency. The ideal candidate is comfortable navigating ambiguity, translating complex information into meaningful employee experiences and leveraging emerging technologies, including AI, to enhance communication effectiveness, efficiency and impact.

This role also plays a key role in measuring communication effectiveness, generating insights and continuously refining strategies to maximize employee understanding, engagement and business impact. The goal is simple: create clear, authentic and engaging communication experiences that inform, inspire and connect employees to the company's vision and priorities.

Key Responsibilities

Executive Communications & Strategic Advisement

• Serve as a trusted communications advisor to senior leaders and executives, helping shape messaging, engagement strategies and communication approaches that advance business objectives.
• Develop and oversee communication strategies that align leadership messaging with organizational priorities, values and culture.
• Provide counsel on sensitive topics, organizational change initiatives, business transformations and employee engagement opportunities.
• Translate complex business strategies into clear, compelling narratives that resonate with diverse employee audiences.
• Anticipate communication risks and opportunities, providing proactive recommendations and solutions.

Strategic Communications Planning

• Partner with executives, business leaders and cross-functional teams to understand communication needs and organizational priorities.
• Design and execute integrated communication strategies and campaigns that support business goals and enhance employee understanding and engagement.
• Identify audience needs and tailor messaging, channels and content accordingly.
• Develop innovative approaches that improve employee reach, understanding and action while enhancing communication effectiveness.

Change Leadership & Employee Engagement

• Lead communication efforts that support organizational change, transformation initiatives and evolving business priorities.
• Create clear and engaging communication plans that help employees understand, navigate and embrace change.
• Partner with stakeholders to ensure employees remain informed, supported and connected during periods of transition.
• Develop communication strategies that strengthen culture, foster inclusion, and elevate the employee experience.

Communications Channels, Technology & Innovation

• Champion innovative communication practices, technologies and digital experiences across the organization.
• Manage and optimize communication channels, platforms and content ecosystems to maximize engagement and effectiveness.
• Leverage AI-powered tools, automation and emerging technologies to enhance content development, personalization, measurement and operational efficiency.
• Evaluate evolving trends in internal communications, employee experience and workplace technology, identifying opportunities to modernize communication practices.
• Ensure all communications maintain high standards of quality, consistency, accessibility and brand alignment.

Project & Event Communications

• Lead communication planning and execution for high-profile organizational initiatives, leadership events, town halls and enterprise-wide programs.
• Collaborate cross-functionally to deliver communication plans that drive awareness, engagement and business outcomes.
• Recommend and utilize the most effective communication channels, formats and experiences to reach intended audiences.

Measurement, Insights & Continuous Improvement

• Use data, analytics, employee feedback and business insights to evaluate communication effectiveness and inform decision-making.
• Develop measurable objectives and success metrics for communication initiatives.
• Analyze trends and employee sentiment to identify opportunities for improvement.
• Continuously evolve communication strategies and practices based on results, industry benchmarks and emerging best practices.

• Bachelor's degree in Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, Marketing, Human Resources, Business or a related field.
• 5+ years of experience in internal communications, executive communications, change management or a related strategic communication function.
• Proven experience serving as a trusted advisor to senior executives and business leaders, with the executive presence, confidence and strategic mindset to influence outcomes, challenge thinking respectfully and provide thoughtful communications counsel.
• Exceptional writing, editing, storytelling and presentation skills.
• Demonstrated ability to distill complex business information into clear, engaging and actionable communications.
• Strong consulting and relationship-building skills with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.
• Experience developing and executing communication strategies that support organizational change and business transformation.
• Strong project management capabilities and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
• Analytical mindset with experience leveraging data and feedback to measure effectiveness and improve outcomes.
• Curiosity and passion for emerging communication trends, technologies, and employee experience best practices.
• Demonstrated AI fluency and digital curiosity, with the ability to responsibly leverage generative AI and emerging technologies to enhance communication strategy, improve employee experiences, streamline workflows and drive more data-informed decision-making.
• Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications, SharePoint, Teams and digital communication platforms.
• Demonstrated ability to thrive in a collaborative, high-performing environment that values innovation, accountability, creativity and continuous learning.
• Candidates should be prepared to provide at least two business writing samples.

jobs.title: Mechanical Project Engineer
jobs.description:
Who we are:

Formic is on a mission to reshape American manufacturing by making automation accessible to every factory. As labor constraints rise, costs increase, and global competition intensifies, automation is no longer optional for manufacturers that want to stay competitive.

We deliver automation through a Robotics-as-a-Service model that combines industrial robotics, proprietary software, and full-service support into a single, integrated solution. By removing the traditional barriers of cost, complexity, and risk, we enable manufacturers to deploy automation quickly and realize measurable gains in throughput, safety, and operational efficiency without large upfront capital investment.

Backed by leading investors including Lux Capital, Initialized Capital, Blackhorn Ventures, and Mitsubishi HC Capital North America, Formic is scaling rapidly and building the foundation for a new era of high-performance, Made in America production.

About the team:

The Project Engineering team is a multidisciplinary engineering group within Automation Engineering Group, bringing mechanical, electrical, and controls engineering together under a single organization. The team serves as the engineering escalation path for the deployed fleet, taking on problems that exceed field-level troubleshooting and converting them into scoped, engineered, and standardized solutions.

The team's work spans three connected areas. The first is the troubleshooting of complex problems: diagnosing multi-discipline failures across deployed robotic systems and engineering permanent, root-cause fixes rather than repeat repairs. The second is continuous improvement: converting recurring issues and field data into reliability upgrades and fleet-wide standardization. The third is support for existing and new product development and enhancements, in partnership with teams across the organization, to improve equipment currently in the field and to bring new capability online.

Positioned at the intersection of design, commissioning, and field support, the team operates as a cross-functional unit, with engineers at the Bolingbrook hub working alongside field implementation resources across North America. The work is a deliberate blend of reactive support and proactive engineering, and each role on the team contributes to uptime, performance consistency, and long-term customer outcomes across the fleet.

About the role:

As a Mechanical Project Engineer, you will own the mechanical design, documentation, and commissioning of electromechanical systems and assemblies as they are developed, productized, and brought into Formic's automation portfolio. You will lead mechanical design efforts - from concept through SolidWorks modeling, drawing release, and BOM management - while also driving hands-on system integration and floor commissioning to ensure automation systems are proven and production-ready before they scale across Formic's fleet.

This is a hands-on, end-to-end role that blends mechanical design, EOAT development, and floor implementation with proactive product engineering. Working in close collaboration with Project Engineering and Software teams, you will design and release mechanical systems and end of arm tooling (EOAT), maintain organized model and drawing release structures, support the build and commissioning of automation systems on the floor, and develop the training and enablement material that equips Formic's fleet operations and deployment teams. Your work directly impacts mechanical design quality, deployment readiness, and the continued evolution and enhancement of Formic's automation portfolio.

In this role you will:

• Own mechanical design of automation systems and assemblies — including palletizing systems, case packing systems, conveyor systems, material handling systems, and end of arm tooling (EOAT) — from concept through release

• Design, prototype, assemble, and test automated end-of-line automation systems using SolidWorks 3D CAD

• Develop and maintain organized SolidWorks model structures, assembly hierarchies, and controlled model/drawing release processes, including revision control and release documentation

• Create and maintain detailed mechanical design documentation, including CAD models, drawings, exploded diagrams, BOMs, schematics, SOPs, and work instructions

• Design EOAT and implement designs on the floor for build, integration, and commissioning of automation systems

• Implement and integrate electrical, mechanical, and control subsystems, ensuring high performance, reliability, manufacturability, and repeatability

• Rapidly iterate and validate mechanical designs and concepts to ensure exceptional product development delivery timelines

• Lead and manage technical aspects of assigned automation projects within the product roadmap, ensuring milestones, technical specifications, and delivery timelines are met

• Configure, validate, and troubleshoot electromechanical automation systems & assemblies on the floor during build and commissioning

• Support design for manufacturability (DFM) and design for assembly (DFA) practices in collaboration with internal and external resources

• Provide equipment support for Formic's Product & Software teams and technical operations teams

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure cohesive product delivery and product sustainment

• Troubleshoot & optimize; support debugging of system issues across software and hardware domains and recommend improvements to mechanical design and implementation

• Participate in iterative development cycles by incorporating learnings from field deployments into mechanical design improvements

• Perform root cause analysis, troubleshooting, and resolution of hardware and mechanical system-level issues

• Develop and execute test plans to validate functionality, performance, and compliance with mechanical design requirements

• Engage with external vendors to identify and scope necessary equipment and components

• Interface with external system integrators and OEMs to ensure alignment on mechanical, electrical, and control design specifications

• Continuously collect, aggregate, and assess Deployment and Production Optimization feedback for necessary mechanical design and Continuous Improvement enhancements

• Prepare and deliver weekly internal reporting on progress for key initiatives

What makes you a great fit:

• 3+ years of experience in Mechanical Design, Mechanical Systems Engineering, Mechatronics, Robotics, or a related field

• 3+ years of experience designing mechanical systems, machine assemblies, or equipment for industrial automation and robotic applications

• Experience owning mechanical designs from concept through manufacturing release, including full 3D assemblies, detailed drawings, component selection, and BOMs

• Strong proficiency in 3D CAD, ideally SolidWorks, with experience designing complete machine or system assemblies, not just individual parts

• Strong drafting and GD&T skills, with the ability to produce fabrication- and assembly-ready drawings, exploded diagrams, and BOMs

• Familiarity with industrial robotic systems and their integration, including robotic arms such as FANUC, KUKA, ABB, Yaskawa, Universal Robots, or similar platforms

• Strong understanding of how mechanical systems interface with robotics, EOAT, conveyance, sensors, actuators, guarding, and other automation components

• Experience troubleshooting and diagnosing mechanical problems on automation systems or machinery

• Willingness and ability to work hands-on on the shop floor, including mechanical assembly, integration, testing, troubleshooting, modification, and repair

• Ability to organize and manage engineering deliverables through iterative development and tight feedback loops across concurrent projects

• Excellent problem-solving, critical-thinking, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills

• Located in, or willing to relocate to, the greater Chicago, IL area and work on-site

• Ability to travel up to 25%

Bonus points if you have:

• Advanced SolidWorks experience, including large assembly management, top-down design, and configuration-driven design

• Experience designing and implementing robotic end-of-arm tooling (EOAT)

• Experience with end-of-line robotic automation applications such as palletizing, case packing, packaging, conveyance, or material handling

• Experience organizing and maintaining PDM/PLM workflows, revision control, model release structures, and formal drawing-release processes

• Direct hands-on experience with sensors, actuators, motion control systems, motors, and VFDs

• Direct hands-on experience with PLCs

• Familiarity with industrial automation protocols such as EtherNet/IP and IO-Link

• Familiarity with machine safety devices such as safety scanners, light curtains, gate locks, and other guarding/interlock systems

• Knowledge of robotic safety standards such as ISO 10218 and ANSI/RIA

• Experience with AutoCAD or additional 2D/3D CAD platforms

Our Total Rewards:

At Formic, we believe people do their best work when they feel supported both professionally and personally. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits and perks package for full-time, U.S.-based team members, including:

• Equity in Formic: Participate in our stock option program and share in the success of a fast-growing start-up backed by leading global investors

• Competitive & Uncapped Commission Structure: Designed to reward performance and impact in commission-eligible roles

• Comprehensive Healthcare Coverage: Medical, dental, and vision insurance through Blue Cross Blue Shield and Unum, with 99% of employee premiums covered and 75% coverage for dependents, with optional buy-up plans available

• Additional Insurance Benefits: FSA and DCFSA, life insurance, short-term disability, and long-term disability through Unum, all 100% employer-paid

• Employee Assistance Program (EAP): Fully funded by Formic, offering support when you need it most

• Paid Parental Leave Program: Up to 12 weeks of paid parental leave

• Company-sponsored 401(k): Invest in your future with our company-facilitated retirement savings plan

• Home Office Stipend: A one-time allowance for fully remote and hybrid employees to support an at-home or on-the-road work setup

• Monthly Cell Phone Reimbursement: Monthly stipend toward personal phone and internet expenses

• Flexible Time Off: Take the time you need, when you need it, supported by our flexible PTO policy

Compensation Philosophy

Formic’s pay and equity packages are thoughtfully benchmarked against peer companies at a similar growth stage. Equity represents a meaningful part of our mutual investment: when Formic succeeds, so do you.

Final offers are customized based on experience, geographic location, market considerations, and a candidate’s preferred balance of cash and equity. Our goal is to attract and reward top talent who will have significant impact, and we are open to thoughtful discussions to align on the right structure.

Compensation Range:

$120,000—$150,000 USD

What we look for:

We’re building this company from the ground up, and every person we hire has an outsized impact on our culture, performance, and trajectory. While each team member brings unique strengths and perspectives, we look for people who align with our Operating Principles and embody them in action. If this sounds like you, Formic may be the right place for you!

• Fearless Optimism: You make bold bets and default optimistic. You believe in the mission, aren’t paralyzed by risk, and fear inaction more than failure. You see ambiguity as opportunity and bring energy to building what doesn’t yet exist.

• Create the Magic: You absorb complexity so customers don’t have to. Whether your customer is external or internal, you focus on delivering experiences that are clear, fast, value-added, and outcome-driven. You don’t say “not my job.” You make things work.

• Today, Not Tomorrow: You have a bias to action. You close the loop. You take extreme ownership. You understand that speed compounds, and you don’t confuse activity with results.

• Seek Truth: You think from first principles. You value data over ego and strong opinions loosely held. You’re willing to challenge assumptions, including your own, in pursuit of the best answer.

• Made of Rubber: You are resolute and adaptable. When things break or priorities shift, you rebound stronger. You treat setbacks as learning moments and move forward with grit.

• One Formic: You operate without silos. You practice radical helpfulness, document clearly, and make clean handoffs. You assume positive intent and prioritize team success over individual credit.

Equal Opportunity Employment:

Formic is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion or religious creed, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, marital status, family or parental status, disability, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. All employment decisions are based on a person’s merit, business needs, and role requirements. If you require further accommodations or have questions regarding accessibility of our roles, please reach out to careers@formic.co.

AI Use:

At Formic, fairness and transparency are at the heart of our hiring process. We use AI-powered tools in some interviews to help our teams evaluate candidate responses, but all final hiring decisions are made by humans. You can learn more about how AI is used in our recruitment process by reviewing our AI Hiring Disclosure linked here.

jobs.description:
This position is open exclusively to current Northeastern University Co-Op students.

Work Period: January 2027 to June 2027. This is a full - time, 40 hours per week position with 5 days in office.

About ProFound Therapeutics

ProFound Therapeutics Inc. is a privately held, early-stage biotechnology company with the vision to revolutionize the human therapeutic landscape. ProFound has recently made the news by being included in the Fierce Biotech’s list of the hottest Biotech companies. ProFound Therapeutics Inc. was founded by Flagship Pioneering, a team of entrepreneurial scientists that conceives, creates, resources, and grows first-in-category life sciences companies. Since 2000, Flagship has created over 75 groundbreaking companies that are pioneering novel and proprietary biological, industrial, and engineering approaches to solve major needs in human health and sustainability. These companies include Moderna Therapeutics (NASDAQ:MRNA), Seres Therapeutics (MCRB), Syros Pharmaceuticals (SYRS), Evelo Biosciences (EVLO), Kaleido Biosciences (KLDO), and Indigo Agriculture. ProFound Therapeutics, Inc. is a highly dynamic, entrepreneurial, and innovation-driven organization seeking to hire an exceptional scientist to join our team.

About Flagship Pioneering

ProFound Therapeutics was founded by Flagship Pioneering's venture creation engine that invents and builds platform companies, each with the potential for multiple products that transform human health or sustainability. Since its launch in 2000, Flagship has originated and fostered more than 100 scientific ventures, resulting in more than $90 billion in aggregate value. Many of the company’s Flagship has founded have addressed humanity’s most urgent challenges: vaccinating billions of people against COVID-19, curing intractable diseases, improving human health, preempting illness, and feeding the world by improving the resiliency and sustainability of agriculture. Flagship has been recognized twice on FORTUNE’s “Change the World” list, an annual ranking of companies that have made a positive social and environmental impact through activities that are part of their core business strategies and has been twice named to Fast Company’s annual list of the World’s Most Innovative Companies. Learn more about Flagship at www.flagshippioneering.com.

Flagship Pioneering Co-Op Program

Welcome to Flagship Pioneering Co-Op Program for the cohort dreaming big and taking courageous leaps. You'll join fellow peers across our ecosystem of companies and learning firsthand how we build first-in-category companies. You’ll have access to enrichment sessions, a dedicated professional development track, and a mentor that help guide you toward your next step. By the end, you will carry on a meaningful project outcome, a genuine network, and a front-row view of how Flagship pioneer new ventures that change the world.

The Role

ProFound Therapeutics is seeking an innovative and highly motivated Co-Op/Intern with experience in cell biology and/or oncology to play a vital role in the company’s Oncology team. This individual will contribute scientific and technical expertise to a multidisciplinary team, emphasizing conceptualization, experimentation, data analysis, presentation, and strategic planning. The ideal candidate for this position will have a background in cellular biology and be enthusiastic and capable of working in a multidisciplinary (e.g. genomics, bioinformatics, protein biochemistry) team in the biosciences. The candidate should be able to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced entrepreneurial setting.

• The successful candidate will work both independently and as part of a collaborative team to design, plan and execute experiments that support research activities, project goals and platform development

• Server as a contributor to the Oncology team, whose mission is to discover new therapeutics and validate new therapeutic targets

• Report experimental plans and results to the scientific team

• Proactively review literature to contribute to new ideas, methods/technologies for discovery and therapeutic areas

Minimum Qualifications:

• Pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in oncology and/or cell biology or related field, such as biochemistry, microbiology, molecular biology, or protein sciences.

• Hands-on laboratory experience in cellular and molecular biology techniques and attention to detail

• Excellent communication and presentation skills, capable of conveying technical information in a clear and thorough manner

• Strong collaborative skills with evidence of working in a team

Preferred Qualifications:

• Prior industry or academic research co-op experience in Cell Biology

• Experience with cell based assay development

• Basic knowledge on Flow cytometry and/or immunoblots

• Confident execution, focused and team-oriented with an ability to thrive in an entrepreneurial environment

• Experience with data analysis using Graphpad Prism and Microsoft Excel.

What We Offer

• This can be the start of a longer story. Strong co-ops are considered for future opportunities across Flagship and its portfolio companies, not just for this one role.

• Work alongside people who left the safe path. Your colleagues are scientists, engineers, and operators who chose to build something new rather than join something already established.

• Take on real ownership. You're contributing to ventures that are still being defined. Your work can shape real decisions, not just support them.

• Be paid like the contributor you are. Compensation reflects the real work you take on.

JOB POSITION:  Industrial Technician

Are you interested in becoming an experienced Overhead Crane Service Technician? Join Konecranes, one of the world’s largest material handling companies. We're seeking skilled individuals with electrical and mechanical expertise, comfortable working at extreme heights. Our service technicians, the heart of our industry, thrive in a safety-first environment. You'll troubleshoot 480 3-phase motors, address crane issues, and collaborate with clients and facility directors to meet service needs across the United States.

Principal Responsibilities:

• Conduct inspections, maintenance, and repairs on electric overhead traveling cranes and hoists at customer locations.
• Provide on-call service as part of a rotation, including after-hours support.
• Troubleshoot electrical, mechanical, structural, and electronic issues on-site.
• Perform post-repair audits to ensure safety features are functional.
• Document findings and recommend corrective actions, including safety notifications to customers.
• Consult with customers on repair and safety issues, offering recommendations for material handling improvement.
• Produce electronic documentation using company tools, obtaining customer signatures.
• Stay updated on industry codes and regulations (OSHA, ANSI, CMAA, HMI).
• Complete service reports and other required documents accurately and promptly.
• Communicate with the Field Operations Manager and Service Coordinator following established practices
• Maintain company-issued equipment, vehicles, and assets in proper working order.
• Operate tools, equipment, and vehicles, reporting deficiencies to the supervisor.
• Follow established safety rules and procedures, including customer guidelines.
• Participate in monthly safety meetings.
• Perform other responsibilities as assigned by the supervisor.

Education: High School Diploma required. Associate degree in Industrial Electrical and/or Mechanical Technology or related field preferred or equivalent vocational/technical training and experience.

Experience: Minimum one (1) year experience involving electrical troubleshooting and mechanical repair. Some electronic experience but not necessary. Prior experience with cranes is a benefit, but not required.

Other Requirements: Must have and maintain a good driving record, including a valid driver's license. Must be willing to work off the ground. Can work varied overtime, as needed by customer, be available for "on call" as part of the service office rotation and be able to travel and work out of town, on occasion.

Must be able to frequently lift to 25 lbs. Must be able to lift up to 50 lbs. on a daily basis. Must be able to lift to 75 lbs. although not on a daily basis. Must be able to lift 100 lbs. on a rare basis. This position requires frequent climbing, balancing, stooping/crouching, and overhead reaching. This position requires occasional pushing, pulling, kneeling, and crawling. This position will be inside approximately 90% of the time and outside approximately 10% of the time. This position will be frequently exposed to heat, cold, noise and heights.

• This is a safety sensitive position.
• *KCN

What we offer:

Salary: $22 - $48 an hour - Pay is determined based on skills, geographic location, internal equity, market/data analysis, number of years of prior relevant experience, degrees and/or certifications, technical assessment score, etc.

Company Vehicle: Our Service Technicians get a work truck and a gas card to be used for business purposes. Candidates must pass a Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) check.

Benefits: Medical Plan, Dental, Vision, 401k plan with a match from day one, identity theft protection, accident insurance, travel insurance and so much more!

Vacation: 2 weeks of vacation per year (pro-rated for the first year depending on start date). 5-12 years of service, 3 weeks. 13+ years of service, 4 weeks.

You work accounts where someone is already using the product. One person trying Fyxer is often a door into a 500-person company. Spot those fast, get to the people who sign, prove out the pattern so it repeats.

Three years in or twelve. We care what you've done, not where you did it.

Time with customers is the only thing that compounds. Everything else is overhead. We automate the research, the notes, the CRM and the follow-up with our own product. 

We move fast and decide in the meeting. You own your outcomes. We challenge each other directly. It's intense and it isn't for everyone.

This culture is intense; it requires focus and discipline. So we’ll do everything we can to remove distraction, support your wellbeing, and reward your impact

Our service technicians, the heart of our industry, thrive in a safety-first environment. You'll troubleshoot 480 3-phase motors, address crane issues, and collaborate with clients and facility directors to meet service needs across the United States.

Principal Responsibilities:

• Conduct inspections, maintenance, and repairs on electric overhead traveling cranes and hoists at customer locations.
• Provide on-call service as part of a rotation, including after-hours support.
• Troubleshoot electrical, mechanical, structural, and electronic issues on-site.
• Perform post-repair audits to ensure safety features are functional.
• Document findings and recommend corrective actions, including safety notifications to customers.
• Consult with customers on repair and safety issues, offering recommendations for material handling improvement.
• Produce electronic documentation using company tools, obtaining customer signatures.
• Stay updated on industry codes and regulations (OSHA, ANSI, CMAA, HMI).
• Complete service reports and other required documents accurately and promptly.
• Communicate with the Field Operations Manager and Service Coordinator following established practices
• Maintain company-issued equipment, vehicles, and assets in proper working order.
• Operate tools, equipment, and vehicles, reporting deficiencies to the supervisor.
• Follow established safety rules and procedures, including customer guidelines.
• Participate in monthly safety meetings.
• Perform other responsibilities as assigned by the supervisor.

Education: High School Diploma required. Associate degree in Industrial Electrical and/or Mechanical Technology or related field preferred or equivalent vocational/technical training and experience.

Experience: Minimum one (1) year experience involving electrical troubleshooting and mechanical repair. Some electronic experience but not necessary. Prior experience with cranes is a benefit, but not required.

Other Requirements: Must have and maintain a good driving record, including a valid driver's license. Must be willing to work off the ground. Can work varied overtime, as needed by customer, be available for "on call" as part of the service office rotation and be able to travel and work out of town, on occasion.

Must be able to frequently lift to 25 lbs. Must be able to lift up to 50 lbs. on a daily basis. Must be able to lift to 75 lbs. although not on a daily basis. Must be able to lift 100 lbs. on a rare basis. This position requires frequent climbing, balancing, stooping/crouching, and overhead reaching. This position requires occasional pushing, pulling, kneeling, and crawling. This position will be inside approximately 90% of the time and outside approximately 10% of the time. This position will be frequently exposed to heat, cold, noise and heights.

• *KCN

What we offer:

Salary: $22 - $48 an hour - Pay is determined based on skills, geographic location, internal equity, market/data analysis, number of years of prior relevant experience, degrees and/or certifications, technical assessment score, etc.

Company Vehicle: Our Service Technicians get a work truck and a gas card to be used for business purposes. Candidates must pass a Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) check.

Benefits: Medical Plan, Dental, Vision, 401k plan with a match from day one, identity theft protection, accident insurance, travel insurance and so much more!

Vacation: 2 weeks of vacation per year (pro-rated for the first year depending on start date). 5-12 years of service, 3 weeks. 13+ years of service, 4 weeks.

Sick Leave: 5 days of Sick Leave per year. Pro-rated the first year after 90 days of service

Holidays: 10 paid holidays per year

jobs.title: Senior Manager, DashPass Strategy & Operations, Benefits and Merchant GTM
jobs.location: Los Angeles, CA; San Francisco, CA; Seattle, WA; New York, NY
jobs.description:
About the Team

At DoorDash, we're redefining the future of on-demand delivery. At the center of this is our marketplace, connecting 30+ million customers on DoorDash with their favorite restaurants and brands! The Marketplace team focuses on growing our consumer business, including DashPass, our global subscription program. Our vision is to create the world’s leading membership program in local commerce, delivering unprecedented value and a world class experience to members.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Manager, DashPass Strategy & Operations to build and own the merchant co-funding strategy behind DashPass. DashPass benefits are what make membership the most valuable proposition in local commerce — this role is about making them sustainable and scalable by unlocking merchant investment in them.

You'll sit at the intersection of our consumer subscription business and our merchant and monetization teams. You'll define what merchants get from DashPass, quantify it credibly, and turn that into co-funded offers that scale across the full spectrum of merchant cohorts — from our largest Enterprise brands down to hundreds of thousands of SMBs, each with fundamentally different economics, decision-making, and tooling needs. You'll also be the voice ensuring the benefits we put in front of members are evaluated on merchant outcomes, not just consumer ones. Success in this role depends on building conviction with data and driving outcomes across product, engineering, data science, marketing, finance, and commercial teams without direct authority.

• Own the DashPass co-funding strategy end to end — define which benefits merchants should fund, at what level, and why; build the business case that makes it compelling for merchants and accretive for DashPass

• Build and defend the merchant value proposition for DashPass — quantify incremental volume, new customer acquisition, and order frequency attributable to DashPass, and turn that into a repeatable, credible pitch our commercial teams can carry

• Influence the promotions and monetization product roadmap — represent DashPass co-funding requirements for offer types, targeting, eligibility, and measurement, and bring a stack-ranked, evidence-backed set of asks

• Be the DashPass DRI in merchant commercial conversations — size the impact of DashPass components in long-term agreements and partnerships, set the guardrails, and protect long-term member and merchant economics

• Hold the member benefit roadmap accountable to merchant outcomes — establish the framework, metrics, and review cadence that ensure new benefits drive positive results for merchants alongside members, and bring a defensible point of view when the two are in tension

• Model complex tradeoffs and bring a strong POV to senior leadership — frame ambiguous, cross-functional decisions with data and carry them to executives

• Experiment and scale — turn strategy into operational experiments with measurable outcomes, then build the processes and tools to scale what works

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

• Own. Be the DRI for how DoorDash funds the most valuable membership program in local commerce, with end-to-end ownership of a strategy that’s still being written

• Build. Create the merchant value proposition for DashPass from first principles — the analysis, the narrative, and the offerings our commercial teams take to market

• Drive “visible from space” impact. Unlocking merchant funding at scale creates a new, durable source of investment in member benefits — materially changing the economics of DashPass and the business

• Model. Frame ambiguous, cross-functional tradeoffs with data and carry a strong, defensible point of view to senior leadership

• Shape. Influence the promotions and monetization product roadmap by translating merchant and member needs into clear, prioritized requirements

• Influence. Drive alignment and outcomes across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Marketing, Finance, and our commercial teams without direct authority

• Experiment. Transform strategy into operational experiments that create measurable, actionable outcomes — then scale what works

We’re excited about you because…

• You have 8+ years of experience in strategy & operations, commercial strategy, management consulting, investment banking, business development, product operations, or a closely related field, with a track record of owning ambiguous, high-stakes problems end-to-end

• You’ve built the business case for a two-sided value exchange — where a decision has to work for two different sets of stakeholders with competing economics — and can hold a credible point of view on both sides

• You’re comfortable in or adjacent to commercial conversations (MSAs, up-front agreements, pricing, partnerships) and can hold your ground against counterparts with competing incentives

• You have strong quantitative and structured problem-solving skills, can self-serve data (intermediate+ SQL/Excel), and can defend your conclusions to skeptical executives

• You have a bias to action. You move quickly and thrive in a fast-paced environment. No job is beneath you and you lead from the front

• You possess a “breakthrough walls” mentality. You are constantly pushing the envelope of what is possible and can figure out a way to make almost anything happen

• You have clarity of thought — you can articulate a clear vision to cross-functional partners and are unafraid of ambiguity

• You communicate complex ideas clearly across technical, commercial, and executive audiences

• Subscription, marketplace, advertising, retail-media, or merchant/SMB experience is preferred

• A bachelor’s degree

jobs.title: Director, Events & Experiential Marketing
jobs.description:
Sr. Mgr/Director, Events & Experiential Marketing

About Pixability

Pixability is the leading AI-driven technology company empowering the world’s largest brands and their agencies to maximize the value of their advertising, organic and creator strategies on YouTube. Leveraging its proprietary technology platform and data, Pixability makes every video impression more meaningful by identifying contextually relevant, brand suitable channels and maximizing cost efficient outcomes.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a highly strategic, creative, and execution-focused events leader to build and scale Pixability's global events program.

This role sits at the intersection of marketing and sales. You'll be responsible for creating memorable experiences that deepen relationships with existing clients, introduce Pixability to prospective customers, and generate meaningful pipeline opportunities.

This role will own our event strategy—from intimate executive dinners and thought leadership lunches to unique entertainment experiences, customer networking events, and major industry sponsorships. You'll work closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Partnerships, and Executive Leadership to ensure every event delivers measurable business impact.

This role oversees event strategy and execution across both the United States and the Europe but the role will be based in the U.S.

What You'll Do

Own Pixability's Custom Event Strategy

• Develop and execute a year-round calendar of high-impact client and prospect events.

• Create experiences that reflect the Pixability brand and strengthen relationships with senior marketers at agencies and brands.

• Produce a variety of event formats including:

• Executive dinners

• Thought leadership lunches and breakfasts

• Roundtable discussions

• Sporting events

• Concerts and entertainment experiences

• VIP hospitality

• Customer appreciation events

• Exclusive networking experiences

• Partner with Sales to identify target attendees and maximize customer and prospect engagement.

• Build repeatable event playbooks while continually introducing fresh ideas and experiences.

Lead Industry Event Strategy

• Own Pixability's annual industry event calendar worldwide.

• Evaluate sponsorship opportunities and recommend where Pixability should—and shouldn't—invest.

• Develop business cases for event investments based on strategic value, audience quality, pipeline potential, and ROI.

• Negotiate sponsorship packages and vendor agreements.

• Ensure every sponsorship has a clear plan for driving meetings, executive engagement, and measurable business outcomes.

Maximize Sales Impact

• Partner closely with Sales leadership to ensure events support pipeline generation and account growth.

• Build pre-event outreach strategies that drive qualified meetings.

• Coordinate attendee lists, executive schedules, and customer invitations.

• Develop post-event follow-up plans that convert engagement into opportunities.

• Track and report on key metrics including attendance, meetings generated, influenced pipeline, and ROI.

Deliver Exceptional Experiences

• Own all aspects of event planning and execution including:

• Venue sourcing

• Vendor management

• Budget management

• Production

• Catering

• Entertainment

• Guest experience

• Registration

• Logistics

• On-site execution

• Work with Marketing to develop event branding, messaging, invitations, and promotional materials.

• Ensure every event reflects Pixability's high standards and premium brand.

Measure Success

• Define KPIs for both custom events and sponsored events.

• Track event performance and continually optimize the program.

• Present regular reporting and recommendations to executive leadership.

• Manage event budgets responsibly while maximizing return on investment.

What We're Looking For

• 7+ years of experience in B2B events, experiential marketing, field marketing, or event strategy, preferably for the advertising industry

• Experience producing executive-level customer events for enterprise audiences.

• Strong understanding of how events contribute to pipeline generation and revenue growth.

• Experience managing sponsorships at major industry conferences and events.

• Exceptional project management and organizational skills.

• Excellent negotiation and vendor management experience.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Ability to work effectively with senior executives, sales leaders, and external partners.

• Comfortable managing multiple complex projects simultaneously.

• Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as needed.

Success in This Role

After your first year, you will have:

• Built a best-in-class events program that is recognized internally and externally.

• Created memorable experiences that strengthen Pixability's relationships with agencies and brands.

• Established a thoughtful, ROI-driven sponsorship strategy for major industry events.

• Become a trusted partner to the Sales organization by consistently helping generate executive meetings and qualified pipeline.

• Developed clear measurement frameworks demonstrating the business impact of Pixability's event investments.

This is an ideal opportunity for someone who loves creating exceptional experiences but is equally passionate about driving measurable business results. We're looking for someone who thinks like a marketer, plans like a producer, and partners like a salesperson.

jobs.title: Senior DevSecOps Engineer
jobs.description:
Join us at Sparksoft, where we're not just another tech company—we're a catalyst for change. Our mission isn't just to offer IT solutions; it's to revolutionize the way you work. Here, passion isn't just a buzzword; it's the fuel behind groundbreaking ideas and transformative technologies. We serve a wide range of government clients, delivering impact that's felt across the nation.

Our true strength lies in our people. They're the problem-solvers and innovators consistently delivering extraordinary outcomes. With Sparksoft, you're not stepping into a routine job; you're joining a team committed to innovation and excellence. Our innovation extends beyond just delivering projects. Through our specialized Innovation Centers, we continuously refine our methods, ensuring we remain industry leaders.

We are Sparksoft!

ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES:

The Senior DevSecOps Engineer designs, implements, automates, secures, and maintains the cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and operational environments supporting the program. This role enables reliable, secure, and scalable acquisition, processing, validation, quality assessment, and delivery of provider data while ensuring compliance with CMS security, privacy, and operational requirements. The Senior DevSecOps Engineer works closely with solution architect, data engineers, data scientists, quality teams, and security personnel to integrate security, automation, monitoring, and compliance throughout the delivery lifecycle.

• Cloud Infrastructure and Environment Management Design, deploy, configure, and maintain AWS cloud infrastructure supporting operations. Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions to automate provisioning and configuration management. Manage development, test, staging, and production environments. Optimize system performance, scalability, reliability, and availability Support disaster recovery, backup, and business continuity objectives. Monitor infrastructure utilization and recommend capacity improvements.

• DevSecOps and CI/CD Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines supporting application, data, analytics, and infrastructure deployments. Automate build, test, security scanning, release, and deployment processes. Integrate automated quality gates and compliance checks into deployment pipelines. Support release management activities and deployment coordination across Agile teams. Implement version control and configuration management practices using CMS-approved repositories.

• Security and Compliance Implement security controls in accordance with CMS, FISMA, NIST, and organizational security requirements. Perform vulnerability scanning, configuration reviews, dependency management, and remediation activities. Support Authority to Operate (ATO), security assessments, POA&M remediation, and audit activities. Ensure protection of sensitive data and compliance with privacy requirements. Integrate security monitoring, logging, alerting, and incident response capabilities into operational environments.

• Data Platform and Operations Support Support secure ingestion, transformation, validation, storage, and delivery of complex datasets. Develop and maintain automated operational workflows supporting data acquisition and quality processes. Implement monitoring and alerting for data pipelines, batch jobs, APIs, and system services. Troubleshoot infrastructure, application, integration, and operational issues. Collaborate with teams to ensure reliable and secure data operations.

• Monitoring and Observability Develop dashboards, operational metrics, alerts, and performance reports. Analyze system health, availability, throughput, and operational trends. Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks and operational risks. Support continuous monitoring requirements and operational reporting.

• Agile and Continuous Improvement Participate in PI Planning, Sprint Planning, retrospectives, and demonstrations. Support DevSecOps best practices and continuous process improvement initiatives. Develop automation solutions that improve operational efficiency and reduce manual effort. Contribute to technical documentation, knowledge sharing, and operational runbooks.

REQUIRED EXPEREINCE:

• Minimum 7 years of experience supporting cloud infrastructure, system administration, DevOps, or DevSecOps environments.

• Minimum 3 years of experience implementing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.

• Experience supporting AWS cloud environments.

• Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or equivalent.

• Experience implementing automated deployment, testing, and monitoring capabilities.

• Experience supporting secure systems in a Federal or highly regulated environment.

• Experience with source code management and version control platforms.

• Experience troubleshooting complex infrastructure and application issues.

• Experience working within Agile development environments.

• Must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance.

• Must have lived in the United States 3 out of the past 5 years.

PREFERRED EXPEREINCE:

• Experience supporting CMS, HHS, or other Federal healthcare programs.

• Experience supporting healthcare, provider, licensing, enrollment, or interoperability data systems.

• Experience supporting FedRAMP, FISMA, NIST 800-53, and ATO compliance activities.

• Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.

• Experience supporting AWS services including Lambda, ECS/EKS, S3, RDS, Glue, Athena, CloudWatch, IAM, and Step Functions.

• Experience implementing DevSecOps practices within SAFe Agile environments.

• Experience supporting data engineering, analytics, machine learning, or AI-enabled solutions.

• Experience working with Python-based data processing frameworks and automation tools.

• Experience integrating automated security testing and compliance validation into CI/CD pipelines.

• Experience supporting large-scale data acquisition, transformation, and quality assessment operations.

EDUCATION & CERTIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or related technical discipline.

• AWS Certification

• Agile Certification, SAFe preferred

WHAT WE OFFER:

At Sparksoft, we know that people do their best work when they feel supported, inspired, and connected. That’s why we’ve built a workplace that balances comprehensive benefits with a culture of collaboration and innovation. From flexible time off to professional growth opportunities, we’re committed to helping you thrive both inside and outside of work. When you join Sparksoft, you’ll enjoy:

•    Competitive compensation and a 401(k) with employer contributions to help you plan for the future
•    Flexible paid time off and hybrid ways of working that support true work-life balance
•    Comprehensive health coverage—including medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance
•    A curated in-office experience designed to foster community, team connections, and innovation
•    Opportunities to give back through Sparksoft Cares, including annual company-wide fundraising events
•    Training and development programs that build new skills and prepare you for leadership roles
•    A collaborative, transparent, and fun culture—recognized as a Great Place to Work®

Accessibility and Accommodations: Sparksoft Corporation is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals. If you require accommodations during the application or interview process, please contact us at Sparksoft.Accommodations@sparksoftcorp.com or call 410-424-7700. Requests are reviewed and fulfilled on a case-by-case basis.

If you receive any suspicious communication claiming to be from Sparksoft, please report it immediately to our security team at abuse@sparksoftcorp.com.

Artificial Intelligence (AI) Policy: While Sparksoft values the appropriate use of artificial intelligence in the workplace, candidates must complete interviews and independent assessments using their own knowledge and abilities. Unless expressly permitted by Sparksoft, the use of AI during interviews and assessments is strictly prohibited. Violations may result in disqualification. jobs.title: Mixer Operator - 2nd Shift
jobs.description:
Mixer I is the entry-level mixer position. Employees in this role are responsible for learning mixing processes, equipment operation, product specifications, safety requirements, and documentation procedures while progressing through established qualification requirements.

Qualified mixer candidates must be able to perform a variety of jobs, tasks, or duties as required; and must be able to work their bid shift, overtime, and weekends as required.

The tasks required, but not limited to, are general housekeeping, rework, preparing packaging, package product, food manufacturing, and other duties as assigned by supervision. Following mix instructions and provide clear concise documentation of production work.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

• Recipe construction/adjustment and understanding
• Knowledge of process flow and tracing flow and lines throughout the process.
• Understanding basic mix variations including salt content, moisture and color.
• Operate and tend machines to mix or blend any of a wide variety of food products such as edible oils, dressings, margarines, spreads, shortenings, cooking Sherries, vinegars, cooking wines, etc.
• Monitor and regulate gauges, recording instruments, flow meters, and thermometers to correctly adjust the addition of raw materials, mixing temperatures, mixing speeds, etc. to maintain product quality, and ensure safe and efficient operation.
• Operation of CIP skids in addition to breakdown and cleaning of line components.
• Knowledge of chemical handling procedures including PPE required.
• Perform a variety of jobs, tasks, or duties as required; and must be able to work their bid shift, overtime, and weekends as required.
• Fill out appropriate documentation regarding product movements, batch sheets, and ingredients addition
• Basic understanding of pumps, valves, and how to change filters.
• Successfully pass qualification test and must have the ability to lift 50 pounds, climb stairs, lift, bend, kneel, stand for long periods of time, work in confined spaces, and work with heights.
• Successfully complete training and qualification requirements for assigned mixer systems.
• Demonstrate the ability to safely operate assigned equipment under the guidance of qualified personnel.
• Learn and apply product specifications, process controls, quality standards, and food safety requirements.
• Develop proficiency in equipment setup, operation, cleaning, and documentation procedures.

Education: Minimum of a high school diploma or equivalent required.

Related Experience: Mixing machine operation, blending, food industry, or manufacturing experience preferred but not required.

Qualification Requirement: Must successfully complete designated training and qualification requirements for assigned mixer systems.

Equipment/Software Skills: Basic computer knowledge - data entry

Competencies

• Demonstrates willingness and ability to learn mixing operations and production processes.
• Successfully progresses through qualification requirements.
• Learns and follows safety, quality, and food safety procedures.
• Demonstrates reliability, attention to detail, and a commitment to continuous learning.
• Accepts coaching and feedback to develop operational proficiency.

Physical: Must be able to walk throughout the plant, to include walking and climbing up/downstairs and ladders (portable, fixed).  Must have be ability to lift up to 50 pounds occasionally is required.

Sensory: Must have the appropriate level of sensory acuity (visual, hearing, speaking, smell and touch) to be able to identify and react to normal, abnormal and alarm conditions (chemicals, temperature, etc.)

Mental/Reasoning: Must be able to logically and methodically work through and break down complex problems and processes to enable effective communication with all levels of the organization.

Benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision

jobs.title: Program Supervisor (BCBA)
jobs.description:
Board Certified Behavior Analyst

Cortica is growing and seeking a passionate BCBA to join our team in a brand-new location in Tempe! This is an exciting opportunity to be the first BCBA and a part of a founding team.

We are a unified team of doctors and therapists, specializing in neurodevelopmental disorders.

We emphasize collaboration and long-term outcomes, grounded in an assent-based, individualized approach and supported by a team of physicians, speech, occupational, and mental health therapists. Learn about our Whole-Child Model!

We're committed to investing in our clinicians from day one, including a first-year retention bonus of up to $7,5000, a competitive salary, and meaningful growth opportunities.

Position Overview

This work is meaningful and complex. Our roles are thoughtfully designed to support sustainable, ethical practice.

Based primarily out of our Warren clinic, with approximately 70-80% of your caseload delivered in-clinic and 20-30% in-home/via telehealth to surrounding communities (roughly a 30–45 minute commute).

Schedule: primarily daytime hours, with 1–2 evenings per week extending to 6:30–7:00 PM; other days typically wrap up around 5:00 PM. Our goal is to keep a balanced caseload for all our new BCBAs, so we balance daytime and evening clients accordingly — this is what you can expect from your schedule.

Clinical & Administrative Support

• Hybrid flexibility for supervision (when appropriate) & administrative tasks

• Clinical Supervisors for case consultation and guidance

• Transdisciplinary partners for collaboration across specialties

• Manageable, individualized caseloads

• Care Coordinators for scheduling and day-to-day logistics

• BT Managers for performance and operational support

• BT Trainers who lead 3-week orientation and support BCAT testing

Learning & Advancement

jobs.description:
Senior Software Engineer (Frontend focused) 
The company and our mission: 
Zartis is a global AI transformation and technology consulting partner where talented engineers and technologists work on cutting edge innovation. We partner with ambitious organizations to design, build, and scale technology solutions that deliver real impact.
Our teams bring deep expertise in AI driven platforms, secure API architectures, and cloud native engineering. You will work on meaningful projects that accelerate the adoption of advanced technologies, from strategy and discovery through to full product delivery, helping turn complex challenges into measurable outcomes.
With engineering hubs across EMEA and LATAM, and long term partnerships in financial services, healthcare and life sciences, and energy and climate, we offer opportunities to work on projects that truly matter. Here, you will not just build technology, you will drive business impact and grow your career alongside industry leaders.
We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer (Frontend focused)  to work on a project in the fashion industry.
The project:

Our teammates are talented people that come from a variety of backgrounds. We’re committed to building an inclusive culture based on trust and innovation.
You will be part of a distributed team developing new technologies to solve real business problems. Our client is a leading premium fashion and lifestyle omnichannel retailer, with a long heritage and a strong digital commerce presence alongside its physical stores. The organisation is actively accelerating its digital capabilities to enhance customer experience and retail operations at scale, making technology a core driver of business growth
We are looking for someone with good communication skills, ideally with experience making decisions, being proactive, used to building software from scratch, and with good attention to detail. 
What you will do:
Own, develop, and maintain customer-facing and back-office frontend applications using Vue.js, TypeScript, modern Web Components, and HTML/CSS.
Design, develop, and optimize mobile application features using Flutter.
Contribute to frontend architecture and technical decision-making, collaborating with the team to propose, evaluate, and implement solutions.
Support full-stack development when needed, including API integrations and smaller backend tasks.
Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code, and actively participate in code reviews.
Collaborate closely with the wider team in an Agile/Scrum environment, using tools such as Jira.
What you will bring:
5+ years of professional software development experience, with a strong focus on frontend development.
A proactive, ownership-driven mindset, with the ability to take initiative, drive conversations forward, take responsibility for topics, and bring new ideas or improvements without needing to be prompted.
Excellent English communication skills (CEFR C1 or above), with the ability to communicate clearly in both technical and interpersonal contexts.
Strong expertise in modern frontend frameworks such as Vue.js, React, or Angular, with a willingness to work primarily with Vue.js.
Hands-on experience with mobile application development using Flutter or a similar cross-platform framework, such as React Native.
Nice to have:
Experience with micro-frontend architectures
Experience with backend technologies (Java / SpringBoot, SQL / noSQL, API design)
Experience with CI/CD, AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform
Experience in the e-commerce sector
What we offer: 

100% Remote Work
WFH allowance: Monthly payment as financial support for remote working.
Career Growth: We have established a career development program accessible for all employees with a 360º feedback that will help us to guide you in your career progression.
Training: For Tech training at Zartis, you have time allocated during the week at your disposal. You can request from a variety of options, such as online courses (from Pluralsight and Educative.io, for example), English classes, books, conferences, and events.
Mentoring Program: You can become a mentor in Zartis or you can receive mentorship, or both.
Zartis Wellbeing Hub (Kara Connect): A platform that provides sessions with a range of specialists, including mental health professionals, nutritionists, physiotherapists, fitness coaches, and webinars with such professionals as well.
Multicultural working environment: We organize tech events, webinars, parties, and activities to do online team-building games and contests.
