jobs.title: Director of Accounting, Grants & Contracts
jobs.description:
What We Do

At Leading Educators (LE), we know that excellent teaching is the most important driver of student success. The moment a student steps foot in the classroom, their opportunity to learn depends on how prepared their teacher is to translate complex content knowledge, standards, and their knowledge of that student into lessons that help them learn deeply and apply their thinking to the real world.

That’s a big lift, and it often happens alone. As a national nonprofit, we partner with school systems to overcome persistent instructional challenges, foster intentional collaboration and adult learning by design, and ignite new possibilities through systemic solutions at the intersection of teaching, talent, and technology.

We work shoulder-to-shoulder with educators at every level of the education system to strengthen their instructional and leadership practices, bring a vision for excellent instruction to life with consistency, and ensure every student reaches their full potential.

Through direct support, strategic advising, innovation pilots, and best-in-class research, we help educators work toward a future where every student is ready to thrive. Learn more about our work at leadingeducators.org.

Internal Candidate Application Deadline: 9/18/26

External Candidate Application Deadline: 9/25/26

Position

Leading Educators is seeking a Director of Accounting, Grants & Contracts to own the full lifecycle of our philanthropic, foundation, and government funding. As grant and contract revenue continues to grow as a share of our total funding, this role manages how we budget, track, report on, and maintain compliance with restricted funds—from proposal development through award closeout.

You'll be the primary point of contact between Development and Finance, translating complex grant agreements and funder requirements into clear, workable budgets and financial systems. You'll ensure Leading Educators stays compliant with grant and contract requirements, including federal requirements under 2 CFR 200 (Uniform Guidance). Your work directly enables us to pursue and manage an increasingly complex portfolio of philanthropic and contract funding.

Currently, Leading Educators manages grants tracking in spreadsheets. You'll lead the effort to identify, select, and implement a grants management system that replaces manual processes with scalable, automated workflows—streamlining how we forecast, track, and close out grants across the organization.

Do you have expertise in…

• Managing the full post-award lifecycle for federal, state, and private foundation grants and contracts, including setup, cost-reimbursement processing, drawdowns, invoicing, and financial reporting?

• Interpreting grant agreements, fiscal tracking, and funder reporting requirements, with demonstrated knowledge of 2 CFR 200 (Uniform Guidance) and indirect cost rate negotiations?

• Leading the selection or implementation of financial management systems, or standardizing financial processes from manual, spreadsheet-based workflows into scalable, automated systems?

• Building strong partnerships with Development and fundraising teams, including hands-on experience developing proposal budgets and translating funder requirements into clear organizational guidance?

Do you enjoy…

• Working independently on complex, ambiguous financial challenges while managing competing priorities and multiple stakeholder relationships?

• Translating technical compliance requirements into clear, accessible guidance that empowers non-finance colleagues to make sound decisions?

• Designing processes and systems that reduce friction, eliminate manual work, and create clarity across an organization?

• Taking ownership of a function and building it from the ground up—turning spreadsheets into systems, confusion into confidence?

If you've answered affirmatively to these questions and meet the following prerequisites, we urge you to seize this opportunity. This role calls for the following:

• Bachelor's or master's degree in Accounting or Finance (CPA preferred)

• Minimum 8 years of nonprofit accounting and finance experience, including substantial experience managing multi-year, multi-funder, and federal/state grants and contracts

• Demonstrated ability to independently build relationships with Development or fundraising teams and lead proposal budget development

• Deep expertise in interpreting grant agreements, fiscal tracking, and funder reporting, including federal compliance under 2 CFR 200 (Uniform Guidance)

• Proven track record leading the selection or implementation of a grants management system, or standardizing financial processes from manual to automated workflows

• Strong technical skills with financial systems and data tools (e.g., SageIntacct, Salesforce, Rippling)

• Strong understanding of GAAP, nonprofit revenue recognition rules, and indirect cost allocation methodology

• Authorization to work for any employer in the United States

Travel Requirements

• This is a remote position requires 2 to 5 amount of trips a year

• National travel for org retreats, programming, job related travel, or professional development

• Outside of the above mentioned travel, this person will work from a home office that must be located anywhere within the U.S.

Questions? We’re here to help.

If you have questions about this role or about our hiring process at any point, please don’t hesitate to reach out to us at talent@leadingeducators.org. This inbox is monitored regularly, and we aim to respond within two business days. To ensure your question receives a thoughtful and timely response, we kindly ask that you refrain from emailing individual staff members or members of our HR team directly. The best way to connect with us is always through talent@leadingeducators.org.

Why Work at Leading Educators?

Imagine being part of an organization where your ideas and perspectives are highly valued. At Leading Educators, we believe in fostering individual strengths, encouraging personal growth, and embracing innovative ideas. If you thrive in a remote working environment, with the added excitement of travel, we're the perfect fit for you. By joining us, you become part of a powerful community of peers nationwide. Regardless of your location, you possess the power to make a significant impact on both students and teachers who rely on us daily. Join Leading Educators and become an integral part of driving progress in education.

Learn About Our Mission & Values:

Mission: Leading Educators partners with school systems to sustain the teaching, leadership, and conditions for every student to succeed in school and in life.

Values:

• Build on strengths: We affirm and begin with the unique and collective talents, experiences, and wisdom of ourselves and others.

• Continuously learn: We develop ourselves and others. We apply new learning and deepened self-awareness to our relationships and practices.

• Prioritize people: We build trust and reflect on the impact of different perspectives and experiences.

• Champion success for all: We re-imagine structures, habits, and mindsets to ensure every learner has access to evidence-based learning opportunities.

Use of Artificial Intelligence in Hiring

• We use artificial intelligence–enabled tools throughout our hiring process, from the moment a candidate applies through the offer stage, to support administrative tasks and the initial review of candidate materials. These tools help us organize, analyze, and surface relevant information efficiently, but they do not make hiring decisions.

• All candidate materials—including applications, resumes, assessments, and interview feedback—are reviewed and evaluated by people. All hiring decisions, including interview selection, advancement, and offers of employment, are made by humans.

• We use AI solely as a support tool to assist with early-stage reviews and process efficiency. We do not use AI in ways that discriminate based on protected characteristics, nor do we use ZIP codes or similar data to target or exclude protected groups. Our hiring practices are designed to be fair, consistent, and aligned with equal employment opportunity standards.

Benefits

• Compensation: If hired for this position, the base salary range is $106,000 to $144,000 per year. Most new hires enter the range at a specific point based on their qualifications and the role level. For this position, the standard starting salary is $125,354, which is based on meeting the minimum requirement of 8 years of relevant experience. If you have more than 8 years of directly relevant experience, your starting salary may be adjusted higher within the range, up to a maximum starting salary of $133,413. This approach ensures that candidates with additional experience beyond the minimum are recognized in the initial salary offer.

• Benefits: 100% paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for individual employees. Additional premium costs are covered 60% by Leading Educators for partners and dependents on medical, dental, and vision plans. 4% matching 401k plan, Flexible Spending Accounts for medical, childcare and commuter expenses, and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP). Benefits are valued at or above $9,000 for employees.

• Time Off: First three years of employment, full time staff accrue 22 days a year. Five additional days are accrued after the third and sixth year of employment. Leading Educators also offer 16 additional paid days off for various holidays, including three floating holidays staff may use at their discretion.

Equal Opportunity Employment

Leading Educators is an equal opportunity employer.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, marital status, military status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local, state, or federal laws, rules, or regulations.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
At Accenture Federal Services, nothing matters more than helping the US federal government make the nation stronger and safer and life better for people. Our 13,000+ people are united in a shared purpose to pursue the limitless potential of technology and ingenuity for clients across defense, national security, public safety, civilian, and military health organizations.

Join Accenture Federal Services, a technology company within global Accenture. Recognized as a Glassdoor Top 100 Best Place to Work, we offer a collaborative and caring community where you feel like you belong and are empowered to grow, learn and thrive through hands-on experience, certifications, industry training and more.

Join us to drive positive, lasting change that moves missions and the government forward!

You are:

A product-minded problem solver who connects mission needs, user value, stakeholder priorities, and technical delivery. You bring together product management, business analysis, and Agile delivery skills to help teams decide what to build, why it matters, and how to deliver the highest-value outcomes for federal clients. This capability posting is designed for candidates who may be building their product-management foundation or already be ready to independently own a product area, backlog, feature set, or stakeholder workstream. As your experience grows, you may define broader product vision and roadmaps, lead cross-team prioritization, mentor product practitioners, and influence portfolio-level product decisions.

The work:

• Discover and clarify mission, user, stakeholder, operational, and business needs through interviews, workshops, analysis, and collaboration.

• Translate needs into product goals, roadmaps, epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, backlog items, and release priorities.

• Support or lead backlog refinement, sprint/PI planning, product discovery, stakeholder alignment, demos, and decision-making activities.

• Use product metrics, customer insights, delivery data, and prioritization frameworks to make tradeoff recommendations and communicate rationale.

• Partner closely with Digital Experience Engineers, Business Application Engineers, Quality Engineers, platform teams, architects, design partners, and delivery leaders.

• Help teams maintain alignment between product outcomes, technical feasibility, user value, quality, delivery constraints, and federal mission priorities.

• Facilitate collaboration across business and technical stakeholders and communicate complex requirements, risks, and decisions in clear language.

• Use AFS-approved AI-assisted tools and workflows to accelerate research synthesis, requirements analysis, backlog refinement, documentation, and product decision support while validating outputs.

• As your experience grows, own larger product areas, define product vision and success measures, mentor others, and influence roadmap and prioritization decisions across teams or programs.

Here’s what you need:

• Professional experience in product management, business analysis, requirements engineering, product ownership, Agile facilitation, or comparable client-facing delivery work, or equivalent practical experience.

• Experience translating user, business, mission, or stakeholder needs into requirements, user stories, backlog items, acceptance criteria, or delivery priorities.

• Experience collaborating with technical teams and communicating effectively with both business and technical stakeholders.

• Understanding of Agile/Scrum/SAFe delivery, backlog management, iterative development, and release planning.

• For candidates with deeper experience, demonstrated ability to independently own product areas, lead discovery and prioritization, mentor others, and influence cross-team product decisions.

Bonus points if you have:

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

• Experience with Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, Miro, Lucidchart, Rally, or comparable product and delivery tools.

• Experience with RICE, WSJF, OKRs, product analytics, customer research, service design, journey mapping, or process modeling.

• Experience with federal consulting, government systems, regulated environments, or mission-oriented delivery.

• Product Owner, Scrum Master, SAFe, Agile, business analysis, or product-management certification.

• Experience working across product management, business analysis, and Agile facilitation responsibilities.

• Ability to facilitate discussions, organize ambiguity, communicate tradeoffs, and take increasing ownership of product or stakeholder workstreams.

Eligibility Requirements:

• U.S. Citizenship required.

• Ability to work with federal clients and comply with applicable AFS, client, security, and program requirements.

• Ability to work in a hybrid, remote, or client-site environment as program needs require.

As required by local law, Accenture Federal Services provides reasonable ranges of compensation for hired roles based on labor costs in the states of California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, and the District of Columbia, and the city of Cleveland. Accenture Federal Services offers a wide variety of benefits. You can find more information on benefits here. We accept applications on an on-going basis and there is no fixed deadline to apply.

We have an unwavering commitment to creating a culture in which all our people are respected, feel a sense of belonging, and have equal opportunity. jobs.title: Medical Social Worker, Home Health
jobs.description:
BAYADA Home Health Care is currently seeking an energetic and experienced Licensed Medical Social Worker, MSW, for a per diem opportunity performing home health visits our Vermont Visits office.  This office services clients on a per visit basis in territories throughout Lamoille, Addison, Washington and Caledonia county.

Prior home care experience preferred, but not required. As a Medical Social Worker, you will be an integral member of a multi-disciplinary health care team that provides skilled nursing and rehabilitative care to clients, affording them the opportunity to receive the medical care required to remain at home.

Responsibilities include:

• Making home visits to clients in designated geographic territories.

• Assist our team in understanding the social and emotional factors related to our clients’ health problems.

• Provide clinical social evaluations and plan appropriate interventions based on evaluation findings.

• Identify appropriate community resource referrals to address the client’s and the family’s practical and environmental needs.

• Act as an advocate for both the client and the family to navigate the patient through the community system.

• Participate in the development of the total plan of care with the multidisciplinary team of BAYADA clinicians, as appropriate.

• Develop and maintain contracts with public and private agencies as resources for the patient.

• Educate and instruct patients, family members, or other patient representatives in community resources to promote the patient's health, safety, well-being, and independent living.

• Accurately document observations, interventions, and evaluations pertaining to patient care management and services provided utilizing a state-of-the-art touch pad tablet.

Qualifications for the ideal candidate:

• A minimum of a Masters in Social Work, with at least 2 years of community-based experience.

• Accreditation by the Council on Social Work Education, as demonstrated by school transcript or degree.

• Home care experience a plus.

• Demonstrated ability to read, write, and effectively communicate in English.

• Ability to work independently and manage time effectively.

• Strong interpersonal skills.

• Solid computer skills; prior experience with electronic medical records (EMR) preferred.

• Ability to travel to cases, as assigned.

• Benefits may include mileage reimbursement; weekly pay and direct deposit; one-on-one training; recognition programs; referral bonuses; 401(k) with company match; and opportunities for career advancement.

Be part of a caring, professional team that is instrumental in providing the highest quality care while developing your career with an industry leader. Apply now for immediate consideration.

Responsible for patient registration, admissions, and associated tasks which include information collection and validation, and requisitioning of orders and services. • Manages, directs and responds to incoming office correspondence as deemed appropriate, including mail, email, faxes, and telephone calls and forward queries to the appropriate staff.

• Attends and provides feedback for departmental staff meetings.

Identifies patients who will need Medicare Advance Beneficiary Notices (ABNs) of non-coverage and maintains accurate records of authorizations within the EMR.

• Role Models the Principals of a Just Culture and Organizational Values.

• Ensures compliance with all applicable HIPAA, EMTLA and Joint commission requirements, providing required associated literature to patients.

• Performs other duties as assigned on department and organizational-level.

Education:

• N/A

#HHSM

jobs.description:
At Accenture Federal Services, nothing matters more than helping the US federal government make the nation stronger and safer and life better for people. Our 13,000+ people are united in a shared purpose to pursue the limitless potential of technology and ingenuity for clients across defense, national security, public safety, civilian, and military health organizations.

You are:

A product-minded engineer who cares about the experience users have with the software you build. You combine modern front-end engineering with practical full-stack skills to turn user needs and designs into accessible, responsive, reliable digital products for federal clients. You may be building your engineering foundation or already be ready to independently own meaningful features and workstreams. This capability posting is intentionally designed for a range of experience. • Professional experience in front-end, full-stack, web, mobile, or product engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

• Hands-on experience with JavaScript or TypeScript and at least one modern framework such as React, Angular, Vue, Next.js, or a comparable technology.

• Experience with HTML, CSS, responsive design, reusable components, and modern web development practices.

• Experience with Node.js, Python, Java, serverless technologies, or other back-end development used to support digital experiences.

• Experience with AWS, Azure, cloud-native application development, containers, or serverless platforms.

• Experience with web performance optimization, observability, CI/CD, automated UI testing, or front-end security practices.

• Ability to communicate clearly, learn quickly, work collaboratively, and take increasing ownership of features or technical workstreams.

jobs.title: Vector Construction Senior Scientist

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Senior Scientist with expertise in molecular biology, vector construction, gene expression, and trait development to join the Seeds Research R&D organization. In this role, you will leverage cutting-edge molecular and automation technologies to design constructs, develop and optimize high-throughput (HTP) cloning workflows, and deliver high-quality vectors that enable genetically modified (GM) and genome-edited (GE) trait development pipelines. The successful candidate will provide technical leadership, drive innovation in automation-enabled workflows, and contribute to the development and mentoring of junior scientists across the team.

Accountabilities:

• Develop effective molecular cloning strategies and deliver high-quality vectors in support of genetically modified (GM), genome editing (GE), and trait development pipelines.
• Lead the development and implementation of high-throughput (HTP) cloning platforms, technologies, and workflows to accelerate research and product advancement.
• Drive adoption of laboratory automation, digital tools, and data-driven solutions to improve throughput, quality, efficiency, and reproducibility.
• Partner with trait, gene expression, genome editing, bioinformatics, transformation, and project teams to design constructs and provide vector construction leadership for key projects.
• Apply expertise in gene expression, regulatory elements, and vector design to optimize construct performance and support trait validation and advancement.
• Evaluate, develop, and implement new molecular biology technologies, methodologies, and protocols that enhance vector construction capabilities and pipeline delivery.
• Mentor, train, and develop junior scientists and associates while promoting scientific excellence, standardized methodologies, and laboratory best practices.
• Maintain high-quality scientific records, perform sequence analysis, and contribute to data management systems, LIMS enhancements, and continuous improvement initiatives

• PhD in Plant Biology, Genetics, Biotechnology, Molecular Biology, or related discipline with 5+ years of progressive industrial research experience or Master’s Degree with 8+ years of experience and demonstrated scientific leadership of complex trait technology programs
• Excellent knowledge leveraging plant biology/physiology and genetics, particularly in corn and/or soy
• GM herbicide and insect control trait discovery and development
• Strong technical leadership with a team-oriented natural way of working
• Fluency in English language both written and orally

Desired Qualifications:

• 8+ years of experience conducting experiments in wet lab, controlled growth and/or field environments
• 8+ years of experience applying state-of-the-art omics and/or genetics technologies to identify genes affecting Biotech traits.
• Demonstrated experience developing and implementing high-throughput cloning platforms and molecular biology workflows in a research or product development environment.
• Proven experience delivering complex cloning and vector construction projects in support of GM, genome editing, and trait development programs.
• Experience applying gene expression and molecular biology principles to construct design, trait evaluation, and technology development.
• Track record of identifying, evaluating, and implementing new technologies that improve scientific capability, throughput, and operational efficiency.
• Experience working effectively in multidisciplinary and highly matrixed research organizations.
• Demonstrated success leading projects, influencing scientific direction, and driving cross-functional decision making.
• Experience mentoring, training, and developing junior scientists and technical staff.
• Experience leveraging automation, data analysis, and digital solutions to improve laboratory performance and research outcomes.

jobs.title: ProFound Therapeutics: Cardiovascular, Metabolic & Neuroscience Co-Op
jobs.description:
This position is open exclusively to current Northeastern University Co-Op students.

Work Period: January 2027 to June 2027. This is a full - time, 40 hours per week position with 5 days in office.

About ProFound Therapeutics

ProFound Therapeutics Inc. is a privately held, early-stage biotechnology company with the vision to revolutionize the human therapeutic landscape. ProFound has recently made the news by being included in the Fierce Biotech’s list of the hottest Biotech companies. ProFound Therapeutics Inc. was founded by Flagship Pioneering, a team of entrepreneurial scientists that conceives, creates, resources, and grows first-in-category life sciences companies. Since 2000, Flagship has created over 75 groundbreaking companies that are pioneering novel and proprietary biological, industrial, and engineering approaches to solve major needs in human health and sustainability. These companies include Moderna Therapeutics (NASDAQ:MRNA), Seres Therapeutics (MCRB), Syros Pharmaceuticals (SYRS), Evelo Biosciences (EVLO), Kaleido Biosciences (KLDO), and Indigo Agriculture. ProFound Therapeutics, Inc. is a highly dynamic, entrepreneurial, and innovation-driven organization seeking to hire an exceptional scientist to join our team.

About Flagship Pioneering

ProFound Therapeutics was founded by Flagship Pioneering's venture creation engine that invents and builds platform companies, each with the potential for multiple products that transform human health or sustainability. Since its launch in 2000, Flagship has originated and fostered more than 100 scientific ventures, resulting in more than $90 billion in aggregate value. Many of the company’s Flagship has founded have addressed humanity’s most urgent challenges: vaccinating billions of people against COVID-19, curing intractable diseases, improving human health, preempting illness, and feeding the world by improving the resiliency and sustainability of agriculture. Flagship has been recognized twice on FORTUNE’s “Change the World” list, an annual ranking of companies that have made a positive social and environmental impact through activities that are part of their core business strategies and has been twice named to Fast Company’s annual list of the World’s Most Innovative Companies. Learn more about Flagship at www.flagshippioneering.com.

Flagship Pioneering Co-Op Program

Welcome to Flagship Pioneering Co-Op Program for the cohort dreaming big and taking courageous leaps. You'll join fellow peers across our ecosystem of companies and learning firsthand how we build first-in-category companies. You’ll have access to enrichment sessions, a dedicated professional development track, and a mentor that help guide you toward your next step. By the end, you will carry on a meaningful project outcome, a genuine network, and a front-row view of how Flagship pioneer new ventures that change the world.

The Role

ProFound Therapeutics is seeking an innovative and highly motivated Co-Op with experience in cell biology and/or disease biology to play a vital role in the company’s Cardiovascular, Metabolic & Neuroscience team. Under the supervision of senior scientists on the Cardiovascular, Metabolic & Neuroscience team, this individual will receive structured training and hands-on experience in in vitro cell-based assays supporting ongoing mid- and high-throughput functional projects. This individual will contribute scientific and technical expertise to a multidisciplinary team, emphasizing conceptualization, experimentation, data analysis, presentation, and strategic planning. The ideal candidate for this position will have coursework or early research experience in cell biology, physiology, or a related discipline and be enthusiastic and capable of working in a multidisciplinary (e.g. genomics, bioinformatics, protein biochemistry) team in the biosciences. The candidate should be able to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced entrepreneurial setting. The Co-Op is designed to complement the candidate’s academic training and provide exposure to industry-based research and therapeutic development.

Key Responsibilities:

• Serve as a contributor to the Cardiovascular, Metabolic & Neuroscience team, whose mission is to discover new therapeutics and validate new therapeutic targets

• Collaborate with senior scientists to support ongoing cardiovascular, metabolic, and neuroscience projects

• Culture, differentiate, and maintain human primary cells and cell lines (e.g. adipocytes, endothelial cells/HUVECs, hepatocytes, and skeletal muscle cells)

• Assist with the development and testing of functional assays using human primary cells for low-, mid-, and high-throughput applications via high-content imaging and confocal immunofluorescence (IF)

• Support disease-relevant readouts, including mitochondrial function, endothelial barrier/permeability, glucose uptake, and lipolysis

• Prepare reagents for functional assays and screens, including peptide reconstitution and aliquoting

• Analyze, interpret, and present experimental data (e.g. GraphPad Prism, Excel) at team meetings and in reports

• Organize and maintain experimental records in Benchling for review

• Report experimental plans and results to the scientific team

• Proactively review literature to contribute to new ideas and methods/technologies for discovery and therapeutic areas

Minimum Qualifications:

• Pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in cell biology, biology, physiology, biochemistry, or a related field

• Coursework or hands-on research experience in mammalian cell culture and basic laboratory techniques, and attention to detail

• Excellent communication and presentation skills, capable of conveying technical information in a clear and thorough manner

• Strong collaborative skills with evidence of working in a team

Preferred Qualifications:

• Prior industry or academic research co-op experience in cell biology or a related discipline

• Experience with mammalian cell culture, including human primary cells

• Coursework or research exposure to metabolic, cardiovascular, or neurological disease biology

• Familiarity with microscopy or imaging-based assays (e.g. high-content imaging, immunofluorescence)

• Exposure to cell based assay development

• Confident execution, focused and team-oriented with an ability to thrive in an entrepreneurial environment

• Experience with data analysis using Graphpad Prism and Microsoft Excel

What We Offer

• Build alongside founders. You’ll work inside the same hypothesis-driven process Flagship uses to conceive and launch first-in-category companies.

• This can be the start of a longer story. Strong co-ops are considered for future opportunities across Flagship and its portfolio companies, not just for this one role.

• Work alongside people who left the safe path. Your colleagues are scientists, engineers, and operators who chose to build something new rather than join something already established.

• Take on real ownership. You're contributing to ventures that are still being defined. Your work can shape real decisions, not just support them.

• Be paid like the contributor you are. Compensation reflects the real work you take on.

jobs.title: Business Application Engineer
jobs.description:
At Accenture Federal Services, nothing matters more than helping the US federal government make the nation stronger and safer and life better for people. Our 13,000+ people are united in a shared purpose to pursue the limitless potential of technology and ingenuity for clients across defense, national security, public safety, civilian, and military health organizations.

Join Accenture Federal Services, a technology company within global Accenture. Recognized as a Glassdoor Top 100 Best Place to Work, we offer a collaborative and caring community where you feel like you belong and are empowered to grow, learn and thrive through hands-on experience, certifications, industry training and more.

Join us to drive positive, lasting change that moves missions and the government forward!

You are:

An application engineer who enjoys turning complex business and mission needs into dependable enterprise software. You build the services, APIs, business logic, data interactions, and integrations that power federal applications. You may be developing your foundation across back-end engineering or already be ready to independently own services, integrations, and meaningful application workstreams. This capability is intentionally broader than a single programming language. As your experience grows, you may lead application modernization efforts, define service and integration patterns, mentor engineers, and influence architecture and engineering standards across teams.

The work:

• Design, build, test, and maintain enterprise application services, APIs, business logic, data-access layers, and integrations.

• Develop solutions using languages and frameworks appropriate to the problem, including Java, C#, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Go, or comparable technologies.

• Integrate applications with databases, messaging platforms, external services, legacy systems, cloud services, and enterprise platforms.

• Modernize legacy application components and help decompose tightly coupled systems into maintainable services and reusable capabilities.

• Write automated unit, integration, and API tests and participate in code reviews, CI/CD, debugging, release support, and production issue resolution.

• Apply secure coding, API design, error handling, logging, observability, performance, and data-integrity practices throughout development.

• Use AFS-approved AI-assisted engineering tools and workflows to accelerate coding, testing, refactoring, documentation, and analysis while validating outputs.

• Partner with Product Managers, Digital Experience Engineers, Quality Engineers, Cloud Platform Engineers, architects, security teams, and client stakeholders.

• As your experience grows, lead complex services or application areas, establish technical patterns, mentor engineers, and shape modernization and architecture decisions.

Here's what you need:

• Professional experience in back-end, application, software, API, or integration engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

• Hands-on development experience in at least one modern enterprise language such as Java, C#, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Go, or a comparable language.

• Experience building or consuming REST APIs, services, business logic, or enterprise application integrations.

• Experience with relational or NoSQL databases and common data-access concepts.

• Understanding of automated testing, source control, code review, debugging, CI/CD, and Agile software delivery.

• For candidates with deeper experience, demonstrated ability to lead complex application work, mentor others, define engineering patterns, and make sound tradeoff decisions across teams.

Bonus points if you have:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience.

• Experience with Spring/Spring Boot, .NET, Node.js, FastAPI/Django/Flask, Go frameworks, or comparable application frameworks.

• Experience with microservices, event-driven architectures, messaging technologies, API gateways, or enterprise integration patterns.

• Experience with AWS, Azure, containers, Kubernetes, serverless technologies, or cloud-native application development.

• Experience with application modernization, legacy integration, data migration, performance engineering, or secure software development.

• Ability to learn unfamiliar systems, communicate technical issues clearly, and take increasing ownership of services or application workstreams.

• Previous federal consulting, government, or mission-oriented delivery experience.

Eligibility Requirements:

• U.S. Citizenship required.

• Ability to work with federal clients and comply with applicable AFS, client, security, and program requirements.

• Ability to work in a hybrid, remote, or client-site environment as program needs require.

As required by local law, Accenture Federal Services provides reasonable ranges of compensation for hired roles based on labor costs in the states of California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, and the District of Columbia, and the city of Cleveland. The base pay range for this position in these locations is shown below. Compensation for roles at Accenture Federal Services varies depending on a wide array of factors, including but not limited to office location, role, skill set, and level of experience. Accenture Federal Services offers a wide variety of benefits. You can find more information on benefits here. We accept applications on an on-going basis and there is no fixed deadline to apply.

$83,600—$196,000 USD

What We Believe

We have an unwavering commitment to creating a culture in which all our people are respected, feel a sense of belonging, and have equal opportunity. This is grounded in our core values and our experience that hiring and developing great people who reflect different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds is key to driving innovation and delivering the results that our clients and the country count on.

Accenture Federal Services is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. Additionally, as an Affirmative Action Employer for Veterans and Individuals with Disabilities, Accenture Federal Services is committed to providing veteran employment opportunities to our service men and women.

Requesting An Accommodation

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description:
ABOUT ODEN:

Manufacturing is undergoing its fourth industrial revolution, with factory operations increasingly driven by real-time applications that combine process and context data with advanced ML and AI algorithms. This is unlocking a staggering opportunity to improve the efficiency and productivity of existing manufacturing processes. 

As a Manufacturing AI company, Oden is at the forefront of this revolution. We combine large-scale data processing architectures and advanced AI and ML algorithms within the Oden platform so manufacturing operations teams can continuously monitor, analyze, and optimize their production, across a diverse set of processes and conditions. Our goal is to maximize efficiency, sustainability, and competitiveness in the manufacturing domain - to help True Makers Make Things Better!




CULTURE

 - We obsess over customers. Everything we do is to create profound results and delight for our customers. Every Viking cares about the purpose of the product and company, and prioritizes work based on customer end results. When in doubt, we go to the Gemba – we’re happy to put on steel toe boots and hit the factory floor to work with the production manager.

 - We move fast and follow through – we live by transparent and scientific thinking, act with urgency, and put in the work to find the best ideas with those around us.

 - We elevate each other by giving and receiving direct, honest feedback and holding ourselves and others to a high standard to help the team rise, deliver, and win together.

 - “Be True Makers to Serve True Makers.” We’re building a community that fuels innovation and accelerates our pace and impact. We always ask if there’s a better way to do something, even if it's unconventional – then we try it. We aim for bold yet simple solutions that cut through complexity and drive meaningful progress.





THE ROLE:

As a Data Scientist on our Customer Solutions team, you'll build the models and algorithms that turn customer manufacturing data into real answers, think predictive quality models, machine failure prediction, and pattern discovery in time-series data. Your work drives real-time solutions we deploy directly with customers, and it feeds back into Oden's core product and roadmap.

You'll dig into real-time process measurements, external context data, outcomes like quality, cost, and yield, and process knowledge from both structured and unstructured sources, drawing on data science, machine learning, and statistics to solve the problem in front of you. With an AI-first mindset, you'll also work with agentic AI models and frameworks that let customers interact with their data and results through natural language, including Oden's own Agentic Root Cause Analysis methodology, which you'll help extend.

You'll partner closely with Customer Success, Product, and customers themselves, defining problems, running trials and proofs of concept, and delivering finished work through the Oden platform. This is an end-to-end role: you'll carry projects from first concept through development and deployment, and act as the bridge between Oden's technical team and customer stakeholders.




RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE BUT NOT LIMITED TO:

 - Work directly with Oden customers to scope data analysis and modeling needs for real manufacturing problems

 - Develop and validate models, algorithms, and methods delivered through the Oden platform

 - Validate results in live, real-world customer deployments

 - Partner with engineering to implement and ship solutions

 - Generalize one-off solutions into the next generation of product features

 - Work with Product to translate customer problems into roadmap requirements

 - Engage with the technical community: share results externally, stay current on the field, and help advance the state of the art




REQUIRED EXPERIENCE:

 - 1-3 years of professional experience as a Data Scientist or ML Engineer, with a B.S. or M.S. in Statistics, Machine Learning, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Economics, or a related field

 - Strong Python skills, including common ML and statistics libraries

 - Strong SQL skills

 - Familiarity with process improvement and exploratory techniques (design of experiments, optimization)

 - Hands-on familiarity with generative AI models, for code development, experimentation, and generating insights for customers and end users on the Oden platform

 - Comfort directing frontier AI models and AI agents as tools you steer, not magic you wait on

 - A drive to own projects end-to-end, from first experiment to customer delivery




COMPENSATION

We anticipate the base salary band for this role (Data Scientist) will be between $95,000 and $155,000, in addition to equity and benefits. The salary at offer will be determined by factors such as the candidate’s experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity among our team.

At this time, we cannot offer visa sponsorship. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without current or future employer sponsorship




AT ODEN, WE ARE DEEPLY COMMITTED TO ENSURING THAT EVERY TEAM MEMBER IS ENGAGED IN WORK THEY ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT AND FIND FULFILLING. WE PRIORITZE YOUR CAREER DEVELOPMENT, OFFERING PERSONALIZED PATHWAYS FOR GROWTH AND ADVANCEMENT. OUR APPROACH IS TO ALIGN YOUR STRENGTHS AND INTERESTS WITH THE COMPANY’S GOALS, ENSURING THAT YOU NOT ONLY CONTRIBUTE MEANINGFULLY BUT ALSO PROGRESS STEADILY IN YOUR PROFESSIONAL JOURNEY, REACHING NEW HEIGHTS IN YOUR CAREER.


WE’RE AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER (EOE). 




DIVERSITY AT ODEN MEANS BUILDING A TEAM THAT IS RICH ACROSS ALL BOUNDARIES OF RACE, ETHNICITY, GENDER IDENTIFICATION, SEXUAL ORIENTATION, DISABILITY, RELIGION, AGE AND THINKING STYLE. WE WELCOME ALL BACKGROUNDS, LIFE EXPERIENCES, AND WORLDVIEWS AS THESE ARE THE CATALYST FOR THE RAPID EVOLUTION OF OUR PRODUCT AND OUR ORGANIZATION. DIVERSITY ALLOWS US TO TACKLE NEW CHALLENGES, EMBRACE CHANGE, MAKE WELL-INFORMED DECISIONS, AND ULTIMATELY MAKE THINGS BETTER. IN ALIGNMENT WITH OUR “PEOPLE FIRST” COMPANY VALUE, ODEN HAS A PASSIONATE INTERNAL TEAM DEDICATED TO THE PROMOTION OF DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION INITIATIVES AS A CORE COMPONENT OF OUR CULTURE.




OUR DIVERSITY INITIATIVES APPLY TO OUR PRACTICES AND POLICIES ON RECRUITING, COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS; PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT; PROMOTIONS; SOCIAL ACTIVITIES AND THE ONGOING DEVELOPMENT OF A PSYCHOLOGICALLY SAFE WORK ENVIRONMENT.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant to CEO
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Imprint helps the world's best brands grow the lifetime value of their customers. We started with co-branded credit cards and rebuilt them to be smarter, more rewarding, and brand-first. We partner with companies like Crate & Barrel, Rakuten, Booking.com http://Booking.com, H-E-B, Fetch, and Shell to launch modern credit programs that deepen loyalty, unlock savings, and drive growth. But the card is just the beginning. We combine advanced payments infrastructure, intelligent underwriting, and deep customer data to create delightful and personalized experiences for members as well as efficient and profitable relationships for our brand partners. Our robust technology and world-class operations allow us and our brand partners to offer powerful financial products without becoming a bank. 

In the U.S., co-branded cards alone account for over $300 billion in annual spend, and most still run on decades-old legacy bank systems. Imprint is the modern alternative: flexible, embeddable, and built for how people actually pay today. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, Thrive Capital, Ribbit, and Khosla Ventures, we're building a world-class team to redefine how people pay and how brands grow. If you want to move fast, solve hard problems, and own real outcomes, we want to meet you.



The Executive Assistant to the CEO is one of the most critical roles at Imprint. You will serve as the right hand to our Founder and CEO, ensuring that their time, focus, and energy are directed toward the highest impact priorities across the business. This is not a traditional administrative role. You will operate as a true strategic partner who creates leverage for the CEO by managing complexity, anticipating needs, and keeping the operating rhythm of the company running smoothly behind the scenes.

Imprint is at a pivotal stage of growth. We have over 220 employees, are nearly doubling in revenue year over year, and are preparing to launch several major new brand partnerships. The CEO is deeply involved across product, partnerships, fundraising, board governance, and company culture. This role exists to make sure nothing falls through the cracks and that the CEO can operate at the highest possible level every single day.

You will be based in our New York City office and expected to be in the office when the CEO is in the office, which is most days. This role requires someone who thrives in a fast-paced, high-ownership environment and who genuinely loves the craft of being an exceptional Executive Assistant.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Manage and optimize a complex, fast-moving calendar across multiple time zones, balancing internal meetings, board commitments, investor conversations, partner meetings, and personal time. Own the CEO's schedule entirely and make daily judgment calls about what gets prioritized, rescheduled, or declined.

 - Coordinate all logistics for board meetings, investor meetings, and partner events including preparation of materials, room setup, travel arrangements, attendee communications, and follow-up items. Ensure the CEO walks into every meeting fully prepared and that nothing is left to chance.

 - Manage all domestic and international travel end to end, including flights, hotels, ground transportation, itineraries, and backup plans. Anticipate complications before they arise and always have a plan B ready.

 - Serve as a gatekeeper and liaison between the CEO and internal teams, external partners, investors, board members, and other stakeholders.

 - Track and follow up on action items, commitments, and deliverables that come out of meetings and conversations. Maintain a running system that ensures nothing the CEO committed to gets dropped.

 - Help prepare for key company moments including all-hands meetings, leadership offsites, and major announcements by coordinating logistics, gathering materials, and ensuring smooth execution.

 - Support light personal tasks as needed to ensure the CEO can stay focused on the business during high-intensity periods.

 - Proactively identify opportunities to improve how the CEO's office operates. Bring ideas for better systems, tools, and workflows that create more leverage and reduce friction.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 10+ years of experience as an Executive Assistant, with at least 2 years directly supporting a CEO or Founder at a high-growth technology or fintech company. You have supported an executive through a period of rapid scaling and understand what it takes to keep up with the pace.

 - Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail. You manage complexity with ease and have a system for everything. Nothing slips.

 - Impeccable judgment and discretion. You will be exposed to highly sensitive information across every area of the business. Trust is non-negotiable.

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills. You can draft emails, messages, and documents on behalf of the CEO that reflect the CEO's voice and standards.

 - High ownership mentality. You don't wait to be told what to do. You see what needs to happen and you make it happen. You take pride in running a tight operation and you hold yourself to an extremely high bar.

 - Comfort with ambiguity and changing priorities. In a company growing this fast, plans change constantly. You adapt quickly, reprioritize without drama, and keep everything moving forward.

 - A genuine love for the Executive Assistant function. You see this role as your craft and your career, not a stepping stone to a different function. You take deep satisfaction in making the person you support more effective and in being the person the entire company trusts to keep things running.

 - Proficiency with modern productivity tools including Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, and the ability to quickly adopt new tools and AI-powered workflows.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience supporting a CEO through fundraising rounds, board processes, or an IPO.

 - Familiarity with fintech, financial services, or payments.

 - Experience at a company with 100 to 500 employees during a period of rapid growth.




PERKS & BENEFITS

 - Competitive compensation and equity packages

 - Leading configured work computers of your choice

 - Flexible paid time off

 - Fully covered, high-quality healthcare, including fully covered dependent coverage

 - Additional health coverage includes access to One Medical and the  option to enroll in an FSA

 - 20 weeks of paid parental leave for the primary caregiver and 8 weeks for all new parents

 - Access to industry-leading technology across all of our business units, stemming from our philosophy that we should invest in resources for our team that foster innovation, optimization, and productivity
   
   

Imprint is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Imprint is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. Imprint welcomes talented individuals from all backgrounds who want to build the future of payments and rewards. If you are passionate about FinTech and eager to grow, let’s move the world forward, together.

jobs.description:

Pioneiros, mudamos o mercado ao lançar o primeiro banco digital do Brasil e seguimos criando tendências com tecnologia de ponta. Evoluímos para um Super App Financeiro Global, com soluções completas e inovação de primeira. Aqui, o trabalho tem propósito: construir oportunidades reais, transformar a vida das pessoas e o mercado financeiro. Esse é o nosso Jeito Inter de Fazer. Se você quer fazer parte dessa mudança e deixar um legado, seu lugar é aqui.

Vem ser Sangue Laranja.

As pioneers, we transformed the market by launching Brazil’s first digital bank and continue to shape the future with cutting-edge technology.
We have evolved into a Global Financial Super App, delivering complete solutions and leading innovation. Here, work has purpose: creating real opportunities, transforming people’s lives, and reshaping the financial market.
This is the Inter way of making things happen. If you want to be part of this transformation and leave your mark, your place is here.

Become Sangue Laranja.

Você fará parte do time de FP&A da Inter Seguros e será referência nas análises de resultado, orçamento e forecast do negócio — conectando números KPIs às decisões da liderança.

• Elaborar apresentações executivas e materiais para a Diretoria: narrativa clara, teses, foco executivo.

• Integrar dados e contexto de mercado ao planejamento, enriquecendo premissas e leitura estratégica.

• Participar da construção do orçamento anual (receita, OPEX e CAPEX) da área de negócio, alinhado à estratégia, cronograma e premissas da Diretoria.

• Apoiar modelagem financeira de produtos, valuation e análises de inteligência comercial.

• Conhecimento do negócios e modelagem financeira.

• Experiência ampla em FP&A e Gestão de Metas e Resultados.

• Habilidades analíticas e domínio do pacote office.

• Compreensão das regulamentações e contabilidade de serviços.

• Excelente capacidade de comunicação verbal e escrita

• Domínio de apresentação e storytelling executivo

Desejáveis:

• Desejável pós-graduação em finanças, gestão de negócios ou gestão de projetos.

• inglês fluente.

Benefícios

• Vale-alimentação e Vale-refeição

• Plano de saúde e odontológico

• Seguro de vida

• DayOff de Aniversário

• Licença parental estendida

• Wellhub e Grupo de Corrida Inter

• Espaço CARE4U (Belo Horizonte): serviços de autocuidado com valores exclusivos, área de descompressão, jogos e minicampo de golfe

• Cartão Prime Inter

Gecko Robotics is seeking a Full Stack Software Engineering Intern to join our Engineering team in New York for Summer 2027. This is a full-time, onsite internship, Monday through Friday.

Gecko’s Engineering teams build customer-facing applications that turn robot, sensor, and document data into decisions about the health of critical infrastructure. React, TypeScript, Python, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Git, Linux, and cloud infrastructure (GCP). Depending on the project, you may also work with LLM APIs and data-processing pipelines, 3D visualization, or containerized deployments. The specific tools will depend on the assigned project.

Preferred Skills

• Demonstrated experience ingesting, parsing, validating, transforming, and troubleshooting JSON and NDJSON, including nested structures, malformed records, schema drift, and large-file processing.

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Anduril Imaging team develops state-of-the-art imaging systems across both hardware and software, deployed to tackle the most significant security challenges of America and its allies. The team is heavily involved in utilizing computer vision, perception, electro-optical, infrared, and sensor data to give our war fighters and allies an advantage.

ABOUT THE JOB

As a Production Software Engineer, you'll be responsible for developing product-agnostic software solutions for our production teams. You'll work cross-functionally with production and software teams to enhance automation and build efficiencies. Your role will involve hands-on software development and collaboration with cross-functional teams to ensure optimal performance and integration of cutting-edge technologies.

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. jobs.description:
Join phData, a remote-first data and AI consultancy company with employees across the United States, Latin America, and India. We partner with industry leaders, including Snowflake, AWS, Anthropic, Glean, and dbt, to solve the complex data and AI challenges that slow large enterprises.

We're growing fast, and we give our people real ownership over their work. We hire top performers and trust them to deliver results.

Why phData?

• Snowflake Implementation Partner of the Year — 7 consecutive years, and 2026 Snowflake AI Partner of the Year

• AWS Premier Tier Services Partner — the highest tier of recognition in the AWS Partner Network

• 2025 Fivetran Partner of the Year (4th consecutive year)

• 2025 dbt Labs Partner of the Year (3x winner) with Visionary partner status

• 2026 KNIME Customer Excellence Partner of the Year

• Preferred Partner in the Anthropic Claude Partner Network

• #1 Partner in Snowflake Advanced Certifications

• 600+ Expert Cloud Certifications (Sigma, AWS, Azure, Dataiku, and more)

• Recognized as an award-winning workplace in the US, India and LATAM

Role Overview

phData is looking for a Principal Analytics Consultant who specializes in Power BI to lead complex analytics engagements and help customers realize measurable value from their data.

In this role, you will combine deep Power BI expertise with strong consulting judgment, executive presence, and delivery leadership. You will guide clients from strategy and discovery through solution design, development, deployment, governance, and adoption. You will translate ambiguous business needs into scalable analytics products that support better decisions and sustainable ways of working with data.

You will work closely with client executives, business stakeholders, technical teams, account leaders, and consultants across phData. You will also help shape Power BI delivery standards, reusable accelerators, enterprise adoption approaches, and the continued growth of the Analytics practice.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead end-to-end Power BI engagements and workstreams, including planning, discovery, requirements, prototyping, development, testing, deployment, enablement, and adoption.

• Establish the overall technical approach, solution architecture, backlog, delivery sequence, and quality standards for scalable Power BI solutions.

• Design and develop Power BI semantic models, reports, dashboards, data products, and self-service analytics experiences that are intuitive, performant, governed, and aligned to business outcomes.

• Apply strong practices in dimensional modeling, DAX, Power Query, SQL, data visualization, metric definition, and performance optimization.

• Connect Power BI solutions to enterprise data warehouses, data marts, lakehouses, semantic models, and other analytical data structures.

• Lead client discovery and working sessions that clarify ambiguous needs, define analytical requirements, align stakeholders, surface tradeoffs, and drive decisions.

• Advise clients on Power BI governance and operating models, including workspace strategy, security, access management, deployment practices, platform administration, adoption, and performance.

• Review and improve existing reports, semantic models, platform configurations, and deployment practices to identify opportunities for optimization, standardization, and scale.

• Manage client expectations through clear communication, status reporting, feedback loops, risk management, transparent escalation, and alignment on decisions and dependencies.

• Provide technical leadership and mentorship to consultants and delivery teams; establish a high bar for quality, usability, maintainability, and client value.

• Contribute to staffing plans, utilization planning, delivery planning, workstream budgets, estimates, and overall project performance.

• Partner with account and practice leaders on discovery, proposals, solution shaping, estimates, and expansion opportunities that deepen client value and support Analytics practice growth.

• Develop reusable Power BI accelerators, frameworks, templates, enablement materials, and points of view that improve delivery consistency and market impact.

• Support backlog development and ongoing enhancement of analytics solutions after initial implementation.

About You

You are a client-focused analytics leader who enjoys solving complex data problems and creating practical, well-designed solutions. You bring strong technical judgment and can move comfortably between business strategy, analytics architecture, hands-on Power BI development, executive conversations, and team leadership.

You are comfortable leading through ambiguity, influencing without authority, and operating in distributed, global teams. You communicate clearly with both technical and business audiences and are energized by helping organizations establish sustainable, value-oriented ways of working with data.

Required Qualifications

Experience

• 7+ years of relevant experience delivering data analytics, business intelligence, or data visualization solutions in an enterprise environment.

• 3+ years of external consulting experience, including ownership of client-facing analytics projects or workstreams from kickoff through completion.

• Experience leading complex delivery teams or workstreams and mentoring consultants or technical practitioners.

• Experience contributing to delivery planning, estimates, staffing, utilization, budgets, proposals, or practice development.

Technical and Functional Skills

• Demonstrated expertise designing and delivering enterprise Power BI solutions, including semantic modeling, report and dashboard development, DAX, Power Query, data visualization, and performance optimization.

• Strong SQL skills and experience working with cloud data warehouses, data marts, lakehouses, semantic models, and analytical data structures.

• Experience with Power BI Service administration and enterprise enablement, including workspace strategy, security roles, access management, deployment practices, platform configuration, governance, and adoption.

• Strong understanding of analytics architecture, data modeling, metric definition, visualization design, usability, scalability, and maintainability.

• Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business needs into clear analytical requirements and communicate recommendations, tradeoffs, risks, and dependencies to technical and executive stakeholders.

• Exceptional customer-facing communication, facilitation, project leadership, and stakeholder-management skills.

• Strong problem-solving skills with a passion for learning and applying new technologies, techniques, and procedures.

Preferred Qualifications

Preferred qualifications help candidates stand out but are not required for success in this role.

• Experience scaling Power BI across an enterprise, including governance, operating models, adoption, performance, platform optimization, and change enablement.

• Microsoft Power BI certification, such as Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate.

• Experience with Power Automate, Power Apps, Copilot Studio, Snowflake, Tableau, Sigma, Alteryx, KNIME, Matillion, Dataiku, Coalesce, or similar modern data and analytics technologies.

• Experience developing reusable accelerators, frameworks, templates, enablement materials, or internal points of view.

• Experience contributing to solution estimates, proposals, discovery activities, and the growth of a consulting practice.

• Experience leading cross-functional teams and influencing senior client stakeholders through complex transformation or modernization initiatives.

Why phData?

• Impactful Work: Partner with leading organizations on meaningful data and AI initiatives.

• Collaborative Culture: Work with a supportive, high-performing global team that values transparency, autonomy, and continuous improvement.

• Growth Opportunities: Access to challenging projects, mentorship, and structured development pathways.

• Values-Driven: We prioritize doing the right thing for our clients, our teams, and our community.

Benefits at phData

US

• Remote-first work environment

• 401(k) plan with company match

• Dental and vision insurance

• Home office equipment stipend

• Annual learning and development stipend

• Competitive compensation, excellent benefits, four weeks of paid time off, 10 holidays, and other perks

Our approach helps us to build a winning team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and abilities. So, regardless of how your diversity expresses itself, you can find a home here at phData. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Senior Field and Partner Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
At Replicant, we believe AI should work for people, starting with customer service. That’s why we built a platform that helps contact centers resolve more requests, proactively identify issues, and improve agent performance with AI-powered conversation intelligence and AI agents that act like your best reps.

Our AI agents handle millions of calls every month for Fortune 500 companies and high-growth innovators. From processing payments to booking appointments and authenticating users, they help customers get what they need instantly, 24/7. Meanwhile, our real-time conversation insights help contact center leaders coach better and improve every interaction.

We’re leading the shift from legacy systems to AI-first service, powered by large language models (LLMs) and designed for enterprise scale, security, and empathy. If you’re excited by the potential of LLMs, voice AI, and building category-defining technology with a kind, ambitious team, you’ll love it here.

We are seeking a dynamic and strategic Senior Field and Partner Marketing Manager. This role is critical to help us engage contact center and customer experience leaders in places they go to network and learn, while driving joint co-marketing initiatives with key channel partners. You will lead the strategy, planning, and execution of high-impact trade shows, VIP activations, and partner campaigns with the goal of building our brand, expanding partner networks, and driving qualified pipeline for our sales team.

This role will report into the Director of Demand Generation.



What you’ll do

 - Drive Quality Pipeline & Revenue: Lead strategy, planning, and execution for high-yield trade shows and conferences, and partner initiatives focused on generating qualified pipeline that ultimately closes as won deals.

 - Stand-Out Event Experiences: Help Replicant stand out in a crowded space by bringing high creativity, innovation, and unique experience design to our trade shows and field activations.

 - Serve as the Sales & Marketing Bridge: Work lockstep as a strategic partner to Sales and BDR teams by actively listening to field feedback, sharing market findings, and coming to the table with proactive ideas to reach pipeline targets.

 - Full-Funnel ABM Mindset: Bring an account-based lens to field execution, collaborating closely across Demand Generation leadership (who own our overarching 1:1, 1:few, and 1:many ABM strategy) to extend target account programming into field events, build top-of-funnel momentum, and prevent mid-funnel deal stagnation.

 - Demand-Focused Partner Marketing: Drive joint co-marketing plays with key channel partners, applying a sharp demand generation lens to market "to and through" partner networks to create qualified pipeline.

 - GTM Orchestration, Strategy & Hand-Offs: Own the overall field event strategy, event calendar, and budget, while leading end-to-end program briefs, project management, and GTM communications—architecting pre-, during-, and post-event execution plans that eliminate ambiguity for BDR/AE follow-up.

 - Performance Tracking & RevOps Alignment: Partner closely with RevOps to measure program impact from ideation to post-mortem, utilizing dashboards, GTM Buddy widgets, and evidence-based reporting to track lead progression and SAO conversion.



What you’ll bring

 - 6+ years of experience in a field and events marketing role, preferably within a fast-paced B2B technology and SaaS environment.

 - Proven track record of holding direct accountability for field-sourced pipeline targets, cost-per-SAO efficiency, and event ROI.

 - Demonstrated success co-designing and executing "to and through" joint demand generation programs with channel partners, consultancies, or tech alliances.

 - Experience working with external vendors (event agencies, design, event supply chain, and trade show organizers) as well as Revenue teams.

 - A proven track record of conceptualizing and executing impactful field marketing events, trade show presences, and conferences.

 - Experience with marketing automation, CRM platforms, and account-based strategy, paired with a drive to continuously innovate program strategies.

 - Proven experience executing joint partner marketing programs with consultancies, tech partners, and channel alliances.

 - Exceptional organizational skills, strong attention to detail, and a process-first mindset.

 - A goal- and data-oriented mindset with deep accountability for program performance and revenue impact.

 - Strong strategic thinking paired with the ability to execute quickly, manage project briefs, and stay several steps ahead.

 - Outstanding communication skills, acting as an empathetic, proactive bridge between Revenue and Marketing teams.

For all full-time employees, we offer:



🌴  In-person connection that counts: company-wide offsites and smaller team gatherings designed to make remote work feel personal

🖥️  Tech & learning stipend: Conferences, books, courses — interested? We’ll fund them

📍  Remote by design: We’re distributed — no guilt about life events, we trust you to manage your calendar

🏋️  Health & wellness: Flexible vacations, paid sabbatical after 5 years, comprehensive benefits, plus a stipend to support your physical and mental well-being

💸  Compensation that matches your impact: competitive salaries in the company you’re helping to build

📈  Equity with upside: We believe in shared ownership—You’ll own a real piece of a fast-growing AI company



Our Values

Replicant has three core values. It is critical that everyone who joins the team feels excited and moved by these values as every new team member makes an impact on our culture.



Blade Runners: We take ownership and pride to influence the outcomes of our goals. We are successful, and like a Blade Runner, use the tools at our disposal to reach our objectives. We value open and honest communication and proactively seek feedback along the way. We are a company driven to grow and achieve both individually and as a team.



Bread Makers: We are humble and strive toward an egalitarian culture. No task is too big or too small. We work together to achieve our goals and develop our company mission. We believe that the whole is greater than the sum of its parts in everything that we do.



Självdistans (Self-Distance): Självdistans is Swedish for self-distance. It's the ability to critically reflect on oneself and one's relations from an external perspective. With this in mind, we act with objectivity and always remember that we are not our work. There's no perfect science to growing a team or business, but we trust everyone at Replicant to point out our blind spots and humbly admit their own.



Replicant is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at talent@replicant.ai hr@replicant.ai and we’ll work to meet your needs.
