jobs.title: Design Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT TRIGGER.DEV

Trigger.dev http://Trigger.dev is an open source platform used by developers to build production-grade AI agents. It's an SDK and the infrastructure to run agents reliably at scale, so teams can focus on the product instead of the plumbing.

Our Cloud product is a managed service where we deploy our users' code and auto-scale from zero to millions of executions. With the rise of AI, being able to offload async tasks reliably is a key part of any developer's toolkit - we're building the infrastructure to make that a reality.



ABOUT THE POSITION

We're a small team shipping fast, and as we accelerate building new features and expand the team, we want to make sure the quality and polish of what we ship keeps pace. That's where you come in.

We're looking for a Design Engineer to help raise the bar on UX and visual quality across our product and marketing surfaces. You'll blend design sensibility with real engineering ability, and be able to take a rough idea, a Figma file, or even just a problem statement, and turn it into a well-crafted, production-quality experience yourself, without needing a traditional design-to-dev handoff.

This is a hands-on, high-impact role for someone who cares as much about how something feels to use as they do about how it's built.

What you'll be doing

You'll do a variety of things including:

 - Designing and building high-quality, polished UI across our web app and marketing site

 - You'll work closely with the rest of the engineering team to build new features with a focus on design craft and great UX.

 - Owning design decisions end-to-end: from rough concept through to shipped, production code

 - Building and evolving our design system and component library so quality scales as the product grows

 - Improving accessibility, responsiveness, and interaction polish across existing product surfaces

 - Prototyping new ideas quickly in code as well as static mockups, so we can iterate fast

 - Helping instil a stronger design/UX sensibility across the wider engineering team


REQUIREMENTS

You really need to have:

 - A strong portfolio showing both design quality and the ability to ship real, production UI yourself

 - Expertise in modern frontend engineering - React and TypeScript (we use Remix)

 - A sharp eye for visual and interaction detail - typography, spacing, motion, and the small things that make software high quality

 - Comfort working directly from a problem statement rather than a fully-specced design - you can drive design decisions yourself

 - If you are remote you must be within CET to ET timezones (GMT+1:00 to GMT-5:00). We will arrange in-person events throughout the year

You'll be an amazing fit if you:

 - Experience owning design end-to-end at a small startup, without a separate design team to hand off to

 - Worked at a developer tools company, or have strong empathy for developers as an end user

 - Experience building or evolving a design system / component library

 - A track record of shipping fast and iterating in public

 - If you're based in the UK and you are able to join the team in London

 - Contributed to open source projects

 - Previously been a venture-backed startup founder

 - Have a social media presence


ABOUT THE TEAM

 - We are a small team with a flat hierarchy

 - We encourage continuous learning and personal development

 - Everyone operates autonomously; we trust you to get the job done, but to also quickly raise your hand if you need help

 - We care about our customers and the open-source community

 - Being a start-up, the work is challenging and fast-paced, but we also understand the importance of taking time off to recharge


WORKING AT A COMMERCIAL OPEN SOURCE SOFTWARE COMPANY IS MORE THAN JUST YOUR DAY JOB

 - We have an active community on Discord and GitHub. Everyone on the team helps customers, reviews PRs, and creates issues

 - Great documentation matters more than ever, both for humans and for the AI tools that read it. Everyone here keeps docs up to date

 - We are a product-led growth company so everyone is expected to get involved in creating content like code examples, blog articles, videos and tweets


BENEFITS

 - Generous, transparent compensation and equity - We hire the best talent and pay to reflect that. We also offer equity as a way to ensure everyone is invested in the success of the company.

 - Async working - Need a heads-down day or meeting-free days to stay productive? No problem!

 - Home office - We will help provide equipment for a comfortable setup so you're as productive at home as you are in the office.

 - Generous vacation - We believe it's important to take time off. We encourage you to take your 25 days vacation excluding national holidays, plus sick leave and generous parental leave.

 - Training budget - An annual budget to contribute towards learning such as purchasing books, an Audible subscription or online courses.

 - Pension and 401k contributions - Enroll in our company pension scheme or we'll contribute directly to your private pension.

The  Infection Preventionist  reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

Performs clinical, educational and research responsibilities within the Infection Prevention Department, working in collaboration with and reporting to the Manager and the Medical Directors of Healthcare Epidemiology and Infection Prevention (HEIP) to reduce the risk of healthcare associated infection and to ensure the safety and health of all patients, visitors and personnel.

Responsibilities:

• Acts as a resource for problem solving issues related to infection prevention.

• Collaborates with Corporate Health in all areas relating to staff issues involving infectious disease exposures.
• Completes and submits reportable data to local, state, and national agencies.
• Presents lectures, orientation and training related to infection prevention.
• Conducts compliance monitoring for hand hygiene and adherence to established policy to assure patient and staff safety.
• Participates in Environment of Care (EOC) rounds and provides recommendations for remediation when necessary.

Additional Functions

• Surveillance indicators as outlined in the Risk Assessment and Infection Prevention Plan are reported as required to the appropriate agencies.

Required:

• Bachelor’s Degree (usually in Nursing, Medical Technology, Chemistry, Biology or Allied Health related field) and 2-3 years recent clinical experience in the acute care setting.

• Certification in Infection Control from the Certification Board for Infection Control and Epidemiology, Inc. If not certified, achieves certification within three years of appointment to the role.

jobs.description:
Director of Demand Generation

Full-time, Salaried  ·  Marketing & Sales

Reports to: VP of Marketing

Location: Remote

Saltbox makes the hardest parts of running a small online business simple. Our workspaces bring together flexible warehouse suites, offices, and hands-on logistics support, all designed to help eCommerce entrepreneurs scale with confidence. Our members run businesses across Fashion & Apparel, Health & Beauty, Electronics, Household Goods, and more. When you join Saltbox, you're not just joining a company, you're helping real small business owners in your own backyard succeed.

Saltbox grows on demand: the leads, tours, and pipeline that keep our buildings full, move members into logistics services, and make a new market launch land. This is a newly created seat at the center of that engine.

To start, this is a player-coach role. You'll design the systems and coach the team, and also run tactical work yourself while the team is small. Your job is to define and build demand generation for scale, the systems, the launch strategy, and the team bench it needs.

We're opening new markets and growing services revenue at the same time, and both depend on a demand engine that doesn't exist yet in a repeatable form. You get to build it, the strategy, the launch playbook, and the team.

What the job looks like

This role sits where three things meet: the demand that keeps stabilized buildings full, the strategy that makes a new market launch land, and the team and systems that make both repeatable rather than one-off. You're translating revenue goals into a pipeline plan, shaping how content and campaigns drive services adoption alongside occupancy, and building the bench underneath you so demand generation scales.

What you will own

Strategy and planning

• Set the demand strategy across owned, paid, and partner channels that keeps buildings full and backfills churn

• Translate company revenue goals into a pipeline plan you can defend in front of leadership

• Keep campaigns, content, and launches working as one strategy, not disconnected efforts

Market launches

• Own the go-to-market campaign for every new market and building, from plan through results

• Set and manage the launch budget across digital, traditional, and partnership spend

• Build each launch plan with the local team so it fits real market conditions

Team and partner leadership

• Manage and coach your direct reports as the team grows from a lean start

• Hold the digital and content agencies to the same standard as the internal team

• Run hands-on onboarding for each new hire and partner until they're fully ramped

• Set clear KPIs for reports and partners alike, and review progress against them on a regular cadence

Pipeline, analytics, and AI

• Own the marketing pipeline numbers and report them to leadership weekly, monthly, and quarterly

• Oversee paid and owned performance, optimizing for lead volume and cost per lead

• Direct which recurring workflows (reporting, content drafting, campaign ops) get handed to AI agents

• Partner with Revenue Ops to keep lead scoring, funnel stages, and reporting accurate

• Step into the tactical work yourself where gaps exist while the team is small

How we measure success

• Qualified leads and tours generated against targets for stabilized buildings

• Marketing-sourced pipeline deals and dollars

• Services revenue attach rate generated from member marketing program

• Lead and tour volume for each new market launch

• Campaign velocity, time from brief to launch, trending down quarter over quarter

• Direct reports hitting their own KPI targets within 90 days of hire

• Number of recurring team workflows successfully automated via agents, tracked quarterly

Who thrives here

• You want to build something, not maintain something that already exists

• You're comfortable owning a number and being accountable for it

• You take ownership of outcomes, not just tasks

• You're energized by ambiguity, this function is still being defined

• You're scrappy enough to do the work on a small team, and disciplined enough to hand it off as it grows

What you bring

• 7+ years in demand generation or growth marketing, with at least 2 years managing people

• You don't just use AI yourself, you raise the AI fluency of the team you lead. We expect concrete examples of what you've shipped and who's better at AI because of you.

• Experience owning a lead and revenue number (MQLs, SQLs) you were accountable to

• A market launch or cross-channel campaign you planned and ran, with metrics to back it up

• Strong with campaign analytics across paid, organic, website, and email

• Comfortable as a player-coach, hands-on yourself while the team is small

What we offer

• Medical coverage, 100% covered for two Aetna plans, or a low premium for PPO

• Dental and vision covered at 100%

• 401K plan options

• Company-paid long-term and short-term disability and life insurance

• Paid holidays, vacation time, sick time, and paid parental leave

• Learning and professional development budget

How we work with AI

AI is part of how we work at Saltbox. Every role here is expected to use AI tools as part of daily work, not as a novelty, but as a real lever for doing the job better. We invest in protected time, training budget, and a peer community to support that growth, and we expect every team member to lean in.

Ready to apply

Saltbox is excited to offer a full-time salaried position with a base pay range of $160,000-$190,000, depending on your location. We understand that cost of living varies across our markets, and our compensation reflects that.

If you're looking for a chance to build a demand generation function from the ground up and lead the team behind it, we want to hear from you. Apply today and become part of the Saltbox team.

Learn more at www.saltbox.com

The Chaplain reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

A chaplain offers spiritual guidance and pastoral care to patients, families, and hospital staff/medical staff. As representatives of spiritual and/or religious traditions, chaplains use insights and principles of psychology religion, spirituality, and theology.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Delivers a ministry of spiritual care, counseling, consultation, worship, prayer, sacraments, and spiritual/ emotional support services to patients, families, and hospital personnel/medical staff for the optimal holistic care of patients.
• Identifies and clarifies ethical dilemmas. Findings will be shared with the Ethics Committee Chairs to determine whether an ethics consult is necessary per site policy/procedure.
• Participates in and provides appropriate leadership in interdisciplinary clinical team activities related to planning and coordinating patient care, including care conferences, team meetings, nursing rounds, palliative care rounds, IDT meetings, and family conferences when appropriate.
• Provides end of life support, bereavement support as needed.
• Provides education to patients and hospital personnel/medical staff on Advanced Directives including Power of Attorney for Healthcare and Goals of Care conversations.
• Develops and leads spiritual care services within the hospital in collaboration with other members of the Spiritual Care Department.
• Serves as spiritual liaisons between the hospital and community (both religious and secular) with referrals and information with patient/family permission that is compliant with HIPAA regulations.
• Escalates any concerns or issues following the NM chain of command policies.
• Offers religious services to hospital personnel/medical staff as appropriate and when requested.
• Accepts on call for spiritual care coverage, crises and emergencies as assigned including nights, weekends, and holidays. Manager may assign required minimum on-call shifts.
• Assists in leading CALM/Mindful Moments as assigned or as needed.
• Attends to cultural and spiritual dynamics that may improve patient treatment and family dynamics.
• Maintains chapel/sacred spaces and workspaces in a neat fashion while keeping supplies available and stocked.
• Maintains board certification and/or minimum annual CEU requirements as set by certifying bodies and organization/industry standards.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Third Party Risk Management

jobs.description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.

What You’ll Do

The CISO organization at CoreWeave is responsible for executing and delivering security, trust, and assurance across our products, platforms, and operations.  Within this organization, the Security Trust & Assurance team is building leading Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) programs, including third party risk management (TPRM).

As a TPRM Technical Program Manager, you will work with cross-functional teams, including engineering, procurement, IT, and Legal to govern CoreWeave’s external data sharing.  This is a hands-on and operational role that will directly contribute to CoreWeave’s security and privacy objectives.

If you are passionate about cloud technologies, thrive in complex technical environments, and excel at orchestrating large-scale programs, we want to hear from you!

In this role, you will:

• Maintain a complete register of external data shares, including data categories, purpose, legal basis, transfer mechanism, and contractual restrictions.

• Define and operationalize controls for onboarding new external shares: pre-share review, minimization, approved transfer methods, and documented approvals.

• Monitor external data flows to detect undocumented, expired, or out-of-scope sharing, and drive remediation to closure with the accountable teams.

• Establish metrics and reporting on data mapping coverage and external sharing risk for leadership and governance forums.

• Contribute to the the Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) strategy and roadmap, ensuring alignment with CoreWeave's overall security, privacy, and business objectives

• Oversee & execute third party security risk assessments, including analysis of appropriate security controls, contract requirements, and compliance documentation

• Act as the primary subject matter expert (SME) for technical TPRM & Privacy risks, effectively communicating complex concepts and remediation strategies to technical and executive audiences

• Tailor communications to a diverse audience and remain adaptable to a wide range of personalities and technical depth

Investing in our people is one of our top priorities, and we value candidates who can bring their diversified experiences to our teams. Here are some qualities we’ve found compatible with our team. We'd love to talk about whether this aligns with your experience and interests and what you’re excited to work on next.

Who You Are

Minimum Qualifications

• 5+ years of experience in third-party risk management, data governance, privacy, or information security risk, with at least 2 years focused on external data sharing.

• Demonstrated experience building or maintaining data inventories/data maps, including data classification, processing purpose, legal basis, and cross-border transfer mechanisms.

• Experience implementing continuous or automated monitoring of data flows

• Relevant certifications such as CIPP/E, CIPM, CIPT, CISSP, CISA, CISM, or CRISC.

• Working knowledge of major privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA/CPRA) and transfer mechanisms such as SCCs, DPAs, and adequacy decisions.

• Hands-on experience conducting third-party security risk assessments, including evaluation of security controls, contractual security/privacy terms, and compliance artifacts (SOC 2, ISO 27001, penetration test reports).

• Familiarity with common security control frameworks (NIST CSF, ISO 27001/27701, SOC 2) and the ability to assess control adequacy for a given data-sharing scenario.

• Experience designing and operating a repeatable review or approval workflow, and driving remediation items to closure with cross-functional owners.

• Ability to define and report metrics to leadership and governance committees, translating technical risk into business impact.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with proven ability to adapt messaging for both engineering teams and executive stakeholders.

• Comfort operating with ambiguity in a fast-moving environment and building programs where limited process exists.

Additional Qualifications

• Experience working with CSPs/Hyperscalers.

• Ability to write light-weight automation or queries (SQL, Python, or scripting) to pull, reconcile, and validate data-sharing inventories at scale.

• Experience supporting audits or certifications and responding to customer or regulator inquiries about subprocessor and data-sharing practices.

• Experience negotiating or reviewing DPAs, subprocessor agreements, and security exhibits alongside legal and procurement teams.

• Prior work building a program from the ground up rather than operating an established one.

The base salary range for this role is $157,000 to $210,000. The starting salary will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).

What We Offer

The range we’ve posted represents the typical compensation range for this role. To determine actual compensation, we review the market rate for each candidate which can include a variety of factors. These include qualifications, experience, interview performance, and location.

In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs. The benefits below reflect our US-based offerings for full-time employees; for roles in other locations, benefits vary and are shared during the hiring process. These include:

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance - 100% paid for by CoreWeave

• Company-paid Life Insurance

• Voluntary supplemental life insurance

• Short and long-term disability insurance

• Flexible Spending Account

• Health Savings Account

• Tuition Reimbursement

• Ability to Participate in Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)

• Mental Wellness Benefits through Spring Health

• Family-Forming support provided by Carrot

• Paid Parental Leave

• Flexible, full-service childcare support with Kinside

• 401(k) with a generous employer match

• Flexible PTO

• Catered lunch each day in our office and data center locations

• A casual work environment

• A work culture focused on innovative disruption

California Applicants

California Consumer Privacy Act

Equal Opportunity & Accommodations

CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. All qualified applicants and candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.

As part of this commitment and consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), CoreWeave will ensure that qualified applicants and candidates with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations for the hiring process, unless such accommodation would cause an undue hardship. If reasonable accommodation is needed, please contact: careers@coreweave.com.

Export Control Compliance

This position requires access to export controlled information. To conform to U.S. Government export regulations applicable to that information, applicant must either be (A) a U.S. person, defined as a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful permanent resident (green card holder), (iii) refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, (B) eligible to access the export controlled information without a required export authorization, or (C) eligible and reasonably likely to obtain the required export authorization from the applicable U.S. government agency.  CoreWeave may, for legitimate business reasons, decline to pursue any export licensing process.

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
About the Role:

We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to join our DevOps team at K Health. You will own and evolve the infrastructure underpinning a healthcare AI platform serving patients and enterprise health system partners. This is a high-ownership role: you will architect and operate cloud environments across K Health and its enterprise partners, lead complex infrastructure migrations, drive disaster recovery programs, and help build the next generation of AI-powered operations tooling. You will also mentor junior engineers and collaborate closely with product and engineering teams across the company. This is a hybrid role based in New York City (4 days/week in office) and includes participation in a daytime on-call rotation.

What you will do:

• Own the design, implementation, and evolution of our GKE-based Kubernetes infrastructure across K Health and enterprise partner environments.

• Build and maintain our Terraform modular infrastructure library, including reusable modules with automated testing, across GCP, Cloudflare, and AWS.

• Architect, build, and maintain GitLab CI/CD shared pipeline templates used by all engineering teams (build, test, security scanning, deployment).

• Own and maintain self-hosted infrastructure software running in-cluster, including GitLab, ArgoCD, Langfuse, DependencyTrack, NGINX Ingress, and others.

• Implement and support security and compliance controls across infrastructure and the software supply chain - secrets management, pipeline secret detection, container scanning, SOC2 and HIPAA.

• Drive disaster recovery readiness: design failover scenarios, author runbooks, and lead periodic DR tests.

• Lead development of AI-powered operations tooling and agentic infrastructure.

• Monitor, troubleshoot, and improve production system reliability; respond to incidents during on-call shifts.

• Mentor junior DevOps engineers and establish team-wide engineering standards.

What we are looking for:

• 5+ years of experience in DevOps, platform engineering, or site reliability engineering.

• Deep, hands-on experience with Kubernetes and the surrounding ecosystem - Helm, Helmfile, ArgoCD, Kyverno, cert-manager, and NGINX Ingress.

• Extensive experience with Google Cloud Platform - GKE, Cloud SQL, Memorystore, Cloud Storage, IAM, and Workload Identity.

• Strong Terraform expertise: modular architecture, multi-environment provisioning, and automated testing.

• Advanced knowledge of GitLab CI/CD and GitOps practices.

• Proficiency in Python and/or Go.

Plus:

• Advanced Bash scripting skills.

• Experience with secrets management solutions such as Akeyless or HashiCorp Vault.

• Experience with database administration across PostgreSQL, Redis, and MongoDB - including DR configuration and operational runbooks.

• Experience with Datadog or equivalent observability platform (APM, infrastructure, log management).

• Experience with Cloudflare for DNS, CDN, and security rules management.

• Demonstrated experience designing and executing disaster recovery programs, including failover testing and runbook authorship.

Bonus:

• Experience in highly regulated environments - SOC2 and HIPAA.

• Excellent communication skills with the ability to lead cross-functional infrastructure initiatives.

• Demonstrated leadership experience, including mentoring junior engineers.

• Experience with HPC or GPU cluster infrastructure, including Slurm..

• Experience building or operating AI agents or agentic infrastructure.

• Experience with microservices architecture and API gateway / reverse proxy patterns.

• Experience with AWS.

Who We Are:

Behind every leading health system is K Health’s AI-powered virtual care engine.

Our deeply integrated model modernizes the primary care loop by using AI to put humans first. For our patients, we offer clinical AI (i.e., PatientGPT) and unparalleled access to close care gaps around the clock. For our Providers, we deliver provider-serving agentic solutions (i.e., Perfect Note) to eliminate administrative overload and burnout. And for the health systems, we deploy our top-grade Virtualists in AI-powered virtual clinics 24/7 to capture the patients' care journeys at step one, retain the journey through the system for longitudinal care, and strengthen profitability.

We’re founded in 2016, headquartered in New York City, and backed by over $443.5M from leading investors including Valor Equity Partners, Claure Group, Mangrove Capital Partners, 14W, Notable Capital, Lerer Hippeau, Primary Venture Partners, Comcast Ventures, PICO Venture Partners, Max Ventures, and other strategic healthcare partners.

We offer competitive compensation packages based on industry benchmarks for function, level, and geographic location. Offer amounts are determined by multiple factors such as a candidate's experience and expertise.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and consider applicants for employment regardless of race, ethnicity, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, childbirth and breastfeeding, age, citizenship, military or veteran status, or any other class protected by applicable federal, state, and local laws. We’re deeply committed to building teams as diverse as the patients we serve and strive to cultivate an environment where everyone can bring their most authentic self to work. We depend on our differences to make our team stronger, our workplace more dynamic, and our product accessible to all of our users.

We are committed to maintaining the integrity of our hiring process and ensuring a safe environment for all candidates. At Paychex, you'll have the opportunity to grow your career, make a meaningful impact, and be part of something bigger as One Paychex.

Overview

Where Complexity Meets Structure and Top Performers Win

There is a reason enterprise buyers are moving to Paycor. We built something no one else in the market can replicate: AI-enabled enterprise technology backed by the deepest operational expertise in the HCM industry. Our platform is purpose-built for how enterprise HR and finance actually work. When you sell for Paycor, you are not asking buyers to take a leap of faith. You are bringing them the answer the market has been waiting for.

Enterprise Sales at Paycor is built for experienced sellers who want to operate at a higher level. You’ll partner with organizations of 100+ employees, helping them solve complex workforce challenges through a modern, end-to-end HCM platform and service experience.

This is a true new-logo, advisory services role, focused on building a pipeline, running disciplined sales cycles, and closing high-impact deals. You’ll work within a structured selling environment with defined territories, clear go-to-market plays, integrated sales support tools, and opportunities to develop Centers of Influence (COI) partnerships and expand your professional network—so you can focus on what matters most: winning.

jobs.title: Senior Advisory Solutions Consultant
jobs.description:
Here at Appian, our values of Intensity and Excellence define who we are. We set high standards and live up to them, ensuring that everything we do is done with care and quality. We approach every challenge with ambition and commitment, holding ourselves and each other accountable to achieve the best results. When you join Appian, you’ll be part of a passionate team dedicated to accomplishing hard things, together.

Senior Advisory Solutions Consultant

Redefine what it means to be a technical advisor by architecting mission-critical cloud solutions that power our nation's most vital public sector agencies.

Location: Remote | Work Model: Remote field role

Note: In accordance with Appian's McLean headquarters policy for this search profile, this position is full-time on-site.

About the Team

The Solutions Consulting organization at Appian sits at the vital center of our global commercial engine, bridging the gap between sophisticated enterprise business needs and cutting-edge platform capabilities to secure the technical win. Our mission is to prove the undeniable value of Appian’s platform within the AI-Powered Process Automation market, driving customer acquisition and fueling corporate growth. Under our SC 2.0 operating model, our consultants don't just demo features—they tell compelling stories, co-create solutions with customers, and help shape strategy with technical credibility and business insight.

The Opportunity

Ready to take your career to the next level alongside the smartest, most creative people in the tech industry? As a Senior Advisory Solutions Consultant, you will step into a highly visible, strategic role serving as the trusted advisor for federal agencies, partners, sales leadership, and product teams. This is a game-changing opportunity to own account strategy and technical orchestration for strategic opportunities, translating intricate agency requirements directly into groundbreaking technical solutions that fuel our next stage of hyper-growth within our Enterprise-Grade Orchestration ecosystem.

What You’ll Do

• Own Account Strategy: Own the technical strategy for strategic accounts and complex sales campaigns, acting as a true co-seller with Account Executives sharing accountability for pipeline health and revenue contribution.

• Facilitate Executive Workshops: Lead customer roadmap sessions, transformation workshops, and executive visioning discussions to connect customer objectives to Appian capabilities.

• Architect Custom Solutions: Lead the scoping, design, and delivery of high-quality, custom technical Proof of Concepts (POCs) and Proof of Values (POVs) with executive sponsorship and clear success criteria.

• Navigate Complex Landscapes: Understand customer IT landscapes including ERP, CRM, data, workflow, AI, partner solutions, and modern web or enterprise development systems to integrate Appian into complex enterprise environments.

• Own Technical Validation: Direct the technical response and functional strategy required to respond to complex functional and technical elements of RFIs, RFPs, security reviews, and architecture discussions.

• Influence Product Roadmap: Convey real-world customer requirements directly to core Product Management teams, actively serving as a vital feedback loop to influence Appian's long-term product roadmap.

• Scale & Mentor: Coach peers, lead field enablement sessions, and contribute strategic reusable assets, blueprints, and customer success stories to scale best practices.

Required Qualifications

• Education: Minimum of a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Information Technology, Business Information Technology, or a related technical or business field.

• Experience: 8+ years of successful experience as a Pre-Sales Engineer, Solutions Consultant, or related enterprise software pre-sales professional, OR 10+ years in a client-facing Professional Services or technical consulting role heavily involved in enterprise sales scenarios.

• Technical Depth: Recent hands-on programming experience or technical fluency within modern development environments using languages such as Java, JavaScript, Python, C#, or C++, alongside database proficiency (SQL, HTML, XML).

• Communication & Leadership: Exceptional communication and influencing skills with a proven ability to conduct deep discovery, analyze requirements, present to executives, and engage C-level audiences.

• Travel: Willingness to travel up to 50% to customer locations throughout the assigned region.

Preferred Qualifications

• Prior experience selling into the Federal or Public Sector landscape with an emphasis on Application Development Platforms, AI-enabled automation, or Case Management frameworks.

• Experience contributing reusable demos, technical assets, enablement content, or industry points of view.

• We value experience with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce or ServiceNow, as these skills translate well into our Enterprise-Grade Orchestration environment.

#SaaS #PreSales #SolutionsConsultant #PublicSectorTech #EnterpriseSoftware #LI-MB1

The base salary range per provided represents a good faith and reasonable estimate of the range at the time of posting. Actual compensation will be dependent on a number of factors including, but not limited to, the candidate’s relevant work experience, qualifications, internal peer equity, and market and business conditions that exist when extending an offer. Sales roles may be eligible to participate in a commission plan subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.

In addition, Appian provides generous benefits offerings that include a 401(k) plan with company match, flexible time off, paid parental leave, medical, dental, and vision plans, life insurance, disability insurance, wellness programs, flexible spending accounts, health savings account contributions, an employee referral bonus program, and learning and development resources. Certain positions may be eligible for equity awards.

Pay and benefits are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation, commission, bonus, or benefit plans.

Base Salary Range

$152,000—$237,500 USD

Tools and Resources

• Training and Development: During onboarding, we focus on equipping new hires with the skills and knowledge for success through department-specific training. Continuous learning is a central focus at Appian, with dedicated mentorship and the First-Friend program being widely utilized resources for new hires.

• Growth Opportunities: Appian provides a diverse array of growth and development opportunities, including our leadership program tailored for new and aspiring managers, a comprehensive library of specialized department training through Appian University, skills based training, and tuition reimbursement for those aiming to advance their education. This commitment ensures that employees have access to a holistic range of development opportunities.

• Community: We’ll immerse you into our community rooted in respect starting on day one. Appian fosters inclusivity through our 8 employee-led affinity groups. These groups help employees build stronger internal and external networks by planning social, educational, and outreach activities to connect with Appianites and larger initiatives throughout the company.

Benefits

Appian offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, wellbeing, and financial future. Benefits may include health coverage, Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with free mental health support, life and disability insurance, an Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP), a retirement/pension plan, wellness dollars, tuition reimbursement, family-forming benefits and more. Benefits vary by country—please ask your Talent Acquisition contact for details specific to the location you are applying to.

Appian provides AI automation for mission-critical work. We automate complex processes in large enterprises and governments. Our platform is known for its unique reliability and scale. jobs.title: Editor, Local Newsletters
jobs.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for.

The New York Times launched a newsletter this summer in Minneapolis-St. Paul as a pilot for a new local journalism initiative. We are now expanding to Phoenix and Nashville, and seeking an experienced, innovative editor who is rooted in one of those three cities.

In this role, you will be the day-to-day point person for at least two of the newsletters, which will publish at least three times each week, as well as an important part of the growing Local team. You will work closely with reporters in each city to shape the tone, structure and content of the newsletters, aiming to break news and drive conversation. You will help hosts select topics of focus and frame stories; ensure that each dispatch contains a lively and engaging mix of items, including visuals; line-edit the copy and manage production;  track progress against goals; and run experiments to maximize impact.

The Local offers a blend of essential and delightful information designed to make readers more connected to their community and more conversant around the news. The newsletters will  be a bridge connecting residents of each place to the full breadth of The Times and Games, Wirecutter, NYT Cooking and The Athletic.They will showcase high-quality independent journalism from local sources, and as editor, you will help develop working partnerships with news organizations and influencers based in each area.

The newsletters help audiences understand the forces driving change around them; introduce readers to interesting characters and places they might not know; moderate and shape discussion  on public issues; curate the best relevant content from the vast digital information ecosystem; and build relationships with their audiences through callouts, social media and in-person events.

Candidates should be deeply rooted in the Twin Cities, Phoenix or Nashville. They must have significant experience in local journalism and be committed to it as a pillar of a functioning democracy. A proven track record of engaging audiences digitally is essential; prior work on newsletters is a plus, and love for them a requirement. We’re seeking journalists with broad interests across news, politics, business, culture, sports and other beats, as well as an understanding of audience needs and the local media ecosystem.

The editor will work remotely from one of the three cities and report in to the newsletter team . Please submit a resume, cover letter and about six work samples of any format — for example, newsletters, videos or traditional clips — that you have edited or written.

Responsibilities:

• Edit The Local newsletter in at least two of its launch markets, including front-end story selection/shaping as well as day-to-day line-editing and production

• Work with reporters in each market and The Local team in New York to shape the tone, structure and content of the newsletter, experimenting with story formats and other tools along the way

• Help grow the newsletter’s audience and engagement through social media, events, callouts, partnerships and other tactics

• Nurture relationships with local news organizations and journalists who share The Times’ values and develop new ways to partner with them

• Monitor the latest in how other news organizations and brands are engaging their communities and building fandom, and look for ways to leverage those ideas

• Help develop engagement goals and track our progress against them, using data to inform our understanding of what is working and to seed innovation and experiments

• Represent The Local at community/media events and help plan/run our own

• Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world

• This role will report into the Deputy Editorial Director, Newsletters

Basic Qualifications:

• 8+ years’ experience working in digital journalism or storytelling, including some editing

• Demonstrated superb news judgment, audience-first thinking and coverage experience across breaking news, features, analysis and enterprise

• Experience with newsletters and social media, and a love for/commitment to both (experience in video, audio and data-journalism are a plus)

• Fluency with analytics tools to yield actionable insights

• Ability to identify and develop story ideas with both journalistic significance and audience resonance

• Track record showing initiative and landing digital media projects

Preferred Qualifications:

• Demonstrated commitment to integrity, independence and accuracy

• Collaborative spirit, willingness to experiment and a sense of humor

• Deep connections to Phoenix, Nashville or Minneapolis-St. Paul

• Omnivorous interests and a commitment to local journalism

This position is represented by the NewsGuild of NY.

jobs.title: Founding Growth Manager
jobs.description:
Who we are

Melotech is revolutionizing media and entertainment. We create art through technology for humans to enjoy. In just 24 months, our work has been heard, watched and loved for over 3 billion minutes worldwide.

Founded by entrepreneur and investor Soheil Mirpour, we are backed by top VCs Cherry Ventures, Speedinvest and GFC, alongside world-class angels from firms such as Spotify, Blackstone and KKR.



What you will do

Melotech is scaling fast, and paid acquisition is one of the engines behind it. As Growth Manager, you own that engine end to end: the budget, the channels, the creative testing and the numbers behind them. This is a paid acquisition role first, measured on what every unit of spend brings back. You decide where the budget goes across a large portfolio of releases and campaigns, in a business where small improvements compound, and you work directly with our founders, product and data team.

Today that means dozens of campaigns, hundreds of ad sets and thousands of creatives across Meta, TikTok and Snapchat. Your first job is to tame that volume: decide what to consolidate and what to split, separate testing from scaling, and segment by geography, age and placement so every number means something.



On a typical day, your tasks may include:

 - Account structure: deciding what to consolidate and what to split, keeping testing and scaling apart, and segmenting ad sets by geography, age and placement

 - Campaign operations: running the campaigns day to day on Meta, TikTok and Snapchat, including budgets, pacing and the targets behind them

 - Creative pipeline: building a system that keeps new creatives flowing every week, with clear rules for what wins and what gets killed, and briefs that turn last week's numbers into next week's ads

 - Creative partners: directing editors, video producers, UGC creators and agencies to the volume and quality the account needs

 - Portfolio allocation: moving budget across many releases and campaigns on data, weighing upside against risk

 - Measurement: knowing which metric answers which question, for example what CPM tells you that CPC does not, and catching a shift in cost the day it happens

 - Tooling: building the reports, scripts and automations you need, with the ad platform APIs and AI tools as your daily coworkers



Who you are

We're looking for a hands-on paid operator who thinks like a trader, or a sharp growth generalist who has done the buying. Either way, you have run real budgets yourself, not through a team or an agency, and you can show the numbers.

Typically, your profile will look like this:

 - Experience: 2 to 7 years of hands-on paid buying, ideally in a startup or small team where you set things up yourself

 - Paid social channel ownership: you have owned Meta, TikTok or Snapchat end to end, ideally more than one of them and more than once, and you have run accounts at real volume, so you can explain how you structured hundreds of ad sets and thousands of creatives without losing control of them

 - Creative testing at scale: you test on a schedule with kill rules, direct creative partners instead of making the ads, and notice when a hook or format is burning out; ideally you bring a network of trusted editors, creators and agencies

 - Portfolio optimization: you are comfortable allocating a budget across many bets with thin margins and making structured decisions under uncertainty; experience with game portfolios, app portfolios, e-commerce with many products or similar is a plus

 - Measurement and payback: you check what platforms report against your own data, you have run holdout or lift tests, you judge spend by payback, not cost per click, and you know which metric answers which question, for example what CPM tells you that CPC does not

 - Data and tooling: you work in SQL or Python, have used the ad platform APIs, and build your own reporting and automations; a data science background is a plus

 - Pace: you thrive in a fast-paced and performance-oriented environment

 - A big plus: you stay close to what works in paid social right now, and you're into music, media, gaming or social



What makes this exciting

You own a lever the whole company feels. Every point of acquisition cost you take out shows up directly in how fast we can grow. You're not a cog in the machine but the captain of your own ship, rewarded for performance and respected for leadership. Flat hierarchies mean that your voice matters, your ideas get implemented, and your impact is immediate.

We pay competitive salaries and make you an owner of the business with equity. We work remotely to give you complete freedom over your life, while meeting regularly around the world for global offsites where we strategize, bond, and push boundaries together.



What the process will look like

We hire on a rolling basis. Earliest starting date is always ASAP.

Once you begin our process, you can progress from start to offer within a week, depending on how quickly you can move through each stage:

 1. Initial interview: 30-minute introductory call, getting to know you

 2. Case interview: 90-minute case discussion, present and debate your skills

 3. Founder interview: 90-minute interview with our CEO, going deep on all topics

 4. Offer, contract signing and onboarding



Note: As we are still in stealth, you will learn more about Melotech as you progress through the stages. By the end of the Founder interview, you will have a full grasp of our business and the details of your role.

Recorded Future is seeking a Senior Demand Generation Manager to build and run the integrated campaigns that drive engagement and pipeline from our target account list. This is a builder's role: you'll develop the demand engine that identifies, prioritizes, and engages target accounts based on intent and engagement signals, then turn product positioning and content strategy into campaigns that run across channels and regions. You'll own campaigns end to end — from brief to reporting — bringing together the right audiences, messages, and channel mix to generate demand, and you'll work closely with Product Marketing, Marketing Operations, Content, and Sales to do it. You use AI tools and marketing technology to work smarter and faster. You'll be accountable for a pipeline number, owning your campaigns' performance from strategy through execution and results.

This role requires working from the Recorded Future office in Boston, MA at least 3 days per week.

What You'll Do:

Program Strategy and Execution

• Build and manage always-on demand generation programs aligned to our solution pillars — continuously refining targeting, messaging, and mix based on performance

• Plan and execute across digital and offline channels — including paid media, email, organic, webinars, and direct mail — to drive global enterprise pipeline

• Own program briefs, asset requirements, and the ongoing cadence of activity within each program

• Lead campaign kickoffs so every stakeholder understands their role, outputs, and timing — and revisit/refresh that alignment as programs evolve

Intent-Based Targeting and Segmentation

• Build intent-based marketing into campaign design, using intent and engagement signals to prioritize accounts, time outreach, and trigger the right touch at the right moment across the funnel

• Develop and refine target account segmentation to identify and engage accounts when they're in-market

Cross-Functional Partnership

• Work closely with Product Marketing to translate positioning and content strategy into executable campaigns

• Partner with Marketing Operations to ensure campaigns are properly built, tracked, and reported on

• Partner with Sales and BDR teams to maintain a feedback loop that improves conversion

• Collaborate with Content to scope and produce the assets each program needs — from campaign copy and landing pages to webinar collateral — keeping requests aligned to program timelines and solution pillar priorities

Performance and Reporting

• Track and analyze performance across the full funnel — conversion rates, MQLs, SQLs, and pipeline generated/influenced — to understand what's working and why

• Report out on program performance against goals on an ongoing basis, calling out wins, misses, and the "so what" for what comes next

• Use performance data to continuously optimize targeting, messaging, channel mix, and spend allocation across live programs

• Partner with Marketing Operations to ensure accurate attribution and campaign tracking from the start of planning, not just at reporting time

What You'll Bring:

• 10+ years of experience in demand generation, growth marketing, or B2B SaaS marketing, with a proven track record of owning a pipeline number

• Experience building and running integrated, multi-channel campaigns (paid, email, organic, direct mail) for global enterprise audiences

• Hands-on experience with intent data and engagement signals to inform account prioritization and campaign timing

• A creative, results-focused approach to campaign development

• Strong analytical skills — comfortable digging into your own campaign data and performance metrics without relying on others to interpret results

• Highly organized communicator who can juggle multiple programs simultaneously and lead cross-functional kickoffs with clarity

• Comfort using AI tools and modern marketing technology to move faster and work more efficiently

jobs.title: Founding Product Engineer
jobs.description:
Founding Product Engineer

Jampack AI · Full-time · New York City (In-office) · Reports to CEO & CTO

About Jampack

Jampack builds AI agents that run wholesale operations, replacing spreadsheets, email chains, and manual data entry with automated workflows. We power brands like Fishwife, immi, and PATH, handling everything from purchase orders and freight coordination to invoicing and payment reconciliation.

We’ve raised a $3.2M seed round led by Maveron, Timber Grove Ventures, and industry operators. We’re a small team working closely with customers to build the AI-native operating system for wholesale.

The Role

We’re hiring our first dedicated design hire: a founding product engineer with impeccable taste who will own how the product looks, feels, and works.

You might be an engineer who designs or a designer who codes. Either way, you can take an idea, figure out how it should work, and build a polished interface that customers use.

Our customers run wholesale operations. They’re managing orders, coordinating shipments, and keeping their businesses moving. We want to make complex, consequential work feel calm, fast, and intuitive.

You’ll primarily create new product experiences from scratch. You own the experience, design, and frontend implementation, partnering with engineers on the backend. A central part of the job is discovering how people should interact with AI agents that do real work on their behalf.

What You’ll Do

- Own experiences from first sketch to production. Work through user flows, explore designs, build prototypes, ship the frontend, and watch customers use it.
- Make complex workflows feel simple. Turn dense information and operational detail into clear interfaces that help people understand what matters and what to do next.
- Discover how people should work with agents. Explore and test interaction patterns that make the product understandable, useful, and easy to trust.
- Build the foundations for consistent craft. Create reusable components and patterns that help the whole team ship better interfaces faster.
- Work directly with customers. Learn how operators think, test prototypes with them, and use their feedback to improve what you ship.

What We’re Looking For

- 4+ years of experience designing and building products at fast-growing startups. You can show us work you personally took from idea to production, how you adapted to changing priorities, and how you balanced shipping quickly with a high bar for craft.
- Exceptional UI/UX taste. You have a point of view on what good looks and feels like, and you can explain the decisions behind your work.
- The ability to design and build. You have strong frontend fundamentals and can independently ship production interfaces.
- Thoughtful systems thinking. You recognize when a component or interaction pattern can make several parts of the product better.
- Initiative and follow-through. You can take an incomplete idea, ask useful questions, share work early, and carry it through to a working product.
- Curiosity about AI experiences. You’re excited to explore what software can become when agents can take action for the user.

Have fewer than four years of experience? We also welcome exceptional early-career candidates whose work demonstrates strong taste and an ability to ship. Personal projects, experiments, and professional work all count.

Why Jampack

- Shape the product from the beginning. As our first dedicated design hire, you’ll establish the patterns and level of craft the team builds on.
- Work on an open design problem. How people work alongside AI agents is still being figured out. You’ll help discover what works.
- Build for real customers moving the real economy. You’ll have direct access to the operators using your work and see how your decisions affect their day-to-day operations.
- Work closely with the founders. You’ll partner directly with the CEO and CTO, with engineering support to bring your ideas into production.

Show Us Your Work

Share whatever best demonstrates your taste and ability to ship: a live product, side project, prototype, portfolio, or something else you’ve made. Tell us what you personally designed and built, and one decision you’re proud of.

Compensation

$160,000–$220,000 base salary + meaningful equity

jobs.title: Senior Procurement & Contracts Analyst
jobs.description:
Here at Appian, our values of Intensity and Excellence define who we are. We set high standards and live up to them, ensuring that everything we do is done with care and quality. We approach every challenge with ambition and commitment, holding ourselves and each other accountable to achieve the best results. When you join Appian, you’ll be part of a passionate team dedicated to accomplishing hard things, together.

You will own the operational backbone of Appian's technology vendor ecosystem, ensuring procurement velocity, contract governance, and cross-functional alignment that powers enterprise-scale AI-Powered Process Automation growth.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Procurement team—operating within Appian’s Finance and Operations organization—is the strategic and operational engine driving global corporate initiatives forward. As Appian expands its footprint in AI-Powered Process Automation, Procurement ensures our internal business resilience and shared services scale safely, swiftly, and cost-effectively. We act as the critical operational bridge between technology investments, vendor ecosystem management, and corporate governance.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Appian is scaling rapidly, and we are looking for a sharp, commercially minded professional to join our Procurement team as a Senior Procurement & Contracts Analyst. In this role, you will take day-to-day ownership of technology vendor sourcing, intake governance, Purchase Order (PO) execution, and Vendor Contract Management (VCM) workflow governance. This position sits at the vital intersection of Procurement operations, financial execution, and risk governance. Success requires strong organizational awareness, sound business judgment, and the agility to navigate ambiguous requirements with poise. You will triage incoming procurement requests, lead commercial negotiations, generate POs within our P2P system, and manage contract flows in VCM to ensure cross-functional approvals proceed without friction.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Drive Intake & Triage Operations: : Manage the inbound procurement request queue, applying established governance rules, triage protocols, and SLAs. Analyze incoming requests to determine appropriate review paths, contract templates, and delegated approval thresholds.

• Navigate Ambiguity & Apply Corporate Judgment: Thrives in dynamic, high-growth environments by translating ambiguous business needs into structured procurement strategies, applying pragmatic business sense to balance velocity with risk mitigation.

• Leverage Organizational Awareness: Build influence and drive cross-functional alignment across Legal, Finance, IT, and executive business partners, adeptly navigating internal structures and decision-making processes to accelerate approvals.

• Oversee VCM Workflows & Approvals: Manage the operational usage of our Vendor Contract Management (VCM) system. Ensure seamless execution of contract workflows, monitor pending approvals, drive bottleneck resolution, and enforce digital signature policies across corporate stakeholders.

• Execute P2P Workflows & PO Creation: Drive end-to-end Procure-to-Pay (P2P) execution, including generating, validating, and issuing Purchase Orders (POs) aligned with executed contract terms, budget approvals, and accounting codes.

• Lead Commercial Sourcing & Negotiation : Manage assigned corporate and technology sourcing engagements. Lead commercial negotiations, evaluate vendor pricing models, and structure commercial terms to maximize ROI.

• Coordinate Cross-Functional Risk Alignment: Serve as a key Procurement liaison to Legal and risk oversight functions. Facilitate contract handoffs, track redlines, and ensure non-standard commercial or legal terms are properly escalated.

• Monitor Vendor Records & Data Integrity: Manage long-term supplier relationships, SLAs, and performance metrics. Define and enforce data taxonomies, repository structures, and data validation rules to maintain audit-ready vendor and contract records.

• Deliver FinOps Analytics & Executive Reporting: Maintain operational procurement reports and dashboards, providing visibility into spend metrics, PO volumes, VCM turnaround times, and renewal pipelines for leadership.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Finance, Legal Studies, Procurement, or a related functional discipline.

• Experience: 4–6+ years of progressive experience in corporate procurement, strategic sourcing, P2P operations, technology category management, or commercial contracting.

• Domain Mastery: Solid command of commercial terms, P2P processes, PO processing, financial mechanics, and cross-functional triage workflows.

• Professional Competencies: Demonstrated ability to operate effectively amidst ambiguity, applying sound corporate judgment, organizational awareness, and clear communication to drive consensus.

• System Proficiency: Hands-on experience navigating and operating Vendor Contract Management (VCM) tools, P2P software, intake ticketing systems, and enterprise Procurement platforms.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Direct experience handling technology contracts (SaaS, software licensing, IT services) in growth-stage enterprise software companies.

The base salary range represents a good faith and reasonable estimate of the range at the time of posting. Actual compensation will be dependent on a number of factors including, but not limited to, the candidate’s relevant work experience, qualifications, internal peer equity, and market and business conditions that exist when extending an offer. A discretionary bonus may be awarded in recognition of individual and company performance.

In addition, Appian provides generous benefits offerings that include a 401(k) plan with company match, flexible time off, paid parental leave, medical, dental, and vision plans, life insurance, disability insurance, wellness programs, flexible spending accounts, health savings account contributions, an employee referral bonus program, and learning and development resources. Certain positions may be eligible for equity awards.

Pay and benefits are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation, commission, bonus, or benefit plans.

Base Salary Range

$75,000—$150,000 USD

Tools and Resources

• Training and Development: During onboarding, we focus on equipping new hires with the skills and knowledge for success through department-specific training. Continuous learning is a central focus at Appian, with dedicated mentorship and the First-Friend program being widely utilized resources for new hires.

• Growth Opportunities: Appian provides a diverse array of growth and development opportunities, including our leadership program tailored for new and aspiring managers, a comprehensive library of specialized department training through Appian University, skills based training, and tuition reimbursement for those aiming to advance their education. This commitment ensures that employees have access to a holistic range of development opportunities.

• Community: We’ll immerse you into our community rooted in respect starting on day one. Appian fosters inclusivity through our 8 employee-led affinity groups. These groups help employees build stronger internal and external networks by planning social, educational, and outreach activities to connect with Appianites and larger initiatives throughout the company.

Benefits

Appian offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, wellbeing, and financial future. Benefits may include health coverage, Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with free mental health support, life and disability insurance, an Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP), a retirement/pension plan, wellness dollars, tuition reimbursement, family-forming benefits and more. Benefits vary by country—please ask your Talent Acquisition contact for details specific to the location you are applying to.

About Appian

Appian provides AI automation for mission-critical work. We automate complex processes in large enterprises and governments. Our platform is known for its unique reliability and scale. We’ve been automating processes for more than 25 years and understand enterprise operations like no one else. For more information, visit appian.com. [Nasdaq: APPN]

jobs.title: Radiologic Technologist (Rad Tech)
jobs.description:
At ConvenientMD, we’re on a mission to make good health more convenient for all – working to improve how patients and providers experience healthcare in New England. To support this belief, we’re building a team of dedicated professionals who genuinely care about improving lives, are passionate about work that can make a difference, and are driven to learn from one another.

The Opportunity

As a Radiologic Technologist (RT), you’ll play a vital role in our mission to provide high-quality care by combining your radiology expertise with hands-on clinical support. In our fast-paced urgent care clinics, you’ll work closely with a collaborative team to make a meaningful difference in patients’ lives, ensuring they receive accurate diagnoses and the best possible treatment.

If you’re passionate about patient care and thrive in a dynamic environment, we’d love to have you join our team!

Be sure to ask your recruiter about our competitive sign-on bonus opportunities for full-time team members!

Your Impact

• Radiologic Procedures & Imaging: Prepare and perform radiologic procedures following ConvenientMD and ARRT protocols. Operate radiographic, fluoroscopic, and portable equipment, ensuring proper radiation safety and adhering to ALARA principles. Position patients for optimal imaging and completed document studies in EMR and PACS. Collaborate with radiologists for study interpretation, manage discrepancies, and coordinate outside imaging requests.

• Clinical Support: Efficiently switch between RT and Medical Assistant responsibilities. Conduct patient triage, including vital signs, medical history, and observational examination. Provide laboratory and diagnostic testing, screenings, and treatment for acute and chronic illnesses. Perform a variety of testing procedures, including vision, hearing, drug screening, pulmonary function testing, and point-of-care diagnostics (e.g., strep, flu, RSV, glucose, urinalysis). Maintain clean, sterile exam rooms and instruments to ensure a safe clinical environment.

• Patient Interaction: Support clinical care standards by adhering to ConvenientMD policies and delivering compassionate, patient-centered care.

• Quality Assurance & Inventory Tracking: Manage radiology supply inventory and submit orders as needed. Ensure medical equipment is operational through preventive maintenance and timely repairs. Participate in quality control and assurance studies to uphold clinical standards. Maintain accurate records, files, and documentation in alignment with HIPAA and ConvenientMD protocols.

• Team Collaboration & Training: Support onboarding and training for new clinic team members. Foster a positive work environment by collaborating with colleagues to deliver high-quality care. Communicate effectively with team members and external providers to ensure seamless patient care.

Who You Are

• Education, Licensure, & Certifications: High school diploma or GED required. State licensed with the American Registry of Radiologic Technologist (ARRT). Basic Life Support (BLS) certified.

• Experience: 1-2 years in radiology and patient care, preferably in urgent care or emergency settings.

• Compassionate, authentic, and patient focused: Supports patients through kindness; demonstrating understanding for others and contributing to the creating a community of belonging.

• Proactive and confident communicator (written and verbal): Foreshadows and elevates concerns as they arise, unafraid of professional directness both with colleagues and patients.

• Excellent team player: You enjoy collaborating with others and being a part of a strong team dynamic.

• Technically savvy: Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite or related software. Must be able and willing to navigate and learn multiple systems.

• Driven and self-motivated: Capable of working independently, possess a level of initiative and enthusiasm to help drive results. Actively identifying better ways of working. Uses resources to achieve the best outcomes for patients, the team, and the organization.

• Trustworthy: Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle all patient information in accordance with HIPAA regulations.

Pay Transparency

In order to maintain equity among team members, ConvenientMD has established defined hourly pay ranges for each role. Individual pay is determined based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to location, years of relevant experience, current market conditions, and budget considerations. The pay range listed reflects the potential compensation for this role within this region. Final compensation is determinedat the conclusion of the interview process. Additional incentives may be available for highly experienced full-time RTs in Massachusetts who are willing/able to travel to multiple locations. We encourage you to apply even if your desired compensation falls outside of the listed range.

Hourly Pay Range for this Position

$31.62—$50.40 USD

Why You'll Love Working With Us

• Collaborative team environment that encourages professional growth

• Urgent care services at no cost to our team members and their families

• Extensive benefit offerings including health, dental, and vision coverage, company paid short-term disability, and optional pet insurance

• 401k match after one year of service

• Access to our primary care (depending on location)

• Educational Alliance with Purdue University Global and reduced tuition rates for team members and their families

• Employer rewards and access to discounts offered on services and products such as hotels, travel, entertainment, restaurants, and more

With powerful AI Agents embedded across our platform, teams can analyze, test, and optimize user experiences faster than ever. Ranked #1 across multiple categories in G2’s Winter 2026 Report, Amplitude is the best-in-class solution for product, data, and marketing teams. Learn more at amplitude.com.

As an organization, we deliver for our customers by living our values. We operate from a place of humility, take ownership of problems and successes, approach challenges with a growth mindset, and put our customers at the center of everything we do.

Amplitude’s Commitment to Diversity Equity & Inclusion (DEI): Amplitude believes that diversity enables the creation of better products, improves the ability to solve complex problems, and drives more powerful solutions. We strive to create an environment of inclusion—one focused on psychological safety, empathy, and human connection—that will allow employees of all backgrounds to thrive.

Senior Product Engineer

At Amplitude, we’re building the operating system for digital products. While we’re known as the leader in product analytics, our Statsig team is redefining how companies learn, iterate, and ship better experiences.

Statsig is one of the fastest-growing and most strategic bets at Amplitude. It sits at the intersection of product, data, and decision-making, and we’re looking for a Product Engineer to help take it to the next level.

Why this role matters

This isn’t a “take tickets and ship code” role. You’ll operate as an owner, shaping both the product and the technical direction of a system used by some of the most sophisticated product teams in the world.

You’ll work across the stack, React frontend, Node.js and Python backend, to build intuitive, high-performance experiences that make experimentation accessible, powerful, and trustworthy.

What you’ll do

• Own critical product surfaces end-to-end from ideation to production and beyond

• Drive product direction in partnership with design and product leaders

• Build and evolve systems across React, Node.js, and Python that scale with customer growth

• Leverage modern AI tooling to dramatically accelerate development, prototyping, and iteration cycles

• Raise the bar for engineering quality - code, architecture, and user experience

• Lead by example - through hands-on development, technical mentorship, and thoughtful decision-making

• Move fast on ambiguous problems, turning ideas into shipped, customer-facing value

What we’re looking for

• 5+ years of experience in software engineering (full stack experience preferred)

• Education: B.S. in Computer Science or an equivalent technical field

• Proven experience operating at a senior-level scope. You’ve led large, ambiguous initiatives with significant business impact

• Strong full-stack expertise (React + backend systems such as Node.js and/or Python)

• A deep sense of ownership - you don’t wait for direction; you create it

• Exceptional product taste - you care deeply about UX, details, and building things people love

• An AI-native mindset - you actively use and experiment with the latest AI tools to amplify your impact and rethink how software gets built

• Ability to balance speed and quality in a high-velocity environment

• Strong judgment in technical trade-offs and system design

What sets you apart

• You think like a product builder first, engineer second

• You’re constantly reinventing how you work, using cutting-edge tools and workflows to achieve outsized results

• You’re energized by open-ended problems with no clear “right” answer

• You hold a high bar, not just for your own work, but for the team and product as a whole

• You turn ambiguity into clarity and momentum

Why Amplitude

• Work on a product used by thousands of companies to make better decisions

• Be part of a team that’s expanding beyond analytics into a full digital optimization platform

• Join a culture that values ownership, velocity, and craft

• Have outsized impact on a top company priority

Our values:

At Amplitude, our values guide how we show up for one another and for our customers:

• Humility: We operate from a place of empathy and openness, seeking to understand many points of view.

• Ownership: We take the initiative to solve problems that drive our shared company success.

• Growth Mindset: We’re tenacious in the face of challenges and seek feedback in order to grow ourselves and others.

• Customer Centricity: We put the customer at the center of everything we do and are deeply committed to their success.

We care about the well-being of our team: We offer competitive pay and benefits packages that reflect our commitment to the health and well-being of our Ampliteers.

Some of our benefit programs include:

• Excellent ​M​edical, ​D​ental and ​V​ision insurance coverages, with 100% employer-paid premiums for employee Medical, ​Dental,​ ​​​​​​​​Vision on select plans

• 401(k) retirement plan with an employer match of up to 1% of your eligible pay each pay period up to $2,000 annually

• Flexible time off, ​p​aid holidays, and more

• Generous stipends to spend on what matters most to you, whether that’s wellness (monthly), commuter transit/parking (monthly), learning and development (quarterly), new hire home office equipment, and much more

• Excellent Parental benefits including​:​ 12 weeks of Paid Parental Leave, Carrot Fertility Benefits/Adoption/Surrogacy support, Back-up Child Care support

• Mental health and wellness benefits including no cost employee access to Modern Health coaching & therapy sessions

• Employee Stock Purchase Program​ (ESPP)

Other fun facts about Amplitude:

• Our customers love us! They've said we're the #1 product analytics solution for 23 quarters in a row on G2.

• We care a lot about product innovation. We've made significant investments in talent and infrastructure to build the most powerful AI analytics platform on the market.

• We invest in our people. We offer mentorship programs, management training, and wellness initiatives.

• We give back to our communities. We give every Ampliteer a charitable giving grant and paid volunteer time off.
