jobs.title: General Counsel
jobs.description:
GENERAL COUNSEL



You'll run legal at Firecrawl, all of it. Strategy, risk posture, policy, the team, and the outside firms. Every question about what we can crawl, license, build, sign, and ship comes to you first, and the founders will treat your read as the read.

Firecrawl sits on some of the least settled legal ground in technology. The rules for web data access, AI training data, copyright, and who owns machine-generated output are being written right now: in courtrooms, in regulators' offices, and in the deals companies like ours sign every week. Our General Counsel doesn't wait for that to settle. You'll set Firecrawl's positions, defend them to customers, counterparties, and regulators, and, where it counts, help shape where the law lands.

You'll report to our CEO, lead and finish building the legal team (commercial and product counsel, a technical compliance program lead shared with our CTO, and legal operations), own outside counsel and the legal budget, and sit next to the founders on financings, board matters, and every decision with a legal edge, which at Firecrawl is most of them.



Salary Range: $310,000–$392,000 USD/year

Equity Range: Competitive equity. Details shared during the process.

Location: San Francisco, CA (SF HQ). On-site, five days a week.

Job Type: Full-Time

Experience: 12+ years of legal experience, including time running or helping run legal in-house at a venture-backed technology company

Work Authorization: Must be authorized to work in the United States. We're not able to sponsor US visas right now, though that may change down the line.




ABOUT FIRECRAWL

Firecrawl is the easiest way to turn the web into data AI agents can use. One API call converts any URL into clean, LLM-ready markdown or structured data. It's the boring-hard problem everyone building with LLMs eventually hits, solved.

We hit 8 figures in ARR in year one and more than doubled it in year two. We have 180k+ GitHub stars, putting us in the top 50 repositories of all time, and developers, agents, and category-defining AI companies build on us every day. Growth like this is rare, and we're just getting started.

We're a small team punching far above our weight, working out of SF HQ and our new Toronto Hub. Everyone here owns a real piece of the product and company, end to end, and runs it themselves. No hiding behind process or headcount.

This is a place for people who want to work at the frontier: an AI company building the infrastructure other AI companies run on, not one bolting AI onto an existing product. We move fast, go deep, and are building the tools superintelligence will rely on to gather data from the web.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Set Firecrawl's legal strategy and risk posture, starting with the questions that define the company: what we crawl and how, how we treat robots.txt and publisher opt-outs, what data provenance we stand behind, and where the lines are on AI training data, agents acting on the web for users, and machine-generated output

 - Own the company's position on web data access and be ready to defend it anywhere: in customer diligence, across a negotiating table, in front of a regulator, or in court if it comes to that. Run disputes, demand letters, and pre-litigation strategy yourself, bringing in outside counsel when the matter warrants it

 - Run corporate and board legal: financings, governance, the cap table and equity plans, board materials and minutes, and the corporate hygiene that holds up under diligence. You'll act as corporate secretary

 - Set the commercial legal posture from the top: risk allocation, indemnity and data-provenance positions, fallback ladders, and approval thresholds. Your counsel run the deals. You decide what they can give

 - Lead privacy, security, and compliance strategy alongside our CTO: GDPR, CCPA, the EU AI Act and the state AI laws behind it, SOC 2 and the enterprise diligence machine, sanctions and export questions, and whether laws written for data brokers reach a company like ours

 - Steward our open source posture: license strategy, contributor terms, trademark and brand protection, and the line between the project and the product

 - Advise People and Operations on employment and contractor matters across every country we hire in: EOR and PEO structures, IP assignment that holds across borders, classification, and immigration as we grow into it

 - Build and lead the legal team: hire, level, and develop the lawyers and legal ops people under you, run outside counsel to a budget, and make legal a function engineers and salespeople route through by choice

 - Represent Firecrawl in the policy conversation on web data access and AI: industry coalitions, amicus opportunities, and direct engagement with regulators and legislators. Where the law is unsettled, we intend to have a hand in settling it

 - Cover everything else with a legal edge: insurance, government inquiries, communications review when something goes sideways, and the questions nobody has assigned yet. At our size the GC's scope is the whole company




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - You've run legal somewhere, or been the person who effectively did. GC, deputy GC, or the senior lawyer the founders actually called, at a venture-backed technology company. A first GC seat is fine if you've operated at that altitude and made calls you had to live with

 - You cover the full field. Corporate, financings, and governance on one side; commercial, product, data, and IP on the other. Deep in at least one, credible in all of them, and honest about where you'll lean on outside counsel

 - You have a real point of view on web data, AI, and copyright, and you can defend it. You've read the cases, you've watched the licensing market form, and you're not waiting for settled law to take a position

 - You give business advice, not legal cover. The founders will ask what you would do and expect an answer: a recommendation and a risk read they can act on, not a memo listing every possible exposure. If your default answer is no, this will be frustrating for both of us

 - You've been in the room when it went wrong. A demand letter, a regulator's inquiry, a deal that died on indemnity, a board meeting with bad news. Calm and clear under that is not a nice-to-have here

 - You lead lawyers and non-lawyers. You've built or run a small legal team, held outside counsel to a budget, and earned the trust of engineers and salespeople by being fast, clear, and unpretentious

 - You're an AI super user. Non-negotiable. You already use AI heavily in your own practice, you'll set the standard for the legal team, and you want to push it further than anyone has taken it in this profession

 - Membership in good standing in at least one US state bar, and either California bar membership or eligibility to register as in-house counsel in California. Preferred: a J.D. from a T14 law school or comparable academic credentials, training at an Am Law 100 firm or a comparably sophisticated firm, and in-house years at a company that scaled fast. Exposure to data licensing, privacy, IP, open source, or data-access disputes is a strong plus




WHAT WE'RE NOT LOOKING FOR

 - A GC who runs legal as the department of no and measures success by risk avoided rather than by what the company shipped and signed

 - A law firm partner or senior associate who has never had to live inside a company with the consequences of their own advice

 - A pure corporate and securities lawyer, or a pure commercial lawyer. This seat needs both

 - Anyone who thinks "can we crawl this" is an obvious yes or an obvious no. Both are wrong, and the whole job lives in the gap

 - Someone who needs a full team, a CLM platform, and settled law before making a call

 - Someone who wants the title and the strategy but plans to send the hard, novel questions to outside counsel. Those questions are the job




A NOTE ON PACE

We operate at an absurd level of urgency because the window for what we're building won't stay open forever. If that excites you, keep reading. If it doesn't, no hard feelings, but this role probably isn't for you.

If you've spent a career advising companies and want to run legal for one at the moment its questions are the most interesting in the profession, this is the one. Very few lawyers get to set the legal posture for infrastructure the AI industry runs on. It won't be boring.




BENEFITS & PERKS




AVAILABLE TO ALL EMPLOYEES

 - Salary that makes sense: $310,000–$392,000 USD/year. Based on impact, not tenure

 - Own a piece: Gain competitive equity in what you're helping build

 - Generous PTO: 15 days mandatory, anything after 24 days, just ask (holidays excluded). Take the time you need to recharge

 - Parental leave: 12 weeks fully paid, for all parents

 - Wellness stipend: $100 USD/month for the gym, therapy, massages, or whatever keeps you human

 - Learning & Development: Expense up to $1,000 USD/year toward anything that helps you grow professionally

 - Team offsites: A change of scenery, minus the trust falls

 - Sabbatical: 3 paid months off after 4 years, do something fun and new




AVAILABLE TO US-BASED FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES

 - Full coverage, no red tape: Medical, dental, and vision (100% for employees, 50% for partner and kids). No weird loopholes, just care that works

 - Life & Disability insurance: Employer-paid basic life and AD&D, short-term disability, and long-term disability. Coverage for life's curveballs

 - Virtual care and a health guide: Teladoc for the couch doctor visit, plus Rightway to answer coverage questions and fight billing errors for you

 - Mental health: Talkspace, therapy and psychiatry on your schedule

 - Fertility and family building: Carrot, covering you and your partner

 - EAP: Free confidential counseling, legal and financial consults, and online will prep through Guardian

 - 401(k) plan: Retirement might be a ways off, but future-you will thank you

 - Pre-tax benefits: HSA, FSA, and commuter benefits to help your wallet out a bit

 - Supplemental options: Extra life and AD&D, accident, critical illness, hospital indemnity, plus pet, legal, and identity protection through MetLife




AVAILABLE TO SF-BASED EMPLOYEES

 - SF HQ perks: Snacks, drinks, team lunches, intense ping pong, and peak startup energy

 - E-Bike transportation: A loaner electric bike to get you around the city, on us




INTERVIEW PROCESS

Application Review: Send us your resume and a short note on why this excites you. Tell us about a legal call you made that the business pushed back on, how you landed it, and whether time proved you right.

Intro Chat (~25 min): A quick conversation to get to know each other before we go deep. What you've been running, what drew you to Firecrawl, and what you want next. Time for your questions too.

Case Chat (~45 min): We'll work through a real problem from our world: a publisher's demand letter, a frontier lab's provenance requirements, a regulator's question nobody has answered yet. How you'd set the company's position, what you'd tell the founders, and what you'd refuse to sign. Come ready to think out loud. We care how you reason, not whether you know the market term.

Strategy Exercise (Paid, ~2 hours): One scoped, realistic scenario. You write the memo you'd hand the founders: your recommendation, the exposure, and what you'd do in your first 30 days. Keep it short. We'll read every word.

Founder Chats (~30 min each): Time with each of our founders on culture, pace, ownership, and how you'd work together. Time for your questions too.

References: We'll want to talk to a founder or CEO you've advised and to someone who sat across the table from you.

Decision: We move fast after references.



If you want to run legal for the infrastructure layer of AI, and set the positions before anyone has written the playbook, you should join us.

👉 Apply now.

💚 O cliente é a razão
O cliente é o motivo pelo qual existimos e só temos sucesso se ele tiver sucesso.

Fazemos o que é certo, do jeito certo, com responsabilidade e tecnologia para decidir melhor.

Construímos um negócio de longo prazo, em time e com colaboração.

jobs.title: Tool Technology Engineer
jobs.description:
We’re ALTEN Technology USA, an engineering company helping clients bring groundbreaking ideas to life—from advancing space exploration and life-saving medical devices to building autonomous electric vehicles. With 3,000+ experts across North America, we partner with leading companies in aerospace, medical devices, robotics, automotive, commercial vehicles, EVs, rail, and more.

As part of the global ALTEN Group—57,000+ engineers in 30 countries—we deliver across the entire product development cycle, from consulting to full project outsourcing.

When you join ALTEN Technology USA, you’ll collaborate on some of the world’s toughest engineering challenges, supported by mentorship, career growth opportunities, and comprehensive benefits. We take pride in fostering a culture where employees feel valued, supported, and inspired to grow.

We are seeking a highly motivated Tool Technology Engineer - to provide technical leadership and end-to-end project management for complex tooling projects within an advanced industrial and manufacturing environment. This role is ideal for a hands-on engineering professional with strong project management experience, a solid mechanical engineering background, and the ability to translate technical requirements into innovative tooling solutions.

The ideal candidate combines technical expertise with exceptional planning, coordination, and stakeholder management skills. They are comfortable leading cross-functional teams, managing project budgets and schedules, overseeing suppliers and subcontractors, and ensuring tooling solutions meet mechanical, dimensional, and functional requirements while delivering outstanding customer satisfaction.

Responsibilities

• Provide technical leadership for tooling projects from design review through qualification, acceptance, and project closure.

• Analyze technical requirements, specifications, and customer needs to develop robust and effective tooling solutions.

• Lead project planning activities, including scope definition, resource allocation, scheduling, risk assessment, and project organization.

• Manage tooling projects from initiation through delivery, ensuring alignment with customer expectations, quality standards, budget objectives, and timelines.

• Ensure tooling solutions meet all mechanical, dimensional, functional, and performance requirements.

• Coordinate cross-functional teams and collaborate effectively with customers, suppliers, subcontractors, engineering teams, and operations personnel.

• Monitor project performance through reporting, dashboards, and key performance indicators, taking corrective actions when necessary.

• Manage project budgets, cost estimates, forecasts, and financial performance throughout the project lifecycle.

• Oversee subcontractors and suppliers to ensure compliance with technical specifications, contractual obligations, and project requirements.

• Provide technical guidance and support to subcontractors and suppliers throughout project execution.

• Contribute to the preparation, submission, and negotiation of technical proposals and tenders during pre-sales activities.

• Support the development, validation, and execution of tooling acceptance procedures and technical documentation.

• Identify technical risks and proactively drive engineering solutions to mitigate project challenges.

• Participate in the development and evaluation of innovative tooling concepts and design improvements.

• Build and maintain strong customer relationships while supporting technical and contractual discussions.

• Ensure compliance with quality, health, safety, and environmental standards throughout project execution.

• Promote a professional and positive company image through effective communication and project delivery excellence.

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline.

• Minimum of 3 years of experience in an industrial mechanical environment.

• Experience managing technical or engineering projects from concept through completion.

• Strong understanding of mechanical systems, manufacturing processes, and tooling solutions.

• Experience with tooling design, development, validation, and implementation.

• Experience in project planning, scheduling, coordination, resource management, and performance monitoring.

• Proven ability to manage project scope, cost, quality, and delivery objectives.

• Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional teams and coordinating multiple stakeholders.

• Experience working with suppliers, subcontractors, and external partners within a technical project environment.

• Ability to interpret technical specifications and translate requirements into practical engineering solutions.

• Experience preparing cost estimates, managing budgets, and supporting technical proposals or tender activities.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to anticipate technical challenges and implement effective solutions.

• Excellent communication, relationship-building, and customer management skills.

• Hands-on, field-oriented approach with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

• Experience with aeronautical tooling is strongly preferred.

• Knowledge of quality, safety, and compliance requirements within an industrial or manufacturing environment.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced project environment while maintaining attention to detail.

Salary Range: $80K - $100k

The actual salary offered is dependent on various factors including, but not limited to, location, the candidate’s combination of job-related knowledge, qualifications, skills, education, training, and experience

jobs.title: Senior IMS Specialist II (Part Time)
jobs.description:
Job Summary

The Senior IMS Specialist II serves as a senior subject matter expert for the Integrated Management System (IMS), providing technical leadership and guidance to ensure effectiveness, conformity, and continual improvement of management system processes supporting ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001. This role is responsible for planning, leading, and enhancing the internal audit program while driving initiatives that strengthen operational performance, support compliance obligations, and advance the organization's quality, environmental, occupational health and safety, and strategic business objectives.  The position leads internal audits, evaluates management system effectiveness, identifies risks and improvement opportunities, and collaborates across functions to ensure alignment with international standards, regulatory requirements, and company expectations. The Senior IMS Specialist II plays a key role in the development, implementation, and continual evolution of the DCE 9000 standard and supports organizational readiness for emerging ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 standard revisions.  Acting as a catalyst for organizational improvement, this role facilitates structured problem-solving activities, leads continual improvement initiatives, and partners with stakeholders at all levels to optimize processes, enhance business performance, and increase customer value. The position also contributes to the development and execution of IMS strategies, roadmaps, and programs that support organizational priorities and long-term business goals.  This is an individual contributor role without direct people management responsibilities. However, the Senior IMS Specialist II provides leadership through expertise, influence, and collaboration, leading cross-functional efforts, driving accountability, and delivering results across the organization without formal supervisory authority.

Responsibilities

• Lead and continuously improve the Integrated Management System (IMS) internal audit program supporting ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001.

• Serve as a subject matter expert on management system requirements, providing guidance and support to business leaders, process owners, and stakeholders.

• Plan, conduct, and oversee risk-based internal audits, corrective actions, and follow-up activities to ensure management system effectiveness and continual improvement.

• Support external certification, surveillance, customer, and recertification audits.

• Support the implementation of the DCE 9000 standard by evaluating, adapting, and enhancing the management system processes, procedures, and controls to ensure alignment with evolving requirements and organizational goals.

• Lead and support organizational readiness efforts for ISO standard revisions, including gap assessments, implementation planning, and stakeholder engagement.

• Analyze audit results, performance data, and business trends to identify risks, drive improvements, and support informed decision-making.

• Lead cross-functional continuous improvement initiatives utilizing Lean, Six Sigma, structured problem-solving, and other improvement methodologies.

• Facilitate root cause analysis and corrective action activities to improve process performance and organizational effectiveness.

• Develop and maintain IMS documentation, procedures, metrics, reporting tools, and governance processes.

• Partner with stakeholders across the organization to align IMS initiatives with business objectives, operational excellence goals, sustainability commitments, and customer requirements.

• Develop and deliver training, coaching, and awareness programs related to management systems, auditing, and continuous improvement.

• Monitor changes to industry standards, regulatory requirements, and best practices to strengthen IMS performance and organizational readiness.

• Contribute to the development and execution of IMS strategies that support long-term business objectives.

• Lead through technical expertise, influence, and collaboration in a highly matrixed environment without direct supervisory responsibility.

• Perform other duties as assigned by manager..

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Environmental Science, Occupational Health and Safety, Quality Management, or a related field.

• Minimum of seven (7) years of experience in integrated management systems, quality management systems, auditing, operational excellence, continuous improvement, or a related discipline.

• Certified Internal Auditor for one or more management system standards (e.g., ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001) or the ability to obtain certification within a specified timeframe.

• Demonstrated knowledge of ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001 standards, including management system implementation, maintenance, and continual improvement.

• Proven experience planning, leading, conducting, and reporting management system audits in complex organizational environments.

• Experience leading cross-functional improvement initiatives and delivering measurable operational, compliance, quality, environmental, health and safety, or business performance improvements.

• Strong knowledge of risk-based thinking, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, management review processes, and continual improvement methodologies.

• Ability to interpret management system requirements and translate them into practical business processes, solutions, and implementation plans.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, project management, communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.

Essential Job Functions

• Ability to conduct internal audits at company facilities and other locations as required.

• Ability to facilitate meetings, workshops, and training sessions, in person and virtually.

• Ability to analyze information, prepare clear reports, and communicate findings to stakeholders and leadership.

• Ability to travel as required to support audits, strategic initiatives, and standards-related activities.

• Regular and on-time attendance.

• This is a hybrid position unless otherwise specified requiring 3 days in the office.

Perks & Benefits

Phoenix Contact offers a generous benefits package that includes medical, dental, and vision coverage, 401k matching, and a generous time off package. There are also a wide variety of additional benefits available including 16 weeks fully paid maternity leave & 10 weeks fully paid paternity leave, life insurance, short & long-term disability, on-site gym access, health & wellbeing center, on-site café, walking trails, tuition assistance, and more!

Phoenix Contact is committed to the diversity of our employees. We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, disability, gender identity or expression, marital status, national or ethnic origin, political affiliation, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, veteran status, and family medical or genetic information.

What is Cirkul?

Cirkul is a rapidly growing company on a mission to transform how beverages are developed, distributed, and enjoyed. It’s a new way to hydrate—so much so that 96% of customers say they drink more water with Cirkul!* With over 150 flavor options available without sugar or calories, Cirkul provides customers with a fully customizable, reusable water bottle and cartridge system. Since 2018, millions have dropped sugary soda and energy drinks, and turned up their plain boring water with Cirkul! A full range of products is available at DrinkCirkul.com, and Cirkul is also sold by Amazon, Costco, Walmart, Kroger, and grocery stores nationwide.

*Based on a survey conducted with 3,258 Cirkul Customers

What is this role?

The National Account Manager (Foodservice & Away-From-Home) at Cirkul is responsible for driving growth across key national and regional foodservice, hospitality, workplace, and small-format accounts. This includes large national operators and service organizations such as Aramark, Cintas, and similar businesses, as well as hotels, bars, restaurants, entertainment venues, and other high-volume away-from-home channels.

This role owns both new business development and the expansion of existing partnerships, with a focus on increasing account penetration, distribution, placements, and revenue. You will identify opportunities to bring Cirkul into new locations, programs, and customer environments while developing strategic relationships with operators, procurement teams, distributors, and other key decision-makers.

You will act as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts and prospects, developing account strategies, negotiating programs, and collaborating cross-functionally to bring Cirkul’s innovative hydration platform to more consumers outside of the traditional retail environment.

What does an average day look like?

Driving Results:

• Owns revenue, distribution, placement, and account growth targets across assigned foodservice and away-from-home accounts

• Develops and executes strategic account plans to drive new locations, increased distribution, and expanded product adoption

• Leads customer presentations, business reviews, sales meetings, and negotiations with national and regional accounts

• Identifies new business opportunities within large operators, foodservice organizations, distributors, hotels, bars, restaurants, and other small-format channels

• Develops programs and solutions tailored to the unique needs of foodservice and hospitality customers

• Works with customers and distribution partners to identify opportunities for incremental volume and account expansion

• Tracks account performance, identifies gaps, and develops action plans to accelerate growth

• Builds compelling business cases using customer, market, and internal data to secure new programs and placements

• Negotiates pricing, programs, promotions, and commercial agreements while balancing customer needs with Cirkul's profitability

Taking Ownership:

• Operates as the end-to-end owner of assigned accounts and prospects, from initial outreach and strategy through implementation and ongoing growth

• Builds and manages sales pipelines, consistently prospecting for new business and expanding Cirkul's presence within existing accounts

• Proactively identifies barriers to growth, including pricing, distribution, inventory, operational requirements, and customer adoption

• Coordinates with Sales Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, Marketing, and other internal teams to ensure customer commitments are delivered

• Manages implementation timelines, customer requirements, product launches, and follow-up activities

• Ensures programs are executed consistently across locations and partners

• Travels regularly to customer locations, meetings, industry events, and field locations to build relationships and identify opportunities

Making Decisions:

• Uses customer insights, financial impact, market trends, and account performance to make informed commercial decisions

• Prioritizes opportunities based on revenue potential, strategic importance, and likelihood of success

• Determines the best approach to expanding Cirkul within complex organizations with multiple decision-makers and locations

• Balances short-term revenue opportunities with long-term account development and penetration

• Navigates complex customer organizations, procurement processes, distributor relationships, and operational requirements

• Quickly adjusts strategies based on customer feedback, competitive activity, and changing business needs

Cultivating Relationships:

• Builds strong relationships with national and regional account decision-makers, including procurement, purchasing, operations, culinary, facilities, HR/workplace, and other relevant stakeholders

• Develops relationships at multiple levels within large organizations to create opportunities for broader account penetration

• Establishes Cirkul as a strategic partner by bringing innovative ideas, solutions, and insights to customers

• Develops strong relationships with foodservice distributors, brokers, and other channel partners when applicable

• Represents Cirkul at customer meetings, industry events, trade shows, and other business development opportunities

• Identifies customer champions and leverages relationships to expand Cirkul into additional locations, business units, and programs

Instilling Trust:

• Consistently delivers on commitments to customers and internal stakeholders

• Communicates clearly and proactively regarding performance, timelines, challenges, and opportunities

• Provides accurate sales forecasts and maintains visibility into pipeline and account risks

• Builds credibility through strong preparation, responsiveness, commercial knowledge, and follow-through

• Acts as a trusted advisor who understands the customer's business and proactively brings solutions

Customer Focus:

• Develops a deep understanding of each customer's business model, operating environment, customer base, and strategic priorities

• Understands the unique needs of foodservice, hospitality, workplace, and small-format customers and adapts Cirkul's approach accordingly

• Creates customer-specific presentations, proposals, and programs that demonstrate clear business value

• Identifies ways Cirkul can improve hydration experiences for employees, guests, customers, and consumers

• Visits customer locations and accounts to understand the customer experience, identify opportunities, and ensure successful execution

• Uses customer feedback and field insights to improve programs and identify additional growth opportunities

• Continuously looks for ways to make it easier for customers to adopt, scale, and succeed with Cirkul

What background should you have?

• 7+ years of experience in CPG, beverage, foodservice, hospitality, or related sales

• Proven track record of managing and growing national or regional accounts

• Experience selling into foodservice, hospitality, workplace, facilities, or other away-from-home channels

• Experience working with organizations such as Aramark, Cintas, Sysco, US Foods, Compass Group, Sodexo, hotels, restaurants, bars, entertainment venues, or similar accounts is highly preferred

• Strong new business development and prospecting experience with a demonstrated ability to open doors and build a pipeline

• Experience navigating complex national accounts with multiple locations and decision-makers

• Understanding of foodservice distribution, broker networks, and/or route-to-market strategies

• Strong negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills

• Strong business and financial acumen with the ability to build compelling customer proposals and business cases

• Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple accounts, opportunities, and priorities simultaneously

• Self-motivated, entrepreneurial, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment

• Willingness to travel frequently to customers, prospects, industry events, field locations, and Tampa HQ

From a collaborative culture to teammates who will always be by your side, find a career that will grow with you. Deliver your impact at Secretariat.

Secretariat is a leading global expert services and consulting firm, trusted by premier law firms, corporations, and government agencies to advise on complex economic, financial, regulatory, and strategic issues. Within our Economics practice, PhD economists and experts apply rigorous, independent analysis to high-stakes disputes where clarity, precision, and credibility matter.

For more than four decades, Secretariat has built a reputation for analytical depth, trusted expert testimony, and sophisticated insight across complex litigation and arbitration matters. Our professionals work at the intersection of economic theory, empirical analysis, and real-world decision-making, helping clients understand critical questions with discipline, objectivity, and intellectual rigor.

If you are completing your PhD and considering how to apply your training beyond academia, we would be excited to get to know you. This role offers the opportunity to use the research, data, and problem-solving skills you have developed in graduate school to contribute to meaningful client work from the start. You will work closely with highly regarded experts and supportive case teams, build practical consulting skills, and develop a strong foundation for a career that draws directly on your doctoral training. We welcome candidates from all economics fields and value the curiosity, persistence, and analytical judgment that PhD candidates bring.

At Secretariat, you will join a collegial, high-performing environment where your ideas are valued and your growth is taken seriously. We offer competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, substantive mentorship, and a flexible work model with opportunities to work from one of our U.S. offices.

As you consider the next step after your PhD, we want you to feel supported, challenged, and excited about the career you can build here. Here is what you can expect from us:

• Competitive compensation that recognizes the depth, discipline, and value of your PhD training.

• Comprehensive benefits designed to support your health, well-being, and life outside of work.

• A flexible work model that gives you space for focused analytical work while helping you stay connected to colleagues, mentors, and case teams.

• A collaborative, team-based approach where you can learn from experienced economists and experts, contribute your perspective, and see how rigorous analysis comes to life in real client work.

• A welcoming, collegial culture where your ideas are valued, your questions are encouraged, and your contributions are recognized from the start.

• Personalized support as you move from doctoral research into consulting, including training, mentorship, peer coaching, frequent feedback, and opportunities to build confidence in your new role.

• A warm and engaging community with opportunities to build relationships through practice-area gatherings, team dinners, social events, and firmwide celebrations.

REQUIREMENTS:

• PhD in Economics, Business, Public Policy, or a closely related field, completed or expected by the start date.

• Strong academic training in microeconomics, econometrics, quantitative methods, applied economics, or related areas.

• Demonstrated ability to conduct rigorous research, work with data, and apply economic reasoning to complex questions.

• Interest in applying doctoral training to consulting, litigation, regulatory, or other high-stakes business and policy matters.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Intellectual curiosity, sound judgment, attention to detail, and a collaborative approach to solving problems.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience with economic modeling, empirical research, data analysis, or statistical programming through dissertation work, coursework, research assistantships, internships, or other projects.

• Familiarity with tools such as Stata, R, Python, MATLAB, SQL, Excel, or other quantitative software.

• Exposure to antitrust, competition, intellectual property, labor, public policy, regulation, industrial organization, applied microeconomics, or related fields is helpful but not required.

• Prior consulting, government, legal, policy, or industry experience is a plus, but not required.

Interested? Please provide a current resume/CV, all applicable university transcripts, a job market paper. Also, please arrange to send 3 letters of reference to aea2027@secretariat-intl.com.

At Secretariat, we believe in pay transparency and equity. Compensation for this role will be based on a variety of factors, including experience, skills, and location. Further details will be provided during the hiring process.

Pay Transparency

$200,000—$260,000 USD

A rewarding career above all

There are a lot of fine consulting firms out there. But when everything is on the line, it takes a unique combination of skill and savvy to succeed under pressure.

Our culture and people are driven by passion, pride, and performance. Passion for the clients we serve, the work we deliver, and the communities we live in. Pride in our cohesive team recognized for excellence and trusted to perform in the most challenging situations. And our track record of outstanding performance across all of our disciplines speaks for itself.

Our people are motivated to be the best in everything they do – from our approach to making the complex simple to the way we mentor our up-and-coming talent to become trusted experts early in their careers.

To learn how Secretariat collects, uses, and protects your personal information during the recruitment process, please review our Privacy Policy

jobs.title: Contract Product Owner (Remote EU - UK timezone)
Affiliate Manager
jobs.description:
Type: Full-time
Location: Remote
Working hours: 14:00–22:00 Kyiv time
Market: United States



About RNK Health

RNK Health is a fast-growing telehealth brand focused primarily on the US market.

We help customers access prescription-based treatments such as NAD+, sermorelin, tirzepatide, semaglutide, and B12. Customers complete an online health assessment and receive treatment only after approval from a licensed medical provider. Approved treatments are then shipped directly to the customer.

Our business is built around recurring treatment and subscription-based care, which means we focus not only on customer acquisition, but also on conversion, retention, customer quality, refunds, and long-term value.

RNK Health has been growing for approximately 1.5 years and today has an international team of around 40–45 people across functions including Marketing, Product, Sales, Analytics, Customer Support, and Retention.

We are now entering the next stage of growth and are strengthening key functions with experienced people who can help us build scalable systems and acquisition channels.



About the role

We are looking for an experienced Affiliate Manager to build and grow our affiliate channel.

This is not a role where you will inherit a mature affiliate program and simply maintain an existing portfolio of partners.

Our affiliate function is still at an early stage, so this is a hands-on, build-from-the-ground-up role with significant ownership.

You will be responsible for developing the affiliate channel end-to-end: identifying and recruiting partners, negotiating commercial terms, launching campaigns, building strong partner relationships, monitoring economics, optimizing performance, and helping shape the processes and infrastructure needed to scale the channel.

We are looking for someone who is proactive, commercially strong, highly data-driven, and comfortable creating a partner pipeline rather than waiting for inbound opportunities.

Existing relationships with affiliates, publishers, and networks in health, wellness, weight loss, supplements, or adjacent performance marketing verticals will be a strong advantage.



What you will own

Partner acquisition
Build a strong pipeline of affiliates, publishers, networks, and strategic partners. You will proactively identify relevant partners, initiate conversations, present RNK Health and its offers, negotiate terms, and move partnerships from first contact through launch. We expect you to actively develop the channel rather than rely primarily on inbound opportunities.

Affiliate relationships
Own relationships with partners throughout the full lifecycle. You will manage onboarding, communication, campaign launches, performance discussions, optimization, troubleshooting, and opportunities for further growth. This is an end-to-end ownership role — you will not simply source partners and hand them over to another team.

Deals and unit economics
Negotiate CPA and other performance-based partnership structures. You should be comfortable evaluating partnerships through key business metrics including: CAC / CPA, Conversion rate, AOV, Revenue, Refunds, Retention, LTV. Your goal will be to ensure that affiliate growth remains commercially sustainable and that increased volume comes from high-quality traffic.

Campaign launches
Coordinate affiliate launches across RNK Health products and offers. Make sure partners have everything required to launch successfully, including: Tracking links, UTMs, Funnels and landing pages, Offers, Creative assets, Messaging, Campaign information. You will work closely with internal teams to remove launch blockers and help partners go live efficiently.

Performance and optimization
Monitor affiliate traffic, conversions, CAC/CPA, revenue, refunds, and partner-level performance. Identify which partnerships can be scaled, where performance is under target, and what needs to change in the offer, funnel, creative, traffic mix, or commercial structure. We expect you to understand what each partner is doing and continuously look for opportunities to improve performance and increase profitable volume.

Tracking and attribution
Own affiliate tracking and reporting. Make sure links, UTMs, conversions, attribution, and partner payouts are accurate. Investigate discrepancies between internal data and partner reporting and work with Analytics or other teams to resolve tracking issues. Experience with Everflow or a similar affiliate platform is highly relevant.

Cross-functional collaboration
Work closely with Marketing, Product, Creative, and Analytics teams. For example, if a strong partner can scale but requires a different landing page, offer, creative concept, or tracking setup, you will help define the requirement and coordinate internally to move it forward.

Compliance and traffic quality
Make sure partners follow approved messaging, claims, brand guidelines, and healthcare marketing requirements. Affiliate growth cannot come at the expense of traffic quality or compliance, so you will also be responsible for maintaining appropriate partner standards as the channel scales.



Who we are looking for

 - 3+ years of experience in affiliate or performance marketing

 - Strong experience recruiting and managing affiliates, publishers, and networks

 - Proven ability to proactively source and activate new partners

 - Experience negotiating CPA and other performance-based partnerships

 - Strong understanding of affiliate tracking, attribution, UTMs, and reporting

 - Experience with Everflow or similar affiliate platforms

 - Strong understanding of CAC/CPA, CR, AOV, refunds, retention, and LTV

 - Ability to analyze partner performance and make decisions based on data

 - Experience managing multiple partners and campaign launches simultaneously

 - Strong commercial and negotiation skills

 - Strong communication and relationship-management skills

 - High level of ownership and ability to operate independently

 - Comfortable building processes and a channel from an early stage rather than joining an established affiliate function

 - Strong working English, both written and spoken, for partner communication and collaboration in an international environment



Strong advantages

 - Existing relationships with affiliates, publishers, or networks in health, wellness, weight loss, supplements, or related performance marketing verticals

 - Experience in telehealth, DTC health, supplements, weight loss, or another subscription-based health business

 - Experience building or significantly scaling an affiliate program from an early stage

 - Strong understanding of recurring-revenue and subscription economics



Why join RNK Health?

Build a channel, not just manage one
You will have the opportunity to shape the affiliate function from an early stage instead of inheriting a mature playbook. You will influence partner strategy, commercial models, processes, tracking, offers, and the overall way the channel operates.

Direct impact on business metrics
Affiliate is viewed as an important growth opportunity for RNK Health. Strong partnerships and successful campaigns can directly influence acquisition volume, CAC, revenue, retention, and overall business growth. You will be able to see the impact of your work from the first months in the role.

High ownership and autonomy
We are looking for someone who can bring ideas, challenge existing assumptions, identify opportunities, and turn them into action. There is a short path between a strong idea and implementation when the business case makes sense.

Close collaboration with senior leadership
You will have visibility across the business and work closely with senior stakeholders while building a strategically important acquisition channel.

Become a key person within the Growth organization
Because the affiliate function is being built at an early stage, the person who successfully develops the channel will become an important contributor within the broader Marketing and Growth organization.

Broader opportunities over time
RNK Health is part of a broader health and wellness product ecosystem. As the business grows, there may be opportunities to contribute to additional products, acquisition initiatives, or related projects over time.



Working format

This is a full-time remote role.

Working hours are 14:00–22:00 Kyiv time, with a daily team sync at 18:00 Kyiv time.

The team is international and includes colleagues from Ukraine and Latin America. English is required for effective collaboration and external partner communication.



Hiring process

The hiring process includes:

 1. Initial interview with a Talent Acquisition Specialist

 2. Screening with RNK Health’s internal Recruiter

 3. Interview with the relevant Hiring Manager

During the later stages, we will go deeper into your affiliate experience, partner network, performance cases, economics, tracking expertise, and how you would approach building and scaling the affiliate channel at RNK Health.

Position Summary

The purpose of this role is to perform installations, preventive maintenance, and repairs on facility HVAC/R systems, food service equipment, plumbing, fuel dispensers, and electrical systems within various food and retail locations.

Responsibilities

• Respond to service requests; troubleshoot, diagnose, and repair equipment in accordance with warranty requirements and industry standards
• Communicate repair status with the service technician supervisor and store management

• Ensure all repairs and work activities comply with OSHA and Pilot Company regulations
• Model company values and support exceptional guest and team member experiences
• Follow all rules, policies, procedures, and safety standards established by Pilot Company

This position requires candidates to be legally authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship

• High school diploma or equivalent required
• Valid state driver’s license and positive driving record required
• Minimum 3 years of recent commercial HVAC service experience required; EPA Universal 608 certification required
• Minimum 3 years of recent experience repairing commercial cooking or refrigeration equipment required
• Basic knowledge and ability to repair commercial plumbing and electrical systems
• Basic understanding of OSHA guidelines (OSHA 10 training provided)
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills
• Ability to work independently with minimal supervision
• Intermediate mathematical ability
• Ability to read and interpret site drawings
• Strong attention to detail and customer service skills
• Ability to work in congested areas during business hours
• Ability to collaborate effectively with internal departments
• Travel requirements less than 10%

Physical Requirements

• Ability to climb ladders
• Lift and carry up to 50 lbs
• Work in inclement weather
• Ability to bend, stoop, twist, crawl, and kneel
• Participate in company-sponsored training, including safety training

• Weekly pay

• 401(k) with company match
• Tuition assistance
• Adoption assistance
• Paid Time Off (PTO)
• Fuel discount
• Company-provided uniforms, including boots, jackets, shirts, and pantsBoots reimbursed up to $150 annuallyPants reimbursed up to $200 annually
• All required PPE provided

jobs.title: Vice President of Equipment Sales
jobs.description:
Mid-Atlantic Truck & Equipment

Vice President of Sales – Equipment Sales (Maryland/DC/Baltimore)

Lead a sales organization. Drive performance. Deliver growth.

MATE is looking for a Vice President of Sales to lead our Equipment Sales organization and help take the business to its next level of growth.

Reporting directly to the CEO and serving on the Senior Leadership Team, you’ll own the people, performance, and profitability of our equipment sales business. You’ll lead an experienced sales organization, strengthen manufacturer and customer relationships, and bring our established sales strategy to life through strong leadership, accountability, and consistent sales performance.

What You’ll Lead

You’ll have a direct impact on the performance and continued development of our Equipment Sales organization. You’ll:

• Own the Equipment Sales P&L and overall financial performance.

• Partner with the CEO to advance the established sales strategy, goals, and growth plans across territories and product lines.

• Coach and develop sales talent, helping an experienced team strengthen performance, build capability, and achieve its goals.

• Establish KPIs, forecasting, accountability, and performance expectations while using CRM and data to drive decisions.

• Drive territory and market development, manufacturer and key customer relationships, and the systems and processes that support consistent sales performance.

• Ensure Mid-Atlantic is a high-performing dealer for every manufacturer we represent across our entire AOR.

• Partner with Branch Operations, Marketing, and executive leadership on major opportunities and initiatives that create a consistent, high-quality customer experience.

You’ll lead the Director of Sales, 11 Regional Sales Managers, Demo Driver, and Marketing Manager, with the opportunity to influence not only the sales organization but the broader business.

Compensation & Benefits

$200,000 guaranteed annual compensation — structured as a combination of base salary and guaranteed draw — with significant additional earning potential through our incentive structure.

You’ll also have access to:

• Company vehicle with EZPass and gas card

• Medical, dental, and vision coverage

• Company-paid life insurance and AD&D

• Company-paid short- and long-term disability

• 401(k) with company match

• Four weeks of annual PTO accrued on a bi-weekly basis

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Referral Program

What We’re Looking For

You’re an experienced sales leader who knows how to lead strong teams, grow markets, develop people, and translate strategy into results. You’re comfortable moving between executive leadership and the field—coaching salespeople, evaluating territories, reviewing pipelines, and building customer relationships.

You bring:

• Proven experience leading and developing sales teams and salespeople

• A track record of profitable sales growth and strong business acumen

• Experience with sales leadership, forecasting, KPIs, CRM, and performance management

• The ability to build strong relationships and balance leadership, accountability, and hands-on execution

Experience in heavy equipment, vocational trucks, municipal fleets, equipment dealerships, or related industries is strongly preferred. Candidates with experience in an industry-adjacent environment will also be considered.

Experience managing longer, consultative sales cycles is important in this role. You should be comfortable building relationships over time, navigating multiple decision-makers, and managing opportunities through proposal, demonstration, negotiation, and close. Direct experience selling to municipalities or other public-sector organizations is especially valuable.

The Opportunity

This is a field-oriented executive leadership role with regular travel to work with sales leaders, visit customers, meet with manufacturers, attend dealer meetings and industry events, and spend time in our territories. Expect 50+ trips per year, including a mix of day trips and overnight travel.

Given the geographic scope of the role, candidates should reside within a 2-hour commute of our Corporate Office in Easton, MD. Ideally, you’ll be centrally located to support travel across our branches and territories throughout the Maryland/DC/Baltimore region, while maintaining convenient access to Corporate.

In your first year, you’ll build relationships, understand the business and team, strengthen sales performance across our territories, and establish a consistent rhythm of coaching, accountability, and performance management.

Long term, the goal is to continue building one of the strongest equipment sales organizations in the industry—one where customers trust us, manufacturers value the partnership, sales leaders are developed from within, and growth is consistent, predictable, and profitable.

Why MATE

At MATE, we believe great businesses are built by great people who take ownership, work together, and keep getting better.

Customer Obsession | 1MATE | Extreme Ownership | Deliver Results | Better Every Day | Act with Urgency

If you’re looking for a role where you can lead a talented team, build strong customer and manufacturer partnerships, bring an established strategy to life, and have a meaningful impact on the future of the business, we’d like to hear from you.

GEAR UP FOR SUCCESS.

We are an equal employment opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.description:
The Staff Nurse Inpatient  reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

A clinically competent, registered, professional nurse who prescribes, delegates and coordinates nursing care to the acutely ill patient through the nursing process of assessment, planning, intervention, implementation and evaluation.  Effectively interacts with patient, significant others, and other health team members, while maintaining ANA standards of professional nursing practice.

Responsibilities:

• Collects and analyzes data, identifies expected outcomes, develops and implements an individualized plan, coordinates care delivery and evaluates progress toward attainment of outcomes.
• Directs care and determines the appropriate utilization of any assistant involved in providing direct patient care.
• Collaborates with patient, family, physicians and ancillary staff. Creates a documented plan, focused on outcomes and decisions related to the care and delivery of services that indicates communications with patients, families, and others.
• Participates in shared governance, committee work, and unit projects.
• Evaluates and documents the patient’s responses to nursing interventions in the health record and properly individualizes the plan of care based on the evaluation of findings.
• Utilizes the best available evidence, including research findings to guide practice decisions.

Required:

• Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN)
• Current State of Illinois Registered Professional Nurse
• American Heart Association Basic Life Support (BLS)
• Strong interpersonal skills
• Ability to collaborate with others
• Strong analytic abilities

*Associate Degree Nursing (ADN) acceptable with commitment to obtain a BSN from an accredited program within three years of first day of employment in clinical nurse role.

Preferred:

• Experience in specific clinical area
• Additional Preferences for the Emergency Room and the Pediatric Emergency Room
• Trauma Nurse Specialist (TNS)
• Emergency Communications Registered Nurse
• Certified Pediatric Nurse
• Certified Emergency Nurse

Northwestern Medicine is an equal opportunity employer (disability, VETS) and does not discriminate in hiring or employment on the basis of age, sex, race, color, religion, national origin, gender identity, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation or any other protected status.

Background Check

Northwestern Medicine conducts a background check that includes criminal history on newly hired team members and, at times, internal transfers. If you are offered a position with us, you will be required to complete an authorization and disclosure form that gives Northwestern Medicine permission to run the background check.  Results are evaluated on a case-by-case basis, and we follow all local, state, and federal laws, including the Illinois Health Care Worker Background Check Act.

Artificial Intelligence Disclosure

Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools may be used in some portions of the candidate review process for this position, however, all employment decisions will be made by a person.

Benefits

We offer a wide range of benefits that provide employees with tools and resources to improve their physical, emotional, and financial well-being while providing protection for unexpected life events.

jobs.title: Corporate Communications and Branding Manager
jobs.description:
Protect our global reputation and amplify our voice – so the world knows the story behind our radars.

As our Corporate Communications and Branding Manager, you own our global corporate narrative, public relations, and brand stewardship. You work side-by-side with Content Marketing, HR, and senior leadership – building a sharp internal communications rhythm, expanding our media presence in key markets like the US, and keeping our brand identity consistent worldwide. You report to the Head of Marketing, and you're a big part of why our global reputation stays strong as we scale.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Corporate narrative and messaging: Own the global corporate communications guidelines and messaging framework. Keep our corporate calendar aligned with Content Marketing to ensure seamless announcements, thought leadership, and executive communications.

 - Global PR and media relations: Lead media engagement by managing our external PR agency and building relationships with priority journalists. Proactively drive visibility around major company milestones, product launches, and key international events, focusing on the US market.

 - Executive positioning and media training: Prepare senior leaders for interviews, keynotes, and speaking opportunities. Provide media training, craft key messages, and position our leadership team as trusted industry experts.

 - Internal communications rhythm: Build and improve information flow between leadership and global teams. Partner closely with HR to deliver engaging internal messaging that reinforces our culture and keeps everyone aligned.

 - Brand stewardship and governance: Serve as the central point of contact for the Robin Radar brand. Maintain strict consistency across brand identity, tone of voice, and corporate assets – including fact sheets, presentations, videos, and templates.


WHAT YOU BRING

 - 5–10+ years of B2B corporate communications or PR experience, ideally in defense, aerospace, or deep tech

 - Proven track record in media relations, managing PR agencies, and building international press coverage

 - Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with fluent Dutch required.

 - Strategic thinker who is commercially driven and comfortable operating in a matrix structure

 - Hands-on experience preparing senior leadership and C-level executives for media appearances

 - Strong brand governance experience, keeping visual identity and tone of voice aligned across markets

 - Travel internationally up to 20% of the time to support key events and media moments

N.B. Don't worry if you don't tick every box. Our mission is a journey, and there's plenty to learn along the way. If most of this fits, we'd love to hear from you.

A Certificate of Conduct (VOG) and a background check are part of our screening process. We appreciate your understanding.


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Working for a Great Place to Work® certified company;

 - Comprehensive pension plan;

 - Commuting allowance;

 - 30 days of paid holiday leave (with the possibility to buy 3 additional days);

 - Opportunities to develop your skills even further through training and certifications;

 - High quality laptop/desktop, monitor, headphones, and any other equipment necessary for your role;

 - An international team of 30+ nationalities, full of high performance colleagues you can exchange experiences with and learn from. As well as having a lot of fun in our social events and Friday drinks!

Robin Radar is a technology leader in tracking and classifying small objects. Our radars and software help prevent bird strikes in aviation, reduce the impact of wind farms on wildlife, and protect critical infrastructure from drone threats. Our work shows up at airports, wind farms, military sites and nature reserves around the world.

We're one of the top 10 fastest-growing companies in the Netherlands, with a crew of bright minds across 30+ nationalities. Growth doesn't mean we lose the plot – eyes on the skies, feet on the ground. Our values keep us grounded: WE TRUST. WE OWN IT. WE AIM HIGH.

Want to work on next-level radar tech, solve real problems, and never have to pretend your job has meaning?

You'll fit right in – we're saving you a seat.

jobs.title: Real Estate & Workplace Services Coordinator I
jobs.description:
Latitude AI (lat.ai) is building the future of Ford’s autonomy roadmap to make travel safer, less stressful, and more enjoyable for everyone. Bringing this vision to scale, our fully in-house developed hands-free ADAS platform will debut on the all-new Ford Fathom in 2027.

When you join the Latitude team, you’ll work alongside leading experts across machine learning and robotics, cloud platforms, mapping, sensors and compute systems, test operations, systems and safety engineering – all dedicated to redefining the relationship between people and their vehicles for millions of customers.

As a Ford Motor Company subsidiary, we operate independently to develop automated driving technology at the speed of a technology startup. Latitude is headquartered in Pittsburgh with engineering centers in Dearborn, Mich., and Palo Alto, Calif.

Meet the team:

The Real Estate and Workplace Services Team (REWS), is an integral cross-function support team comprised of Facilities, Physical Security, Logistics, Asset Management, and Real Estate groups. This team is responsible for internal and external site coordination across all Latitude locations, as well as support for employees and external guests.

What you’ll do:

• Support daily facility operations across Palo Alto sites, addressing routine maintenance requests and troubleshooting building issues in coordination with Ford facility leads and vendors.

• Assist with vendor and contractor management, scheduling, scope verification, quality control, and invoice/PO coordination for facilities related services.

What we offer you:

jobs.title: Personal Travel Manager
jobs.description:
About the Role

We are toogeza, a Ukrainian recruiting company specializing in finding talent and building teams for IT companies around the world. People make a difference in the big game and we can help you find the right ones.

We are currently looking for a Travel Manager to support a high-profile entrepreneur with an intensive international schedule. This role focuses on personal support, complex travel coordination, and lifestyle management at the highest level of confidentiality and service.

This is not a traditional Travel Manager position. It is a high-intensity, service-oriented role that demands exceptional organization, resilience, and the ability to anticipate needs before they are expressed. The ideal candidate doesn’t just execute — they think ahead, protect the principal’s time, and free him to focus entirely on his business.

Key Responsibilities:

 - Own end-to-end planning of all trips and business travel — flights, transfers, hotels, and on-site activities — from first booking to return.

 - Take full ownership of the travel process and its outcomes, with minimal oversight required.

 - Organize and coordinate all international travel end-to-end, including complex itineraries with multiple flight segments within a single trip.

 - Book and manage private aviation — charter selection, scheduling, and coordination with operators.

 - Source and book hotels globally, based on the Principal’s travel rider, matching property, room category, and location to the principal’s preferences and trip purpose.

 - Research and book restaurants in different cities and countries, accounting for cuisine preferences, occasion, and privacy requirements.

 - Monitor passport validity, visa status, and all required travel documentation.

 - Arrange visa applications and renewals across jurisdictions.

 - Prepare packing lists tailored to climate, dress code, event type, and length of stay; manage all luggage logistics.

 - Coordinate transfers, meet-and-greet services, and on-site logistics.

 - Liaise with drivers, private aviation operators, airlines, hotels, and local service providers.

 - Manage airline loyalty programs, hotel memberships, lounge access, and priority services.

 - Build contingency plans for flight cancellations, hotel issues, or last-minute itinerary changes.

 - Manage urgent or crisis situations during travel calmly and efficiently.

Requirements:

 - 3+ years as a Personal Assistant, Lifestyle Manager, Travel Manager, or similar.

 - Proven experience supporting UHNWIs, founders, or executives with intensive, travel-heavy schedules.

 - Strong expertise in complex international travel: visas, passports, multi-leg itineraries, last-minute changes.

 - Hands-on experience booking hotels, private aviation, and restaurants across multiple destinations.

 - Highly structured, able to manage multiple priorities and frequent changes at once.

 - Full ownership mindset: proactive, service-oriented, able to anticipate needs without supervision.

 - Strong problem-solving skills; calm under pressure in non-standard or crisis situations.

 - High emotional intelligence, discretion, and an unwavering sense of confidentiality.

 - Excellent communication skills and cross-cultural awareness.

 - Willing to work a flexible, non-standard schedule, including evenings, weekends, and holidays when required.

 - Fluent in Russian and English (written and spoken).

 - Based in Cyprus, or willing to relocate to Cyprus following successful completion of the probation period.

What We Offer:

 - Competitive compensation package commensurate with experience.

 - Performance-based bonus.

 - Relocation support for candidates moving to Cyprus.

 - Access to a dynamic, international environment with significant growth potential.

 - The opportunity to work in close proximity to a driven and visionary entrepreneur.

Hiring Process:

 - Initial screening with the TA Specialist.

 - Interview with the Chief of Staff and Service Excellence Advisor.

 - Team-fit / case-based interview.

 - Background and reference checks.

 - Final interview with the Founder.

jobs.title: Senior účtovník / účtovníčka
jobs.description:
Hľadáme skúseného Senior účtovníka/účtovníčku, ktorý/á prevezme kľúčovú úlohu v oblasti lokálneho účtovníctva a finančného reportingu pre slovenskú entitu spoločnosti TOMRA RECYCLING.

Táto pozícia nie je o rutinnom účtovaní. Budete mať významný vplyv na kvalitu finančných procesov, podporovať automatizáciu, spolupracovať s vedením spoločnosti a podieľať sa na ďalšom rozvoji finančného oddelenia.

Čomu sa budete venovať?

🟠zodpovednosť za hlavné účtovné procesy v súlade so slovenskou legislatívou,

🟠spracovanie a kontrola účtovných operácií vrátane DPH, dlhodobého majetku a mzdových transakcií,

🟠príprava mesačných, kvartálnych a ročných uzávierok,

🟠príprava štatutárnych výkazov a daňových podaní,

🟠spolupráca s externými audítormi, daňovými poradcami a úradmi,

🟠inventarizácia účtov a majetku,

🟠identifikácia a riešenie účtovných nezrovnalostí,

🟠návrh a implementácia procesných zlepšení,

🟠podpora automatizácie a digitalizácie finančných procesov,

🟠poskytovanie odborného vedenia a podpory kolegom v rámci tímu,

🟠úzka spolupráca s lokálnym aj medzinárodným finančným tímom.

Úspešný kandidát by mal mať:

• minimálne 5 rokov skúseností v oblasti účtovníctva,
• veľmi dobrú znalosť slovenských účtovných a daňových predpisov,
• skúsenosti s mesačnými a ročnými uzávierkami,
• skúsenosti s DPH, daňovými priznaniami a auditmi,
• pokročilú znalosť MS Excel,
• skúsenosti s ERP systémami (SAP, IFS alebo ekvivalent),
• angličtinu na úrovni umožňujúcej každodennú pracovnú komunikáciu,
• analytické myslenie a orientáciu na riešenie problémov.

Výhodou bude:

• skúsenosť z výrobného alebo medzinárodného prostredia,
• skúsenosti s automatizáciou procesov,
• znalosť Power BI,
• skúsenosti s IFRS reportingom.

Prečo si vybrať TOMRA?

V TOMRA budete súčasťou globálnej spoločnosti, ktorá sa venuje riešeniam pre obehové hospodárstvo a udržateľnosť. Vaša práca bude mať priamy dopad na fungovanie spoločnosti a budete mať priestor prinášať vlastné nápady a zlepšenia.

Ponúkame stabilné pracovné prostredie, dlhodobý rozvoj a možnosť pracovať s odborníkmi z celého sveta.

Ponúkame:

• Mzda od 2400 euro brutto
• Šťastná trinástka: Užite si 13. plat vo výške 100% vášho hrubého mesačného platu.
• Dodatočné výhody: Vychutnajte si denne stravné lístky v hodnote €7.40 (nad rámec zákonných požiadaviek) a 2 ďalšie dni plateného voľna.
• Náborová prémia: Odporučte známeho a ak sa pridá, získate €1500!
• Ročný bonus: Oceňujeme vašu tvrdú prácu, takže očakávajte ročný bonus.
• Dôchodkové sporenie: Máme pre vás príspevky do DDS
• Priateľská atmosféra: Ponorte sa do našej priateľskej severskej kultúry a pracujte v čistom pracovnom prostredí s jednou zmenou v projektovej výrobe
• Stabilita: Pridajte sa k dobre zavedenej medzinárodnej spoločnosti.
• Príplatky za nadčas: Ak sa rozhodnete ísť nad rámec, pridáme príplatok nad rámec zákonníka práce
• Vedomostný boost: Bezplatné školenia a príspevok na jazykový kurz Anglického jazyka
• Športoví nadšenci, radujte sa: Pripojte sa k našim firemným športovým aktivitám - futbal, tenis, stolný tenis, volejbal a ďalším!
• Multisport karta: Buďte fit a aktívni.
• Podpora pre nových rodičov: Oslavujte rodičovstvo špeciálnym príspevkom.
• Štýlový pracovný odev: Nosite naše značkové oblečenie od Strauss.
• Pohodlná doprava do práce: Nastúpte na náš firemný autobus (PK - Tomra, Tomra - PK).

TOMRA je hrdá na to, že je zamestnávateľom poskytujúcim rovnaké príležitosti, a zabezpečuje rovnaké podmienky pre všetkých zamestnancov a uchádzačov bez ohľadu na rasu, farbu pleti, náboženstvo, pohlavie, rodovú identitu, vek, národnosť, zdravotné postihnutie, rodičovský alebo tehotenský status, manželský či partnerský status, sexuálnu orientáciu, status veterána alebo akékoľvek iné charakteristiky.

Primerané úpravy budú poskytnuté všetkým kandidátom, ktorí o ne požiadajú v rámci akéhokoľvek kroku výberového procesu.

jobs.title: Mechatronics Assembly Technician (All-round)
jobs.description:
About the role

Are you a skilled technician? At Thermopatch B.V., we are opening a brand-new, unique position for a serious and meticulous mechatronics professional who wants to own the production process from start to finish.

In this role, you won't just be a cog in a machine - you will be the one building them. You will bridge the gap between fine-tuned electronics and robust mechanical assembly. You will take loose components and turn them into fully operational, high-quality heat seal machines. If you have a passion for technology, a steady hand for precise soldering, and the flexibility to pivot from programming to light logistics, this role offers the ultimate technical variety.

Key responsibilities

• End-to-End Machine Assembly: Build our signature heat seal machines completely from scratch, seamlessly integrating both mechanical and electronic components.
• Testing & Calibration: Run comprehensive diagnostic testing and calibrate the finished devices to ensure they meet our strict performance standards before shipment.
• PCB Manufacturing & Finishing: Perform precise component-level work on printed circuit boards (PCBs), including soldering switches and displays, programming, and fine calibration.
• Spare Parts Production: Manufacture high-quality spare parts to support our customers, such as precisely fitting connectors to heating elements.
• Logistics Collaboration: Maintain a smooth workflow by handling light warehouse duties, which include collecting manufactured products and preparing them for the logistics department.

Qualifications

• Proximity: Currently residing in the Netherlands, in or within a reliable commuting distance of Almere (absolute must).
• Technical Aptitude: Strong mechanical insight and a genuine curiosity about how things work. A background in Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, or a similar field is preferred.
• Soldering Expertise: Proven, hands-on experience with PCB soldering, specifically with delicate components like switches and displays.
• Meticulous Mindset: A serious, accurate approach to your craft. You are someone who takes pride in the details and ensures every calibration is perfect.
• All-Round Flexibility: An autonomous worker who thrives on variety and is equally happy programming a circuit board, building a machine frame, or helping out in the warehouse.

What We Offer

Here's a glimpse of the great benefits you can expect:

• Financial & Health Benefits: Benefit from our Pension Fund.
• Time Off & Flexibility: Enjoy Birth/Parental leave in accordance with Dutch labor law.
• Continuous Development: We invest in your growth with Individual Development Plans, regular Development Discussions, and customized training programs tailored to your needs.
• On-Site Perks: Take advantage of free parking and a commuting allowance (80km per day by car) /public transport reimbursement.
• Community Engagement: Opportunities to participate in volunteer activities to support Non-Profit Organizations.

We are a global materials science and digital identification solutions company with locations in over 50 countries, and approximately 35,000 employees worldwide. Full Time | Monday–Friday | 8am - 4pm | Jacksonville Beach
