jobs.title: Inference Engineering and Product Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT US:

AI needs a new infrastructure layer. We're building it at Modal.

Every era of computing brought new workloads that previous infrastructure couldn't support: mainframes, databases, and the cloud. Each time, the company that rebuilt the layer underneath defined the decade. AI is no different, except it touches everything instead of one slice, and the window to build the layer underneath it is open right now.

Our customers include category-defining companies like Lovable https://modal.com/blog/lovable-case-study, Ramp https://modal.com/blog/how-ramp-built-a-full-context-background-coding-agent-on-modal, Cognition, DoorDash, and Suno. They rely on Modal for instant GPU access, sub-second container starts, and native storage, so it's simple to serve low-latency inference, fine-tune models, and access production-ready sandboxes at scale.

We recently raised a $355M Series C https://modal.com/blog/modal-series-c at a $4.65B valuation, led by General Catalyst and Redpoint Ventures. We've crossed $300M+ ARR and grown fivefold since September.

Our team includes creators of popular open-source projects (e.g.,Seaborn https://github.com/mwaskom/seaborn,Luigi https://github.com/spotify/luigi), academic researchers, international olympiad medalists, and experienced engineering and product leaders with decades of experience.



The Role

Modal's LLM inference platform delivers frontier performance https://modal.com/blog/kimi-k3-by-moonshot-now-available-on-modal for open-source models with best-in-class elasticity and developer experience, made in part possible by our custom runtime with GPU memory snapshots https://modal.com/blog/gpu-mem-snapshots and multi-cloud substrate https://modal.com/blog/resource-solver.

We're looking for a leader to own the direction and execution of this platform to continue to establish us as the clear market leader, working closely with customers like Cognition, Doordash, Ramp, and many more. You'll be leading a group of highly talented engineers working on our market-leading LLM inference offering, spanning the serving stack, routing infrastructure, internal agentic optimization platform, and the user-facing product surface area.

This is a hands-on leadership role — expect to split your time between technical contribution, product shaping and people management depending on what the team needs. You'll set direction, remove blockers, and build a strong engineering culture as your team tackles hard problems in distributed computing, frontier inference serving, and performance optimization.



Responsibilities

Team

 - Recruit, hire, and grow a high-performing team of engineers; run regular 1:1s focused on coaching, feedback, and career growth.

 - Set clear performance expectations, hold a high bar, and build an environment where engineers do their best work.

 - Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, customer obsession, and continuous improvement.

Technical and Product Direction

 - Drive technical and product decisions through design reviews, code reviews, and architectural discussions.

 - Lead our efforts working with customers with novel or frontier workloads so they can be successful running on Modal.

 - Translate learnings from frontier customers into a roadmap for our internal optimization platform and user-facing product, so that gains from optimization and research efforts are accessible to all of our users.

 - Establish standards for reliability and product excellence; ensure the team owns projects end-to-end, from spec through production.

Cross-Functional Leadership

 - Partner with business operations and compute strategy on continuing to develop our strategy for compute purchases across a variety of accelerators.

 - Collaborate with GTM on product launches, positioning, and improving win rates for inference opportunities.

 - Help guide the roadmap for teams building the infrastructure platform underlying inference, as well as adjacent product teams.

Requirements

 - 10+ years of industry experience, including 3+ years in a leadership role

 - Track record building high-performance systems at scale

 - Strong background in cloud infrastructure

 - Deep knowledge of low-level OS foundations (Linux kernel, file systems, containers, etc.)

 - Nice to have: Experience working with LLM inference in production and familiarity with underlying concepts like engines, kernels, routing, KV cache management and speculative decoding.

jobs.description:
JOIN THE TEAM BRINGING ADVANCED AUTONOMY TO THE BUILT WORLD

At Bedrock, we're moving AI out of the lab and into the real world. Our team includes veterans who helped launch Waymo, scaled Segment to a $3.2B acquisition, and grew Uber Freight to $5B in revenue. Today, we're deploying autonomous systems on heavy construction equipment across the country, improving safety on job sites and accelerating schedules on critical infrastructure projects.

We're not here debating the future of AI. We're deploying it in the real world. In just two years, we've raised $350M and achieved the first fully autonomous excavator deployments in construction.

This is where algorithms meet steel-toed boots. You'll work alongside construction veterans and world-class engineers to solve physical-world problems that simulations can't touch. If you're ready to do meaningful work on hard problems, we'd love to have you join us.




ABOUT THE ROLE & TEAM

As Bedrock scales deployments nationwide, every machine has to be reliably built, provisioned, calibrated, updated, monitored, and kept healthy. Fleet Engineering builds the platforms and internal tools that teams across the company use to manage our growing fleet of autonomous machines.

You'll spend the summer designing, building, and shipping a critical internal tool end to end, one we'll continue using after you leave. Along the way, you'll work with teams across engineering and operations, and see firsthand what it takes to run robots in production.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Understand, design, and build an internal tool that addresses a key challenge in the robot lifecycle, and define what "done" means

 - Interview the people who'll actually use the tool and translate their pain into requirements

 - Build the tool end to end: data, backend, and interfaces, working with cross-functional teams to unblock yourself

 - Instrument usage so you can tell whether it's helping

 - Iterate fast on real feedback from real operators, traveling to the field if needed

 - Document and hand off so what you build survives past the summer




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR


REQUIRED

 - Currently pursuing a BS or MS in computer science, software engineering, or a related field, or equivalent hands-on building experience

 - Ability to design and build full-stack software applications

 - Proficiency in at least one high-level programming language (Python, Rust, C++, TypeScript, etc.)

 - Product sense: you'd rather ship the useful version than the elegant one

 - Comfort working with ambiguity and defining your own scope

 - Clear communication with teams outside engineering. Your users may operate excavators, repair hardware in the field, or work directly with customers.




PREFERRED

 - Experience with data visualization or operational dashboards

 - Experience shipping software to production

 - Exposure to fleet telemetry, IoT, robotics, or operations tooling

 - Familiarity with cloud infrastructure and CI/CD

The Field Services Engineer will be responsible to provide technical support of control system including setup, installation, startup, commissioning as well as post startup support.  The candidate must have a strong desire to gain DCS/PLC system experience (both hardware and software), troubleshooting experience, and a deep knowledge of computers with Microsoft Windows/Server operating systems.  This opportunity will also provide learning opportunities around virtual system architectures such as VMware and HyperV, bus technologies (Fieldbus, ASi, DeviceNet and ProfiBus), field instrumentation, wireless and 3rd party communications (serial or ethernet).  A general knowledge of industrial electrical and wiring practices is helpful.

• Preventative Maintenance – Perform periodic reviews of the systems for Proconex service contract customers. These reviews could be monthly, semi-annual or annual. The scope of work is defined in the customer service agreement. Work will be performed per the Preventative Maintenance SOP / checklist. Report will be delivered within 5 day of the review. Responsible to meet schedule and budget requirements.

• Demand Services – Small project work. Typically, one day of service to three weeks of service. Work scope will vary from system setup / build, upfront project activities, surveys, or small control / graphic modifications.

• DeltaV Version Upgrades – Support the execution of the version upgrade of the DeltaV system. This support includes development of the migration plan, migration of the DeltaV database and graphics, buildout of the DeltaV system and onsite support. System platform could be physical machines or virtual machines (VRTX, VMware). Responsible to meet schedule and budget requirements.

• Project Services – Includes supporting the project teams in buildout of computers per design specifications, supporting customer factory acceptance testing, performing system installations, supporting site acceptances testing and supporting loop checkout, commissioning and startup. Responsible to meet schedule and budget requirements.

• Emergency Support Provide after-hours support for our contract customers. Scheduled on call 24/7 pager support. Responsible to return a customer call within 15 minutes. Perform remote diagnostic over the phone up to 30 minutes. Onsite response, if needed, 4 hours.

• Other Activities Develop / cultivate a relationship with your service contract customers to become a trust advisor. Sales and proposal support

EDUCATION AND TRAINING REQUIREMENTS

• Strong verbal and written communications skills and the ability to interface with customers, Proconex internal groups and Proconex management

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

Title of Job: Senior Product Acceleration Specialist - Auth0
Reports to: Director, Product Acceleration

Job Purpose

As a Senior Product Acceleration Specialist for Auth0, you will play a critical role in driving customer success, deep product adoption, and long-term retention across Okta’s most strategic Global 2000 (G2K) enterprise accounts. In this highly technical, developer-centric role, you will act as a trusted advisor to enterprise engineering, architecture, security, and application teams, helping them deploy complex, low-friction, high-volume Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM) solutions on the Auth0 platform.

Leveraging your deep Auth0 domain knowledge, you will guide customers through their deployment journeys by supporting key architectural decisions, driving optimal platform usage, and troubleshooting complex technical issues. Operating at the intersection of post-sales support, developer enablement, and product innovation, your core focus will include deploying modern front-end frameworks alongside validating New Product Introductions (NPIs). In doing so, you will act as the essential feedback bridge between G2K engineering teams and Auth0’s Product Management.

Duties & Responsibilities

• Post-Sales Architectural Advisory & Troubleshooting: Partner directly with G2K Enterprise Customers to guide complex implementation patterns, navigate key architectural decisions, and resolve complex configuration challenges to maximize platform capabilities.

• Pre-Sales & NPI Launch Support: Partner with Sales Engineering and Go-To-Market (GTM) teams during the rollout of New Product Introductions (NPIs). Develop high-impact Proof of Concepts (PoCs), early-adopter demonstrations, and technical enablement assets to help secure technical wins and drive initial pipeline for emerging Auth0 capabilities within G2K accounts.

• Developer Enablement & Prototyping: Assist customer development teams by providing architectural guidance on custom Auth0 Actions, SDK implementation blueprints, and modern full-stack application patterns (Node.js, TypeScript, React, Mobile).

• Product & NPI Feedback Loop: Act as a technical liaison between G2K Enterprise Customers and Auth0 Product Management to identify feature gaps, test early-stage NPIs, and drive product roadmap enhancements based on real-world enterprise needs.

• Field & Customer Mentorship: Create reusable code samples, technical documentation, and enablement guides to train G2K teams (Professional Services, Customer Success, Pre-Sales, Partners) and customer developers on advanced Auth0 capabilities.

• AI Tooling & Automation: Leverage AI tools and LLM workflows to accelerate code generation, SDK debugging, technical documentation, and complex implementation analysis.

• Multi-Project Execution: Manage multiple concurrent technical engagements effectively while prioritizing tasks to ensure high customer satisfaction, which includes providing a rapid, hands-on response to high-priority customer escalations and fast-moving GTM activities.

Qualifications & Technical Requirements

• Experience: 6+ years in a customer-facing technical field role within a Go-To-Market (GTM) organization (e.g., Pre-Sales/Sales Engineering, Professional Services, Solutions Architecture, Technical Account Management, Customer Success, or Senior Support) delivering identity or SaaS solutions to enterprise accounts.

• Auth0 & CIAM Depth: Expert-level understanding of the Auth0 platform and modern Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM) patterns, including low-friction authentication, high-volume user management, and extensibility via custom Auth0 Actions.

• Full-Stack Development Skills: Proven experience reading, writing, and debugging full-stack application code using JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, React, and modern Mobile SDKs.

• Identity Protocols & Security: Deep understanding of identity federation, access control frameworks, and core protocols including SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), and SCIM.

• Identity Security & Threat Defense: In-depth knowledge of the CIAM threat landscape, with a proven ability to design and scale resilient authentication flows that mitigate both traditional identity attacks (credential stuffing, account takeover, automated bot attacks, etc.) and emerging next-generation threats (AI-driven social engineering, LLM-based phishing, and automated fraud attacks, etc.)

• G2K Enterprise Experience: Demonstrated history of navigating complex, large-scale IT landscapes, web technologies, and cloud architectures for G2K customers.

• Communication & Advisory: Exceptional ability to translate complex technical/developer concepts to non-technical stakeholders and strategically guide senior engineering leaders.

• Education: A Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline is required.

jobs.description:
ABOUT ABUNDANT

AI models rely on two fundamental ingredients: compute and data. Abundant is building the NVIDIA of training data. NVIDIA, the leader in compute, has a peak market cap of $5T and generated $130B in revenue last year as the need for scaling compute has exploded. We believe the need to scale data is just beginning, as we move beyond SFT and human supervision to RL and Learning from Experience.

 

Our founding team consists of former founders, ML engineers, roboticists and data leads from Waymo, Google, Mercor and AWS. Our team has previously worked with DeepMind to deploy deep learning models at 1B user scale, trained SOTA models for self-driving at Waymo, and scaled data pipelines of tens of thousands of human annotators at YouTube. Our pioneering work in human computation, synthetic data, simulation and RL give us the advantage in delivering results to our customers.

 

Why now? Training data is more important and more scarce than ever before. Scaling laws dictate that linear improvement in model performance demands an exponential increase in training data. But there is only one World Wide Web and most of it has already been trained on. The next advances will require major advances in simulation, synthetic data and learning from experience.

 

What happens if we succeed? Abundant will be the core enabler for not only AGI, but ASI and physical intelligence. Most of the challenges in model algorithms and compute are already solved. What’s missing? The data necessary to move from general knowledge to domain expertise; from chatbots to agents; and from text to multimodal and physical AI. Ask any AI researcher or roboticist: the core bottleneck to progress is the availability of data, hence “abundant data”.

 

Abundant works with a majority of the top AI labs, as well as frontier startups and F500 enterprises.

 


THE ROLE

As a Research Intern you will work directly with Abundant's founding team to architect the next generation of model reasoning and intelligence. You will lead at the absolute frontier where research and execution collide, co-designing strategies alongside top-tier researchers from AI labs to push SOTA boundaries. This is a role for researchers who are already investigating the frontier and are looking to apply their learnings alongside world-class peers.

 


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Drive Foundational Research & Execution: Architect and execute a core research agenda to discover simple, generalizable ideas that advance model reasoning and intelligence at scale. This includes owning the full research-to-production lifecycle and ensuring rapid deployment of your work in live systems.

 - Model Alignment & Data Strategy: Partner with the world's most advanced AI research teams to design, engineer, and iterate on high-impact datasets and large-scale benchmarking efforts that shape how frontier models behave, specifically focusing on critical alignment, safety, and defining optimal reward signals.

 - Autonomous Problem Selection: Autonomously identify, scope, and manage long-running research projects, choosing the most impactful problems that are critical to scaling data for AGI/ASI.

 - System Infrastructure: Collaborate closely with engineering teams on data pipelines, internal tooling, and high-performance deep learning algorithm implementations.


WHO YOU ARE

 - Exceptional Research Depth & Strategic Vision: Research expertise in a related field (e.g., CS, ML, NLP) ideally with that work published at a major conference (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR). You must possess the velocity to master complex fields and a proven track record in the productization of research, encompassing high-stakes evaluation, large-scale benchmarking, and product feature development.
   
   - Proven experience shipping research directly to production and live systems, specifically focusing on advanced post-training, distillation, and high-stakes evaluation methodologies.
   
   - Large-scale agent systems: orchestration frameworks, tool APIs, distributed execution, observability, and logging infrastructure.

 - Strategic & Ethical Leadership: You possess a thoughtful, strategic perspective on the societal and safety impacts of deploying general-purpose AI systems. Experience advising on or shaping governmental policy related to AI safety and governance (e.g., House of Lords or Online Safety Bill initiatives) is required.
   
    


COMPENSATION

Base Salary

$14,500/month

Benefits

Health, dental, vision + flexible PTO

Please be cautious of potential recruitment fraud. With the increase of remote work and digital hiring, phishing and job scams are on the rise with malicious actors impersonating real employees and sending fake job offers in an effort to collect personal or financial information.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone at the start of their career who is interested in commercial contracts, negotiation and how businesses work. You don't need years of contracts experience, we're looking for someone with strong attention to detail, good commercial instincts, excellent communication skills and a genuine desire to learn.

You'll work closely with Sales, Operations, Finance and senior leadership, supporting the contract process from initial review through to negotiation, approval and execution. Over time, you'll develop a strong understanding of commercial agreements, contractual risk and how contracts work in practice.

Please note: We are not seeking a lawyer, attorney or paralegal. This is a commercial and operational contracts role, focused on supporting the business, understanding commercial priorities, identifying potential risks and helping teams reach practical agreements.

What You'll Do

Support the Contract Process

• Support the end-to-end contract process across the US business, from initial review through negotiation, approval and execution.

• Review a range of commercial agreements, including MSAs, SOWs, client terms, amendments, contractor agreements and other commercial documentation.

• Work with Sales and internal stakeholders to understand contractual requirements and ensure agreements are progressed efficiently.

• Help ensure contracts are accurately documented, approved and stored in line with company processes.

• Build your knowledge of commercial contracts and develop confidence in reviewing contractual terms.

Support Sales & Commercial Negotiations

• Work closely with Sales teams during contract negotiations and help them understand key contractual requirements.

• Review proposed client terms and flag clauses that may create commercial, financial, operational or contractual risk.

• Support discussions around contractual terms and help identify practical solutions.

• Develop an understanding of how contractual commitments can affect the wider business.

• Help Sales teams progress agreements while ensuring appropriate risks are identified and escalated.

Identify & Manage Risk

• Learn to identify areas of contractual exposure and highlight potential issues before they become problems.

• Develop an understanding of clauses relating to liability, indemnification, payment terms, termination, warranties, insurance, confidentiality, intellectual property and contractual obligations.

• Escalate material or complex issues to senior colleagues or specialist legal support where appropriate.

• Work with Finance, Operations and Compliance to understand whether contractual commitments can be delivered effectively.

What We're Looking For

You don't need to have previously worked in a dedicated contracts role. What we're looking for is:

• A degree or equivalent qualification, ideally in a subject such as Business, Finance, Economics, Law, Commercial Management or a related discipline.

• A genuine interest in business, commercial agreements, negotiation and how companies operate.

• Strong attention to detail and the ability to spot inconsistencies or issues in written information.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• The confidence to ask questions, challenge information and seek clarification when something doesn't make sense.

• Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities.

• A practical, solutions-focused approach and a willingness to learn.

• Good commercial awareness and an interest in understanding how decisions affect a business.

• The ability to work collaboratively with different teams and stakeholders.

• A proactive attitude and the willingness to take ownership as your knowledge develops.

What We Offer

• Hybrid working environment with flexibility and autonomy

• Monthly lunch clubs and team social events

• Personal development allowance to support your career growth

• Opportunity to attend two international company conferences each year

• Employee-led culture committees and initiatives

• Access to professional development and leadership training programmes

• Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) with wellbeing and mental health support for you and your family

Why Join CMC?

CMC is part of a global consulting group. Since launching our Dallas office in 2022, we've been rapidly expanding our footprint across North America.

This is an opportunity to build your career within a high-growth business, gaining hands-on exposure to commercial contracts and working alongside Sales, Operations, Finance and senior leadership.

Our work supports critical industries including renewable energy, infrastructure and advanced engineering, giving you the opportunity to work within sectors that are helping shape a more sustainable and connected future.

You'll also be part of a culture built around Positivity, Respect, Ownership, Fun, Excellence and Success (PROFES), where collaboration is valued and people are encouraged to make an impact.

If you're a recent graduate or early-career professional who is commercially curious, detail-oriented and excited to build a career in contracts, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT TRIGGER.DEV

Trigger.dev http://Trigger.dev is an open source platform used by developers to build production-grade AI agents. It's an SDK and the infrastructure to run agents reliably at scale, so teams can focus on the product instead of the plumbing.

Our Cloud product is a managed service where we deploy our users' code and auto-scale from zero to millions of executions. With the rise of AI, being able to offload async tasks reliably is a key part of any developer's toolkit - we're building the infrastructure to make that a reality.



ABOUT THE POSITION

We're looking for a Marketing Lead to own growth marketing at Trigger.dev http://Trigger.dev: influencer partnerships, GEO/SEO, and the bold, high-visibility campaigns that get us noticed.

Rather than spreading effort thin across five channels, we want someone who picks one or two and goes deep. You'll have real budget and autonomy to run steady channel work alongside genuine "big swing" ideas.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

You'll do a variety of things including:

 - Owning influencer marketing beyond our existing activity, using tools like Plug.dev http://Plug.dev to find, manage, and measure partnerships

 - Driving GEO/SEO strategy and execution

 - Planning and executing high-impact "big swing" campaigns - think an SF billboard, or premium merch sends to YC founders - with real budget behind them

 - Running narrow, targeted paid spend (e.g. a small daily budget tied to a free tool) where it supports a wider campaign, kept deliberately focused rather than broadents attended, video of any talks given, and a written recap of who you met


REQUIREMENTS

You really need to have:

 - Experience running influencer marketing campaigns end-to-end, from outreach through to measurement

 - A track record in GEO/SEO or organic growth channels

 - Comfort pitching and executing bold, unconventional campaign ideas - not just optimizing an existing playbook

 - The ability to work with real budget and ownership, prioritizing depth on a couple of channels over breadth

 - If you are remote you must be within CET to ET timezones (GMT+1:00 to GMT-5:00). We will arrange in-person events throughout the year

You'll be an amazing fit if you:

 - Experience at an early-stage startup where you were marketing's first or only hire

 - A portfolio of "big swing" campaigns you can point to

 - Familiarity with tools like Plug.dev http://Plug.dev or similar influencer marketplace platforms

 - Previously worked in developer tools or on a technical/developer-facing product

 - If you're based in the UK and you are able to join the team in London

 - Have a social media presence


ABOUT THE TEAM

 - We are a small team with a flat hierarchy

 - We encourage continuous learning and personal development

 - Everyone operates autonomously; we trust you to get the job done, but to also quickly raise your hand if you need help

 - We care about our customers and the open-source community

 - Being a start-up, the work is challenging and fast-paced, but we also understand the importance of taking time off to recharge


WORKING AT A COMMERCIAL OPEN SOURCE SOFTWARE COMPANY IS MORE THAN JUST YOUR DAY JOB

 - We have an active community on Discord and GitHub. Everyone on the team helps customers, reviews PRs, and creates issues

 - Great documentation matters more than ever, both for humans and for the AI tools that read it. Everyone here keeps docs up to date

 - We are a product-led growth company so everyone is expected to get involved in creating content like code examples, blog articles, videos and tweets
   


BENEFITS

 - Generous, transparent compensation and equity - We hire the best talent and pay to reflect that. We also offer equity as a way to ensure everyone is invested in the success of the company.

 - Async working - Need a heads-down day or meeting-free days to stay productive? No problem!

 - Home office - We will help provide equipment for a comfortable setup so you're as productive at home as you are in the office.

 - Generous vacation - We believe it's important to take time off. We encourage you to take your 25 days vacation excluding national holidays, plus sick leave and generous parental leave.

 - Training budget - An annual budget to contribute towards learning such as purchasing books, an Audible subscription or online courses.

 - Pension and 401k contributions - Enroll in our company pension scheme or we'll contribute directly to your private pension.

jobs.title: Software Engineer I
jobs.description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com http://OpenGov.com.




JOB SUMMARY

As a Software Engineer I at OpenGov, you’ll build best-in-class SaaS solutions that enable efficiency, transparency, and accountability within government agencies. As a crucial member of our engineering team, you’ll lead and deliver new features and improvements in a fast-paced, agile environment, utilizing modern technologies such as ReactJS, Typescript, GraphQL, and NodeJS in an AI first engineering culture.

A typical day in this role would provide opportunities to optimize applications for speed and scalability and resolve various unique technical challenges. Strong collaboration skills with the product, UX, and platform engineers and the ability to execute quickly will enable your success.

You are naturally passionate about good component design and solid application architecture. We value natural self-starters who can effectively communicate ideas and contribute to OpenGov’s culture of respect, dedication, and fun. You value clean code, principles over dogma, and making the world a little better every day.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Collaborate across the organization to understand and translate business priorities into shipped features delivering customer success.

 - Generate clean, efficient, and well-documented software following industry best practices.

 - Write robust, highly performant, well-crafted code.

 - Design and develop well-structured and easy-to-consume APIs

 - Implement unit and integration tests to improve and maintain high code coverage

 - Deliver quality, scalable, and maintainable software to customers at an impressive pace

 - Contribute to OpenGov’s Engineering culture of innovation, leading-edge technology adoption and quality
   
   


REQUIREMENTS AND PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

 - Thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth, ambiguous environment where new ideas ship daily, staying closely aligned to customer needs and outcomes, and consistently turning rapid iteration into measurable customer impact.

 - Demonstrated experience in working with customers to improve product experiences

 - Experience working across the stack (frontend + backend) and comfort shipping features end-to-end

 - Experience building with AI-driven UX, agents, and workflow automation (direct ML experience not required)

 - BA/BS in a computer-science-related discipline or equivalent experience required

 - Proficiency in Java, C++, and C# or equivalent program languages is required.

 - Demonstrate a strong understanding of data structures and algorithms

 - Working knowledge of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, ReactJS, and NodeJS preferred

 - Working knowledge of SQL preferred

 - Working knowledge of GraphQL APIs preferred

 - Working knowledge of event-driven architecture and Kafka preferred

 - Working knowledge of ElasticSearch/OpenSearch preferred



Compensation:

Boston, MA: $110,000 - $124,000

On target ranges above include base plus a portion of variable compensation that is earned based on company and individual performance.

 

The final compensation will be determined by a number of factors such as qualifications, expertise, and the candidate’s geographical location.




WHY OPENGOV?



A Mission That Matters. 

At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust.  Some people say this is boring.  We think it’s the core of our democracy.



Opportunity to Innovate

The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.



A Team of Passionate, Driven People

This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.



A Place to Make Your Mark

We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.



Benefits That Work for You

Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:

 - Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families

 - Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays

 - 401(k) with company match

 - Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions

 - Professional development and growth opportunities

 - A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer (Systems & Network Proxy)
jobs.description:
About the role

We’re looking for an experienced systems software engineer to help drive and evolve our product. This person would extend and own our on-endpoint network proxy solution, intercepting and manipulating the network traffic of third party software. Our technology is new and rapidly evolving, and you’ll have a chance to be an early contributor with a substantial impact on the product architecture.



What you'll do

 - Hook or redirect outbound connections, terminate and re-establish TLS sessions, and apply content-aware policies in real time

 - Add low-level collectors that trace data flows across apps, files, sockets, and pipes, feeding a unified event stream

 - Solve challenging performance optimization problems: we’re building software that monitors hundreds of thousands of events with minimal impact on performance of the endpoint applications

 - Design and build highly reliable code that never impacts the end-user experience

 - Build secure-by-design hardened software that must withstand real-world attacks, while processing untrusted data and communicating with a backend over the internet



Who you are:

 - 6+ years of professional experience in systems software, networking, proxy, or security engineering, with strong depth in network interception and low-level systems.

 - Strong track record in network interception and parsing

 - Prior work on at least one forward proxy used by security software

 - Experience debugging, profiling, and optimizing the performance of low-level system software

 - Proficient in designing and implementing application architecture

 - Experience with agile development and SCRUM

 - Proven ability to collaborate with a distributed cross-functional team

 - Possess verbal and written communication skills in English

 - Availability to frequently communicate with a distributed engineering team in Central European and US Eastern time zones.



Joining Cyberhaven means joining the team building Data Security for the Agentic Enterprise. Traditional tools fall short. Cyberhaven traces the full lifecycle of your data, adapting protection to changing context, so protection moves with the way people actually work, not against it. AI Changed Work. We Protect It.
Backed by $250M from leading investors like Khosla and Redpoint, our team includes leaders who built industry-defining technologies at CrowdStrike, Palo Alto Networks, Meta, Google, and more. This role lets you shape the future of data security, working alongside people driven to protect workflows, not just data, for customers who cannot afford to slow down to stay safe.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
ABOUT MOTHERDUCK

Don’t let the quirky name fool you: At MotherDuck, we’re on a mission to make data warehousing fun, frictionless, and ducking awesome for developers and data practitioners building blazing fast internal and customer-facing analytics experiences. We're building a cloud-hosted version of DuckDB, working hand-in-hand with the creators of the fastest-growing and fastest-improving query engine on the planet. Unlike other databases, MotherDuck was architected to unify local development with cloud operations to bridge the gap between software and data engineering workflows. Our team is a mix of thoughtful, passionate, and empathetic data industry veterans.


WHAT YOU WILL DO

MotherDuck is looking for a highly motivated Business Development Representative (BDR) to help drive our growth and introduce companies to the next generation of cloud-based data analytics. This is an opportunity to join our growing BDR team, helping to shape our top of funnel sales strategy and build a strong pipeline of potential customers.

As a BDR at MotherDuck, you’ll be the first point of contact for many of our prospective customers, engaging them in meaningful conversations about how our platform can help them duck and cover from data complexity. You will work closely with our Sales and Marketing teams to identify, engage, and qualify leads, ensuring a seamless handoff to our Account Executives. If you thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and love the challenge of building relationships and identifying business opportunities, this role is for you!

This role based will be located in our New York City office. 




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Identify & Qualify Opportunities: Listen actively, ask great questions, and determine if a prospect is a strong fit for MotherDuck’s solutions.

 - Pipeline Building: Develop and maintain a pipeline of high-quality leads to support our Account Executives.

 - Product Education: Learn and articulate MotherDuck’s value proposition to prospective customers in a way that resonates with their pain points.

 - Collaboration: Work closely with Sales, Marketing, and Product teams to refine messaging and improve outreach effectiveness.

 - Communicate with Clarity: Explain technical concepts in a way that’s easy to understand, ensuring potential customers grasp the value of MotherDuck.

 - Continuous Improvement: Gather feedback from prospects to help improve our messaging and go-to-market approach.

 - Adapt & Problem-Solve: Tailor your approach based on different industries, customer pain points, and personalities.

 - Own the Process: Maintain accurate records in our CRM, follow up with prospects, and continually refine your outreach strategies.

 - Outbound Prospecting: Conduct targeted outreach via email, phone, and social channels to generate interest and set meetings with potential customers.

 - Stay Curious & Keep Learning: Develop a deep understanding of data analytics, industry trends, and the challenges our customers face.




WHAT YOU BRING

 - A high motor—you thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and love pushing forward.

 - Resilience and adaptability—you see challenges as opportunities and can quickly pivot when needed.

 - Strong communication skills—you know how to engage, listen, and connect with different audiences.

 - Emotional intelligence—you read the room, handle objections with grace, and build trust naturally.

 - Intellectual curiosity— You have a natural curiosity for learning about new industries, technologies, and customer pain points, coupled with a willingness to experiment, iterate, and adapt based on feedback to continuously refine your outreach strategies.

 - A collaborative mindset—you’re a team player who works well across functions and values shared success.

 - Technical aptitude—you’re excited about data and analytics and eager to learn more about how MotherDuck helps companies.

 - A hunter mentality—you’re motivated, persistent, and thrive on finding and developing new opportunities
   


WHAT PEOPLE SHOULD BE SAYING IF YOU’RE DOING DUCKING AWESOME

 - “This BDR is a prospecting machine! They consistently bring in high-quality leads that convert.”

 - “Their ability to break down technical concepts and spark interest is unmatched.”

 - “They don’t just send emails—they build relationships and open doors.”

 - “The pipeline is flowing smoothly, thanks to their proactive outreach and keen qualification skills.”




OUR INTERVIEW PROCESS

We like to keep things transparent, so here's what to expect if you apply...

 1. Discovery call with our recruiting team to get acquainted and make sure we're a mutual fit

 2. A conversation with our BDR Lead to learn more about your prospecting approach, communication style, and what excites you about the data space

 3. A deeper conversation with our Sales team covering outbound strategy, how you handle objections, and a short role-play exercise

 4. A final conversation with our CEO focused on values and vision




PLEASE APPLY

Does this role sound appealing to you, but you’re missing some of the requirements or don’t quite think you’re qualified?  Please apply anyway. Research has shown that underrepresented groups in technology often shy away from roles which aren’t a 100% match. We aim to build a diverse team and will strongly consider applicants who bring many of the requirements plus have other experiences which round out their qualifications.

MotherDuck is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. MotherDuck is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with physical and mental disabilities.

jobs.description:
ABOUT KYRA

Kyra is an enterprise influencer marketing platform working with brands like SharkNinja, Coach, H&M, Ray-Ban, and Converse. Our platform manages the full lifecycle — creator discovery, campaign management, content review, payments, analytics, and AI-powered intelligence across TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.



If you've spent the last few years inside the creator economy watching brands realise how central creators have become to their strategy, this is a role where that knowledge pays off.



💡 THE ROLE IN A NUTSHELL

You own a portfolio of brand accounts. Your job is to keep them happy, keep them renewing, and spot growth before anyone else does.



💡 WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Everyone at Kyra is client-facing. Campaign Management talks to clients daily about delivery. What makes this role different is accountability: you are answerable for the relationship, the commercial outcome, and the story the client believes about working with us. You'll have senior team members behind you on the most complex accounts, but day to day, your portfolio is yours.


 - The accounts. Your portfolio is yours end-to-end. If an account is healthy or struggling, that's on you to know first.

 - The relationship. You're the person the client contacts first, whether it's a new idea, a small worry, or a big question.

 - The account narrative. Campaigns generate results. You turn results into a story the client acts on: what happened, why it matters, what we do next. If the client can't articulate why Kyra is working for them, that's your gap to close.

 - The early warning. If something is drifting, you catch it early and bring a plan. Leadership never hears bad news from the client before they hear it from you.

 - The signals. You notice when a client is ready to do more and pass it up with enough context for leadership to act on it.
   


🎯 LEAD THE RELATIONSHIP

 - Run client calls and check-ins across launches, seasonal moments, and always-on programs. Keep every stakeholder in the loop without dropping threads.
   


📈 OWN THE STORY IN THE NUMBERS

 - Reporting is a team sport: Campaign feeds delivery data, Strategy feeds insight. You own the narrative and the recommendation. Engagement, EMV, sales lift, affiliate impact. Numbers alone don't move a client, so your job is to explain what they mean and what to do next.


🤖 AI-FIRST

 - You use AI daily to speed up reporting, sharpen comms, and pull insight out of campaign data, which frees up your time for the relationship itself.
   


🔍 OWN WHAT THE CLIENT EXPERIENCES

 - Campaign Management runs the mechanics of delivery. You're accountable for what the client experiences of it: commitments kept, scopes protected, budgets clear, no surprises. When something inside delivery threatens a client commitment, you know before the client does and you arrive with a plan.
   


📊 PROTECT REVENUE

 - Healthy accounts renew. Beyond that, you spot upsell opportunities in the day-to-day and get them in front of leadership early.
   


🛡️ KEEP THINGS RUNNING

 - Keep trackers clean and workflows efficient. Make sure client feedback reaches the right team instead of getting lost in Slack.
   


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 2-4 years in influencer or creator marketing, with real time on brand accounts

 - Hands-on campaign fluency and genuine command of Meta and TikTok

 - Clients who stayed because of you. Bring the examples

 - Strong organisational skills and close attention to detail

 - Commercial awareness: budgets, margins, and a feel for when an account is ready to grow

 - Comfortable owning both the relationship and the commercial conversation, and flexing across delivery when the account needs it

 - AI is already part of how you work day to day

You should be reliable, easy to trust with a client, and able to talk clearly about the accounts you've run: what worked, what didn't, and why.



TRAITS THAT MATTER

Curious. Organised. Direct. Adaptable. You build trust quickly, take feedback well, flag problems early with a plan, and don't wait to be told what to do.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

6 months in: your clients treat you as their go-to, the account story is sharp and lands on time, delivery commitments hold, issues surface early with a plan attached, and leadership regularly hears about expansion opportunities because you spotted them first.

From there, the path is real: bigger accounts, more commercial ownership, and a route to Senior Client Solutions Manager for people who prove they can grow what they hold.



BENEFITS

 - 🌎 Remote-first, so you can work from wherever you do your best work

 - 🌴 Annual Time Off: 25 days PTO + bank holidays, 4 company-wide days off (Kyra Days), 3 wellness days, and paid sick leave each year

You will work collaboratively with affiliate Medical Teams across therapeutic areas, medical advisors, medical science liaisons, investigators, site staff, legal teams, and other internal and external stakeholders.

• Develop project management processes to support the effective delivery of local studies and other medical projects in the Netherlands and identify opportunities to improve processes, systems, and the overall user experience.

jobs.title: DevRel (SF Events)
jobs.description:
ABOUT TRIGGER.DEV

Trigger.dev http://Trigger.dev is an open source platform used by developers to build production-grade AI agents. It's an SDK and the infrastructure to run agents reliably at scale, so teams can focus on the product instead of the plumbing.

Our Cloud product is a managed service where we deploy our users' code and auto-scale from zero to millions of executions. With the rise of AI, being able to offload async tasks reliably is a key part of any developer's toolkit - we're building the infrastructure to make that a reality.



ABOUT THE POSITION

We're looking for someone based in San Francisco whose entire job is turning up to events, meeting developers, advocating for Trigger, and being brilliant. This role is deliberately narrow: it's 100% events, not product education, content strategy, or general marketing.

The work breaks down into three things: showing up to existing events (meetups, AI Tinkers, YC events, conferences) and being visibly excellent in the room; getting speaking slots at those events and delivering awesome talks; and, over time, organizing our own events or co-hosting them with other big tech names, like joint hackathons at the YC offices.

The goal is pure awareness. You might not even mention Trigger.dev http://Trigger.dev by name at most events - the point is being visibly excellent and well-liked in the rooms where developers already are, so that a groundswell of Trigger.dev http://Trigger.dev mentions builds naturally across the SF ecosystem over time.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

You'll do a variety of things including:

 - Turn up to events, meet developers, advocate for Trigger, be brilliant - attending SF developer events, meetups, AI Tinkers, YC events, and conferences, and building genuine relationships across the SF developer and founder ecosystem

 - Get speaking slots at existing events, deliver awesome talks - pitching yourself for talks and panels, and showing up polished and memorable when you get the slot

 - Organize our own events (or co-host them with other big tech names) - running Trigger.dev http://Trigger.dev meetups or talks, and exploring joint events like hackathons co-hosted at spaces such as the YC offices

 - Optionally writing blog recaps or producing short YouTube clips of talks, where it's a natural byproduct of the work rather than the focus

 - Working largely independently - you'll be on your own in SF a lot, so being deeply self-motivated is essential

 - Reporting back on activity: number of events attended, video of any talks given, and a written recap of who you met


REQUIREMENTS

You really need to have:

 - Genuine stage presence and charisma - we'll want to see video evidence of you speaking, presenting, or performing (YouTube is the bar)

 - A developer background; you should be credible and comfortable in a room of engineers

 - High self-motivation - this role has little day-to-day oversight and a real risk of isolation, so you need to thrive working independently

 - Genuine belief in what Trigger.dev http://Trigger.dev is building, since you'll be representing us informally in every room you're in

You'll be an amazing fit if you:

 - Are an ex-YC founder, giving you access to YC-only events and community

 - Existing relationships or an existing audience within the SF/AI developer or founder scene

 - Been an early-stage founder yourself, or are very early in your career and highly self-directed

 - A track record of speaking at or organizing developer events

 - Have a social media presence


ABOUT THE TEAM

 - We are a small team with a flat hierarchy

 - We encourage continuous learning and personal development

 - Everyone operates autonomously; we trust you to get the job done, but to also quickly raise your hand if you need help

 - We care about our customers and the open-source community

 - Being a start-up, the work is challenging and fast-paced, but we also understand the importance of taking time off to recharge


WORKING AT A COMMERCIAL OPEN SOURCE SOFTWARE COMPANY IS MORE THAN JUST YOUR DAY JOB

 - We have an active community on Discord and GitHub. Everyone on the team helps customers, reviews PRs, and creates issues

 - Great documentation matters more than ever, both for humans and for the AI tools that read it. Everyone here keeps docs up to date

 - We are a product-led growth company so everyone is expected to get involved in creating content like code examples, blog articles, videos and tweets
   


BENEFITS

 - Generous, transparent compensation and equity - We hire the best talent and pay to reflect that. We also offer equity as a way to ensure everyone is invested in the success of the company.

 - Async working - Need a heads-down day or meeting-free days to stay productive? No problem!

 - Home office - We will help provide equipment for a comfortable setup so you're as productive at home as you are in the office.

 - Generous vacation - We believe it's important to take time off. We encourage you to take your 25 days vacation excluding national holidays, plus sick leave and generous parental leave.

 - Training budget - An annual budget to contribute towards learning such as purchasing books, an Audible subscription or online courses.

 - Pension and 401k contributions - Enroll in our company pension scheme or we'll contribute directly to your private pension.

We run a closed content loop across three products:

 - AlphaNovel — a reading and audiobook platform where 50,000+ writers publish serialized fiction, and readers (not publishers) decide what becomes a hit.

 - StorybyWriter — the author platform behind it.

 - DramaShorts — our vertical streaming app. Launched in April 2024, it now has 12M+ viewers, 5M+ of them coming back every month, and 50+ original titles in the catalogue.


The loop is the point: AlphaNovel tells us exactly which stories, tropes and characters an audience of millions actually pays for. DramaShorts turns the winners into vertical drama. Performance data from launch tells us what to write next. You will be writing with that data in your hands, not guessing.

We shoot in the US and Europe with professional actors and crews, and we use AI across the pipeline — scripting support, dubbing, post-production — as a co-pilot, not a replacement. The creative calls stay with writers and directors.

 - Generating and testing new ideas for series, formats, and content mechanics

 - Working with AI tools for scriptwriting, scene generation, and storytelling

 - Analyzing vertical content trends and adapting the best storytelling practices for a global audience

 - Optimizing scripts for retention and binge-watching behavior

 - Collaborating with the product and creative teams to move content into production quickly

You're our ideal candidate if you:

 - Have a strong "watch history": you regularly consume serialized, short-form, and vertical content and can deconstruct what actually keeps viewers hooked

 - Understand the specifics of vertical drama and can tell the difference between YouTube storytelling, classic film dramaturgy, and mobile-first content

 - Can build a dynamic structure: hook → conflict → cliffhanger

jobs.title: Technical SME & Project Lead
jobs.description:
AbbVie is seeking a Technical SME & Project Lead to join the Core 1 Manufacturing team. In this role, you will provide technical expertise across manufacturing processes and technologies, supporting the introduction of new products and technologies, the optimization of existing operations, and the resolution of day-to-day technical challenges.

You will work closely with colleagues across Operations, Engineering, Quality, Validation, Technical Services, and other functions, as well as with AbbVie teams across the global network and external vendors and consultants.

This is an excellent opportunity for a technically minded professional with experience in biologics, pharmaceuticals, medical devices, or a related regulated manufacturing environment.

Key Responsibilities

• Act as the Operations point of contact for site projects involving the introduction of new technologies or products and the upgrade of existing equipment and processes.
• Provide technical support for day-to-day manufacturing queries, including support for change controls and CAPAs.
• Lead or support process improvement initiatives focused on manufacturing reliability, efficiency, quality, and cost reduction.
• Provide technical expertise for sterilization processes, including:FiltrationSteam sterilizationEthylene Oxide (ETO)Gamma sterilization
• Support manual and automated cleaning processes to ensure compliance with regulatory and quality requirements.
• Provide technical support for depyrogenation processes and the effective removal of pyrogens from components.
• Support lyophilization processes, including freeze-drying and vacuum-drying operations.
• Provide technical expertise for Vaporized Hydrogen Peroxide (VHP) sterilization within cleanroom environments.
• Support the design of facilities and utilities relevant to manufacturing processes, ensuring compliance and operational suitability.
• Act as a technical authority for aseptic processing, including vial, cartridge, and syringe filling operations.
• Contribute technical expertise to ongoing risk assessments and process evaluations.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement innovative solutions that improve manufacturing performance and product quality.
• Ensure new technologies and products meet applicable regulatory, quality, safety, and operational requirements and can be effectively integrated into existing processes.
• Support departmental initiatives relating to safety, training, quality, and continuous improvement.
• Participate in recruitment activities and relevant interview panels when required.
• Travel occasionally to support project work and collaboration with other subject matter experts.

Required

• A third-level qualification in a STEM discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
• Experience working in a biologics, pharmaceutical, medical device, or similarly regulated manufacturing environment.
• Typically, 2–5 years of relevant experience in a technical or manufacturing role.
• Strong understanding of regulatory requirements and industry standards relevant to aseptic manufacturing.
• Demonstrated technical expertise and the ability to apply scientific and engineering principles to manufacturing challenges.
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional project teams.
• Ability to work independently, take initiative, define functional requirements, and deliver practical solutions.
• Strong collaboration and team leadership skills, with the ability to work effectively across departments and organizational levels.

Preferred

• Experience with aseptic filling operations for vials, cartridges, or syringes.
• Experience with sterilization, cleaning, depyrogenation, lyophilization, or cleanroom technologies.
• Experience supporting change controls, CAPAs, risk assessments, validation, or process improvement projects.
• Experience working with external vendors, consultants, and global technical teams.

What You Will Bring

You will be a proactive, solutions-focused professional who can combine strong technical knowledge with practical manufacturing experience. You will be comfortable working in a regulated environment, managing multiple priorities, and communicating effectively with stakeholders at all levels.

About AbbVie

AbbVie is a global, research-driven biopharmaceutical company committed to discovering and delivering innovative medicines and solutions that address complex health challenges. Our culture is built on collaboration, scientific excellence, integrity, and a commitment to improving patients’ lives.

AbbVie is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can contribute, grow, and succeed.

jobs.title: Customer Success Specialist
jobs.description:
About Everfield

Everfield buys, builds, and grows European vertical market and specialist software companies, providing them with the tools they need to move to the next level. Our mission is to foster ambition, fuel growth, and unlock opportunities for Europe’s software ecosystem.

Companies in the Everfield ecosystem follow a decentralised model, maintaining their team, brand, and offices, while focusing on what they do best - building products and supporting customers. Everfield provides support in talent acquisition, HR, and access to a team of experts in building and growing European B2B SaaS companies who consult on financial and operational topics. Founded in 2022, Everfield has an ecosystem presence in 9 countries, and growing.

Customer Success-medarbejder med hjerte for vores storkunder

OnlinePOS Randers

Brænder du for at skabe stærke relationer til vores storkunder, og trives du bedst, når du selv er med til at sætte retningen? Er du struktureret, tager du initiativ og ansvar uden at blive bedt om det, og formår du at bevare overblikket, selv når det går stærkt? Så er det dig, vi leder efter til vores Customer Success-team hos OnlinePOS.

Hvem er vi?

Måske kender du ikke navnet endnu, men du kender os helt sikkert alligevel. Hen over sommeren og resten af året møder du vores røde logo overalt: på restauranter, cocktailbarer, bodegaer, isboder ved Vesterhavet, festivaler, events og forlystelsesparker.

Vores mange kunder har valgt os i et konkurrencepræget marked, og det ansvar tager vi seriøst. Vi lever af stærke relationer og god service, og derfor er vores Customer Success-team helt afgørende for vores succes, ikke mindst i forhold til vores storkunder.

Hvem er du?

Du er den, vores storkunder ringer til, når det betyder noget, og den, dine kollegaer ved, de kan regne med, når der skal tages ansvar. Det vigtigste er, at du:

• Er positiv og udadvendt

• Er struktureret og kan tage initiativ samt ansvar

• Trives med kundekontakt

• Kan arbejde både selvstændigt og sammen med andre

• Motiveres af ansvar og synlig indflydelse på forretningen

• Kan bevare overblikket i stressende situationer

Du har erfaring med kundekontakt og kundepleje, gerne fra en key account-rolle, og du er vant til at styre flere projekter ad gangen. Har du derudover erfaring med IT og en teknisk forståelse, er det en fordel, men det er ikke et krav.

Hvad kommer du til at lave?

Ingen dage er ens, og tempoet er højt. Du kommer til at være i tæt dialog med både vores storkunder og dine kolleger, og dine primære opgaver bliver at:

• Være den faste kontaktperson for vores storkunder

• Sikre den bedst mulige løsning for kunden og udvikle den løbende

• Arbejde med opsøgende salg

• Være med til at sikre, at vi som organisation kan give kunderne den bedst mulige service

• Have et tæt samarbejde med vores supportafdeling

Hos os handler det ikke kun om tal og aftaler. Det handler om mennesker og relationer, og om at du tør tage ansvar og sætte dit præg på vores vigtigste kundeforhold.

 

Hvordan er det at starte hos os?

Kort sagt, virkelig godt. Du er ikke “den nye”, når du starter, for du har allerede mødt os. Vi begynder onboarding inden din første dag, så du lærer både kollegaer, produkter og kultur at kende på forhånd.

Og ja, vi tager imod dig med åbne arme og høj energi fra dag ét.

Hvad tilbyder vi?

• En ambitiøs og uformel virksomhed med fart på

• Stor indflydelse på egne kunder og på forretningens udvikling

• Vi er en del af Everfield, en europæisk koncern med mere end 40 softwarevirksomheder, som giver dig adgang til et stort fagligt fællesskab på tværs af landegrænser

• Masser af sociale arrangementer og godt sammenhold

• En arbejdsplads med højt til loftet og plads til grin

• Fokus på ansvarlighed og CSR. Vi arbejder aktivt med det og er stolte af det

• Løn efter kvalifikationer samt pension og sundhedssikring

Lyder det som dig?

Perfekt. Og du behøver ikke kunne det hele. Har du viljen, energien og lysten til at tage ansvar for vores storkunder, så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Send din ansøgning og CV via linket. Vi ansætter, når vi finder den rette, så tøv ikke.

Har du spørgsmål? Kontakt vores Customer Success Teamlead på +45 71 74 12 76

Vi glæder os til at møde dig.

jobs.title: Project Manager (PMP Certification preferred)
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Market Research Project Manager to lead end-to-end market research projects across global markets, with a primary focus on supporting US-based stakeholders and clients. The ideal candidate will possess strong project management expertise, exceptional communication skills, and a passion for leveraging Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools to improve project efficiency, decision-making, and execution.

The Project Manager will be responsible for planning, scheduling, coordinating, monitoring, and delivering complex market research and business initiatives while ensuring projects are completed on time, within scope, and to the highest quality standards.

Project Planning & Execution

Stakeholder Management

• Facilitate project meetings, status reviews, and executive updates.

jobs.title: Gratis opleiding tot centralist
jobs.description:
🔒 Gratis opleiding tot centralist

📍 Locatie: Amsterdam

💰 € 16,63 bruto per uur excl. toeslag

📅 36 uur per week

✅ Extra’s: Eindejaarsuitkering, reiskostenvergoeding, pensioen, fietsplan, tot 30% korting op bijv. winkels en hotels via Benefits at Work.

🎓 Geen diploma? Geen probleem! Jouw opleiding wordt volledig door Securitas vergoed. Bij Securitas vinden we jouw ontwikkeling belangrijk. Er zijn volop kansen om je verder te ontwikkelen, zo kan je doorgroeien naar een leidinggevende functie of een kantoorfunctie. Lees meer in onze verhalen.

Als centralist in het Securitas Operations Center (SOC) werk je in het hart van onze beveiligingsorganisatie. Vanuit onze alarmcentrale verwerk je 24/7 meldingen van klanten uit heel Nederland. Geen dienst is hetzelfde: je schakelt snel, blijft rustig en zorgt dat de juiste actie wordt ingezet.

Heb je nog geen ervaring in de beveiliging? Geen probleem. Bij Securitas kun je je laten omscholen. Je krijgt een goede inwerkperiode en leert stap voor stap hoe je meldingen beoordeelt en opvolgt.

Je bewaakt locaties op afstand (denk aan Geldmaat), ondersteunt collega’s in het veld en je ondersteunt tijdens probleem situaties. Daarmee draag je direct bij aan een veiligere wereld.

Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

• Ontvangen en beoordelen van inbraak-, brand- en overvalmeldingen
• Controleren van camerabeelden en signaleren van afwijkingen
• Afstemmen met mobiele surveillanten en andere hulpdiensten
• Inzetten van de juiste opvolging bij alarmmeldingen
• Bewaken van veiligheid op afstand via camera- en (voertuig)volgsystemen
• Communiceren met klanten en collega’s in stressvolle situaties

• Je bent stressbestendig, analytisch en ziet iedere alarmmelding als een uitdaging.
• Je beschikt over mbo werk- en denkniveau.
• Ervaring in de beveiliging is niet noodzakelijk. We hechten meer waarde aan jouw motivatie.
• Je bent flexibel inzetbaar en je vindt het prima om in een 24/7 omgeving te werken, incl. weekenden, ochtend-, middag- of nachtdiensten.
• Je woont in een straal van 40km rondom Amsterdam.
• Je herkent je in onze kernwaarden: integriteit, waakzaamheid en behulpzaamheid.
• Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal goed.

• Salaris van € 16,63 bruto per uur.
• Na het behalen van je opleiding een arbeidsovereenkomst bij Securitas voor minimaal een jaar met uren garantie.
• Contract voor 36 uur in de week.
• 24 vakantiedagen (bij fulltime contract).
• Een wisselend rooster, waardoor jij veel vrije tijd hebt. Je rooster is 4 weken van tevoren bekend.
• Pensioenregeling, reiskostenvergoeding eindejaarsuitkering.
• Ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden via onze eigen Learning Hub.
• Benefits at Work app met hoge kortingen op allerlei winkels en dagjes uit.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Manager
jobs.description:
In your role, you are responsible for leading and setting up supply chain team in both the Boards and Furniture units. Organizing and overseeing supply chain activities is a key aspect of your role, and you provide effective leadership and motivation to our dedicated employees.

Preparation of comprehensive documentation and reports for management, including sales evaluation, stock development, and material deliveries, is part of your responsibilities. Working closely with the production and quality departments, you ensure customer needs are met. You maintain control over compliance with storage and logistic standards. Active participation in the sales budget preparation process is expected from you. Collaborating with all departments of the company, you actively contribute to introducing new products.

• You should hold a Master's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration or a related field
• 10 years of proven experience in Supply Chain preferably in manufacturing
• You should possess strong leadership skills and the ability to train and develop people and building the team

We welcome your application

• Opportunity to take an active role in building one of the most competitive furniture clusters on the planet.
• Opportunities for professional development and career growth.
• Supportive and inclusive workplace culture.

At IKEA, we are looking for people who believe everyone deserves a seat at the table. You’re welcome no matter where you come from, what you believe, or what you look like. jobs.title: Sales Associate, New York
jobs.description:
INSTITUTIONAL FABRIC FOR THE DIGITAL ASSET MARKET

Founded in 2018, Talos provides institutional-grade trading technology for the global digital asset market, powering many of the major players in the crypto ecosystem. Our mission is clear: to advance the mass adoption of digital assets by seamlessly connecting institutions to the digital asset ecosystem. We are committed to building the most innovative and trusted platform in the world, supporting the entire trading lifecycle.

At Talos, you’ll find an environment that champions kindness and respect, values diverse perspectives, and upholds inclusivity at every turn. We believe every member of our team brings invaluable insights and abilities that drive Talos forward. In our pursuit of excellence, we foster a culture of trust, integrity, collaboration, and mutual growth.

We are a tight-knit yet globally distributed team of highly experienced engineers and business leaders, with hubs in New York, London, Singapore, and Cyprus. Whether in-office or remote, you’ll be part of a hybrid-friendly environment where your unique talents and insights will play a crucial role in building something extraordinary.




SALES ASSOCIATE

This is an early-career sales opportunity for individuals looking to build a long-term career at the intersection of institutional finance and digital assets.

As a Sales Associate at Talos, you will work closely with senior Sales and Solutions colleagues across the full deal lifecycle - from initial outreach and qualification through to solutioning, trials, and close. You will develop strong product expertise, gain a deep understanding of institutional trading workflows, and contribute directly to pipeline generation and deal execution.

Talos operates a structured, consultative sales environment. This role is well-suited to someone who is organized, intellectually curious, and motivated to understand how markets and trading infrastructure function.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Support pipeline generation through targeted prospecting, outreach, and early-stage qualification across Talos’s core client segments, including hedge funds, market makers, prime brokers, and digital asset service providers.

 - Participate in discovery and demo calls alongside senior sales team members, learning to map client workflows and requirements to Talos’s product capabilities.

 - Maintain high-quality CRM hygiene in Salesforce, ensuring all opportunities, contacts, and activities are accurately recorded and up to date.

 - Conduct market and account research to identify high-potential prospects and inform account prioritization strategies.

 - Coordinate cross-functionally with Solutions, Account Management, Product, and Engineering to advance deals and ensure accurate client communication.

 - Support proposal development, workflow documentation, and follow-up materials for active opportunities.

 - Capture and quantify product feedback and feature requests, connecting client insights to product roadmap discussions.

 - Build strong product knowledge over time, including Talos’s capabilities, competitive positioning, and technical architecture.

 - Represent Talos at industry conferences and client events to build relationships, enhance brand presence, and identify new business opportunities.




REQUIREMENTS

 - 1 - 2 years of experience in a client-facing role, ideally within enterprise SaaS, fintech, or institutional financial services.

 - Strong recent graduates with relevant internship experience will also be considered.

 - Demonstrated interest in financial markets, trading, and technology.

 - Familiarity with digital assets or crypto markets is advantageous but not required.

 - Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple workflows reliably.

 - Experience using CRM systems (preferably Salesforce) within a structured sales process.

 - Clear and professional communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts in straightforward terms.

 - Coachable, proactive, and thoughtful in approach, with good judgment on when to escalate versus act independently.

 - High level of ownership and self-direction; able to identify priorities, remove blockers, and maintain momentum without constant guidance.

 - Comfortable working in a fast-paced, distributed team environment with a high degree of autonomy.




OUR SALES APPROACH

Talos operates a systematic, consultative sales process built around a simple principle: listen first, sell second. We take the time to understand a client's workflows, constraints, and goals before positioning a solution. We sell what we have - with deep product mastery and honest conversations about what's on the roadmap and what isn't.

We maintain a balanced pipeline across focus segments, use Salesforce rigorously to track progress, and hand off every closed deal with a documented account plan so the relationship starts on solid footing from day one.

We play the long game. Underpromise, overdeliver, and build the kind of relationships that compound over time.



Check out these videos and links to learn more about Talos and our culture!

Andreessen Horowitz re: Talos: "The company best suited to drive institutional adoption is one that understands traditional capital markets deeply and is forward-thinking enough to fully grasp the promise of crypto. Talos is that company."




BENEFITS

You will also enjoy a comprehensive array of competitive benefits, regardless of your location, within our warm, welcoming, and ambitious company culture. Some of our benefits include:

 - Retirement plan contributions

 - Unlimited Vacation + a PTO bonus: Employees that take 15 days of vacation, with 5 days being consecutive, receive a $2000 USD bonus.
