jobs.title: Indirect Tax Manager - 6 Month Fixed Term Contract
jobs.description:
Role OVO-View

Team: Indirect Tax

Salary banding: £70,000 - £80,000

Experience: Expert

Contract Type: Fixed Term Contract

Reporting to: Indirect Tax Senior Manager

Sponsorship: Unfortunately we are unable to offer sponsorship for this role.

This role in 3 words: Expert, Compliance, Attention to detail

Top 3 qualities for this role: Thorough, pro-active, communication

Where you’ll work:

At OVO, we understand that a one size fits all approach doesn’t work for everyone. That’s why we created the OVO Way of Flexibility.

All our roles are hub based (Bristol, Glasgow or London), providing a dedicated space for collaboration, connection and teamwork, however within this role you’ll have the flexibility to work mostly from home.

Everyone belongs at OVO

At OVO, we are on a mission to solve one of humanity's biggest challenges, the climate crisis. And we know it takes all of us to change the world. That's why we need diverse people from all abilities, gender identities, ethnicities, ages, sexual orientations, life experiences and backgrounds to join us.

Teamworking for the planet

Everything we do here spins around Plan Zero. So, naturally, the team you’ll be joining plays a gigantic role in making that happen, and having an efficiently functioning Finance team will help us towards this journey.

This role in a nutshell:

This role will be a key member of the Indirect tax team. This is an essential role which will be focused on providing expert indirect tax support for VAT-focused projects, with an emphasis on compliance, process reviews, and internal controls.

Your key outcomes will be:

• Review and document end-to-end VAT processes from source to return.

• Analyse and adapt processes to support VAT projects and transitional activities.

• Identify and implement control improvements to ensure robust compliance.

• Partner with wider finance and technology project teams to design and implement necessary processes and reporting.

• Proactively identify necessary actions and take ownership of delivering changes, with support from the Senior Indirect Tax Manager.

• Assisting the Indirect Tax Senior Manager with projects and support as required.

You’ll be a successful Indirect Tax Manager here at OVO if you…

• Are ACA/CTA qualified.

• Possess excellent indirect tax technical knowledge.

• Are a strong team player, recognising the needs of all stakeholders and ensuring outcomes maximise value and impact across the enterprise.

• Have the ability to problem solve complex issues, by using your experience and skills.

• Are diligent with a preference for attention to detail, and be willing to investigate at depth to resolve problems.

• Have excellent communication skills in order to explain complex tax issues and information to a non-tax audience.

• Have In-house experience in a consumer facing business.

Ideally you will have:

• A strong background in indirect tax, with specific expertise in compliance processes and financial controls.

• The ability to identify 'what needs to happen' and comfortably take ownership of delivery.

• A collaborative approach, and a team player who is comfortable working with finance teams and wider project teams.

• Excellent communication skills to bridge the gap between tax, the wider finance function and the operational business areas.

Let’s talk about what’s in it for you

We’ll pay you between £70,000 and £80,000, depending on your specific skills and experience. If your expectations are a little different, have a chat with us!

We keep our pay ranges broad on purpose to give us, and you, flexibility to match your experience to our zero carbon mission.

You’ll be eligible for an on-target bonus of 15%. We have one OVO bonus plan that focuses on the collective performance of our people to deliver our Plan Zero goal.

We also offer plenty of green benefits and progressive policies to help you feel like you belong at OVO…and there’s flex pay. We'll give you 9% Flex Pay on top of your salary – 4% of this is auto enrolled into your pension, and the remaining 5% is yours to do what you like with. You can use this to buy from our extensive range of flexible benefits, including our green benefits which we've put at the heart of our offering, add to your pension or even take it as cash.

Here’s a taster of what’s on offer:

For starters, you’ll get 34 days of holiday (including bank holidays).

For your health
With benefits like a healthcare cash plan or private medical insurance depending on your career level, critical illness cover, life assurance, health assessments, and more

For your wellbeing
With gym membership, travel insurance, workplace ISA, will writing services, dental insurance, and more

For your lifestyle
With extra holiday buying, discount dining, home & tech loans, and supporting your favourite charities with give-as-you-earn donations

For your home
Get up to £400 towards any OVO Energy plan, plus great discounts on solar, smart thermostats and EV chargers

For your commute
Nab a great deal on ultra-low emission car leasing, plus our cycle to work scheme and public transport season ticket loans

Want to hear about our full range of flexible benefits and progressive people policies? Our People Team can tell you everything you need to know.

For your Belonging

To find better ways to support our people, we need to listen to each other’s experiences and find ways to build a truly inclusive and diverse workplace. As part of this, we have 8 Belonging Networks at OVO. Led by our people, for our people - so when you join OVO, you can play a part - big or small - with any of the Networks. It's up to you.

Oh, and one last thing...

We’d be thrilled if you tick off all our boxes, yet we also believe it’s just as important we tick off all of yours. And if you think you have most of what we’re looking for but not every single thing, go ahead and hit apply. We’d still love to hear from you!

If you have any additional requirements, there’s a space to let us know on the application form; we want to make the process as easy and comfortable for you as possible..

jobs.title: Tax Manager
jobs.description:
Key Responsibilities

1. Tax Compliance

• Prepare federal taxable income calculations and supporting schedules for corporate income tax filings
• Gather and review state tax data from controllers; analyze for reasonableness and year-over-year consistency
• Coordinate with external compliance providers to ensure accurate and timely filing of federal, state, and local income tax returns
• Calculate and monitor quarterly estimated tax payments, ensuring timely and accurate submission
• Prepare and manage miscellaneous tax filings (e.g., withholding tax returns, tax residency certificates, FinCEN reporting)

2. Tax Provision & Reporting

• Prepare and review the U.S. income tax provision (ASC 740 or IFRS IAS 12), including current and deferred tax calculations
• Validate tax payable balances and deferred tax accounts
• Calculate and analyze the effective tax rate (ETR) and provide explanations to the parent company
• Perform quarterly tax account reconciliations and variance analysis
• Partner with the Controller and accounting team to ensure accurate financial data and proper recording of tax journal entries

3. Tax Advisory & Business Support

• Support the Tax Director on special projects, tax planning initiatives, and strategic matters
• Collaborate with external tax advisors on technical issues, transactions, and structuring considerations
• Provide ongoing guidance to finance and business teams on tax-related questions and impacts

4. Tax Controversy & Notices

• Manage federal and state tax audits, including timely and complete responses to Information Document Requests (IDRs)
• Handle tax notices and inquiries, resolving discrepancies with tax authorities
• Maintain audit-ready documentation and support ongoing compliance readiness

5. Process Improvement & Technology

• Identify and implement opportunities to improve tax processes, controls, and efficiency
• Leverage tax technology and automation tools to streamline compliance and reporting
• Demonstrate intellectual curiosity and initiative to challenge the status quo and enhance the tax function

This job description is not limited to the responsibilities above.  Smiths Group may require you to undertake other tasks as feasible.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field
• Master's in Taxation or equivalent preferred
• 5–8+ years of corporate tax experience (Big 4 and/or industry)
• Strong knowledge of:U.S. federal and state corporate income taxASC 740 and/or IFRS IAS 12 (tax provision)
• Experience managing external service providers and compliance processes
• Proficiency with tax software (e.g., OneSource, CorpTax)
• Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills

Preferred Attributes

• Ability to work cross-functionally and influence non-tax stakeholders
• Detail-oriented with strong problem-solving capabilities
• Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment
• Experience with tax technology, process automation, or transformation initiatives

Why Smiths?

• Be Part of Something Big: As we expand our footprint across APAC and MEA, you’ll play a key role in building the teams that will define our future.
• Growth Opportunities: At Smiths, we believe in your growth as much as our own. You’ll have the chance to shape your career and expand your leadership capabilities in an ever-evolving global landscape.
• Collaborative Culture: Join a diverse, collaborative team where innovation and fresh ideas are encouraged.
• Work-Life Balance: Enjoy flexible working arrangements and a supportive work environment.

.

We are proud to be an inclusive company with values grounded in equality and ethics, where we celebrate, support, and embrace diversity.

jobs.title: Bespoke B2B Events Sales Executive
jobs.description:
The Company

When it comes to digital communities, The Alliance https://allianceled.io/ is leading the way. Product marketing, sales enablement, product-led growth, AI, customer success, CMOs, you name it, we’re home to thriving communities for them all.

We connect industry leaders and innovators through unparalleled networking opportunities. We bring together leading minds to share the latest trends, challenges and opportunities facing companies, the tactics and tools needed to drive results, and a forum to make meaningful connections. 

Our Alliance brand is renowned for its VIP dinners, exclusive breakfasts, and bespoke 1-2-1 meeting packages designed to bridge supply and demand across various verticals. Join our dynamic team and drive sales to new commercial prospects, creating valuable connections and driving business growth.



The Role

We’re looking for a commercially driven VIP Event Sponsorship Sales Executive to take ownership of our high-level, invitation-only dinner series and related bespoke experiences.

You’ll focus on selling sponsorship packages to top-tier B2B brands looking to engage with senior audiences through intimate, content-driven environments. These conversations often serve as the entry point to broader partnership discussions, including full-series or multi-event sponsorships, making this a role with both immediate and strategic impact.

You’ll work closely with our wider event sponsorship team to identify opportunities, open doors, and nurture long-term commercial relationships that span across our community portfolio.



Key Responsibilities

 - Executive Event Sales: Lead sponsorship sales for The Alliance’s portfolio of exclusive, invite-only dinners and professional experiences.

 - New Business Development: Proactively identify, target, and secure sponsorship opportunities with prospective clients across both existing Alliance communities and new markets.

 - Client Outreach & Relationship Building: Re-engage existing clients from our digital and event portfolios, cultivating long-term sponsorship partnerships.

 - Revenue Growth: Consistently deliver new business revenue through proactive outreach, pitching, and closing bespoke event sponsorship deals.

 - Consultative Sales Approach: Understand client objectives and position bespoke event solutions that deliver tangible ROI.

 - Market Insight & Opportunity Creation: Stay ahead of B2B event trends to spot new opportunities, feeding insights back to product and event teams.

 - Pipeline Management: Maintain disciplined pipeline management, accurate forecasting, and consistent progress toward monthly and quarterly targets.

 - Collaboration: Work cross-functionally with events, marketing, content, and community teams to ensure flawless delivery of sponsorship packages.

 - Reporting & Feedback: Provide regular sales performance updates, client feedback, and market insights to inform ongoing strategy.
   
   

Requirements
If the below sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you:

 - Proven track record in event or sponsorship sales, ideally within B2B, media, or conferences.

 - You have a deep understanding of prospecting and developing strong relationships with enterprise customers 

 - You’ll be determined and focused, and enjoy the challenge of hunting and closing net new business

 - Tough targets won’t scare you and you’ll have a demonstrable track record of not just meeting them - but exceeding them

 - Confidence to experiment with different tactics, shake up strategy, adapt to new trends, to incorporate new products, changes, or to bounce back from subpar results

 - You want ownership in your role from the beginning and ready to level up. 

 - You expertly balance and prioritise your daily to-do's, as well as your short-term and long-term planning

 - Experience with Asana or project management tools a plus (desirable)



Location: This role can be either Hybrid in our London office or completely remote across the UK (not abroad). 

Salary: Base Salary range £32K - £38K (*Based on previous experience) - OTE £70K+

_______________________




BENEFITS


TIME OFF & FLEXIBILITY

 - 34 days’ paid holiday including UK Bank holidays and a day off on your birthday

 - Flexible working hours: our core hours are 10am–4:30pm, with the flexibility to structure your working day between 8am and 8pm around when you work best

 - Work from where works for you: choose to work remotely within the UK or hybrid from our London office. Our office is always open to the wider team whenever you fancy coming in

 - WFH Kit: a comprehensive tech setup, plus a dedicated WFH equipment budget

 - A well-stocked office: snacks, drinks and fresh fruit available in our London office


HEALTH & WELLBEING

 - Private Medical and Dental Insurance with Bupa

 - Life Insurance: cover worth 4x your annual salary

 - On-demand therapy & coaching: company sponsored access to therapy and career coaching through Spill

 - Wellness perks: discounts on gym memberships, fitness and wellness classes

 - Cycle to Work & Workplace Nursery schemes

 - Perks at Work: access to a wide range of corporate discounts

 - Monthly flexible benefits allowance through ThanksBen (£50/month in year one, £100/month in year two and £165/month from year three), giving you extra flexibility to spend on the benefits that matter most to you


LEARNING & DEVELOPMENT

 - A growing personal L&D budget (starting at £500 per year and increasing with tenure to £3,000 per year)

 - Dedicated L&D or volunteering time: one paid day every quarter to invest in your development or support a cause you care about.

 - Unlimited access to our internal Academy: including courses, learning resources and professional certifications

Community and Inclusion

We are committed to creating a workplace that is free from discrimination and bias, and where everyone has equal opportunities to succeed and contribute. We acknowledge that our work here is never done - and we promise to continue striving for inclusivity every day.
If you’re worried you don’t quite hit all the requirements we’ve listed, don’t let that hold you back from submitting your application! Unique backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives are essential for our ability to innovate and grow, so if you think you’d be a great fit then we’d love to hear from you.
We are The Alliance - in more ways than one.

jobs.title: Startups Lead
jobs.description:
Attio is the CRM for agentic revenue. Designed for the most ambitious go-to-market teams, it gives companies the power to understand every customer, automate at scale, and build their go-to-market motion exactly as they need. We've raised $116M from some of the world's best investors: GV (Google Ventures), Redpoint, Balderton, Point Nine, and 01A.

We hire builders who thrive on complex technical challenges, hold themselves to a high bar, and genuinely care about delighting the people who use what they build. The team here brings sharp judgement, real craft, and the drive to do exceptional work. We're obsessed about the details and energized by the frontier.

If you want to do the best work of your career, this is the right place.





ABOUT THE ROLE

We want every great startup to be using Attio. This role exists to make that happen.

We're looking for someone who has lived the startup journey, knows the ecosystem inside out, and has the relationships and instincts to move fast at the highest level. You'll own Attio's position in the Bay Area entirely - from the programs and partnerships that drive adoption, to the events and content that shape how founders think about Attio, to removing whatever friction stands between a great startup becoming a customer.

You'll operate with founder-level scope and autonomy - working across product, sales, and marketing to remove blockers and do whatever it takes to make Attio the default CRM for the best startups in the world.

The ideal candidate is deeply networked in SF and the broader tech ecosystem, has the pattern recognition of a former founder, VC, or early operator at a generational company, and is senior enough to drive forward and make things happen.

Important Note: We’re approaching this search with some flexibility on title, level, and compensation — our priority is finding the right person, and we’ll shape the role accordingly.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Startup dominance - Own the goal of getting every top startup onto Attio, with a relentless focus on YC and top accelerator cohorts, Series A penetration, and logos across the best VC portfolios

 - Strategic partnerships - Build deep relationships with the most influential VCs, accelerators, and ecosystem players - not as a channel, but as a genuine partner in how they support their portfolios

 - Events + community - Conceive and execute high-impact events - demo days, summits, dinners, hackathons - that bring the best founders together and position Attio at the centre of that world

 - Founder relationships - Be personally known and trusted by the founders of the next generation of breakout companies; be their go-to for advice, introductions, and tools

 - Cross-functional execution - Work across product, sales, and marketing to remove friction, identify gaps, and ship whatever is needed - new motions, integrations, custom work - to serve the startup market

 - Content + storytelling - Shape the narrative that makes Attio the obvious CRM choice for founders, producing content that resonates deeply with how they actually build


WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - 7+ years of experience as a founder, VC, or early operator at a high-growth startup - you've been in the room when the important decisions get made

 - A genuine, existing network across the startup ecosystem - you know the founders, the investors, and the connectors

 - The instincts and credibility to earn trust with early-stage founders quickly, and the seniority to drive decisions internally at pace

 - A track record of building and shipping complex programs or initiatives that moved the needle

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to craft compelling narratives for the founder audience

 - A builder's mindset - you're comfortable with ambiguity, operate with urgency, and take full ownership of outcomes

 - An eye for quality - whether it's a startup program, a founder dinner, or a piece of content, you know what great looks like and hold yourself to it
   
   


WHAT DOES THE HIRING PROCESS LOOK LIKE?

 - Initial conversations
   
   - 30-minute intro with a member of our Talent team
   
   - 30-minute track record interview with our Chief of Staff

 - Core interviews
   
   - The interview process will include three working sessions exploring your approach to problem solving and execution, ecosystem and activation thinking, and your perspective on AI, founder authenticity, and values alignment.

 - Final stage
   
   - 30-minute closing conversation with a member of our leadership team
   
   - Offer call (if it’s a mutual fit)

jobs.description:

Als verkoopmedewerker bij H&M speel je een centrale rol in het creëren van een unieke klantervaring.

KOM ERBIJ

Onze kracht en uniciteit zitten in veel dingen – in onze inclusieve cultuur, onze sterke waarden en onze ontwikkelmogelijkheden. Maar bovenal zijn het onze teams die ons maken tot wat we zijn.

Je vult dit assessment in als onderdeel van je sollicitatie. Je antwoorden worden getoetst aan vooraf vastgestelde criteria van de H&M Group.

jobs.title: Gestor de Clientes - Benguela
jobs.description:
Atender às solicitações dos clientes dos serviços bancários «Personal» e «Prestige» relativamente a quaisquer questões bancárias, desde dúvidas sobre produtos até atividades nas contas dos clientes, bem como quaisquer outros pedidos de serviço. Fazer uma avaliação e compreensão precisas das solicitações, de modo a dar-lhes resposta de forma definitiva, garantindo sempre o que é importante para o cliente, dentro dos parâmetros relativos aos produtos, ao segmento e à legislação (por exemplo, FAIS).

Funções Essenciais

Receber pedidos e consultas de clientes através de todos os meios de comunicação, relativos a produtos, atividades nas contas, RCPs, cartões de crédito e descobertos bancários, e fornecer-lhes uma resposta imediata ou facilitar a resolução do pedido de acordo com os procedimentos estabelecidos e todos os requisitos regulamentares (KYC, POPI, etc.), a fim de prestar um serviço de excelência e, assim, contribuir para a rentabilidade global da agência.

Compreender os riscos associados ao pedido do cliente e cumprir todos os requisitos de risco e conformidade ao executar o pedido.

Gerir os riscos associados a novas contas, mandatos e amostras de assinaturas, cumprindo os requisitos de risco e conformidade (por exemplo, utilização de verificação de impressões digitais online, digitalização na origem, assinatura eletrónica, etc.).

Informar os clientes de que está a agir sob supervisão, juntamente com outras divulgações relevantes da FAIS, e garantir que os processos operacionais são seguidos para assegurar que o cliente receba esta informação por escrito.

Identificar oportunidades de geração de procura durante as conversas com os clientes e promover a utilização de vários canais, tanto nas agências como fora delas, para aumentar as oportunidades de vendas adicionais; recolher e registar a documentação e as informações dos clientes correspondentes, conforme exigido pelas políticas e regulamentos.

Avaliar o que é importante para o cliente em relação à capacidade dos processos e sistemas de satisfazer as suas necessidades através da análise de dados, a fim de apresentar recomendações ao chefe de equipa para que este tome medidas no sistema e como contributo adicional para as áreas de Banca Pessoal e Produtos.

Analisar dados e informações para desenvolver e aplicar medidas de autocorreção dentro do âmbito de competências, de modo a permitir a satisfação constante das necessidades do cliente.

Atualizar gráficos de capacidade e o Sistema de Informação de Gestão (MIS), de modo a manter uma base de dados precisa para apoiar os líderes que têm de intervir no sistema.

Recolher informações sobre valor, variação e falhas no sistema durante a execução dos processos de trabalho, a fim de contribuir para o desenvolvimento de informações de gestão para o departamento.

Compreender o comportamento de um cliente numa conta através da leitura de extratos bancários, verificação de receitas e despesas, leitura e interpretação de quadros de resultados.

Abrir novas contas (incluindo a integração de novos clientes), efetuar transferências, alterações e encerramentos de contas de acordo com os procedimentos estabelecidos e os requisitos regulamentares.

Tipo de qualificação: Ensino secundário

Área de estudo: Não aplicável

Experiência exigida

Atendimento a clientes

Banca pessoal e privada

3-4 anos

Qualificação e experiência relevantes na área de FAIS. Caso não haja experiência em FAIS, será necessário trabalhar sob supervisão. Experiência anterior em agências bancárias ou em centros de atendimento, com bom conhecimento dos processos, políticas e produtos bancários.

Competências Comportamentais:

• Adotar abordagens práticas
• Articular informações
• Questionar ideias
• Convencer as pessoas
• Explorar possibilidades
• Seguir procedimentos
• Gerar ideias
• Tomar decisões
• Produzir resultados
• Apresentar perspetivas
• Mostrar serenidade
• Compreender as pessoas

Competências Técnicas:

• Verificação de candidaturas e submissões (Banca de Retalho)

• Aceitação e análise de clientes

jobs.title: AA Clinical Specialist
jobs.description:
As a Clinical Specialist – Allergan Aesthetics, you will support healthcare professionals in the safe and effective use of Allergan Aesthetics products through tailored, in-clinic facilitation aligned with the AMI Educational Journey.

You will identify educational needs, develop personalised learning pathways, and help HCPs build confidence and skills in patient assessment, treatment planning, anatomy, and approved injection techniques.

Key responsibilities include:

• Delivering in-clinic facilitation services (70%).

• Supporting approximately 30 HCPs aligned with strategic priorities.

• Developing tailored educational pathways and documenting activities in Veeva CRM.

• Promoting AMI Digital World and digital curricula (15%).

• Supporting AMI events, workshops, conferences, and mentorship programmes (15%).

• Ensuring a high-quality, consistent, and compliant educational experience.

• University degree in a clinically based subject, such as medicine, nursing, dentistry, physiotherapy, clinical pharmacy, or another relevant patient-facing clinical discipline.
• Experience in a sales, clinical specialist, training, or education role within the pharmaceutical, medical device, or aesthetics industry.
• Experience in facial aesthetics is highly desirable.
• Experience facilitating, training, or coaching healthcare professionals.
• Experience preparing and delivering workshops, events, or other training solutions.
• Valid driver’s licence and ability to drive.
• Strong communication, presentation, organisation, and stakeholder-management skills.
• Ability to tailor educational support to different levels of knowledge, skill, and confidence.
• Commitment to ethical, compliant, and patient-focused ways of working.
• Fluency in Dutch

In addition, experience in at least two of the following areas is desirable:

• Command of English.
• Tracking activity and performance metrics through a CRM system.
• Intermediate proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook.

Funções Essenciais

Avaliar, determinar e manter os indicadores de capacidade dos recursos da sucursal (pessoas, processos e sistemas) através da recolha e análise de informações/dados fiáveis, a fim de determinar o que os recursos podem, de forma previsível, alcançar no atendimento às exigências variáveis dos clientes, o desempenho atual face a esses indicadores e as alterações operacionais e de recursos, bem como as melhorias de eficiência, que é necessário implementar.

Avaliar, identificar e monitorizar todas as formas de risco enfrentadas pela agência e implementar e manter controlos adequados em todas as atividades e operações da agência, de modo a garantir a mitigação eficaz de riscos potenciais e o cumprimento das normas de gestão de risco para reduzir a exposição.

Criar em conjunto soluções de marketing para a agência, em colaboração com a Função de Marketing, alinhadas com a estratégia de captação de clientes, e impulsionar a concretização de oportunidades de vendas cruzadas entre a equipa, de acordo com os procedimentos estabelecidos, para garantir que os clientes estejam cientes e, consequentemente, sejam encaminhados para os canais mais adequados às suas necessidades específicas.

Desenvolver e impulsionar estratégias e táticas adequadas para os clientes, de modo a garantir que os objetivos da demonstração de resultados e do balanço sejam atingidos, de acordo com os limites explícitos de fixação de preços ao nível do cliente e os objetivos de rentabilidade.

Desenvolver e impulsionar metas e objetivos a curto e médio prazo para a filial, em apoio aos objetivos gerais da área de influência, de modo a garantir uma gestão eficaz das receitas e despesas, com ênfase na contenção dos custos controláveis.

Impulsionar e avaliar o alinhamento entre as necessidades de pessoal da filial e o plano local de recursos humanos, para garantir que existem recursos humanos suficientes para responder às exigências variáveis dos clientes.

Impulsionar a implementação dos requisitos relativos aos representantes de Saúde e Segurança no Trabalho (SST) 16(2) em toda a agência, de modo a garantir o seu cumprimento nos termos da lei (ou seja, auditorias trimestrais/anuais, nomeação de responsáveis pela segurança e socorristas, simulacros de evacuação de emergência, seguro de acidentes de trabalho, manutenção anual do equipamento de combate a incêndios, verificação e reabastecimento da (em conjunto com o socorrista).

Impulsionar a implementação, o lançamento e a adoção das iniciativas de mudança necessárias em toda a sucursal, atuando como interface entre as equipas de mudança e as equipas da sucursal, para garantir a evolução contínua e eficaz da sucursal no sentido de satisfazer as exigências em constante mudança dos clientes.

Encaminhar os problemas do sistema que estejam fora do controlo da equipa para as partes interessadas adequadas, para resolução através de um caso de negócio para a mudança.

Implementar e promover práticas de excelência operacional, orientando os colaboradores no cumprimento dos procedimentos operacionais exigidos e das melhores práticas, e implementando melhorias nos processos para garantir que o que é importante para o cliente seja efetivamente prestado e esteja disponível.

em consulta com a Função de Capital Humano.

Aproveitar e otimizar os recursos humanos, os meios, os canais, os controlos de negócio e de risco, em consonância com o potencial de mercado, para maximizar as metas de crescimento do negócio, retenção e rentabilidade na sucursal e/ou na rede de distribuição.

jobs.title: Senior Optical Manufacturing Test Engineer - Hardware Automation
jobs.description:
ABOUT LUMILENS

At Lumilens we are building the critical photonics infrastructure that powers tomorrow’s AI supercomputing. From chip-to-chip optical interconnects to scalable photonic engines, Lumilens is unlocking a new era of computing - faster, cooler, and massively more efficient.

We’re a well-funded startup backed by Mayfield and led by veterans who’ve built and scaled some of the most transformative technologies in the industry. At Lumilens, we’re developing high-speed photonics products purpose-built to power the future of AI infrastructure and high-performance computing.

This isn’t incremental innovation, it’s a ground-floor opportunity to rethink the optical layer from the silicon up. You’ll work alongside a team of world-class engineers solving some of the hardest challenges in scaling optical systems. Every line of code, every design decision, every breakthrough you help deliver will shape the infrastructure of tomorrow.

If you're looking for mission, momentum, and the chance to make an outsized impact, jump on the rocket ship. We’re just getting started.




POSITION OVERVIEW

As an Optical Manufacturing Test Engineer, you will play a critical role in validating and ensuring the quality of Lumilens’ photonic components, modules, and systems.  This role blends hands-on production testing with hardware test development and reporting, supporting both new product introduction (NPI) and volume manufacturing.  You’ll work closely with optical design, hardware, and manufacturing teams to perform design for manufacturing, calibration, characterization, and troubleshooting duties for next-generation photonics technologies.




DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES

 - End-to-end manufacturing test ownership:  Ensure all the changes to test hardware, processes, etc. are under change control and follow established QMS requirements.  This includes equipment selection and specification, tester BOM and estimated cost, test schematic diagram, test flows, work instructions, etc.

 - Responsible for tester documentation and specifications.  Analyze test results to ensure compliance with performance specifications and quality standards.

 - Develop, assemble, validate, buy off and release the testers for production.

 - Responsible for product test yield, with quality and reliability.

 - Responsible for analyzing, defining, developing, and executing continuous improvement plans to achieve test yield, cycle time, throughput, and scrap reduction.

 - Collaborate with quality teams for the planning and execution of qualification tests.

 - Collaborate with design teams and process engineering to ensure design for manufacturing (DFM) and design for test (DFT) guidelines are met.

 - Design, plan, and conduct optical and fiber testing on components, devices, and systems.  Perform production calibration and testing of fiber optic components and modules.

 - Maintain accurate, detailed records of test procedures and outcomes.

 - Generate comprehensive test reports for internal and external stakeholders.

 - Support troubleshooting and root cause analysis to resolve product issues.

 - Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to support NPI and manufacturing ramp.

 - Work closely with contract manufacturing partners to train operators, provide test process guidelines, and review/approval for any test change orders.

 - Develop and implement the troubleshooting guidelines, including tools, templates, and data analysis for testers and products in manufacturing.

 - Responsible for process control of all testers, including SPC, GR&R and other correlation studies.

 - Collaborate with software engineers, IT and database architects to define better solutions to manage and analyze manufacturing test data at reasonable cost, high efficiency, and high scalability.




SKILLS/EXPERIENCE

 - Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Physics, or related field plus 7 years experience in high-volume optical transceiver manufacturing and/or automated test system development for electronics and optics manufacturing.  Experiences in transceiver module tests at 400G, 800G, 1.6T, etc., are preferable.

 - Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.

 - Expert in optical test equipment and protocols, and how they pertain to the manufacturing and design of optical transceivers.

 - Hands-on experience with optical test instruments (e.g., optical spectrum analyzers, power meters, polarization controllers, bit-error-rate testers).

 - In-depth technical knowledge and hands-on experience in yield analysis, problem solving, and implementation of manufacturing processes.

 - Familiarity with processor communication interfaces and test automation tools.

 - Data query and data analysis skills, using statistical tools and techniques is a plus.

 - Practical experience in SPC, GR&R, tester correlation, and report generation.

 - Ability to write or adapt scripts for automation (Python, LabVIEW, Visual Basic; Shell scripting is a plus)

 - Experience in ongoing reliability testing and quality control best practices.

 - In depth understanding of the quality management system and quality standard requirements.

 - Expertise in optics FA processes and tools.

 - Resourceful problem-solver with ability to apply knowledge creatively to test challenges.

 - Capable of managing multiple test projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment.

 - Ability to work well in a geographically diverse cross-functional team.

 - Good command in English communication both verbal and written, including in-person and virtual presentation skills.  Able to train and mentor peers when needed.

 - International travel required.



All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, religious creed, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military and veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender, gender expression, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by local law, regulation, or ordinance.

jobs.title: Solutions Engineer, Post-Sales (remote, US East Coast)
jobs.description:
(Remote, US East Coast, Series B DevTools SaaS, synthetic monitoring)

The best developers don't wait for a customer to tell them something's broken.

They catch it first, in the pull request, in staging, or in the checkout flow at 3am, before a single user notices. That instinct is Checkly https://www.checklyhq.com/'s whole reason to exist. We give developers and their agents the tools to own reliability the way they own their code: end-to-end tests and synthetic monitoring defined as code, powered by OpenTelemetry and Playwright, versioned and reviewed like everything else they ship. From pull request to post-mortem, in one place.

Thousands https://www.checklyhq.com/customers/ of them, from modern AI companies like Mistral and resolve.ai http://resolve.ai to large engineering orgs like LinkedIn, Citi, and 1Password, build with us. In 2024 we raised $20M in Series B https://www.checklyhq.com/blog/announcing-20m-to-enable-engineers-to-detect-and-r/ funding from Balderton, CRV and Accel.

Here's the thing about 2026: AI agents and coding assistants are shipping more software, faster, than any team could review by hand, and more of it is breaking in ways nobody has seen before. LLM-backed features fail probabilistically. Agents take actions no runbook anticipated. "Is my app healthy?" is becoming an unanswerable question for a whole generation of AI-native software.

That’s where you come in. This role starts where the sale ends. You will onboard new customers, train their engineering teams, and stay close to those accounts as their use of Checkly grows. You are the technical counterpart in the account, and you run your own customer meetings.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

We're looking for a Solutions Engineer to make sure customers get real value out of Checkly after they sign.

 - You will learn Checkly and the monitoring space deeply, then help customers solve real reliability problems.

 - You will own technical onboarding for new accounts: implementation, configuration, and getting their first monitoring into production.

 - You will run workshops and trainings for customer engineering teams.

 - You will be the technical counterpart in existing accounts, supporting adoption, troubleshooting, and growth alongside the sales team.

 - You will run your own customer meetings, from technical deep dives to account check-ins.

 - You will contribute to technical documentation and internal playbooks as you learn what works.

 - You will speak with customers directly and share your learnings with Product Engineering and Marketing.




WHAT YOU SHOULD HAVE

 - Around 2 years of experience in a post-sales technical role: customer onboarding, workshops and trainings, and helping accounts grow. Solutions engineering, professional services, customer success engineering, technical account management, or a similar path all work.

 - Hands-on experience with monitoring, observability, or automated testing.

 - Strong technical skills that allow you to read, write, and debug code (Javascript/Node.js preferred).

 - Ability to use AI tools to accelerate customer-facing work: researching a customer's stack, generating tailored example code, building proof-of-concept repos, drafting technical responses. We build with Claude Code, Codex, and similar tools.

 - Genuine interest in working directly with customers. You enjoy talking to people, running workshops and demos, driving a meeting yourself, and explaining technical concepts clearly.

 - Excellent spoken and written English skills

 - Ability to be autonomous and self-motivated in an async-work environment, while you also enjoy getting to know your colleagues and helping others.

 - Based on the US East Coast, in Eastern Time (ET).

 - Able to travel occasionally to customers.

 - Startup experience is helpful, but not required.




WHY US?

 - Transparent salary (more info below)

 - Become part of a fast-growing, and international team where your work matters. Your impact won’t get lost in layers of bureaucracy.

 - Stock options

 - Flexible paid vacation

 - Paid sick leave & up to 14 weeks of paid parental leave

 - US: Medical, Dental, Vision, FSA, long- and short-term disability, life insurance, 401(K) and more

 - Annual company on-site

WHO ARE WE?

We strive to create a customer experience built on sharing our love and passion for the brand while building long-lasting relationships with our customers…turning friends into fans. As we experience rapid growth, we are seeking career-driven leaders obsessed with creating a unique, exceptional customer experience. We need great people to represent the brand where it matters most…in front of our customers. These leaders will help shape the voice and character of the Squishable store experience.

They are confident, creative, bright, friendly, adaptable, and able to perform at the highest level consistently. Candidates must be well-spoken and confident interacting with people at all levels while remaining calm and organized at all times.

jobs.title: Marketing Executive
jobs.description:
The Marketing Executive will support the delivery of Product Marketing activities for Evolution’s Live Casino portfolio, working closely with the Product Marketing Lead to ensure projects, product launches and marketing materials are delivered efficiently, on time and to a high standard.

The role will be highly hands-on, supporting the day-to-day execution and project management of Product Marketing activities, including the creation and maintenance of marketing materials, coordination of game launch marketing packs, internal marketing requests and stakeholder communications.

The Marketing Executive will also work closely with the Marketing Events Manager to support the planning and delivery of major global exhibitions and events, particularly ICE.

This role requires excellent organisational and project management skills, strong written English, attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.

Main Responsibilities:

Product Marketing

• Work closely with the Product Marketing Lead to implement the marketing strategy for Live Casino, supporting the delivery of game and product launch plans and associated marketing activities.
• Lead assigned Product Marketing projects from planning through to implementation, ensuring deliverables are completed on time and to a high standard.
• Coordinate the creation and delivery of full Marketing Packs for new game and product launches, working closely with Product Marketing, Creative, Content Creation, Localisation and other relevant teams.
• Track Product Marketing projects, timelines and deliverables using appropriate internal tools, proactively following up with stakeholders to ensure deadlines are met, and projects continue to move forward.
• Create, edit and proofread product marketing materials including factsheets, presentations, newsletters, website copy, email content and other marketing collateral.
• Support the Product Marketing Lead in translating product information into clear, engaging and commercially relevant marketing messaging.
• Ensure the existing bank of Live Casino marketing materials is kept accurate and up to date, coordinating updates with relevant Marketing teams where required.
• Support updates to product-related content across Evolution's websites, Client Area, newsletters and other relevant marketing channels.
• Provide day-to-day marketing support to Product, Commercial and other internal stakeholders, including presentations, collateral, product information and other marketing requests.
• Manage and coordinate assigned internal marketing requests, ensuring stakeholders are kept informed of progress and agreed timelines.
• Support reviews of how Evolution's marketing materials and game assets are being used on operator websites, helping to identify opportunities to improve the relevance, quality and adoption of Marketing materials.
• Conduct competitor and market research to support Product Marketing projects and provide relevant insights to the Product Marketing Lead.

Events & Exhibitions

• Work closely with the Marketing Events Manager to support the organisation and delivery of assigned areas of major global exhibitions, particularly ICE, across brands within the Evolution Group.
• Take responsibility for assigned elements of exhibition delivery, which may include stand requirements, hotel group bookings and travel arrangements, catering and refreshments, meeting schedules, internet provision and other event logistics.
• Liaise with stand designers, suppliers, internal stakeholders and other partners on assigned areas of exhibition preparation and delivery.

• Attend selected exhibitions and events where required and provide on-site support.

• Act as a key operational contact with Accounts and Finance for assigned event costs, purchase orders, invoices and reconciliation where required.
• Support the Marketing Events Manager with additional exhibitions and events as required, including research, costings, supplier coordination and event logistics.

General Marketing

• Build strong working relationships with internal stakeholders, third parties, agencies, suppliers and other partners.

• Marketing/Business degree preferred
• Previous experience in a Marketing, Product Marketing, Marketing Executive or similar role.
• Excellent written and spoken English, with strong copywriting, editing and proofreading skills.
• Excellent organisational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously and work methodically.
• Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering work to a high standard.

jobs.title: Service Desk Officer | Bosch Building Technologies
jobs.description:
Wat ga je doen?

Je helpt klanten op weg

• Je neemt telefonisch en per e-mail incidenten, storingen, hulpvragen en wijzigingen aan.
• Je vraagt door om de situatie helder te krijgen en biedt eerstelijnsondersteuning.
• Je registreert klant- en storingsgegevens zorgvuldig zodat collega's direct verder kunnen met de afhandeling.
• Je zorgt voor een duidelijke overdracht naar monteurs en andere betrokken afdelingen.

Je houdt grip op de opvolging

• Je bewaakt afspraken rondom storingsafhandeling en terugkoppeling.
• Je informeert klanten proactief over de voortgang.
• Je zorgt dat monteurs en andere betrokkenen tijdig over de juiste informatie beschikken.
• Je neemt deel aan planningsoverleggen en bewaakt lopende afspraken.

Je denkt mee over verbetering

• Je signaleert knelpunten in processen en werkwijzen.
• Je draagt ideeën aan om de klanttevredenheid en efficiëntie verder te verbeteren.
• Je ondersteunt de ontwikkeling van een moderne, toekomstgerichte Servicedesk met aandacht voor digitalisering en automatisering.

Waarom deze rol bij jou past

Je vindt het leuk om mensen verder te helpen en bent pas tevreden als een vraag of storing goed is afgehandeld. Je luistert aandachtig, stelt de juiste vragen en weet hoofd- van bijzaken te onderscheiden.

Ook wanneer meerdere meldingen tegelijk binnenkomen, blijf je rustig en behoud je overzicht. Je schakelt gemakkelijk tussen verschillende gesprekspartners. Een klant wil een duidelijke uitleg, terwijl een monteur behoefte heeft aan concrete informatie. Jij zorgt ervoor dat beiden verder kunnen.

Wat maakt deze functie interessant?

Geen dag is hetzelfde. Je schakelt continu tussen klanten, monteurs en interne afdelingen. Het ene moment help je een klant met een storing, het volgende moment stem je werkzaamheden af met een monteur of bewaak je de voortgang van een urgente melding.

Daarnaast werk je mee aan de verdere professionalisering van onze Servicedesk. Digitalisering, procesverbetering, moderne tooling en AI-ondersteuning spelen daarbij een steeds grotere rol. Je krijgt de kans om mee te denken over verbeteringen die onze dienstverlening nog efficiënter en klantgerichter maken.

Wat breng je mee?

• MBO werk- en denkniveau.
• Technische affiniteit. Je hoeft geen monteur te zijn, maar je vindt het interessant om technische vraagstukken te begrijpen en de juiste informatie boven tafel te krijgen.
• Goede communicatieve vaardigheden, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.
• Een nauwkeurige werkwijze en ervaring met computersystemen.
• Het vermogen om zelfstandig te werken binnen afgesproken procedures en richtlijnen.
• Ervaring met een storingsregistratiesysteem of servicedesk-omgeving is een pré.

Wie ben jij?

Je bent servicegericht, toegankelijk en neemt verantwoordelijkheid. Je houdt overzicht, werkt nauwkeurig en laat niet los voordat een melding correct is opgevolgd.

Ontbreekt er informatie? Loopt een afspraak vertraging op? Dan onderneem jij actie. Je krijgt energie van tevreden klanten en van een dienstverlening die elke dag een beetje beter wordt.

Waarom Bosch?

Bosch is een organisatie met een sterke langetermijnvisie, waarin kortetermijnwinst kwaliteit, ontwikkeling en duurzame relaties centraal staan. We investeren bewust in onze mensen en innovatie. Daardoor krijg je de ruimte om te leren, initiatief te nemen en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen.

Wat wij bieden:

• Samenwerking met enthousiaste collega's binnen een hecht team.
• Een goed salaris en 38 verlofdagen per jaar bij een fulltime dienst verband.
• Een jaarcontract met uitzicht op vast dienstverband.
• Laptop en iPhone.
• Hybride werken mogelijk in overleg
• Uitstekende begeleiding en volop ruimte voor opleidingen en doorgroeimogelijkheden.
• Een stabiele, internationale werkgever met een mensgerichte en professionele cultuur.
• Goede pensioenregeling via PMT

Klaar voor de volgende stap?

Wil jij klanten verder helpen, het verschil maken in onze dienstverlening en bijdragen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze Servicedesk? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

Solliciteer vandaag nog en groei mee #LikeABosch.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Engineer
jobs.description:
About Payoneer

Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.

By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.

Role summary

PAYO Digital Bank, N.A. (PDB), Payoneer's national trust bank subsidiary, is seeking a deeply experienced Senior Staff Engineer to serve as the technical anchor of the bank's engineering organization and the architect of record for its core transactional systems. You will own the design of the integration between the core banking ledger and the stablecoin issuance engine: the system of record that reconciles fiat reserves, on-chain token supply, and customer balances with bank-grade accuracy and auditability.

This is a high-impact, hands-on architecture and leadership role reporting directly to the Chief Technology Officer of PDB, providing technical direction to the core team of engineers.

The ideal candidate is a distributed systems expert with high-integrity transactional experience (banking core, payments ledger, exchange, or settlement infrastructure). You must be able to defend architectural decisions to independent auditors and OCC examiners, and build engineering culture as deliberately as you build systems.

New York, NY | Miami, FL | Full-time

What you'll do

• Core Architecture Ownership: Architect and build the bank's core backend, including microservices, transactional persistence schemas, event messaging endpoints, and internal APIs, documented to a standard suitable for OCC examination.

• Ledger & Stablecoin Integration: Design the reconciliation architecture guaranteeing absolute consistency between the fiat subledger, reserve accounts, and on-chain token supply. Build the event messaging layer securely synchronizing core ledger transactions with custody platform mint/burn actions.

• Technical Leadership: Serve as the technical lead and mentor for the Core Backend team. Establish uncompromising standards for code reviews, testing, observability, and deployment appropriate for a regulated bank.

• Compliance in the Transaction Path: Integrate automated sanctions screening connectors with auditable screening and case escalation hooks.

• Resilience & Observability: Partner with the SRE Lead on multi-region availability, failover targets, and real-time ledger alerting. Work with the Security division on IAM, key management interfaces, and threat modeling for mint/burn pipelines.

• Audit Readiness: Support UAT, feature freezes, and external control validation ahead of the pre-opening exam.

Who you are

• Engineering Depth: 12+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years hands-on architecting high-integrity transactional systems (banking core, payments ledger, exchange, or settlement infrastructure).

• Distributed Systems Expertise: Deep understanding of event-driven architecture, exactly-once processing semantics, idempotency, and reconciliation at scale.

• Cloud-Native Infrastructure: Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, Infrastructure-as-Code, and multi-region deployment in a regulated or audited environment.

• Audit-Grade Engineering: Track record designing immutable transaction logs, reconciliation controls, and automated evidence generation for examiners and external auditors.

• Technical Mentorship: Proven success elevating the technical output of senior engineers, setting architectural standards, and owning delivery end-to-end.

• Regulator-Ready Documentation: Ability to produce system architecture documentation that withstands intense regulatory and audit scrutiny.

Not a must but a great advantage:

• Digital Asset Systems: Direct experience with stablecoin, digital asset custody, or blockchain settlement systems, including on-chain/off-chain reconciliation.

• Examination Environments: Familiarity with FFIEC IT examination expectations or SOC 2 audit environments.

Why This Role Matters Every dollar of PAYO-USD in circulation depends on the systems this role designs. The Senior Staff Engineer builds the transactional backbone that regulators examine, auditors verify, and merchants trust.

In accordance with New York City Law, below is the annual base salary range for this position. Actual annual base salary is based on, but not limited to: experience, education, professional licenses, location and business needs. The position is eligible for health insurance, disability insurance, life insurance, 401k plan, paid-time off, and sick (and where applicable safe) leave. This position is also eligible for a discretionary year-end bonus.

The annual base salary range for this position is

$185,000—$200,000 USD

The Payoneer Ways of Working

Act as our customer’s partner on the inside
Learning what they need and creating what will help them go further.

Do it. Own it.
Being fearlessly accountable in everything we do.

Continuously improve
Always striving for a higher standard than our last.

Build each other up
Helping each other grow, as professionals and people.

If this sounds like a business, a community, and a mission you want to be part of, apply today.

We are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. Payoneer is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment no matter your race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any stage of the hiring process, please speak to the recruiter managing the role for any adjustments. Decisions about requests for reasonable accommodation are made on a case-by-case basis.

jobs.title: Founding Security Engineer
jobs.description:
WHY CASCA?

Casca is building AGI for banking. We’re replacing decades-old legacy systems with AI-native technology that automates 90% of the manual work humans once had to do. 


WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

Our customers are FDIC-insured banks. Every one of them puts us through security review, control questionnaires, pen test results, and third-party risk assessment before we touch production. Then they hand us borrower tax returns, bank statements, and the data behind credit decisions on their own balance sheet.

So security isn't a compliance checkbox here. It's a precondition for the company existing. Every deal we win depends on it, and one bad breach ends the business.

The surface area is large and getting larger: a multi-tenant AI platform, a cloud estate under bank data-handling requirements, agents that read and act on customer data, and an engineering team shipping into all of it every day. Nobody can review their way across that. You build the guardrails, defaults, and tooling that scale past you.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - Software. Detections, libraries, policy-as-code, automation, CI/CD checks — reviewed, tested, and deployed like any other service.

 - Design reviews and threat models on what actually matters: auth, tenant isolation, data handling, anything touching borrower PII.

 - The AI attack surface. Prompt injection, tool-use abuse, exfiltration paths through agents, and the evals that tell you whether your controls hold.

 - Incidents, end to end, including the write-up and the fixes that follow.

 - Bank security reviews and audits, turned into engineering work that improves the system rather than paperwork that describes it.




WHAT WE LOOK FOR

 - Several years of experience in AppSec, with specifics you can walk us through: bugs you found, incidents you ran, systems you hardened, tooling you shipped.

 - You write production code. We work primarily in TypeScript/Node.js and Python.

 - You know where security boundaries break in multi-tenant systems, and why it's usually authorization.

 - You can explain risk to an engineer in engineering terms and get the fix shipped without escalating.

 - You can sit across from a bank's security team, take hard questions honestly, and leave them more confident than when you walked in.

 - Steady during incidents. Honest afterward.

 - You'd rather build leverage than become a bottleneck.




HELPFUL, NOT REQUIRED

 - Securing LLM or agentic products in production.

 - Standing up a security function at a fast-growing company.

 - Working inside or selling into regulated financial institutions: SOC 2, GLBA, FFIEC guidance, third-party risk, exam support.


WHAT YOU'LL GET: 

 - Impact & Ownership: A unique opportunity to shape the future of banking through AI, owning end-to-end product initiatives.

 - Collaborative Environment: Work alongside a talented and passionate team that values continuous improvement and knowledge sharing.

 - Competitive Compensation: Includes salary, benefits, and potential equity in a fast-growing startup.

 - Professional Growth: Access to resources and mentorship to expand your skill set, influence strategy, and accelerate your career.

 - Culture of Innovation: We encourage risk-taking, learning from failures, and pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in fintech.

As an early-stage company building at the frontier of AI, we work with high intensity and commitment. While schedules can vary by role/team, many weeks will demand extra focus, flexibility and time particularly during major launches and high impact sprints. We're seeking those who are aligned to and able to commit to that expectation.

jobs.description:
ABOUT DUALENTRY

DualEntry is building the OS for finance.

 

Every business needs a financial system of record, yet the world's largest fintech market ($220B+) still runs on software from the 1990s, with no new entrants in 30 years. DualEntry's AI-native ERP automates accounting from data entry to close, so finance teams move faster, spend less and incur less risk.

 

In just 2 years we've raised $100M+ from Lightspeed, Khosla Ventures, Contrary and Google Ventures and earned the trust of customers from $5M ARR to publicly traded companies.

 

We hire outliers. We're looking for people with a track record of accomplishing difficult things, whether through their careers or achievements outside of work. You'll find leaders, colleagues who've competed at the highest levels of sport, performed on Broadway, trained with UFC champions and founded the country’s largest Python community - because that's what it takes to reinvent a $220B industry.

 

 


WHERE YOU'LL CREATE IMPACT

 - Drive the full product lifecycle for a new product area, from discovery and definition through launch and iteration

 - Define and manage the product strategy and roadmap for your area

 - Define the metrics and customer signals that demonstrate outcomes and drive continuous improvement across all customer personas

 - Act as the voice of the customer in strategic decisions and translate complex accounting workflows into clear, simple requirements

 - Partner closely with engineering and design day to day, navigating technical trade-offs together

 - Own product reliability, accuracy and usability as first-class outcomes

 - Partner with product marketing, GTM and sales in both directions, feeding insights back into the roadmap and supporting launches

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Lifecycle Marketing
jobs.description:
Dataiku is the Platform for AI Success, the enterprise orchestration layer for building, deploying, and governing AI. In a single environment, teams design and operate analytics, machine learning, and AI agents with the transparency, collaboration, and control enterprises require. Sitting above data platforms, cloud infrastructure, and AI services, Dataiku connects the full enterprise AI stack - empowering organizations to run AI across multi-vendor environments with centralized governance.

The world’s leading companies rely on Dataiku to operationalize AI and run it as a true business performance engine delivering measurable value. For more, visit the Dataiku blog, LinkedIn, X, and YouTube.

About the role

Dataiku is the platform for AI Success, helping organizations put AI to work across their business. The Growth team drives pipeline generation globally through paid media, content syndication, ABM, and marketing operations, and we're looking for a Senior Manager, Lifecycle Marketing to build and own the lifecycle function end to end.

You'll work closely with the VP of Digital & Growth and cross-functional partners across Web, Content, Acquisition, Field, Marketing Ops, Sales and Customer Success, supporting a global organization across regions. We don't have a lifecycle function today. Email and nurture are secondary responsibilities inside other teams' jobs, so nobody owns what a prospect or customer hears from us, in what order, or how often. There are existing nurture workflows without a current owner and no single view of what runs where, so establishing that visibility is the first priority. You'll build the function from there: the strategy, the systems, the programs, and the team.

What you'll own

The lifecycle operating system

• One authoritative email and lifecycle calendar across prospect, new-user and customer programs: what goes out, to whom, from which team, and when.

• Frequency governance, suppression logic and deliverability standards, including being able to say how much of an audience a given send reaches.

• Segmentation and audience standards, set with the web and marketing ops teams who manage list creation today.

• A standard for what a lifecycle program needs before it launches: entry criteria, success metric, exit.

Prospect and new-user nurture

• New-user onboarding and activation nurture: the sequences that move a first touch to an engaged, sales-ready account.

• Account progression communication: the programs that move accounts from first engagement toward qualified opportunity.

• Nurture designed around named-account cohorts, built alongside the integrated campaign work so the two don't duplicate each other.

• Visibility for BDRs into what a lead has already received before they reach out.

Customer lifecycle, retention and expansion

You'll partner closely with Customer Success and Product on this.

• Programmatic customer nurture: adoption, education, and the sequences that keep users active after initial deployment.

• Retention and expansion programs, built on account signals rather than calendar cadence.

Automation, data and measurement

• The lifecycle layer of the marketing automation stack end to end: HubSpot workflows, Salesforce integration, and account and intent data from 6sense.

• Consolidating the existing nurture workflows into something documented and maintained.

• Reporting lifecycle contribution in terms the business already uses: engagement progression, influenced pipeline, retention and expansion. You'll build your own reporting rather than wait for a dashboard.

• The data quality this function depends on, with marketing ops: deliverability, consent, record hygiene.

AI and agentic workflows

• Lifecycle work inside agentic workflows, rather than AI as a separate experiment. Lifecycle is one of the clearest applications: audience assembly, copy variation, program QA, performance summaries.

• A standard for what a well-built lifecycle agent looks like, and where human in the loop is required.

Building the function

• This is the lead role for a function that doesn't exist yet. You'll build the team as the function develops.

• Getting the rest of the organization aligned on what you're building. Lifecycle touches Web, Content, Acquisition, Field, Marketing Ops, Sales and Customer Success.

What you bring

• 6+ years in lifecycle, nurture, email or growth marketing in B2B, ideally enterprise software with long, multi-threaded buying cycles.

• Hands-on marketing automation depth. You've built and owned complex nurture programs yourself. HubSpot or Marketo depth, Salesforce fluency, and real comfort with the data model under both.

• Command of deliverability, frequency capping, suppression, consent and list hygiene. This role exists partly because nobody has owned these.

• Experience on both sides of the lifecycle, prospect and customer. If your background covers one, tell us how you'd approach the other.

• Fluency with intent and account data (6sense, Demandbase or similar), and a view on where it should drive program entry rather than only reporting.

• Comfort building with AI, expected rather than optional. No engineering background needed. You should already be using LLMs in your own work, with a view on where they belong in lifecycle programs and where human in the loop is required.

• Analytical strength. You can define a metric, instrument it, and defend it, including when the honest answer is that the current number isn't reliable.

• Comfort with a build role: ambiguity, direct conversations about tradeoffs, and establishing a function through influence before you have a team.

• Experience working across regions in a global organization.

• Excellent written English. Other languages welcome, not required.

Why this role

Lifecycle is unowned at Dataiku today. This role defines it, reporting to the VP who owns the function, with a mandate to build the team behind it.

#LI-CM

What are you waiting for!

At Dataiku, you'll be part of a journey to shape the ever-evolving world of AI. We're not just building a product; we're crafting the future of AI. If you're ready to make a significant impact in a company that values innovation, collaboration, and your personal growth, we can't wait to welcome you to Dataiku! And if you’d like to learn even more about working here, you can visit our Dataiku LinkedIn page.

Our practices are rooted in the idea that everyone should be treated with dignity, decency and fairness. Dataiku also believes that a diverse identity is a source of strength and allows us to optimize across the many dimensions that are needed for our success. Therefore, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All employment practices are based on business needs, without regard to race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, veteran status or any other aspect which makes an individual unique or protected by laws and regulations in the locations where we operate. This applies to all policies and procedures related to recruitment and hiring, compensation, benefits, performance, promotion and termination and all other conditions and terms of employment. If you need assistance or an accommodation, please contact us at: reasonable-accommodations@dataiku.com

Protect yourself from fraudulent recruitment activity

Dataiku will never ask you for payment of any type during the interview or hiring process. Other than our video-conference application, Zoom, we will also never ask you to make purchases or download third-party applications during the process. If you experience something out of the ordinary or suspect fraudulent activity, please review our page on identifying and reporting fraudulent activity here.

QUÉ HARÁS

Como Sales Advisor en H&M, desempeñarás un papel clave para crear una experiencia excepcional para el cliente. Les darás la bienvenida, les guiarás por la tienda, y les ayudarás a encontrar lo que necesiten mientras les muestras nuestros productos. Te encargarás de:

• Compartir tus conocimientos sobre moda y productos para ayudar a los clientes a tomar decisiones.
• Colaborar con tu equipo para ofrecer un servicio excepcional en cada etapa de la experiencia del cliente.
• Asegurar que la zona de ventas y el almacén estén limpias y ordenadas.

• Representar una imagen positiva de ti y de la marca durante todas las interacciones con los clientes.

​

CON QUIÉN TRABAJARÁS

Nuestras tiendas son el corazón de nuestra empresa, donde los clientes experimentan nuestra marca de primera mano. Como parte del equipo de tienda, cada rol—desde Sales Advisors, Department Managers, Store Managers, Visual Merchandisers, Cash Office Responsible, y Delivery Responsible en tiendas más grandes—contribuye a crear un ambiente inspirador y acogedor. También conectarás con el Area Team, colaborando entre tiendas para compartir conocimientos y lograr el éxito juntos. Junto a tu equipo, desempeñarás un papel vital ayudando a los clientes a sentirse seguros y a expresar su individualidad con las últimas tendencias y estilos atemporales. Al construir conexiones significativas con los clientes en nuestras tiendas, hacemos que la moda sea accesible y sostenible para todos.

​

QUIÉN ERES

Estamos buscando personas con...

• Experiencia en atención al cliente en el sector de la moda, retail o similares.

Y que sean…​

• Con pasión por la moda y por ofrecer una experiencia excepcional en la tienda mientras promocionas nuestros productos a impulsas las ventas.
• Te desenvuelves bien en entornos colaborativos y dinámicos.
• Comunicándote, con creatividad, con curiosidad por usar la tecnología de la tienda, y un fuerte deseo por aprender y desarrollarte.
• Flexible y con orientación a la acción.

QUIÉNES SOMOS

H&M Group es una empresa global de fuertes marcas y proyectos. Nuestro objetivo es demostrar que no hay compromiso entre un diseño excepcional, precios asequibles y soluciones sostenibles. Queremos liberar la moda para la mayoría, y nuestros clientes están en el centro de cada decisión que tomamos.

​Somos miles de compañeros apasionados y talentosos, unidos por nuestra cultura y valores compartidos. Juntos, queremos usar nuestro poder, nuestra escala y conocimiento para impulsar la industria de la moda hacia un futuro más inclusivo y sostenible.​

​

POR QUÉ TE ENCANTARÁ TRABAJAR AQUÍ

​En H&M Group, estamos orgullosos de ser una empresa dinámica y acogedora. Ofrecemos a nuestros empleados beneficios atractivos con amplias oportunidades de desarrollo en todo el mundo. ​

• 25% de Staff discount en todas nuestras marcas del H&M Group, tanto en tiendas físicas como online (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories y ARKET).
• Programa de Incentivos H&M (HIP) - un programa global que recompensa la dedicación a largo plazo.
• Oportunidades de desarrollo: Acceso al crecimiento profesional dentro del H&M Group, con oportunidades tanto a nivel local como internacional.

ÚNETE A NOSOTROS

Nuestra singularidad proviene de una combinación de muchos factores: nuestra cultura inclusiva y colaborativa, nuestros sólidos valores y las oportunidades de crecimiento. Pero, sobre todo, son nuestras personas las que nos definen.

​Da el siguiente paso en tu carrera junto a nosotros. El viaje comienza aquí.

* Evaluación de roles de tienda:
