jobs.title: Internal Control, Audit & Process Specialist
jobs.description:
Are you interested in developing hands-on experience in internal control and audit remediation and at the same time gaining regional exposure and working closely with senior management? Then this role, which is based in Madrid is an attractive opportunity.

Position Objective

• Provide regional governance, coordination, and technical guidance to EMEA entities on internal control (SICS) and Corporate Internal Audit–related topics.
• The role supports countries before the Corporate Internal Audits and controls the follow-up and closure of audit findings, ensuring consistent improvements in both, internal audit performance and remediation of findings.
• The role supports countries before the Corporate Internal Audits and controls the follow-up and closure of audit findings, ensuring timely, effective, and sustainable remediation and continuous improvement of the internal audit readiness across EMEA.
• This role does not perform internal audits, does not participate in audit fieldwork, and does not interact with external auditors.

Main Responsibilities / Key Accountabilities

1. Internal Control & SICS Governance

• Act as the EMEA reference for internal control (SICS) and audit-related governance topics.
• Drive consistent understanding and application of SICS requirements across EMEA entities through hands-on guidance and review of implementation quality.
• Translate Corporate governance expectations into pragmatic regional guidance, considering scale and complexity of the region, and actively review whether controls are designed and operating as intended.

2. Audit Readiness & Preventive Support

• Analyze recurrent findings and common weaknesses identified in Corporate Internal Audits.
• Proactively support countries scheduled for upcoming Corporate Internal Audits through preparation guidance and clarification of expectations.
• Strengthen audit readiness without replacing, diluting, or taking over local management accountability.

3. Follow-up and Closure of Audit Findings (Critical Responsibility)

• Own regional tracking, monitoring, and escalation of findings resulting from Corporate Internal Audits.
• Ensure action plans are clearly defined, responsibilities assigned (GM-owned), deadlines respected, and remediation evidence properly documented.
• Ensure audit findings are closed in substance, not only formally closed in systems.
• Escalate overdue or critical findings to Area and Regional management as required.

4. Governance Frameworks & Policies

• Establish and maintain regional governance frameworks for selected topics (e.g. Manual of Authority – MoA), with a focus on practical application and effectiveness.
• Ensure alignment between Corporate requirements, regional standards, and local implementation.

5. Process Improvement & Best Practices

• Identify structural control or process weaknesses observed across multiple countries.
• Propose pragmatic improvements and share best practices across EMEA, avoiding unnecessary complexity and bureaucracy.

Authority & Decision Rights

• No authority to perform, influence, or interfere with Corporate Internal Audits.
• No involvement during internal audit execution or fieldwork.
• Authority to define regional governance standards within Corporate frameworks.
• Authority to challenge and escalate issues related to internal control, SICS implementation, and audit findings.

Key Stakeholders

• Local Finance Managers and Controllers
• Country and Area General Managers
• Area / Regional Finance Leadership
• Corporate Internal Audit
• Corporate SICS teams

Scope & Complexity

• EMEA region with ~65 countries and highly diverse regulatory environments.
• Strong coordination and governance role with limited operational depth per country.
• Impact-based prioritization is required to ensure scalability and effectiveness.
• No direct reports.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Audit, or a related field is a must
• Fluent English, both written and verbal; additional languages - especially Spanish - are an advantage in a diverse EMEA environment
• Proven experience and minimum 5 years in internal control, governance, audit readiness, risk management, or a comparable corporate assurance function
• Solid understanding of internal control frameworks (e.g., SICS or similar) and how to assess control design and operational effectiveness
• Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the confidence to challenge constructively and collaborate across countries and seniorities
• Highly structured, organized, and detail‑oriented, with the ability to manage complex follow-up processes and monitor multiple audit findings simultaneously
• Strong analytical mindset, able to spot patterns, identify structural weaknesses, and translate them into practical, scalable improvements
• A proactive, solutions-oriented working style, comfortable balancing governance expectations with pragmatic business realities in a multinational context

• We offer intensive training and interesting perspectives for anyone who wants to build a career
• Sika is like a global SME: With subsidiaries in more than 100 countries around the world. This begins in Switzerland and breaks down borders allowing exciting prospects all around the world
• The chance to bring new ideas, interesting areas for development, and taking responsibility early on are some of the key factors that drive Sika's pioneering spirit

We look forward to your application. For this position visa sponsorship is not offered and only direct applications will be considered. For any further information please reach us at inbox.hr@ch.sika.com

jobs.title: Lead, Financial Systems & Strategy
jobs.description:
Lead, Financial Systems & Strategy

Remote (Spain, United Kingdom, US)

Lead, Financial Systems & Strategy

This is a rare FP&A role — one where the work goes well beyond variance reporting and budget cycles. This role exists because financial systems architecture and reporting efficiency are both of the largest gaps and one of the highest-leverage investments the finance function could make. As the primary owner of Duetto's financial reporting platform and model, you'll own the infrastructure behind every number leadership and the board sees: the data model, the model architecture, and the AI-augmented workflows that make reporting fast and trustworthy. As with the rest of Duetto's finance team you'll be expected to bring AI into the workflow — using tools like Claude to automate reporting, accelerate close, and raise the analytical bar.

What Makes Us Different?

Duetto is the hospitality industry's leading revenue management platform, founded in 2012 by former Wynn Resorts executives who knew the industry needed better technology. We built the world's first Revenue & Profit Operating System — a suite of tools (GameChanger, ScoreBoard, BlockBuster, Advance and more) that goes beyond room pricing to give hotels, resorts and casinos a complete picture of their revenue and profitability. Trusted by clients ranging from independent boutique hotels to global chains, we've been named the #1 Revenue Management Software by HotelTechAwards four years running and the #1 Best Place to Work in Hotel Tech in 2025. Backed by GrowthCurve Capital since 2024, we're accelerating our investment in AI — and we're genuinely passionate about the industry we serve. We build products we're proud of, for customers we care about.

What You'll Be Doing

• You'll own Duetto's FP&A systems architecture — driving the data centralization and infrastructure that consolidates data from NetSuite, Salesforce, and departmental sources into a single source of truth.

• Own Duetto's core data model and platform governance in Abacum as it rolls out — architecting how department and consolidated views are structured, partnering with department analysts and the FP&A team on inputs and assumptions.

• You'll architect and maintain the integrated financial model — P&L, cash flow, and the reforecast/budget engine — ensuring it scales across departments and initiatives.

• Own the monthly and quarterly board/sponsor reporting package, translating department-level submissions into a single, defensible narrative for the CFO and board.

• Build scenario and sensitivity analyses to support leadership decision-making around growth, investment, liquidity, and other strategic initiatives.

• Partner with Accounting on accelerating the monthly close process.

• You'll own cash flow forecasting and covenant compliance monitoring — building the visibility that flags risk before it becomes a surprise.

• Define how modern FP&A is built — deploying AI-augmented workflows and agents, and setting the standard for what an AI-first finance operations function looks like.

• Own consolidated P&L variance analysis, partnering with FP&A team members to understand performance and trends across departments, and synthesize key drivers into departmental and company wide leadership-ready explanations.

• You'll partner with R&D and G&A leaders to provide data-based strategic recommendations for efficient productivity and growth.

What We're Looking For

You may be a good fit if you have:

• 6–10 years in FP&A or Financial Systems, with meaningful focus on executive reporting, financial processes, systems architecture, or data infrastructure in a SaaS environment

• A genuine orientation toward AI-augmented work — you've already thought about how LLMs, automation, and prompt-driven workflows change what finance can produce, and you're looking for a mandate to build that way.

• Demonstrated mastery of financial modelling and reporting — models that are accurate, scalable, and navigable by cross-functional audiences.

• Deep fluency in financial systems architecture: ERP platforms (NetSuite or equivalent), and FP&A platforms (Abacum, Adaptive Insights, OneStream, Pigment, or equivalent).

• Hands-on experience owning forecasting, scenario modeling, and covenant compliance.

• Experience partnering and collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders at all levels.

• Proven ability to translate complex, multi-department data into a single, executive-level narrative

Strong candidates may also have:

• Experience in a private equity-backed or high-growth SaaS B2B environment

• Proficiency with Excel, Google Suite, NetSuite, and Salesforce in a finance context

• Familiarity with data visualisation or BI tools — Tableau, Looker, or equivalent

• Experience supporting SOX compliance or audit-readiness processes

• Hospitality technology industry experience

Why Duetto?

• Finance with genuine strategic influence. You'll own the infrastructure that determines whether leadership can trust the numbers — building the systems that make every other finance function possible.

• AI is already in the workflow. This role explicitly expects you to bring AI into how finance gets done — automating consolidation, accelerating close, building prompt-driven processes. If you've been wanting to do this and haven't had the mandate, you'll have it here.

• The problems are genuinely interesting. Multi-department consolidation and forecasting with real data complexity — the infrastructure challenges are foundational and the stakes are high.

• A seat at the table. You'll be presenting variance analysis and insights directly to the CFO and board, and setting the technical direction for how Duetto's finance stack scales.

• Growth-stage energy with market-leader credibility. Backed by GrowthCurve Capital since 2024, Duetto is accelerating — you'll be building the financial systems backbone during a period of genuine momentum.

The Details

• Location: Remote (Spain, United Kingdom, US)

• Department: Finance

• Reports to: VP FP&A

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: Senior Process Engineer (Optical Manufacturing)
jobs.description:
ABOUT LUMILENS

At Lumilens we are building the critical photonics infrastructure that powers tomorrow’s AI supercomputing. From chip-to-chip optical interconnects to scalable photonic engines, Lumilens is unlocking a new era of computing - faster, cooler, and massively more efficient.

We’re a well-funded startup backed by Mayfield and led by veterans who’ve built and scaled some of the most transformative technologies in the industry. At Lumilens, we’re developing high-speed photonics products purpose-built to power the future of AI infrastructure and high-performance computing.

This isn’t incremental innovation, it’s a ground-floor opportunity to rethink the optical layer from the silicon up. You’ll work alongside a team of world-class engineers solving some of the hardest challenges in scaling optical systems. Every line of code, every design decision, every breakthrough you help deliver will shape the infrastructure of tomorrow.

If you're looking for mission, momentum, and the chance to make an outsized impact, jump on the rocket ship. We’re just getting started.



POSITION OVERVIEW

We are seeking an experienced Senior Process Engineer who will be responsible for the development and oversight of manufacturing processes supporting our optical transceiver roadmap. The successful candidate will work closely with contract manufacturers, suppliers, and internal cross-functional development teams to meet product objectives and instill a culture of quality and continuous improvement.  The engineer must be eager to learn and explore new processes and solutions for high-volume manufacturing of optical transceivers used in AI data centers.



DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Define, develop, prove and deploy the manufacturing process for new products and implement continuous improvement projects to achieve product yield, throughput, efficiency, scrap and quality targets.

 - Responsible for manufacturing process documentation, and reviewing and approving the processes implemented on the production line.

 - End-to-end manufacturing ownership:  Ensure all the changes to product, processes, materials, etc. are under change control and follow established QMS requirements.

 - Collaborate with design engineering and contract manufacturing teams to execute, improve and sustain the manufacturing processes.  Ensure design for manufacturing (DFM) guidelines are met.

 - Collaborate with the quality team for planning and execution of qualification testing.

 - Prepare process reports by collecting, analyzing, and summarising information and trends.

 - Automate all manufacturing processes, where possible.

 - Engage with equipment selection, create the statement of purpose, work with suppliers and stakeholders in developing the algorithm, machine hardware, software from buy-off to release in manufacturing.



SKILLS/EXPERIENCE

 - Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Physics, or related field, plus 7 years experience in high-volume optical transceiver and/or laser manufacturing.

 - Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.

 - In-depth technical knowledge and hands-on experience in design, development, selection, implementation of manufacturing processes, equipment, materials, and methodologies for the optical assemblies.

 - Expert in one or more of the optical transceiver assembly processes, such as wire bond, die bond, active optical alignment, product testing, burn-in, etc.

 - Expertise in data analysis, statistical process control (SPC), and report generation.

 - In depth understanding of the quality management system and quality standard requirements.

 - Data query and data analysis skills with using statistical tool and techniques

 - Expertise in optics FA processes and tools.

 - Ability to work well in a geographically diverse cross-functional team.

 - Good command in English communication both verbal and written, including in-person and virtual presentation skills.

 - International travel required.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, religious creed, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military and veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender, gender expression, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by local law, regulation, or ordinance.

jobs.title: Manager, Product Management
jobs.description:
At Reltio®, an SAP Company, we believe data should fuel your success in the enterprise AI era. Our  Context Intelligence Platform turns fragmented data into a trusted, connected context so AI agents and systems can act with expert-level judgement at enterprise scale. Reltio’s cloud-native SaaS platform harmonizes, unifies, and governs data across sources and formats—including unstructured data—in real time, turning them into data assets that can be mobilized in milliseconds to any application, user, or AI agent. Trusted by more than 200 of the world’s largest brands across industries such as life sciences, financial services, healthcare, and technology, we fuel frictionless operations and help enterprises accelerate innovation and reduce risk.

At Reltio, our values guide everything we do. With an unyielding commitment to prioritizing our “Customer First”, we strive to ensure their success. We embrace our differences and are “Better Together” as One Reltio. We are always looking to “Simplify and Share” our knowledge when we collaborate to remove obstacles for each other. We hold ourselves accountable for our actions and outcomes and strive for excellence. We “Own It”. Every day, we innovate and evolve, so that today is “Always Better Than Yesterday”. If you share and embody these values, we invite you to join our team at Reltio and contribute to our mission of excellence.

Reltio has earned numerous awards and industry and analyst recognition for our technology, our culture, and our people. Reltio was founded on a distributed workforce and offers flexible work arrangements to help our people manage their personal and professional lives. If you’re ready to work on unrivaled technology where your desire to be part of a collaborative team is met with a laser-focused mission to enable digital transformation with connected data, let’s talk!

About the Role

Reltio is looking for a Manager, MDM Operations & Product Management to join our Product Management organization. This is a high-impact, player-coach role that operates across two complementary tracks: product delivery and MDM operations.

On the product side, you will own and drive a roadmap of platform capabilities — delivered through the core Reltio platform and Reltio IDE — that directly reduce time-to-value for Reltio implementations. You'll work closely with Engineering and Product leadership to define, prioritize, and ship features that make implementations faster, more repeatable, and less dependent on manual effort.

On the operational side, you'll own and advance Reltio's own internal instance of the Reltio platform — our "Reltio on Reltio" deployment. This means continuously improving our internal data unification capabilities, expanding master data coverage across the organization, and enabling agentic access to master data so that internal teams can act on trusted, unified data with minimal friction. You'll lead a small team of analysts and implementation specialists who operate, extend, and evolve this environment as a strategic internal asset.

This is a role for someone who can think like a product manager, execute like a practitioner, and lead a team with clarity and purpose.

What You'll Do

Product Management — Platform & IDE Capabilities

• Own a product roadmap focused on TTV improvement, spanning features in the core Reltio platform and Reltio IDE that reduce implementation complexity, accelerate configuration, and lower the barrier to productive deployments

• Translate implementation friction — sourced from PS delivery, partner feedback, and customer data — into clearly scoped product requirements and user stories

• Partner with Engineering to prioritize and deliver capabilities that have measurable impact on implementation cycle time: guided configuration workflows, IDE productivity enhancements, validation tooling, template-driven setup, and similar

• Build and maintain a curated library of implementation accelerators — configuration templates, data model patterns, integration scaffolding, and validation tooling — grounded in real-world Reltio deployments and informed by the internal instance

• Define success metrics for shipped capabilities and track adoption and impact post-launch; establish clear cycle time benchmarks and report on measurable TTV reductions over time

• Represent the implementation practitioner perspective in product planning and roadmap reviews, ensuring that time-to-value remains a first-class product concern

MDM Operations — Reltio on Reltio

• Own and operate Reltio's internal Reltio deployment as a living, production-grade MDM environment — not a demo instance, but a strategic platform for internal data unification

• Continuously improve data unification quality across internal domains: expanding entity coverage, refining match and survivorship rules, and closing gaps in master data completeness and accuracy

• Drive the expansion of agentic access to master data — enabling AI agents and internal tools across the organization to query, consume, and act on unified master data through well-defined interfaces

• Define and enforce data governance standards for the internal instance, ensuring master data remains authoritative, consistent, and trustworthy as coverage grows

• Surface learnings from internal operations back into the product roadmap — the internal deployment is both a customer zero environment and a proving ground for new platform capabilities

Team Leadership

• Lead a team of 2–4 operations analysts and implementation specialists, providing direction, mentorship, and prioritization support across both the internal MDM operations and product workstreams

• Balance your own hands-on contributions — configuring entities, authoring product requirements, designing tooling — with the coaching and coordination your team needs to operate effectively

• Partner with Product Management leadership to ensure investments across product delivery and internal operations are aligned and mutually reinforcing

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Work closely with Engineering, Product, IT, and business stakeholders to expand master data utility across the organization

• Serve as the connective tissue between internal data consumers, agentic tooling teams, and the Reltio platform roadmap

• Represent internal operational experience in product planning discussions, ensuring the platform serves real-world operational needs

What You Bring

Required Experience

• Hands-on experience with the Reltio platform — including entity configuration, matching and survivorship rules, data pipelines, Reltio IDE, and API behavior; you've delivered or overseen real Reltio implementations

• Product management experience — you've owned a roadmap, written requirements, worked with engineering teams to deliver software, and measured outcomes post-launch; you know how to move something from problem to shipped capability

• Background in SaaS implementation or professional services, with a track record of delivering complex data or MDM solutions in customer-facing or internal delivery roles

• Experience operating or administering a production MDM environment, including ongoing data quality management and governance

Skills & Competencies

• Strong technical fluency — comfortable reading and writing configuration JSON, scripting, evaluating API behavior, and working directly in Reltio IDE; can prototype and validate tooling yourself when needed

• Familiarity with agentic AI patterns and how AI agents consume structured master data via APIs or MCP-style interfaces is a meaningful plus

• Demonstrated ability to lead small teams, including setting direction, managing priorities, and developing talent

• Excellent written communication; capable of producing PRDs, runbooks, documentation, and asset deliverables that engineering teams and practitioners can act on without hand-holding

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, AI-Native Merchant Experiences
jobs.description:
This is Adyen

Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition.

For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.

Senior Product Manager, AI-Native Merchant Experiences

The world's largest businesses run on Adyen. Payments, financial products, and increasingly the commerce workflows around them — money movement, billing, loyalty — flow through a single platform, across dozens of markets and hundreds of payment methods, at a scale most companies never encounter.

That scale comes with complexity, and handling it on our merchants' behalf has always been our mission. But the way people expect to work is changing in real time. The payment operations lead who spent their morning chasing down why a batch of transactions failed now expects to ask a question and get an answer. The analyst who worked a dispute queue case by case now expects the evidence gathered and drafted before they start their work. AI has collapsed the distance between wanting something done and it being done.

This is where you come in.

You'll own the AI assistant that works on a merchant's behalf across Adyen – one that can find and read their data, provide insights, take real actions, and know where its limits are. You'll build some of what it can do yourself, and build the foundation that lets teams across Adyen contribute the rest – reporting and insights, disputes, configurations, and everything that follows. And you'll own how merchants experience these capabilities, as our assistant grows from answering questions to doing the work.

By allowing merchants to operate Adyen themselves – accurately, instantly, at any hour – we’ll enable them to go live faster, get more from our platform, and grow, while we in turn unlock growth for Adyen.

What you’ll do

• Set the vision for how merchants will run their business on Adyen through an assistant that works alongside them, and build the multi-quarter strategy that gets us there.

• Build AI Assistant capabilities. Decide what it can do on a merchant's behalf and how it strings work together – what it should handle on its own, what it should confirm first, and what it should never touch.

• Ship to drive outcomes. Take capabilities from idea to production, and drive measurable results for customers and for Adyen.

• Set the bar for quality and safety. Define what good looks like for merchant-facing agentic capabilities at Adyen, and make it something teams can measure themselves against.

• Enable teams across Adyen to build into your surface. Get product teams across domains contributing capabilities to a shared foundation, and guide how it comes together.

• Galvanize cross-functional teams across product, design, engineering, analytics, commercial, marketing, and legal to move with velocity.

• Go deep with customers and data to pressure-test strategic choices and ensure your team is building solutions customers genuinely use and value.

Who you are

• AI-Forward Product Sensibility & Experience. Hands-on experience shipping AI-native product experiences to real users – LLM-powered, agentic, conversational, or workflow automation. Strong, opinionated intuition for what "great" looks like in this emerging design space.

• A Proven Track Record of Impact. You've built and scaled customer-facing products with material business impact, and you can point to what you personally owned and how you thought about it.

• Strategic Thinking. Track record translating customer needs and commercial priorities into multi-quarter product strategies.

• Product Execution. Demonstrated ability to drive complex programs spanning multiple teams and ship with velocity.

• Excel in Ambiguity. Comfortable taking open-ended, undefined business problems and turning them into clear strategy, sequenced roadmaps, and high-velocity execution.

• Analytical Rigor: Set clear metrics and use data to align on priorities, set targets, measure impact, and reset course as needed.

• Cross-Organizational Leadership. Demonstrated ability to drive adoption of shared capabilities across teams with their own roadmaps and their own priorities, in a high-autonomy, bottom-up culture.

• Simplicity On Top of Complexity. You've shipped clear, simple experiences on top of systems that are genuinely complicated — regulated, high-stakes, unforgiving of error. You go deep enough on the domain to earn simplicity, and you don't pass the complexity on to the customer.

• Customer Obsession. Passion for deeply understanding the payment operations, finance, support teams, and more at some of the largest businesses in the world, and understanding what they need to excel and get the most out of our products.

• 5+ years of experience building customer-facing products in high-growth tech or fintech environments

Total Rewards & Compensation

The annual base salary range for this role is $201,600 - $302,400. Compensation is based on factors including qualifications, experience, and location. Total compensation package includes equity (RSUs), 401(k), health, dental, vision, and more.

In-office expectations

This role is based in our San Francisco office. We're an office-first company and expect employees to work in-office at least 3 days a week on average. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while also supporting flexibility.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Adyen

We actively seek different perspectives to sharpen our ideas. Our unique culture is a product of our diverse backgrounds and experiences. No matter who you are or where you’re from, you’re welcome to be your true self at Adyen.

If you need accommodations or support during the recruitment process to perform at your best, you’ll have the opportunity to let our team know in your application. We encourage people from all backgrounds and abilities to apply.

What’s next?

Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. If you have specific time constraints, please communicate them with your recruiter, and we’ll do our best to accommodate them where possible.

EEO statement

jobs.title: Principal Customer Engineer, Digital Natives
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations

• Germany

Responsibilities

The Customer Engineer (CE) is the core driver of our technical go-to-market strategy: a trusted technical advisor and primary architect of the customer journey. You will bridge the gap between technical strategy and business value—guiding enterprise clients from initial pre-sales technical validation through onboarding, deployment architecture, and full lifecycle expansion. Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to a Customer Engineering Leader, you will not hand off your customers once an initial agreement is reached. Instead, you will operate as a quota-carrying technologist, leveraging AI-augmented workflows to eliminate administrative toil so you can focus on high-value architectural design and driving measurable business outcomes across the entire customer journey.

• Technical Validation: Partner closely with Account Executives to lead technical deep-dive discovery, capture business requirements, and map complex customer infrastructure - DNS, CDN, Zero Trust, Network Security, Workers - to fit-for-purpose Cloudflare architectures and bespoke solutions. . Define, scope, success criteria, and technical evaluations plans for Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Technical Validations. Deliver tailored technical presentations, architectural diagrams, and demonstrations that show how Cloudflare solves specific performance, security, and reliability challenges. Proactively address complex technical objections, security compliance questions, and edge-case architectural requirements during the sales cycle. Take accountability for a suitable solution deployment strategy (Customer, Partner or Cloudflare Professional services) being an integral part of all proposals.

• Customer Adoption & Value Realization: Provide oversight to technical onboarding and implementation, but not execute the implementation, serving as the primary executive and engineering contact for the customer. Design structured migration and onboarding blueprints tailored to the customer’s environment (e.g. DNS migrations, Zero Trust rollouts, WAF tuning guidance), and act as the lead consultant for customer engineering teams, walking them step-by-step through configuration best practices. Partner with Account Executives to own discovery, demos, onboarding, technical health, risk, and expansion strategy. Proactively monitor customer health scores and telemetry to ensure rapid time-to-value, resolve integration bottlenecks, and reduce deployment risk.

• Commercial Accountability & Expansion: Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. Be commercially accountable for ensuring deep platform adoption, retaining revenue, and identifying strategic cross-sell and up-sell opportunities based on product usage data. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.

• Trusted Advisory: Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion. Provide thought partnership on architecture, AI control layers, security posture, and deployment confidence. Identify potential deployment risks or integration bottlenecks early, and provide remediation strategies to de-risk customer outcomes.

• AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation: Leverage AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and internal platforms to automate routine tasks such as RFP/Security Questionnaire responses, sandbox provisioning, basic telemetry monitoring, and internal/external documentation, reclaiming your time for strategic customer advisory.

• Education & Enablement: Partner closely with the Enablement Team to design, build, and govern technical resources. Define, document, and educate both internal teams and customers on deliverables such as Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), architectural best practices, and technical guides to continuously raise the technical baseline across the organization.

• This role may require travel up to 20–50% to attend customer meetings, conferences, industry events, and in-person team collaboration.

Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience

• Experience: Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Professional Services, Sales Engineering, Technical Account Management, or as a Forward Deployed Engineer (years of experience required will vary based on Associate, Senior, Staff, or Principal leveling).

• Architectural Mindset: Ability to white-board, design, and articulate complex enterprise network and security architectures clearly.

• Consultative & Advisory Skills: Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate deeply technical concepts into business outcomes for both hands-on engineers and C-level executives.

• Commercial Mindset: Proven track record of operating in a quota-carrying or revenue-aligned environment, with a strong understanding of SaaS metrics, business value translation, and enterprise sales cycles.

• Communication: Exceptional presentation and stakeholder management skills, capable of bridging the gap between deep technical implementation details and high-level C-suite business strategy.

• Technical Breadth: We do not expect every candidate to be an expert in every domain. Qualified candidates will demonstrate depth in at least four of the technical areas below: Internet fundamentals: Deep understanding of how the Internet works, including OSI Model layers 1–7, BGP, GRE, TCP/UDP, DNS (authoritative and recursive), HTTP(S), and SSL/TLS. Security: Expertise in the security of Internet properties, including WAF, Bot Management, Firewalls, Rate Limiting, (M)TLS, Zero Trust, and SASE concepts. Performance: Expertise in the performance of Internet properties, including speed, latency, caching, video streaming, HTTP/2, and TLS 1.3. AI Proficiency: Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI-assisted scripting and log analysis, LLM utilization, and workflow automation to augment everyday CE workflows. Coding/Scripting: Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, Bash, Lua, Go, or similar languages to write custom integration scripts, API connectors, and edge computing functions. Developer Platform Fluency: Experience designing, building, deploying or scaling applications using RESTful/GraphQL APIs, SDKs, webhooks, and developer tooling in cloud-native environments. Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi), CI/CD pipelines, and observability for developer-led deployments.

• Business Fluency in German

Bonus Points

• Technical Enablement: Track record of creating and delivering technical enablement - workshops, code samples, documentation, or developer onboarding - that accelerates customer adoption of complex platforms.

• Applied AI Knowledge: Experience with LLM orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and model-access controls.

• Regulatory Knowledge: Understanding of regulatory requirements such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, and SOC 2.

• Hyperscaler / Digital Native Background: Talent coming out of hyperscalers, digital natives, distributed systems environments, or startups is strongly valued for its deeper cloud fluency and advanced architecture depth.

Compensation

For Germany based hires: Estimated annual salary is between €148,000 - €204,000.

This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation under Cloudflare's Sales Compensation Plan. The estimated annual salary range includes the on-target incentive compensation that may be attained in this role under the Sales Compensation Plan.

Equity: This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare's equity plan.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase.

As a TMS Compliance Analyst III on the CX Compliance team within Customer Experience, you'll conduct end-to-end transaction monitoring investigations to identify suspicious activity, protect Coinbase from financial crime risk, and ensure compliance with BSA/AML regulatory requirements. This team partners with the Financial Crime Risk Service (FCRS) line and cross-functional stakeholders to maintain the highest production and quality standards across global compliance operations. You'll investigate automated alerts, analyze complex transaction patterns, draft SAR narratives, and apply independent judgment to determine whether customer behavior warrants escalation or filing.

• Draft clear, accurate SAR narratives and maintain detailed investigation documentation to demonstrate compliance with regulations, internal policies, and audit requirements.

• Incorporate feedback from the Quality Assurance team and participate in calibration sessions to continuously improve investigation accuracy and consistency.

• Support process improvements within the TMS Compliance function by identifying gaps in procedures, contributing to documentation standards, and staying current with developments in KYC, BSA/AML, and OFAC regulations.

Required Skills and Experience:

• 4+ years of experience in financial services, crypto, or fintech with a focus on transaction monitoring, BSA/AML compliance, or financial crime investigations.

jobs.title: Growth Operations Lead
jobs.description:
GROWTH OPERATIONS LEAD



ABOUT US

Sieve is a multimodal lab curating the world’s highest-quality training datasets, spanning video, audio, images, text, and 3D. We combine exabyte-scale data infrastructure with novel multimodal understanding techniques to push the frontier of foundation models. We exist to solve one of the biggest bottlenecks in AI: high-quality training data.

We partner with top AI labs and did $XXM last quarter alone, with a team of roughly 30 people. We raised our Series A from firms including Matrix Partners https://matrix.vc/, Swift Ventures https://www.swift.vc/, Y Combinator https://www.ycombinator.com/, and AI Grant https://aigrant.com/.



WHY NOW

AI’s next wave needs data from people with real skills, creative expertise, and access to the physical world. Building a contributor network that can meet that demand is central to Sieve’s growth.

You’ll join early enough to build the systems that shape how contributors discover Sieve, start earning, and keep coming back. Your work will directly expand the data available to the world’s leading AI labs.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re hiring a Growth Operations Lead to build and own growth for our contributor platform. You’ll run experiments to acquire contributors, improve activation and retention, and develop supply-side partnerships across physical AI and media generation.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can build from scratch. You’ll find creative ways to reach contributors, test what works, and turn successful experiments into repeatable systems. You should be equally comfortable launching a campaign, digging into funnel data, improving onboarding, and pitching a potential partner.



WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Run growth experiments: Develop and test acquisition channels across outbound, referrals, communities, content, paid campaigns, and unconventional growth tactics.

 - Build growth systems from scratch: Create the tooling, automation, tracking, and playbooks that turn successful experiments into repeatable contributor acquisition.

 - Improve activation and retention: Identify where contributors drop off, shorten the path to a first paid task, and build programs that keep them engaged and contributing.

 - Develop supply-side partnerships: Source, pitch, and launch partnerships with studios, creator networks, specialist firms, and organizations that can bring contributors and data into Sieve.

 - Expand supply across physical AI and media generation: Translate emerging project needs into targeted campaigns and partnerships that bring in the right skills, access, and expertise.

 - Own growth measurement: Track acquisition cost, conversion, activation, retention, and contribution quality; use the results to decide what to scale or stop.

 - Work across product and operations: Turn contributor feedback and experiment results into improvements to onboarding, communication, incentives, and the platform experience.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - Consistent growth in qualified, active contributors who complete paid tasks

 - Higher conversion from signup to first paid task and a shorter time to activation

 - Stronger 30/60/90-day retention and repeat participation

 - Multiple repeatable acquisition channels with measurable costs and results

 - Active partnerships that deliver relevant contributors and usable data

 - Growth systems that support increasing volume while maintaining contributor quality


REQUIREMENTS

 - Experience owning growth, growth operations, or marketplace supply, with a track record of building programs from scratch

 - Demonstrated ability to design experiments, launch quickly, measure results, and scale what works

 - Strong analytical skills; comfortable working with funnel data, cohorts, dashboards, and acquisition economics

 - Hands-on experience with outbound tools, CRMs, lifecycle messaging, and workflow automation

 - Strong communication and commercial instincts; comfortable recruiting early contributors and closing partnerships yourself

 - Resourceful, self-directed, and willing to handle the operational details needed to get a new initiative off the ground

 - Based in San Francisco or willing to relocate


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience growing the supply side of a marketplace, contributor platform, creator network, or expert community

 - Familiarity with physical AI, robotics, media generation, or AI training data

 - Experience building referral programs, contributor communities, or retention campaigns

 - Existing relationships with creative studios, professional communities, or organizations relevant to data collection

 - Ability to use SQL, scripting, or AI tools to analyze data and build lightweight internal tools

jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.description:
ABOUT US 


QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in! 



As our Account Executive, you will own a defined international territory and be responsible for generating mainly new business across research institutes, universities, national laboratories and commercial quantum computing companies. You will also build and manage strategic relationships with ecosystem partners, distributors and technology partners that help expand QuantWare’s reach.

You’ll work closely with the field, application engineer and product teams to bring cutting-edge quantum technology to organizations shaping the future of computing.



What you'll be doing

 - Own and grow an assigned international territory.

 - Develop and execute a territory plan to exceed revenue targets.

 - Generate new opportunities through outbound prospecting, conferences, industry networks and referrals.

 - Build relationships with professors, principal investigators, research directors and technical decision-makers.

 - Manage the complete sales cycle from first contact through contract signature.

 - Coordinate complex technical evaluations with our engineering and applications teams.

 - Build and expand strategic channel and technology partnerships.

 - Maintain accurate pipeline forecasting in HubSpot.

 - Provide structured market feedback to Product, Marketing and Leadership.
   
   

Your Profile

 - 5+ years of enterprise B2B technology sales experience.

 - Proven track record of consistently exceeding quota.

 - Experience selling complex technical solutions.

 - Strong hunter mentality with exceptional prospecting skills.

 - Experience working with channel partners and strategic alliances.

 - Willingness to travel internationally.
   
   

Nice to have

 - Experience in quantum computing, semiconductors, photonics, scientific instrumentation, deep tech or advanced hardware.

 - Experience selling into publicly funded research organizations.

 - Knowledge of government procurement or grant-funded purchasing processes.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway! Research https://hbr.org/2014/08/why-women-dont-apply-for-jobs-unless-theyre-100-qualified shows women often self-select out if they don't meet every requirement. Here's our take: nobody ticks every box. This is a description of our ideal candidate, not a filter. If most resonates and you're keen to learn the gaps, apply. We hire for trajectory, not perfection. 

What We Offer:

At QuantWare, you’ll be part of a high-performing team of world-class experts in an ambitious, fast-moving environment. From day one, you’ll have the trust, tools, and support to do your best work. Here’s what you can expect:

Competitive salary - A salary that reflects the impact and importance of the role (and of course 8% holiday allowance)

Pension that’s built to last - A generous and future-proof pension plan that includes partner and dependent coverage.

Flexibility built on trust - We focus on outcomes. Work flexibly, in a hybrid setup, with an open vacation policy that lets you manage your time

Personal growth - We invest in your L&D, with a budget available to each team member, dependent on their individual ambitions, development needs, and performance

A connected team - We make space to celebrate wins together, with team events, offsites, and spontaneous moments that bring us closer

Diversity & Inclusion at QuantWare

We’re an ambitious company, not only for our goals but also to become an even more diverse and inclusive team. We know great candidates don't always follow a straight path, and we value diverse experience, perspectives, and ways of thinking. We know this helps us make better decisions, drives more innovation, and strengthens our culture. 

As part of our recruitment process, candidates may be required to undergo pre-employment screening.

jobs.title: Software Intern - Summer 2027
jobs.description:
About Us

At Antares, our long-term mission is to make clean energy abundant from Earth to the Asteroid Belt. We’re fueled by the belief that advanced nuclear energy can strengthen our military, solve the climate crisis, elevate global living standards, and expand humanity's presence in outer space. To achieve our mission, we’re building mass-producible, inherently safe, deployable microreactors that can be used terrestrially, underwater, and in space.



The Antares team hails from SpaceX, the White House, the Pentagon, the Department of Energy, MIT, Rigetti Computing, General Atomics, Relativity Space, Ursa Major, and National Laboratories like Idaho, Oak Ridge, Los Alamos, and Savannah River. Antares has raised over $600M in venture capital from top-tier investors and has hundreds of million-dollars on contract with the military services, NASA, and the Department of Energy.



About the Summer Internship Program

Internships at Antares are anything but ordinary. You'll work alongside our team as we design, build, and test fission microreactors built to deliver reliable energy for critical missions on Earth, in space, and underwater.

Our interns contribute to real work from day one. Depending on your role, you may touch hardware, write and test software, support manufacturing and operations, or help build the systems that allow Antares to move quickly as we scale. You'll work alongside engineers, operators, and other experts solving challenging problems—and you'll leave your internship with hands-on experience that's difficult to find anywhere else.

We work hard, move quickly, and take pride in what we're building. If you're excited to learn by doing and want to contribute to the next generation of nuclear energy, we'd love to have you join us next summer.



We will be running two separate cohorts to accommodate students on both semester and quarter schedules:

Cohort #1

Monday, May 17 – Friday, August 13

Cohort #2

Monday, June 14 – Friday, September 10



All internship roles are based at our Torrance headquarters and require interns to work onsite five days per week. We will not be considering candidates for remote or hybrid arrangements.

Interns will receive a relocation and housing stipend as part of their offer package.



About the Role

As a Software Intern, you will work on the infrastructure and tooling that enables Antares teams to deploy, monitor, and operate internal applications and compute workloads. You will own substantive projects spanning cloud deployment tooling, systems automation, observability, data project infrastructure, and cluster operations.

You will work across both cloud and on-premises infrastructure, improving how applications and data projects are deployed and monitored while helping make internal compute resources more reliable, recoverable, and efficient. This role is well suited for someone who enjoys building practical tools, automating manual processes, and improving the systems other technical teams rely on.



Roles and Responsibilities:

 - Improve cloud deployment tooling for shared internal applications

 - Automate integrations between internal and external systems

 - Create Grafana dashboards and alerts to improve visibility into internal systems

 - Build standardized templates for Python data projects that improve deployment, monitoring, and dependency management

 - Document quality processes so they can be consistently used by non-software developers

 - Migrate cluster infrastructure to the latest versions of Rocky Linux and Warewulf

 - Build storage tooling to improve recovery and performance

 - Analyze and optimize cloud costs for internal job pipelines

 - Create dashboards that provide visibility into cluster usage

 - Build tooling to help teams better understand and optimize their use of shared compute resources



Basic Qualifications:

 - Enrolled in at least a bachelor’s degree program, and going into your Junior or Senior year of studies

 - Must have prior internship experience, or significant (>1yr) project team, laboratory, or research experience



Preferred Skills & Experience:

 - GPA of 3.5 or above

 - Experience in a University club or organization, leadership role preferred

 - Strong interpersonal and technical communication skills (examples: leading a student project team, presenting research at conferences, etc.)

 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail

 - Ability to work cross-departmentally with different groups and teams

 - Ability to work effectively in a dynamic environment with changing needs and requirements

 - Ability to work independently and in a team, take initiative, and communicate effectively



Location

 - We are located in Torrance, CA in a 322,000 square foot, brand new facility featuring large open spaces for team collaboration, R&D, and production, as well as easy access to the 405, 105, and 110 freeways. Our facility is in the heart of Los Angeles' vibrant emerging tech ecosystem alongside many other high growth startups and enterprises.



Culture

At Antares, we like to specifically tie each role to our founding document’s set of values–here are the top five cultural values we think you should believe at your core to be successful:

 - Think in Systems - Energy and Defense are complex ecosystems with numerous stakeholders with competing priorities, conflicting policies, perverse incentives, and emergent and path-dependent properties. First principles thinking alone is insufficient. Think probabilistically and then take action. “If you want to be certain, then you are apt to be obsolete.” Over-optimizing the components often degrades the system

 - Obsess over the End User - The customer and end user are often not the same. We will never build globally competitive commercial products if we lose sight of our end users and their entire interaction with the product life cycle

 - Be Unconstrained by Convention - Our only limits are the laws of physics. Many, even experts, will say what we are working on is impossible. They said the same about SpaceX reusing rockets. Generationally impactful companies, by definition, must accomplish the seemingly impossible. If it were easy, it would have already been done. Never shy away from a solution because it has never been tried before, and never choose to do something because that's “how it's always been done”

 - Go Where the Work Is - Never miss a chance to meet a customer, user, or stakeholder face to face, even if that means hopping on a plane. If you can’t make it, find a teammate who can channel your intentions and go in your place. Deep work can be done from anywhere, but we believe teams are built in person, and aim to maximize our time together

 - Operate in the Grey - Embrace nuance in pursuit of truth. Question every fundamental assumption
   
   

Equal Opportunity

Antares is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are based solely on merit, competence, and qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability, or any other legally protected status.




ITAR REQUIREMENTS

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987.

jobs.title: Cloud Solutions Architect (US)
jobs.description:
Neural Concept embeds AI into design and simulation workflows so engineering teams make continuous, data-driven decisions instead of waiting on sequential design–simulation–validation cycles. None of that matters until the platform is running inside the customer's environment, on their infrastructure, under their rules.
That is this role. You take an enterprise customer and make the platform real for them: architected, deployed, integrated, cleared by their security organisation, and stable enough that their engineers stop thinking about it. You own that outcome end to end for named accounts, as their primary technical counterpart.



What you will do 

 - The deployment, from the first architecture conversation through go-live and into steady-state operation.

 - Its integration with the customer's identity, data and engineering systems, and the infrastructure and model serving layer beneath it.

 - The relationship with their IT, security and platform teams: assessments, architecture reviews, and the call when something breaks.

 - The diagnosis when it does break, including when the cause sits outside our own software.

 - The runbooks, post-mortems and playbooks that make the next deployment easier, and the feedback loop into Product.



Where you will do it
Managed Kubernetes across the major clouds. On-premises and fully air-gapped clusters with no route to the internet, GPU infrastructure, self-hosted model serving. Customer HPC environments, schedulers, and shared storage under real load.



If installing software with no internet access, on hardware you do not control, reads as the interesting part of the job rather than the obstacle, this will suit you.



Who you are 

You will often be the only Neural Concept engineer in the room. We are looking for someone with:

 - 6+ years deploying and operating enterprise software in production, two of them in environments you did not control.

 - Kubernetes at configuration depth: how chart values become rendered manifests, and why a workload will not start.

 - Identity and SSO fundamentals: OIDC and SAML, clients and credential rotation, redirect URIs, group-to-role mapping.

 - Linux, networking and TLS: DNS, routing, ingress and egress, certificate chains and interception proxies.

 - Kubernetes storage: persistent volumes and CSI, access modes, diagnosing shared storage that degrades under load.

 - A production deployment you personally carried and then supported. Name it, date it, tell us what went wrong.

 - Professional customer-facing English, and willingness to travel and work your customers' hours.

Also valuable: regulated or air-gapped deployments · private registries and image mirroring · GPU scheduling and LLM serving · enterprise IdP administration · Terraform and GitOps · Prometheus and Grafana · HPC schedulers · ISO 27001 evidence · Python · PLM, CAD or CAE exposure.



You Get

 - Work with a world-class technology team – our engineers are top-notch, and we always aim for excellence.

 - Benefit from a competitive salary and rewarding opportunities as we continue to scale.

 - Thrive in a collaborative, multicultural environment where your work is visible and recognized.

 - Develop professionally alongside talented colleagues who share knowledge freely and support one another.

 - Make a global impact by helping customers shift to AI-assisted design, making innovation faster, smarter, and more sustainable.

 - Balance life and work with remote work or hybrid model (20% remote) —we care about results, not rigid schedules.

 - Enjoy paid vacations, healthcare (medical/vision/dental), 401K matching



Where You Will Be

 - Jersey City office or West Coast; 

 - Travelling: This position will require travelling to customer locations in the US.

 - Start date: ASAP

 - Eligibility: ITAR clearance required
