jobs.title: Asistent i shitjes 30 orë, TEG MALL
jobs.description:
ÇFARË DO TË BËSH​

Si Sales Advisor, do të luash një rol kyç në krijimin e një përvoje të shkëlqyer për klientët. Do të mirëpresësh klientët, do t'i udhëzosh ata në dyqan dhe do t'i ndihmosh të gjejnë atë që u nevojitet, ndërsa u prezanton produktet tona. Duke vepruar në përputhje me vlerat tona, do të kontribuosh si për suksesin tënd ashtu edhe për suksesin e kompanisë.

Çfarë do të bësh:

• Ndaji njohuritë e tua për modën dhe produktin që t'i ndihmosh klientët të bëjnë zgjedhje të informuara.
• Bashkëpuno me ekipin tënd për të ofruar shërbime të shkëlqyera në çdo hap të rrugëtimit të klientit
• Sigurohu që pavijoni i shitjeve dhe zona e pasme të jenë të furnizuara mirë, të organizuara dhe tërheqëse.
• Ndihmo në hapjen dhe mbylljen e dyqanit.
• Përfaqëso pozitivisht veten dhe markën gjatë gjithë ndërveprimeve me klientët.

ME KË DO TË PUNOSH​

Dyqanet tona janë zemra e kompanisë sonë, ku klientët e provojnë markën tonë në vetë të parë. Si pjesë e ekipit dinamik të dyqanit, çdo pozicion – nga këshilltarët e shitjeve, menaxherët e departamenteve, menaxherët e dyqaneve dhe ekipi i tregtimit vizual deri tek përgjegjësi i arkës (Cash Office Responsible) – kontribuon në krijimin e një mjedisi frymëzues dhe mikpritës. Do të lidhesh gjithashtu me ekipin e zonës më të gjerë, duke bashkëpunuar nëpër dyqane për të ndarë njohuri dhe për të arritur sukses së bashku. Së bashku me ekipin tënd, do të luash një rol thelbësor duke i ndihmuar klientët që të ndihen të sigurt dhe të shprehin individualitetin e tyre me tendencat më të fundit dhe stilet që i mbijetojnë kohës. Përmes krijimit të lidhjeve domethënëse me klientët në dyqanet tona, ne e bëjmë modën të disponueshme dhe të qëndrueshme për të gjithë.

KUSH JE TI​

Po kërkojmë persona me …​

• Përvojë në shërbimin ndaj klientit në fushën e modës, shitjes me pakicë ose fusha të ngjashme, që do të konsiderohet si avantazh.
• Pasion për të ndihmuar klientët dhe të interesuar për modën ose shitjen me pakicë. Të tjerat ua mësojnë ne!

Dhe njerëz që janë …​

• Që shkëlqejnë në mjedise bashkëpunuese dhe dinamike.
• Komunikues, kreativ, kureshtarë për të punuar me teknologjinë e dyqaneve, me një dëshirë të fortë për të mësuar dhe për t'u zhvilluar.
• Fleksibël dhe të orientuar drejt veprimit.

KUSH JEMI NE​

H&M Group është një kompani globale e markave të fuqishme të modës dhe iniciativave të guximshme. Qëllimi ynë është të provojmë se nuk ka kompromis midis dizajnit të jashtëzakonshëm, çmimeve të përballueshme dhe zgjidhjeve të qëndrueshme. Ne duam ta bëjmë modën të prekshme për të gjithë, ndaj klientët tanë janë në qendër të çdo vendimi që marrim.​

​Ne jemi të përbërë nga mijëra kolegë të pasionuar dhe të talentuar që na bashkon kultura dhe vlerat tona të përbashkëta. Së bashku, ne duam ta përdorim fuqinë tonë, shkallën dhe njohuritë tona për ta shtyrë industrinë e modës drejt një të ardhmeje më gjithëpërfshirëse dhe të qëndrueshme. ​

PSE DO TË TË PËLQEJË TË PUNOSH KËTU ​

Në H&M Group, ne jemi krenarë që jemi një kompani e gjallë dhe mikpritëse. Ne u ofrojmë punonjësve tanë përfitime tërheqëse me mundësi të shumta zhvillimi në mbarë globin. ​

• 25% zbritje për stafin në të gjitha markat tona të H&M Group, si në butikë ashtu edhe në internet
• H&M Incentive Program – HIP. Më shumë rreth programit mund të mësosh këtu.
• Sigurim Shëndetësor Privat
• Shpërblim për Shërbimin e Gjatë
• Pushim i atësisë
• Shpërblim për pensionim
• Kartelë Dhurate për Foshnje
• Bonus për referimin një mik

BASHKOHU ME NE​

Veçantia jonë vjen nga një kombinim i shumë gjërave - kultura jonë gjithëpërfshirëse dhe bashkëpunuese, vlerat tona të forta dhe mundësitë për rritje. Por mbi të gjitha, janë njerëzit tanë ata që na bëjnë ata që jemi.​

Hidhe hapin e radhës në karrierën tënde së bashku me ne. Udhëtimi fillon këtu.​

*Vlerësimi i Roleve në Dyqan:

Për të menaxhuar volumin e lartë të aplikimeve për rolin e Këshilltarit të Shitjeve, ne përdorim një metodë vlerësimi online për rekrutimin e bazuar në aftësi në disa nga dyqanet tona. Do t’ju duhet ta përfundoni atë si pjesë e procesit të aplikimit dhe përzgjedhjes. Përgjigjet tuaja do të vlerësohen nga një mjet vlerësimi që zbaton kriteret e paracaktuara nga Grupi H&M.

Pasi të keni përfunduar vlerësimin, do të keni mundësinë të jepni komente dhe të bëni pyetje. Nëse hasni vështirësi ose preferoni një metodë alternative vlerësimi, ju lutemi kontaktoni: recruitment_support@hm.com . Zgjedhja e një alternative nuk do të ndikojë në aplikimin tuaj.

Për më shumë informacion mbi mënyrën se si përpunojmë të dhënat tuaja personale, ju lutemi shikoni Njoftimin tonë të Privatësisë.

** Ne jemi të përkushtuar për një proces rekrutimi të drejtë, të barabartë dhe të bazuar në kompetencë. Prandaj të kërkojmë të mos bashkëngjitësh një letër motivimi në aplikim.

jobs.title: Business Development Executive (North Canterbury)
jobs.description:
ABOUT HALTER

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard. 

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund https://foundersfund.com, Bessemer Venture Partners https://www.bvp.com/, BOND, https://www.bondcap.com/ DCVC https://www.dcvc.com/, Blackbird https://www.blackbird.vc/, Promus Ventures https://www.promusventures.com/, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures https://www.icehouseventures.co.nz/?utm_term=icehouse%20ventures&utm_campaign=Brand+Keywords&utm_source=adwords&utm_medium=ppc&hsa_acc=4064636360&hsa_cam=16902737884&hsa_grp=134004309485&hsa_ad=592971340272&hsa_src=g&hsa_tgt=kwd-1082530126230&hsa_kw=icehouse%20ventures&hsa_mt=b&hsa_net=adwords&hsa_ver=3&gclid=Cj0KCQjw2v-gBhC1ARIsAOQdKY0J0DepRVFDmjQlAkJPbZuQnLSA5UVzUzOXYiPxkjX-SeVa513_BhkaAr-MEALw_wcB.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/halter-limited & Instagram https://www.instagram.com/lifeathalter/.


ABOUT THE ROLE. 

As a Business Development Executive at Halter, you will play a critical role in driving business growth and ensuring customer success within your designated territory. You will be responsible for executing sales strategies, building strong customer relationships, and meeting ambitious growth targets, all while acting as Halter’s on-the-ground representative. This role requires a proactive and hands-on approach, with a focus on both expansion and long-term customer satisfaction.

In this role, you will prioritise daily efforts that optimise growth performance and drive value for your customers. Working closely with cross-functional teams, including Product, Support, and other regional sales teams, you’ll share field insights to ensure Halter’s technology continues to meet the needs of farmers. Your contributions will directly support Halter’s mission to support 50% of the world's habitable landmass to be more productive and sustainable.

This role is based in the North Canterbury / Selwyn region and will require travel. 

 


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR. 

These requirements are fundamental for this role. 

 - A deep passion for helping farmers succeed. Experience in farm systems or within the agricultural sector.

 - A hunter. Someone who is driven to exceed goals in a sales role. Experience in growing new business, owning the end-to-end sales cycle from lead generation to close.

 - Passion and enthusiastic people. Attitude and potential are extremely important to us.

 - A phenomenal attitude and a team player with the ability to consistently overcome challenges.

 - A Hunter with a never-say-never attitude.

 - A deep passion for helping farmers succeed.

 - A phenomenal attitude and a team player with the ability to consistently overcome challenges.

 - The ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced working environment with a high degree of autonomy.

 - A hunger for success and personal growth to be able to evolve quickly alongside a world-class sales team.

 


WHAT YOUR DAY COULD LOOK LIKE. 

 - On-farm sales meetings: Understanding the needs and problems of your prospects then clearly communicating functionality, benefits and highlighting value relative to each farming operation.

 - Prospecting: Building and growing a pipeline of quality farms fit for Halter, while continuously reducing sales cycle times. Managing newly sourced and inbound leads through the initial stages of the pipeline including screening and qualifying.

 - Networking: Building and leveraging industry relationships to establish and maintain Halter's brand.

 - Forecasting: Working with the Regional Sales Manager to enable monthly and quarterly forecasting of revenue.

 - Growth initiatives: Working with the Regional Sales Manager to optimise and evolve the sales process to become faster, more efficient, and more predictable as the company scales.

 - Other duties as required from time to time.




JOIN OUR TEAM

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page https://www.halterhq.com/careers for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/halter-limited & Instagram https://www.instagram.com/lifeathalter/.




WHY OUR TEAM LOVES WORKING AT HALTER:

 - Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.

 - Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.

 - You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our $1,000 personal growth fund.

 - This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

jobs.title: Electronics Specialist  / Elektrotechnický špecialista
jobs.description:
Do nášho výrobného tímu v jednozmennej rannej prevádzke hľadáme zodpovednú a spoľahlivú osobu, ktorá sa chce stať dôležitou súčasťou nášho výrobného procesu. Uvítame človeka so zmyslom pre poriadok, presnosť a tímovú spoluprácu, ktorý má záujem učiť sa a rozvíjať svoje odborné zručnosti.

Čo bude súčasťou tvojej práce:

• Starať sa o to, aby výrobné stroje správne fungovali – od oživenia až po finálne testovanie
• Pomáhať pri montáži strojov a ich častí, mechanicky aj elektricky
• Inštalovať a aktualizovať softvér, firmvér, PLC a VFD
• Kontrolovať a testovať stroje počas výroby a pripravovať ich na ďalšie použitie (PAT)
• Pracovať podľa výrobného plánu a všímať si veci, ktoré by mohli spôsobiť problém
• Riešiť bežné technické situácie samostatne alebo s podporou tímu
• Prispievať nápadmi a skúsenosťami k zlepšovaniu kvality a efektivity výroby
• Dodržiavať bezpečnostné pravidlá a zaužívané pracovné postupy
• Dbať na poriadok a príjemné pracovné prostredie pre seba aj kolegov

Koho hľadáme:

• Máš aspoň 2 roky skúseností z výrobného prostredia
• Máš odbornú spôsobilosť podľa vyhlášky 508/2009 (§21 alebo vyššie)
• Dorozumieš sa v angličtine na základnej úrovni (A2 a viac)
• Vieš sa orientovať v elektrotechnických a strojárskych výkresoch
• Máš praktické skúsenosti s nastavovaním a programovaním elektrických komponentov
• Máš záujem o elektroniku a chuť sa v tejto oblasti ďalej rozvíjať
• Základná práca s MS Office (najmä Excel, Outlook) ti nerobí problém

Ponúkame:

• Mzda. od 1650 euro brutto
• Šťastná trinástka: Užite si 13. plat vo výške 100% vášho hrubého mesačného platu.
• Bonus pre nováčikov: Naštartujte svoju cestu s €500 bonusom!
• Dodatočné výhody: Vychutnajte si denne stravné lístky v hodnote €7.40 (nad rámec zákonných požiadaviek) a 2 ďalšie dni plateného voľna.
• Náborová prémia: Odporučte známeho a ak sa pridá, získate €1500!
• Ročný bonus: Oceňujeme vašu tvrdú prácu, takže očakávajte ročný bonus.
• Dôchodkové sporenie: Máme pre vás príspevky do DDS
• Priateľská atmosféra: Ponorte sa do našej priateľskej severskej kultúry a pracujte v čistom pracovnom prostredí s jednou zmenou v projektovej výrobe
• Stabilita: Pridajte sa k dobre zavedenej medzinárodnej spoločnosti.
• Príplatky za nadčas: Ak sa rozhodnete ísť nad rámec, pridáme príplatok nad rámec zákonníka práce
• Vedomostný boost: Bezplatné školenia a príspevok na jazykový kurz Anglického jazyka
• Športoví nadšenci, radujte sa: Pripojte sa k našim firemným športovým aktivitám - futbal, tenis, stolný tenis, volejbal a ďalším!
• Multisport karta: Buďte fit a aktívni.
• Podpora pre nových rodičov: Oslavujte rodičovstvo špeciálnym príspevkom.
• Štýlový pracovný odev: Nosite naše značkové oblečenie od Strauss.
• Pohodlná doprava do práce: Nastúpte na náš firemný autobus (PK - Tomra, Tomra - PK).

TOMRA je hrdá na to, že je zamestnávateľom poskytujúcim rovnaké príležitosti, a zabezpečuje rovnaké podmienky pre všetkých zamestnancov a uchádzačov bez ohľadu na rasu, farbu pleti, náboženstvo, pohlavie, rodovú identitu, vek, národnosť, zdravotné postihnutie, rodičovský alebo tehotenský status, manželský či partnerský status, sexuálnu orientáciu, status veterána alebo akékoľvek iné charakteristiky.

Primerané úpravy budú poskytnuté všetkým kandidátom, ktorí o ne požiadajú v rámci akéhokoľvek kroku výberového procesu.

A mid-level accounting position responsible for delivering comprehensive fund accounting services with minimal supervision. • You’ll identify, assess, and escalate operational risks, conduct self-reviews, and participate in quality assurance activities to uphold compliance and operational standards.

You will manage complex accounting processes and resolve technical accounting matters with minimal supervision. You will also identify opportunities for process improvements and contribute to operational excellence across the function.

What you'll do

• You'll post journal entries, perform bookkeeping and reconciliations, and prepare working schedules, working papers, periodic accounts, and financial statements in compliance with accounting standards.
• You'll independently compute tax and VAT obligations, respond to audit queries, and liaise directly with auditors to support audit and compliance requirements.
• You'll conduct thorough self-reviews, address reviewer feedback promptly, complete required checklists, and maintain high standards of accuracy and quality across all deliverables.

jobs.title: Software Engineering Intern - Summer 2027
jobs.description:
About Us

At Antares, our long-term mission is to make clean energy abundant from Earth to the Asteroid Belt. We’re fueled by the belief that advanced nuclear energy can strengthen our military, solve the climate crisis, elevate global living standards, and expand humanity's presence in outer space. To achieve our mission, we’re building mass-producible, inherently safe, deployable microreactors that can be used terrestrially, underwater, and in space.



The Antares team hails from SpaceX, the White House, the Pentagon, the Department of Energy, MIT, Rigetti Computing, General Atomics, Relativity Space, Ursa Major, and National Laboratories like Idaho, Oak Ridge, Los Alamos, and Savannah River. Antares has raised over $600M in venture capital from top-tier investors and has hundreds of million-dollars on contract with the military services, NASA, and the Department of Energy.



About the Summer Internship Program

Internships at Antares are anything but ordinary. You'll work alongside our team as we design, build, and test fission microreactors built to deliver reliable energy for critical missions on Earth, in space, and underwater.

Our interns contribute to real work from day one. Depending on your role, you may touch hardware, write and test software, support manufacturing and operations, or help build the systems that allow Antares to move quickly as we scale. You'll work alongside engineers, operators, and other experts solving challenging problems—and you'll leave your internship with hands-on experience that's difficult to find anywhere else.

We work hard, move quickly, and take pride in what we're building. If you're excited to learn by doing and want to contribute to the next generation of nuclear energy, we'd love to have you join us next summer.



We will be running two separate cohorts to accommodate students on both semester and quarter schedules:

Cohort #1

Monday, May 17 – Friday, August 13

Cohort #2

Monday, June 14 – Friday, September 10



All internship roles are based at our Torrance headquarters and require interns to work onsite five days per week. We will not be considering candidates for remote or hybrid arrangements.

Interns will receive a relocation and housing stipend as part of their offer package.



About the Team

The Software team builds the software that enables Antares engineers to operate, test, and understand our reactor systems. The team works across embedded software, hardware interfaces, controls, telemetry, testing, and developer tools, connecting software with the physical hardware being designed and tested across Antares.

As a Software Engineering Intern, you will work on embedded software and the systems used to test, diagnose, and understand the behavior of Antares hardware. Your work will span software development, hardware-in-the-loop testing, and system telemetry, giving you hands-on exposure to the connection between software and physical systems.

Interns will be tasked with small starter projects, and then quickly tasked with a long-duration project that will culminate in a technical deliverable and presentation. You will be integrated and evaluated as if you are a first-year junior engineer, not just an “intern”. The bar for success here is high, and the expectation is that you’re able to smartly use your mentor and the resources around you to execute on your project and identify more issues and opportunities for improvement.



Roles and Responsibilities:

 - Support the development, debugging, and testing of embedded software, including hardware interfaces, diagnostic capabilities, automated testing, and development tools.

 - Perform hands-on testing and validation of hardware-in-the-loop environments, executing test procedures and evaluating system behavior against expected results.

 - Reproduce and investigate software and hardware-in-the-loop failures, document results, and help identify the source of unexpected system behavior.

 - Improve test coverage and validation processes based on findings from hands-on system testing.

 - Improve system telemetry from source to destination by instrumenting software components and routing and validating telemetry data.

 - Integrate system signals into HMI and Grafana so system health and behavior are consistently available for monitoring and troubleshooting.



Basic Qualifications:

 - Enrolled in at least a bachelor’s degree program, and going into your Junior or Senior year of studies

 - Must have prior internship experience, or significant (>1yr) project team, laboratory, or research experience



Preferred Skills & Experience:

 - GPA of 3.5 or above

 - Experience developing, debugging, or testing embedded software

 - Experience with hardware-in-the-loop testing or other hands-on software/hardware integration and validation

 - Experience with software instrumentation, telemetry, or system monitoring

 - Experience with HMI and/or Grafana

 - Experience in a University club or organization, leadership role preferred

 - Strong interpersonal and technical communication skills (examples: leading a student project team, presenting research at conferences, etc.)

 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail

 - Ability to work cross-departmentally with different groups and teams

 - Ability to work effectively in a dynamic environment with changing needs and requirements

 - Ability to work independently and in a team, take initiative, and communicate effectively



Location

 - We are located in Torrance, CA in a 322,000 square foot, brand new facility featuring large open spaces for team collaboration, R&D, and production, as well as easy access to the 405, 105, and 110 freeways. Our facility is in the heart of Los Angeles' vibrant emerging tech ecosystem alongside many other high growth startups and enterprises.



Culture

At Antares, we like to specifically tie each role to our founding document’s set of values–here are the top five cultural values we think you should believe at your core to be successful:

 - Think in Systems - Energy and Defense are complex ecosystems with numerous stakeholders with competing priorities, conflicting policies, perverse incentives, and emergent and path-dependent properties. First principles thinking alone is insufficient. Think probabilistically and then take action. “If you want to be certain, then you are apt to be obsolete.” Over-optimizing the components often degrades the system

 - Obsess over the End User - The customer and end user are often not the same. We will never build globally competitive commercial products if we lose sight of our end users and their entire interaction with the product life cycle

 - Be Unconstrained by Convention - Our only limits are the laws of physics. Many, even experts, will say what we are working on is impossible. They said the same about SpaceX reusing rockets. Generationally impactful companies, by definition, must accomplish the seemingly impossible. If it were easy, it would have already been done. Never shy away from a solution because it has never been tried before, and never choose to do something because that's “how it's always been done”

 - Go Where the Work Is - Never miss a chance to meet a customer, user, or stakeholder face to face, even if that means hopping on a plane. If you can’t make it, find a teammate who can channel your intentions and go in your place. Deep work can be done from anywhere, but we believe teams are built in person, and aim to maximize our time together

 - Operate in the Grey - Embrace nuance in pursuit of truth. Question every fundamental assumption
   
   

Equal Opportunity

Antares is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are based solely on merit, competence, and qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability, or any other legally protected status.




ITAR REQUIREMENTS

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987.

Henning Larsen

We aim to promote a creative, non-hierarchical workplace, which fosters supportive environments and the freedom to assert and test new ideas and visions. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT PROBABLY GENETIC

Probably Genetic is changing the lives of patients living with severe, complex diseases. Our data platform is used by drug developers and patient advocacy groups to develop and launch treatments for these patients. Our technology discovers undiagnosed patients online, analyzes their disease state using machine learning and at-home testing, and enables compliant communication with patients. In doing so, we help patients access diagnoses, clinical trials, and treatments as early as possible.

We are a tight-knit group of hard-working, ambitious problem solvers united by a mission greater than ourselves. We do well by doing right by patients. We are developing some of the most cutting-edge solutions in healthcare, and our roadmap is packed with innovations in bioinformatics, AI, and drug development. We have built a lean, all-star team to help us bring our vision to life, and we want you to be a part of it.

Probably Genetic has raised multiple rounds of funding from Silicon Valley’s best investors, including Threshold, Khosla, and Y Combinator, and offer competitive salaries, comprehensive benefits, and meaningful early stage equity.


ABOUT THE ROLE:

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead a new product line end to end, owning the vision, strategy, and roadmap that will guide its growth. You will define requirements, run discovery, and partner with engineering to prioritize and ship improvements. You will also own the post-sale relationship for key biopharma accounts, serving as an integral link so the voice of the customer stays prevalent across our products.




WHAT YOU WILL DO:

 - Lead a new product line end to end, owning the vision, strategy, and roadmap that will guide its growth

 - Define product requirements and write specs, partnering closely with engineering to scope, prioritize, and ship improvements

 - Run product discovery, including customer interviews, competitive research, and market analysis, to inform roadmap decisions

 - Define success metrics for the product and track performance post launch, iterating based on data

 - Prepare and deliver polished, data-driven insight packages and presentations that turn raw data into clear, compelling narratives

 - Own the full post-sale relationship for key biopharma accounts, serving as the primary point of contact so the voice of the customer is prevalent across all our products

 - Build lightweight AI-assisted tools and automations to streamline workflows and reduce manual effort over time

 - Collaborate with leadership on product strategy, account strategy, renewal planning, and expansion opportunities across the biopharma and insurance portfolio




WHO YOU ARE:

We are looking for a few specific things that will help you succeed in this role:

 - 5+ years of experience in product management or a related role combining strategy and execution, ideally in a biopharma, healthtech, or data-driven B2B environment

 - Track record of owning a product roadmap end to end, from discovery through shipping and measuring impact

 - Strong data fluency, comfortable working in spreadsheets and ideally with SQL or Python to pull, clean, and package insights without heavy analytical support

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of producing polished decks, dashboards, and insight summaries

 - AI native, you use AI tools as a core part of your workflow and are comfortable vibe coding lightweight solutions without engineering support

 - Experience translating customer or stakeholder feedback into product requirements and working alongside engineering to deliver improvements

 - Demonstrated ability to manage senior stakeholder relationships at large organizations, including handling escalations when needed

Some things that are not required, but you will learn on the job:

 - Familiarity with rare disease, genetics, or the biopharma drug development lifecycle

 - Experience with patient-facing or healthcare data platforms

 - Formal ownership of a customer-facing platform or tool

As with all new hires at Probably Genetic, you will also need to be:

 - A good person. We work with some of the most marginalized populations on the planet and empathy is key

 - Patient-focused and motivated to have a lasting, positive impact on humanity

 - Comfortable in a fast-paced, often ambiguous environment with rapid change

 - Action-oriented and excited to build a company from the ground up


The salary range for this role is $155,000-$210,000 annually. Actual compensation offered will depend on several factors including but not limited to: work experience, education, skill level, and/or other business and organizational needs. 


WHAT WE OFFER AT PROBABLY GENETIC:

 - An engaging and supportive team all on a mission to improve lives

 - Parental Leave Benefits (12 weeks for both birthing and non-birthing)

jobs.title: Model Policy Manager
jobs.description:
About the Team

Our Safety Systems https://openai.com/safety/safety-systems team is at the forefront of OpenAI's mission to build and deploy safe AGI, driving our commitment to AI safety and fostering a culture of trust and transparency.

Within Safety Systems, the Model Policy team aligns model behavior with desired human values and norms. We co-design policy with models and for models by driving rapid policy taxonomy iteration based on data and defining evaluation criteria for foundational models’ ability to reason about safety.

About the Role

If you have a specific expertise or speciality related to this work, please note it in your application via your resume, cover letter or application note.

Frontier AI systems are expanding what people can do across domains, creating both enormous opportunities and difficult safety questions: when should a model help, when should it refuse, and how do we make those boundaries clear enough to train, evaluate, and enforce?

In this role, you will help define how OpenAI’s models should behave in high-risk or high-ambiguity contexts, such as agentic systems, multimodal systems, user safety, privacy, and other emerging risk domains.

This is an ideal role for someone who can move across unfamiliar topics, reason from first principles, and turn ambiguity into practical model behavior. You will work closely with research, engineering, product, preparedness, and operations teams to build policies that are technically grounded, measurable, and responsive to real-world risk.

Your Responsibilities:

 - Design and maintain model policies across safety-relevant domains, including dual-use, agentic, and emerging frontier-risk areas.

 - Translate risk and harm models into clear behavioral specifications, evaluation criteria, grading guidance, and system-level safeguards.

 - Define practical boundaries between beneficial uses of AI and assistance that could materially enable harm, exploitation, misuse, or unsafe outcomes.

 - Build policy artifacts that support model training, evaluation, and deployment.Partner with safety researchers, engineers, product teams, and other stakeholders to operationalize policy into scalable model behavior and measurable safeguards.

 - Use red-teaming results, deployment data, model failures, over-refusals, under-refusals, and ambiguous edge cases to improve policy and evaluation quality over time.

 - Identify emerging capability areas where frontier AI systems could create new safety challenges or lower barriers to harm.

 - Study real-world deployments to identify where model behavior succeeds, fails, or drifts from the intended safety posture.

 - Combine longer-horizon safety research with hands-on launch and deployment work.

 - Contribute to system cards, safety reports, policy documentation, launch reviews, and external communications on OpenAI's approach to model safety and risk mitigation.

 - Design and run human data campaigns, including gold set construction, labeling guidance, calibration, adjudication, and eval coverage analysis, to ensure policies can be reliably measured and improved.

We’re seeking someone who:

 - Has strong judgment about how advanced AI systems may affect real-world risk, especially in ambiguous, fast-moving, or high-impact areas.

 - Has experience building or applying policies, taxonomies, harm models, threat models, or risk frameworks for complex technical, social, or adversarial systems.

 - Can move across domains without needing to be the deepest subject-matter expert in every area, while knowing when to seek expert input.

 - Can turn fuzzy questions into structured policy frameworks, evaluation criteria, operational guidance, and enforceable model behavior.

 - Is comfortable using empirical evidence, including evaluations, red-teaming results, deployment observations, and model failure modes, to inform policy decisions.

 - Thinks in systems across policy, data, graders, classifiers, training, deployment safeguards, measurement, monitoring, and escalation workflows.

 - Has technical judgment about what model behavior can realistically be trained, measured, evaluated, and enforced at scale.

 - Works well across research, engineering, product, policy, domain experts, and operational teams.

 - Writes clearly about complex tradeoffs where safety, user value, and implementation constraints all matter.

 - Takes a pragmatic approach to safety, focused on reducing real-world risk while preserving legitimate, beneficial, and socially valuable uses of AI.

 - Enjoys fast-paced, collaborative research environments where priorities shift as models, evidence, and risks change.

 - Stays grounded in implementation details, empirical results, and what can actually be trained or measured.

Our relevant publications:

 - Accelerating the cyber defense ecosystem that protects us all https://openai.com/index/accelerating-cyber-defense-ecosystem/

 - Trusted Access https://openai.com/index/scaling-trusted-access-for-cyber-defense/

 - Safety at every step https://openai.com/safety/

 - Safety evaluations hub https://openai.com/safety/evaluations-hub/

Workplace & Location

This role is based in our San Francisco office. We do encourage you to apply even if you prefer a different work location as factors may change over time.

We offer relocation support to new employees, and we use a hybrid model: three days in the office per week with optional work from home on Thursdays and Fridays.

Our open-plan offices have height-adjustable desks, conference rooms, phone booths, well-stocked kitchens full of snacks and drinks, three in-house prepared meals daily, a private outdoor space for working in the sun or socializing, nap rooms, private bike storage, and more.

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. jobs.title: Controller
jobs.description:
CONTROLLER

Greptile is an AI code reviewer that catches bugs and anti-patterns in pull requests with complete context of the codebase. Hundreds of top software companies, from YC startups to big tech, and teams in finance, healthcare, and defense, use Greptile to merge PRs faster and catch more bugs.

Greptile reviews 5B lines of code every month for 22,000+ customers. A new repo starts using Greptile every 2 minutes. We also uniquely offer self-hosted, air-gapped deployments for enterprises across defense, financial services, and healthcare.

This is Greptile’s first accounting hire. You will report to the Head of Finance and own accounting end to end, from closing the books and writing policies to implementing an AI-native ERP. You will take us from outsourced bookkeeping to an audit-ready accounting function, then build the team as the company scales.


RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Build and own the monthly and quarterly close, including reconciliations, journal entries, accruals, flux analysis, and financial statements

 - Own revenue recognition across self-serve, enterprise, and usage-based contracts, including Greptile’s ASC 606 policy and supporting technical memos

 - Set Greptile’s technical accounting positions across equity, leases, capitalized software, R&D capitalization, and complex deal structures

 - Build the accounting for compute and inference spend, including prepaid commitments, consumption accruals, and gross margin reporting

 - Lead the implementation of an AI-native ERP and its integrations across billing, banking, cards, payroll, and cap table management

 - Own tax and compliance, including corporate tax, sales tax, R&D credits, 1099s, and state filings

 - Run accounting operations across AP, AR, collections, payroll accounting, expenses, and treasury

 - Get Greptile audit-ready and lead our first external audit

 - Build the accounting team as the company grows


QUALIFICATIONS

 - 7+ years of progressive accounting experience, including Controller, Assistant Controller, Director, or Senior Accounting Manager scope at a high-growth technology company

 - CPA with a foundation in Big Four audit, ideally within a technology practice

 - Deep ASC 606 experience in a subscription and consumption-based business

 - Experience owning the close and leading or supporting an external audit

 - Experience building an accounting function, or a major part of one, from the ground up

 - Comfortable writing and defending technical accounting memos for complex transactions

 - Hands-on ERP implementation experience

 - You use AI seriously in your own work and have strong opinions about where it can improve accounting


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience at a company with both self-serve and enterprise sales motions

 - Experience as an accounting lead through a Series B to E fundraise or IPO diligence

 - SQL proficiency or enough comfort with data to validate numbers at the source


YOU’LL LIKE WORKING HERE IF

 - You want to build an accounting function from zero instead of inheriting one

 - You want to be the technical authority on the answer while remaining close to the work

 - The speed and responsibility of a high-growth AI company are exciting to you

 - You want a path to CAO and are willing to earn it by building the function yourself

This role is based in San Francisco and requires at least three days per week in the office.

Jump Trading Group is committed to world class research. We empower exceptional talents in Mathematics, Physics, and Computer Science to seek scientific boundaries, push through them, and apply cutting edge research to global financial markets. Our culture is unique. Constant innovation requires fearlessness, creativity, intellectual honesty, and a relentless competitive streak. We believe in winning together and unlocking unique individual talent by incenting collaboration and mutual respect. At Jump, research outcomes drive more than superior risk adjusted returns. We design, develop, and deploy technologies that change our world, fund start-ups across industries, and partner with leading global research organizations and universities to solve problems.

About the Role

We are looking for a seasoned Technical Project Manager to drive the delivery of complex, high-impact projects within one of our quantitative trading teams. In this role you will sit at the intersection of engineering, quantitative research, and trading, coordinating the people, timelines, and dependencies required to support mission-critical software and a dynamic research infrastructure. You bring both a strong technical foundation and a proven track record of managing engineering programs end to end.

What You'll Do

• Own the end-to-end delivery of technical projects spanning trading platforms, execution infrastructure, and quant research tooling — from scoping through launch.

• Partner with engineers, quantitative researchers, and traders to translate ambitious goals into clear plans, milestones, and measurable outcomes.

• Manage cross-team dependencies, surface risks early, and keep initiatives on track in a fast-moving, low-latency environment.

• Establish and improve project management practices — planning, prioritization, status reporting, and post-mortems — that fit an engineering-driven culture.

• Communicate progress, trade-offs, and decisions clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.

What You'll Bring

• 7–10 years of experience managing technical projects or engineering programs, ideally including systems where performance and reliability are critical.

• A background in engineering or computer science — whether an academic degree or equivalent hands-on experience as a software engineer or in a closely related technical role.

• The technical fluency to engage credibly with engineers and researchers on architecture, trade-offs, and delivery risk.

• A strong track record of shipping complex projects on time by aligning multiple teams and stakeholders.

• Excellent written and verbal communication, with the judgment to know what to escalate and when.

• Experience in trading, financial markets, or another high-performance, data-intensive domain.

At Coram AI, we’re reimagining video security for the modern world. Our cloud-native platform uses computer vision and AI to help businesses stay safe, make smarter decisions, and move faster; from real-time alerts to seamless clip sharing and multi-site visibility.



You’ll be joining an ambitious, fast-moving team that values clarity, craftsmanship, and impact. Every person here has a voice, ships meaningful work, and helps shape how AI can make the world safer and more connected.



The role:

Coram AI is hiring for our next cohort of Marketing Development Representatives to join our growing sales team. This is an entry-level technology sales role designed for ambitious early-career professionals looking to build a career in AI, SaaS, and B2B sales.



Our accelerated MDR program combines the best parts of a Marketing Development Representative (MDR), Business Development Representative (BDR), and Account Executive role. You'll work directly with experienced Account Executives on live deals, build and own pipeline through outbound prospecting, develop your sales skills, and work toward promotion into a full-cycle Account Executive role within 6 months, compared with the traditional 1–2 year SDR-to-AE path. You'll learn how to prospect, qualify opportunities, run sales conversations, build pipeline, and sell Coram AI's physical security platform to businesses across the U.S.



Our second Fall 2026 cohort will start on November 2nd. 



Responsibilities:

 - Build and qualify pipeline through targeted, strategic prospecting

 - Partner with senior AEs on live deals, from discovery to close

 - Participate in and help deliver product demos to prospects and partners

 - Understand and uncover customer needs and business problems to effectively communicate how Coram can solve them

 - Master Coram’s platform and learn how to sell value

 - Consistently outperform assigned goals and earn your promotion to a full-cycle Account Executive title

 - Ability to understand complex business environments and uncover customer issues, process problems, and translate need into business opportunities.



Skills and qualifications:

 - Bachelor's or Associate's degree, or relevant working experience

 - We’re especially interested in college athletes and others with highly competitive backgrounds (military, performing arts, debate, high‑level competition, entrepreneurship, etc.) but this is not a requirement to apply

 - A strong work ethic with a focus on winning the right way

 - Motivation to win and a willingness to out‑prepare and out‑work your competition

 - Intrinsically-driven with the ability to takes initiative by default

 - Coachable and curious mindset with the ability to ask questions, take feedback, and apply it to your work

 - Resilient in challenging and fast-paced environments

 - Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English

 - Ability to work in an onsite environment
   
   

What we offer:

 - Competitive compensation package which includes annual base salary of $60,000 + variable compensation of $10,000

 - Clear promotion path from Associate Account Executive to full-cycle Account Executive within 6 months

 - Opportunity to relocate into any of our US offices (SLC, AZ, NYC, or ATL)

 - Flexible paid time off and 10 paid holidays

 - Daily team breakfast and dinner, and regular team off-sites

 - The latest Apple products and unlimited tech stack (Claude, Nooks, Clay, Instantly, etc.)

 - Free onsite EV charging + commuter stipend

 - 100% Employer-paid medical, dental, vision, and base life insurance

 - 401(k) with both Traditional and Roth options

 - Early-stage equity in a rapidly growing company

 - Referral bonuses



We're on a mission to transform a $50B+ legacy industry by bringing the power of cutting-edge multimodal LLMs and computer vision to real-world security and operations. From firearm detection to intelligent access control, our AI-native platform turns every camera and sensor into a smart system that enhances safety, efficiency, and awareness. 



Founded by Ashesh Jain (ex-Lyft Level 5, PhD Cornell) and Peter Ondruska (ex-Lyft, PhD Oxford), Coram AI is backed by Ansa Capital, Battery Ventures, Mosaic, 8VC and Up Partners, have raised over $65M, and were named to the CB Insights AI 100 as one of the most promising AI companies in the world. If you're excited to work on mission-critical AI that makes an impact in the real world, we’d love to meet you.

jobs.title: Product-Focused Data Scientist (LLM Products)
jobs.description:
Blue Rose Research helps Democrats win elections and advance progressive causes. We work with campaigns in battleground races up and down the ballot and major Democratic, progressive, and advocacy organizations across the country to produce the research and build the tools they use to decide what to say and where to spend.

We are hiring a product-focused data scientist to help build LLM-powered research and analysis tools that deliver greater breadth, depth, and speed than ever possible before. You’ll be co-evolving the product experience along with the models that power it. Help revolutionize how political strategy is developed and communicated to campaigns.

You will:

• Spend time with political strategists to understand how they think and what AI can do to improve their work..

• Translate that work into product decisions: how to structure workflows that involve humans and agents working together.

• Help set the bar for rigor on what “good” looks like for an AI system, while staying pragmatic about what a real deadline and a real user actually need.

• Design evaluations and LLM-as-judge systems that tell us whether an LLM-powered feature is accurate, well-grounded, and useful.

• Prototype quickly, using coding agents to test ideas before they become product commitments.

• Communicate findings and tradeoffs clearly to both technical and nontechnical audiences, including in client-facing settings.

Our ideal candidate likely:

• Has 5+ years of experience as a data scientist or applied statistician, with lots of exposure to shipping features or products, not just producing analyses.

• Is proficient in Python, SQL, and standard statistical/ML tooling, and comfortable with the mess of real-world data.

• Has hands-on experience evaluating or building on top of LLMs: designing eval sets, building LLM-as-judge pipelines, and working with embeddings.

• Has good product instincts. Cares deeply about how the end user is going to interact with the model through the product.

• Communicates clearly in writing and in conversation with engineers, product managers, and non-technical stakeholders alike.

• Is energized by ambiguous problems — translating “help win elections” into a model, a metric, or a product decision, without a clean playbook to follow.

• Is motivated by Blue Rose Research’s mission and interested in learning the progressive political ecosystem. Prior political or civic-tech experience is welcome but not required.

Join us!

We are a remote-first company and we have an office in NYC.

The salary range for this position is $160,000 - $210,000 annually, commensurate with experience.

We offer medical, dental, vision, 401k match, and unlimited PTO.

Candidates must be authorized to work lawfully in the United States.

jobs.title: Business Systems Analyst II (Portland, OR - US)
jobs.description:
Interested in joining a growing company where you will work with talented colleagues, enhance a supportive and energetic culture, and be part of the climate solution? At Energy Solutions, we focus on the big impacts. And we believe that market-based programs can be a powerful force to deliver large-scale energy, carbon, and water-use savings. Since 1995, we’ve harnessed that power to offer proven, performance-based solutions for our utility, government, and institutional customers.

ES is currently seeking a powerhouse Business Systems Analyst II to join our fast-paced Information Systems Team. You'll play a key role in delivering innovative solutions that help drive business success. Partnering with stakeholders, developers, and cross-functional teams, you'll translate business needs into clear requirements that shape platform enhancements and technology initiatives. In this role, you'll analyze business processes, define and refine requirements, and help ensure solutions align with strategic objectives. Your ability to simplify complex concepts, facilitate collaboration, and bridge the gap between business and technical teams will be critical to delivering successful outcomes.

You'll work with a high degree of ownership while collaborating closely with others to support solution design, validate requirements, maintain project documentation, and contribute to Agile delivery practices. You'll also have opportunities to share your expertise, mentor fellow analysts, and help strengthen business analysis best practices across the organization. If you're a curious problem-solver who enjoys turning ideas into solutions and loves working with people and technology, this is an exciting opportunity to make a meaningful impact while growing your career.

This is a hybrid work opportunity. ES has offices in Oakland, CA; Orange, CA; New York, NY; Portland, OR; Chicago, IL; and Boston, MA.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

• Collaborate with minimal guidance with internal and external stakeholders to understand, clarify, and document business needs

• Partner with domain experts and engineers to support solution design for moderately complex technical problems

• Prepare and maintain well‑documented functional specifications, workflows, mock-ups, and user stories

• Maintain and refine epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria to ensure clarity, completeness, and alignment with business priorities

• Contribute to backlog refinement, sprint planning, and release planning activities to support alignment between business priorities and development capacity

• Analyze current product workflows and evaluate opportunities for improvement based on business needs and system capabilities

• Coordinate and support user acceptance testing (UAT) activities by developing test cases, facilitating execution, and validating requirements against delivered solutions

• Track and analyze key metrics and KPIs to evaluate solution performance and identify improvement opportunities

• Participate in retrospective discussions and contribute recommendations to improve team processes and delivery outcomes

• Participate in prototyping and proof‑of‑concept efforts to validate solution approaches and workflows

• Contribute to process improvement initiatives by identifying gaps in requirements, documentation, and delivery practices

• Support adoption of Agile best practices by reinforcing consistent standards across teams

• Assist and guide junior analysts by sharing knowledge, providing feedback and supporting skill development

Minimum Qualifications: (Quantifiable Skills i.e Years of experience)

• Bachelor's degree in engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related or technical field

• Five years of experience as a Business Systems Analyst or in a closely related role

• Experience working within the Agile development lifecycle, collaborating with cross functional teams

• Experience conducting and supporting UAT efforts, including coordinating with stakeholders to validate requirements against delivered solutions

• Strong technical analysis skills with the ability to translate and document business needs into clear, actionable technical specifications

• Strong communication skills, with the ability to convey and clarify information between non-technical stakeholders and technical teams

• Proficiency in writing and managing user stories, epics, and acceptance criteria using Jira or similar Agile tools

• Working knowledge of SQL or BI tools to analyze data and support requirements validation and decision-making

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a collaborative environment

The salary range for this role is $106,000 - $123,000 with a target compensation of $106,000 - $115,000 based on experience and qualifications.

Compensation is commensurate with experience and includes a generous retirement package. Energy Solutions provides an excellent benefits package including medical, dental and vision insurance, other pre-tax contribution plans and an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP).

AI Use

At Energy Solutions we believe in the importance of authentic interactions and equitable opportunities. We base our candidate selection on one’s own skills, knowledge, and experience. To ensure the integrity and fairness of our interview process, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools (including Generative AI) or other means to generate or assist with responses during interviews is strictly prohibited. This practice supports our commitment to create a transparent and equitable space where skills, knowledge and experience can truly shine.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Energy Solutions is an affirmative action-equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type. We afford equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristics protected by law. Energy Solutions conforms to the spirit as well as to the letter of all applicable laws and regulations.

Office Locations and a Remote Workforce

Energy Solutions operates as a predominantly remote workforce with offices in  six different locations. Employees who reside within 40 miles of an office (except New York) will be assigned to that location, though in-office attendance requirements may vary by team. At this time, we are not accepting applications from candidates residing in the following states: Delaware, Kentucky, Mississippi, Montana, Nebraska, and North Dakota.

Background Check Information

Information will be requested to perform the compulsory background check. A drug screen and authorization to work in the U.S. indefinitely are preconditions of employment. Energy Solutions is an equal opportunity employer.

Reasonable Accommodations

Energy Solutions is committed to providing access and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities. jobs.title: Growth Marketing Design Lead
jobs.description:
AI AT ZAPIER

At Zapier https://zapier.com/about, we build and use automation every day to make work more efficient, creative, and human. So if you’re using AI tools while applying here - that’s great! We just ask that you use them responsibly and transparently.

Check out our guidance on How to Collaborate with AI During Zapier’s Hiring Process https://zapier.com/l/jobs/ai-at-zapier, including how to use AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or others during our hiring process - and when not to.

 

Job Posted: September 2026

Location: NAMER



Hi there!



As our Growth design Lead you'll lead the creation of a high-velocity experimentation engine that drives measurable business impact across the top of our funnel. You'll help define and execute an AI-first design strategy that connects world-class creative with core growth metrics — ensuring continuous optimization across acquisition, conversion, and activation. Operating at the intersection of design, data, and marketing, you'll translate behavioral and search insights into scalable, on-brand experiences, establish rigorous testing frameworks, and partner closely with Growth Marketing, Web/Engineering, Brand, and Data to accelerate conversion and revenue outcomes through disciplined, data-driven execution.

If you have a strong track record of driving growth through experimentation, bring deep design and product thinking, understand SEO and conversion rate optimization, and have a forward-looking perspective on how AI can unlock customer and business value, we'd love to hear from you!

 - Our Commitment to Applicants https://zapier.com/jobs/our-commitment-to-applicants/

 - Culture and Values at Zapier https://zapier.com/jobs/culture-and-values-at-zapier/

 - Zapier Guide to Remote Work https://zapier.com/learn/remote-work/

 - Zapier Code of Conduct https://zapier.com/jobs/zapier-code-of-conduct/

 - Diversity and Inclusivity at Zapier https://zapier.com/jobs/working-on-diversity-and-inclusivity/

About You

 - You have 10+ years of experience in growth, product, or marketing design, with a strong portfolio of shipped, top-of-funnel work that drove measurable business impact (lead generation, conversion lift, acquisition). Your portfolio shows both craft and outcomes.

 - You drive growth through experimentation. You've designed and run A/B and multivariate tests, built and scaled experimentation programs, and moved quickly from hypothesis to live experiment without dropping your quality bar.

 - You understand SEO and conversion rate optimization deeply, and you design with them in mind. You know how information architecture, landing page structure, page speed, and content strategy affect discoverability and conversion. You also stay ahead of how AI is transforming organic search and discovery, evolving site architecture and content strategy to remain optimized for SEO and localized (GEO) behaviors.

 - You think in systems and you strengthen the ones that already exist. You've designed for CMS-driven platforms and modular frameworks, and you've built and contributed to reusable components inside a shared design systems so the whole team ships faster and more consistently.

 - You've owned lead-capture experiences — forms, gated content, and CRM-integrated workflows — and you're fluent in growth metrics like MQLs, CAC, and LTV and lead qualification workflows.

 - You're AI-first in your craft. You actively use AI tools (e.g., Cursor, v0, Claude, Figma AI) to accelerate research, generate variants, prototype faster, and increase design velocity — and you have a forward-looking view on how AI can unlock customer and business value.

 - You're deep in Figma: auto-layout, AI prototyping, and a track record of contributing to design systems there rather than working around them. You hold a high bar for usability, accessibility and brand integrity, and you treat brand and conversion as the same goal.

 - You're a seasoned operator and a force multiplier. You've worked at the scale and pace of a fast-growing company, you own ambiguous, high-impact work end-to-end, and you mentor and level up other designers.

 - You communicate and collaborate well. You partner naturally with growth marketers, brand designers, writers, engineers, and data, and you can articulate the "why" behind design decisions in terms of both user experience and business outcomes.

 - You embody our values. At Zapier, our values https://zapier.com/jobs/culture-and-values-at-zapier are at the heart of how we work together and how we think about our customers. In our remote setting, they help develop trust and ensure we work and collaborate to democratize automation.

Things You'll Do

 - Own and define the end-to-end visitor-to-lead experience across our marketing site and campaigns — shaping how prospects discover, learn about, and decide to try Zapier.

 - Build a high-velocity experimentation engine for the top of our funnel — designing, running, and scaling A/B and multivariate experimentation programs across landing pages, campaigns, and conversion surfaces.

 - Define and execute an AI-first design strategy that connects world-class creative with core growth metrics, and continuously optimizes for acquisition, conversion, and activation.

 - Own conversion rate optimization from a design perspective: form hypotheses, design experiments, and iterate based on test results, funnel data, and growth metrics (MQLs, CAC, LTV).

 - Refine site-wide information architecture to improve discoverability, navigation, and conversion efficiency, and evolve our content strategy for SEO and AI-driven search (GEO).

 - Design high-performing lead-capture experiences — forms, gated content, and CRM-integrated workflows — and partner with marketing and revenue ops to improve lead qualification and handoff.

 - Extend the systems we already have (the web design system, the email design system, brand guidelines) so they serve growth and experimentation needs. You decide whether the pattern earns a place in the system and build the component in Figma.

 - Partner closely with Growth Marketing, Brand, Web/Engineering, and Data to translate behavioral and search insights into scalable, on-brand, accessible experiences. You'll be active in what Brand Studio ships: critique, design review, and the systems.

 - Bring a high creative bar to performance-driven work, balancing brand integrity with funnel optimization.

 - Use AI to raise the ceiling on what we can test: variants at volume, prototypes fast enough to test an idea, and sharing what works with the rest of Brand Studio.

 - Set the standard for growth design practice across Brand Studio — mentoring designers and fostering craft, experimentation, and AI fluency.

 


HOW TO APPLY

At Zapier, we believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us better, which is why we have a non-standard application process designed to promote inclusion and equity. We're looking for the best fit for each of our roles, regardless of the type of companies in your background, so we encourage you to apply even if your skills and experiences don’t exactly match the job description. All we ask is that you answer a few in-depth questions in our application that would typically be asked at the start of an interview process. This helps speed things up by letting us get to know you and your skillset a bit better right out of the gate. Please be sure to answer each question; the resume and CV fields are optional.

Education is not a requirement for our roles; however, if you receive an offer, you will need to include your most recent educational experience as part of our background check process.

After you apply, you are going to hear back from us—even if we don’t see an immediate fit with our team. In fact, throughout the process, we strive to never go more than seven days without letting you know the status of your application. We know we’ll make mistakes from time to time, so if you ever have questions about where you stand or about the process, just ask your recruiter!

Zapier is an equal-opportunity employer and we're excited to work with talented and empathetic people of all identities. Zapier does not discriminate based on someone's identity in any aspect of hiring or employment as required by law and in line with our commitment to Diversity, Inclusion, Belonging and Equity. Our code of conduct https://zapier.com/jobs/zapier-code-of-conduct provides a beacon for the kind of company we strive to be, and we celebrate our differences because those differences are what allow us to make a product that serves a global user base. jobs.title: Regional Early Careers/University Recruiter, Asia
jobs.description:
Step into a career with ASM, where cutting edge technology meets collaborative culture. ​

For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what’s next, at the forefront of innovation and what’s technologically possible. With more than 4,500 ASMers representing 70 nationalities, our people and our advanced semiconductor devices are playing a crucial role in trends such as 5G, cloud computing, AI, and autonomous driving.  But we’re more than just a tech company. We value diversity, inclusion and sustainability as we strive to make a positive impact on the world.  Our development programs help support your growth, shaping your future and pushing the boundaries of innovation to unleash potential.

Role Summary

We are looking for a high-potential, hands-on Regional University Relations & Early Careers Recruiter to help build ASM’s future talent pipeline across Asia. This role offers early-career professionals the opportunity to build regional talent acquisition experience in one of the world’s most dynamic industries. You will work across Taiwan, Japan, Korea, China, and Singapore, partnering with local TA teams, hiring managers, universities, professors, labs, and student communities to connect emerging engineering and technology talent with meaningful opportunities at ASM. This role will partner closely with the US/EU Early Careers recruiting team and recruitment marketing on annual program, planning, and execution.

Key Responsibilities

University & Academic Partnerships

• Build and execute ASM’s university recruiting plan across Asia with clear focus on practical outcomes and hiring impact.

• Develop trusted relationships with universities, professors, labs, career centers, and student groups.

• Build targeted engagement plans for key STEM disciplines including Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, and Computer Science.

• Create and maintain relationships with PhD advisors, researchers, post-doctoral communities, and university leadership.

• Identify opportunities for strategic collaboration including guest lectures, technical talks, capstone projects, research partnerships, scholarships, competitions, and sponsorships.

Early Career Strategy

• Translate business hiring needs into a practical early-career roadmap that can be executed across Asia.

• Lead internship, co-op, new college graduate (NCG), and graduate hiring programs across Asia.

• Create fresh and authentic ways to engage students and young professionals, including campus events, social content, employee stories, technical talks, and talent communities.

• Partner with business leaders to identify future capability needs and build sustainable talent pipelines.

jobs.title: Machine Operator - 1st Shift
jobs.description:
Machine Operator I is an entry-level machine operator position responsible for safely operating and monitoring assigned production equipment. Under the guidance of experienced operators and supervisors, the incumbent performs basic machine adjustments, quality checks, sanitation activities, and routine equipment operation tasks while developing proficiency on assigned equipment. This role supports the production of high-quality products by adhering to safety, food safety, quality, and operational standards.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Safety and Compliance

• Follow all company safety policies, GMPs, food safety requirements, and quality standards.
• Wear required PPE and comply with all safety procedures.
• Follow Lockout/Tagout procedures when performing equipment cleaning, maintenance support, or troubleshooting activities.
• Handle cleaning chemicals safely and according to established procedures.
• Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment.

Equipment Operation

• Set up, start up, operate, monitor, and shut down production equipment according to established standards.
• Perform machine adjustments based on product specifications, packaging requirements, and operating conditions.
• Monitor machine performance and product flow throughout production runs.
• Detect and respond to machine malfunctions, equipment abnormalities, and product defects.
• Stop, reset, and restart equipment safely following established procedures.
• Clear jams and minor equipment issues while minimizing downtime.
• Perform product changeovers efficiently while maintaining quality and food safety standards.

Quality Assurance

• Perform required quality checks, inspections, and product evaluations.
• Verify fill weights, package integrity, coding accuracy, and product appearance.
• Identify, communicate, and assist in resolving quality concerns.
• Complete all required quality documentation accurately and on time.
• Ensure products consistently meet customer and company specifications.

Sanitation and Cleaning

• Perform equipment teardown, cleaning, sanitization, and reassembly activities.
• Clean pumps, sanitary piping, fillers, conveyors, and associated production equipment.
• Operate CIP systems as required.
• Verify equipment cleanliness and readiness prior to production startup.
• Report any sanitation or quality concerns immediately.

Equipment Care and Maintenance

• Perform routine inspections of equipment and identify potential mechanical issues.
• Complete assigned autonomous maintenance activities and MSS tasks.
• Assist maintenance personnel with preventative maintenance and repair activities as needed.
• Communicate equipment performance concerns to supervisors and maintenance teams.
• Help reduce downtime through proactive equipment monitoring and troubleshooting.

Production Documentation

• Accurately complete all production records, downtime reports, quality checks, sanitation records, and operational documentation.
• Record downtime events and root causes within company systems.
• Maintain accurate production and efficiency data.

Continuous Improvement

• Identify opportunities to improve safety, quality, efficiency, waste reduction, and equipment performance.
• Participate in continuous improvement initiatives and problem-solving activities.
• Support departmental goals related to OEE, productivity, quality, and cost control.

Education: High school diploma or GED required.

Equipment/Software Skills: Ability to operate production equipment safely and effectively. Basic mechanical aptitude and troubleshooting skills. Ability to read and follow work instructions, SOPs, and production schedules.

jobs.title: Sr. Analytics Engineer/ Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Laurel is on a mission to return time. As the leading AI Time platform for professional services firms, we’re transforming how organizations capture, analyze, and optimize their most valuable resource: time. Our proprietary machine learning technology automates work time capture and connects time data to business outcomes, enabling firms to increase profitability, improve client delivery, and make data-driven strategic decisions. We serve many of the world's largest accounting and law firms, including EY, Aprio, Crowell & Moring, and Frost Brown Todd, and process over 1 billion work activities annually that have never been collected and aggregated before Laurel’s AI Time platform. 



Our team comprises top talent in AI, product development, and engineering—innovative, humble, and forward-thinking professionals committed to redefining productivity in the knowledge economy. We're building solutions that empower workers to deliver twice the value in half the time, giving people more time to be creative and impactful. If you're passionate about transforming how people work and building a lasting company that explores the essence of time itself, we'd love to meet you.



About the Role

As a Senior Analytics Engineer/Data Engineer at Laurel, you’ll turn product and business data into clear, trustworthy insights leaders can act on. You’ll own the analytics lifecycle—from ingestion and modeling to BI visualization and decision enablement. You’ll deliver self-serve insights using SQL/Python and embedded BI (e.g., ThoughtSpot). You will also help define the design patterns and data infrastructure to scale.

We’re especially interested in candidates who thrive in early-stage environments and pair analytical rigor with clear storytelling. You’ll partner closely with our CX team to quantify and communicate Laurel’s ROI, and you’ll join customer-facing presentations. You will be able to translate complex methods for non-technical leaders while going deep with technical stakeholders when needed.

In addition, you’ll apply machine learning to real-world product and business problems. You should be comfortable prototyping AI/ML models in notebooks, experimenting with approaches (classification, clustering, regression, NLP, etc.), and translating findings into actionable insights for the product and business.

What you will do

 1. Build analyses & automation (SQL/Python)
    
    - Run recurring ROI analyses (Business Impact Reports). Write performant SQL and pandas; productionize repeatable jobs (scheduling, alerts, anomaly checks) with orchestration (e.g., Airflow).

 2. Define metrics & model the data
    
    - Own metric definitions (e.g., True Time vs. Released), create reusable SQL Data Models that serve as the analytics source of truth.

 3. Partner with CX on customer ROI
    
    - Quantify and communicate Laurel’s impact, prepare exec-ready materials, and join customer-facing presentations—translating for both non-technical and technical stakeholders.

 4. Ship dashboards & actionable insights
    
    - Deliver customer-facing ThoughtSpot dashboards and turn findings into concise actionable insights

 5. Raise data quality & instrumentation
    
    - Add validation tests and monitoring, triage data issues quickly, and collaborate with Product/Engineering to improve data quality.

 6. Data Platform Development
    
    - Design, build, and maintain Laurel’s Analytics Data Warehouse as the single source of truth for analytics and reporting needs.
    
    - Create scalable ETL pipelines to ingest, process, and organize data from diverse sources (PMS, Web Analytics, WebApp).
    
    - Deploy and maintain Business Intelligence tools to provide analytics and reporting capabilities.

You will be a great fit if you have

 - Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

 - Experience: 3+ years of professional experience as a Data Scientist. Ideal candidates will be comfortable working with large-scale data systems.

 - Technical Proficiency:
   
   - Advanced SQL and Python
   
   - Experience with data orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow, Prefect, Dagster).
   
   - Proficiency in modern data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift).
   
   - Familiarity with data modeling, warehousing principles, and BI tools (e.g., Thoughtspot, PowerBI, Tableau).
   
   - Ability to build ML models and quickly prototype solutions (classification, clustering, regression, NLP) that inform product direction.

 - Experience With:
   
   - Cloud platform expertise (AWS, GCP, Azure).
   
   - Knowledge of dbt, Kubernetes, and Terraform.
   
   - Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.

 - Soft Skills:
   
   - Strong problem-solving and communication skills.
   
   - Ability to work in a fast-paced startup environment and manage multiple priorities.

Nice to haves

 - Experience with knowledge worker productivity tools

 - Familiarity with modern data visualization libraries (e.g., D3.js http://d3.js)

 - ML and AI: Prototype, build and test ML models to quickly validate hypotheses and generate insights that guide Laurel product features

Flexibility and Logistics

 - Location: This role will be hybrid based in our San Francisco office, 3 days per week. We will consider exceptionally qualified candidates based in other US-locations on a case by case basis.

 - Compensation: Competitive salary, generous equity, comprehensive medical/dental/vision coverage with covered  premiums, 401(k), additional benefits including wellness/commuter/FSA stipends. For candidates based in San Francisco the compensation range for this role is $205,000-$249,000 USD. Final compensation amounts will be determined based on several factors including candidate experience, qualifications and expertise and may vary from the amounts listed.

 - Visa Sponsorship: Unfortunately we are unable to provide Visa Sponsorship at this time.


WHY JOIN LAUREL:

 - To date, we've secured significant funding from renowned venture capitalists (Google Ventures, IVP, Anthos, Upfront Ventures), as well as notable individuals like Marc Benioff, Gokul Rajaram, Kevin Weil, and Alexis Ohanian

 - A smart, fun, collaborative, and inclusive team

 - Great employee benefits, including equity and 401K

 - Bi-annual, in-person company off-sites, in unique locations, to grow and share time with the team

 - An opportunity to perform at your best while growing, making a meaningful impact on the company's trajectory, and embodying our core values: understanding your "why," dancing in the rain, being your whole self, and sanctifying time

We encourage diverse perspectives and rigorous thinkers who aren't afraid to challenge the status quo. Laurel is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. We are not able to support visa sponsorship or relocation assistance. 



If you think you'd be a good fit for this role, we encourage you to apply, even if you don’t perfectly match all the bullet points in the job description. At Laurel, we strive to create an inclusive culture that encourages people from all walks of life to bring their unique, diverse perspectives to work. Every day, we aim to build an environment that empowers us all to do the best work of our careers, and we can't wait to show you what we have to offer!
