jobs.title: Associate General Counsel - Privacy
jobs.description:
ABOUT ABRIDGE

Abridge was founded in 2018 with the mission of powering deeper understanding in healthcare. Our AI-powered platform was purpose-built for medical conversations, improving clinical documentation efficiencies while enabling clinicians to focus on what matters most—their patients.

Our enterprise-grade technology transforms patient-clinician conversations into structured clinical notes in real-time, with deep EMR integrations. Powered by Linked Evidence and our purpose-built, auditable AI, we are the only company that maps AI-generated summaries to ground truth, helping providers quickly trust and verify the output. As pioneers in generative AI for healthcare, we are setting the industry standards for the responsible deployment of AI across health systems.

We are a growing team of practicing MDs, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to empower people and make care make more sense. We have offices located in the Mission District in San Francisco, the SoHo neighborhood of New York, and East Liberty in Pittsburgh. 


THE ROLE

Abridge is seeking an experienced Privacy Counsel to lead our privacy team and scale our privacy and data governance program as the company grows. This is a highly visible role at the intersection of artificial intelligence, healthcare, data governance, data protection, and product innovation.

You will serve as a trusted legal advisor to senior leadership and partner closely with Security, Product, Engineering, and other cross-functional teams. You will provide practical, risk-based guidance, lead critical privacy and data initiatives, and build systems that enable Abridge to innovate responsibly while meeting evolving regulatory and customer expectations.

The ideal candidate brings deep privacy expertise, sound business judgment, and experience operating with autonomy and leading a team in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Build Abridge’s privacy program, providing practical, product-focused counseling to the Security, Product and Engineering teams.

 - Advise teams on privacy laws related to artificial intelligence, machine learning, clinical data, product development, secondary use of data and the responsible use of sensitive information.

 - Help develop, maintain, and scale global privacy programs.

 - Support data sharing and ecosystem questions (first/third-party, vendors, partners, internal platform services), including governance and contractual expectations in partnership with commercial counsel.

 - Monitor and respond to changes in privacy laws and regulations, including AI regulations.

 - Draft, maintain, and operationalize privacy policies, playbooks, templates, governance standards, and training materials that promote awareness and consistent decision-making across the company.

 - Work cross functionally with talented product and engineering teams in evaluating the impact of privacy and data protection laws and regulatory guidance on exciting product developments.




WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - Have 10+ years of experience with a mix of in-house, health tech, or technology-focused law firm roles.

 - Experience building, developing, advising, and evaluating programs that ensure products comply with laws, regulations, and external commitments.

 - Knowledge of HIPAA and other healthcare privacy requirements, as well as CCPA/CPRA, biometric privacy laws, and applicable U.S. state privacy and data security frameworks.

 - A practical, risk-based approach and the ability to balance legal, regulatory, business, and customer considerations.

 - Strong business judgment and the ability to work independently in an environment that values autonomy, accountability, and trust.

 - Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to translate complex legal requirements into clear, actionable guidance for technical and nontechnical audiences.

 - Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple high-priority matters in a dynamic, fast-moving environment.

 - A Juris Doctor degree from an accredited law school and active membership in good standing with at least one U.S. state bar.
   


BONUS POINTS IF…

 - Strong preference for prior experience on healthcare or health tech.

 - Familiarity with recent trends in the intersection of privacy regulations and artificial intelligence.

 - IAPP CIPP certification.

This is a hybrid role requiring employees to work from our SF or NYC office 3 days per week.


WHY WORK AT ABRIDGE?

At Abridge, we’re transforming healthcare delivery experiences with generative AI, enabling clinicians and patients to connect in deeper, more meaningful ways. Our mission is clear: to power deeper understanding in healthcare. We’re driving real, lasting change, with millions of medical conversations processed each month.

Joining Abridge means stepping into a fast-paced, high-growth startup where your contributions truly make a difference. Our culture requires extreme ownership—every employee has the ability to (and is expected to) make an impact on our customers and our business.

Beyond individual impact, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a team of curious, high-achieving people in a supportive environment where success is shared, growth is constant, and feedback fuels progress. At Abridge, it’s not just what we do—it’s how we do it. Every decision is rooted in empathy, always prioritizing the needs of clinicians and patients.

We’re committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally. Whether it's flexible work hours, an inclusive culture, or ongoing learning opportunities, we are here to help you thrive and do the best work of your life.

If you are ready to make a meaningful impact alongside passionate people who care deeply about what they do, Abridge is the place for you.



HOW WE TAKE CARE OF ABRIDGERS:

 - Generous Time Off: 14 paid holidays, flexible PTO for salaried employees, and accrued time off for hourly employees

 - Comprehensive Health Plans: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage for all full-time employees and their families.

 - Generous HSA Contribution: If you choose a High Deductible Health Plan, Abridge makes monthly contributions to your HSA.

 - Paid Parental Leave: Generous paid parental leave for all full-time employees.

 - Family Forming Benefits: Resources and financial support to help you build your family.

 - 401(k) Matching: Contribution matching to help invest in your future.

 - Personal Device Allowance: Tax free funds for personal device usage.

 - Pre-tax Benefits: Access to Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Commuter Benefits.

 - Lifestyle Wallet: Monthly contributions for fitness, professional development, coworking, and more.

 - Mental Health Support: Dedicated access to therapy and coaching to help you reach your goals.

 - Sabbatical Leave: Paid Sabbatical Leave after 5 years of employment.

 - Compensation and Equity: Competitive compensation and equity grants for full time employees.

 - ... and much more!


EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Abridge is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability.

We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the interview process. Once you submit your application, we'll follow up with details on how to request an accommodation for interviewing, completing any assessments, or otherwise participating in the selection process.




STAYING SAFE - PROTECT YOURSELF FROM RECRUITMENT FRAUD

We are aware of individuals and entities fraudulently representing themselves as Abridge recruiters and/or hiring managers. Abridge will never ask for financial information or payment, or for personal information such as bank account number or social security number during the job application or interview process. Any emails from the Abridge recruiting team will come from an @abridge.com http://abridge.com email address. You can learn more about how to protect yourself from these types of fraud by referring to this article https://consumer.ftc.gov/consumer-alerts/2023/05/scammers-are-hijacking-job-ads-heres-how-spot-fakes. Please exercise caution and cease communications if something feels suspicious about your interactions.

jobs.title: Floor Trader - 2027 Graduate Program (August Start)
jobs.description:
Old Mission is a global proprietary trading firm that leverages state-of-the-art technology and research to identify and execute profitable trading strategies across multiple asset classes around the world. Our offices in Chicago, New York, and London are all composed of naturally-curious individuals who thrive in a team environment and constantly strive for improvement.

About the Position

We’re looking to hire a Floor Trader to join our expanding team on the CBOE (Chicago Board Options Exchange). After completing our comprehensive new-grad training program and working closely with experienced traders, this individual will transition to the trading floor, operating in an open outcry environment as part of a collaborative team using our proprietary pricing strategies. The ideal candidate is competitive, driven, and thrives in a fast-paced, team-oriented setting.

Responsibilities:

• Responsible for verbally executing trades and building out our floor footprint

• Communicate effectively with our traders upstairs and other floor traders

• Responsible for creating and maintaining relationships with floor brokers

Required Skills:

You will also partner with Getting Started leadership and cross-functional teams to identify opportunities, improve processes, and evolve Bloomerang’s onboarding programs as our products and customers’ needs grow.

jobs.title: Sr. Growth Manager, Agents
jobs.description:
ABOUT OSCILAR

Oscilar is building the most advanced AI Risk Decisioning™ Platform for banks, fintechs, and digitally native organizations. Our platform helps financial institutions manage fraud, credit, compliance, and onboarding risk using modern AI.

Founded by Neha Narkhede, co-creator of Apache Kafka and co-founder of Confluent, Oscilar is building a category-defining company — and our GTM engine is a core competitive advantage.


THE ROLE

Oscilar is hiring a Sr. Growth Manager, Agents to help scale the growth engine for our AI Agents product and rapidly learn which audiences, use cases, messages, channels, and programs drive the strongest commercial outcomes.

This is a hands-on growth role focused on both pipeline generation and pipeline progression. You will partner closely with Sales, BDRs, Product Marketing, and the broader Growth team to design and execute creative programs that generate new opportunities and help move existing opportunities through the funnel.

You will operate across a wide range of channels and tactics — including outbound and inbound campaigns, BDR programs, account-based plays, events, webinars, direct mail, digital programs, and signal-based activation. Just as importantly, you will capture what we learn from every campaign and feed those insights quickly back into our messaging, targeting, product positioning, and broader go-to-market strategy.

We are looking for someone analytical and technical, but above all highly execution-oriented. You should be equally comfortable developing the strategy, launching the campaign, writing the copy, building the workflow, reviewing the data, and iterating quickly based on what you learn.

This is a high-ownership role reporting to the Head of Growth, with close partnership across Growth, Sales, BDR, Product Marketing, and the broader GTM organization.


WHAT YOU’LL OWN


SCALE THE AGENTS GROWTH ENGINE

 - Own growth programs that generate and accelerate qualified pipeline for Oscilar Agents.

 - Identify the audiences, use cases, personas, signals, and channels with the highest potential.

 - Build repeatable growth motions while continuing to test new ideas aggressively.

 - Translate campaign and pipeline learnings into clear recommendations for the broader GTM organization.

 - Help establish the playbooks that will allow the Agents business to scale.


PIPELINE GENERATION & PROGRESSION

 - Build programs that create new qualified opportunities and help existing opportunities progress through the funnel.

 - Partner closely with AEs and BDRs to identify where marketing and growth programs can unlock specific accounts and deals.

 - Develop targeted campaigns for strategic accounts, active opportunities, and new market segments.

 - Design plays that create urgency, increase engagement, multi-thread accounts, and accelerate sales cycles.

 - Measure performance based on meetings, qualified opportunities, pipeline created, pipeline progression, and revenue impact.


MULTI-CHANNEL GROWTH PROGRAMS

 - Launch and iterate programs across outbound email, LinkedIn, calling, inbound, events, webinars, direct mail, paid, and other creative channels.

 - Build coordinated campaigns that combine Growth, BDR, Sales, and Product Marketing efforts.

 - Partner with Events on executive dinners, roundtables, conferences, and other field programs.

 - Develop inbound and content-driven programs around emerging Agent use cases and customer pain points.

 - Experiment with new channels and unconventional tactics to reach high-value prospects.


RAPID EXPERIMENTATION & LEARNING

 - Run continuous experiments across messaging, audiences, channels, offers, and signals.

 - Develop clear hypotheses and rapidly test what drives engagement and pipeline.

 - Maintain multiple active experiments rather than waiting for perfect information or long campaign cycles.

 - Kill weak programs quickly and scale the tactics showing strong early results.

 - Create tight feedback loops so campaign learnings influence targeting, messaging, Product Marketing, Sales plays, and future investments.


GTM SYSTEMS, SIGNALS & AI

 - Use Oscilar’s GTM stack to automate research, targeting, personalization, campaign execution, and follow-up.

 - Work hands-on with tools such as Clay, Salesforce, HubSpot, Outreach, Nooks, and LinkedIn.

 - Leverage AI agents and tools such as Claude and ChatGPT to scale research, personalization, and campaign orchestration.

 - Turn signals such as product activity, website engagement, events, intent data, executive changes, and account research into actionable campaigns.

 - Partner with Growth Engineering to build workflows and systems that make the Agents growth motion faster and more scalable.


MESSAGING & MARKET FEEDBACK

 - Translate Oscilar’s Agent capabilities into compelling campaigns for fraud, compliance, risk, operations, and executive audiences.

 - Write and test campaign messaging, outbound copy, landing pages, event concepts, and activation materials.

 - Stay close to Gong calls, customer conversations, and Sales feedback to understand why buyers engage, stall, or convert.

 - Work closely with Product Marketing to refine positioning and communicate market learnings.

 - Funnel insights from campaigns and customer interactions back into the business quickly.


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR


GROWTH OPERATOR

 - 5–8+ years of experience in B2B growth, demand generation, outbound, ABM, or related GTM roles.

 - Proven track record of generating qualified pipeline in an enterprise B2B environment.

 - Experience launching new products, verticals, use cases, or GTM motions where the playbook did not already exist.

 - Comfortable operating across outbound, inbound, events, webinars, direct mail, ABM, and digital channels.

 - Strong understanding of enterprise sales cycles and multi-threaded buying processes.


BUILDER MENTALITY

 - Highly hands-on and comfortable moving between strategy and execution.

 - Strong bias toward action, experimentation, and iteration.

 - Willing to personally build campaigns, write copy, analyze data, and solve operational problems.

 - Resourceful when data, processes, or tooling are imperfect.

 - Thrive in high-growth environments where the goal is to learn quickly and scale what works.


TECHNICAL & ANALYTICAL

 - Fluent with modern GTM tooling and comfortable learning new systems quickly.

 - Experience using AI for research, personalization, automation, or campaign orchestration.

 - Comfortable working with data, enrichment workflows, integrations, and automation.

 - Able to diagnose why a campaign or funnel stage is underperforming and systematically test solutions.

 - GTM engineering experience — APIs, Clay workflows, MCP connectors, or lightweight scripting — is a strong plus.


SALES FLUENCY

 - Deep experience partnering with AEs and BDRs.

 - Understand how growth programs influence both pipeline creation and opportunity progression.

 - Comfortable developing account-level strategies for large enterprise prospects.

 - Able to create programs and messaging that resonate with both technical practitioners and senior executives.


BONUS EXPERIENCE

 - Experience marketing or selling AI products.

 - Experience in financial services, fintech, fraud, compliance, risk, or other regulated industries.

 - Experience at a high-growth B2B company scaling from approximately $5M–$100M ARR.

 - Experience building AI-powered outbound or signal-based growth programs.

 - Background at a company known for strong growth execution, such as Ramp, Samsara, Verkada, Vercel, Clay, or a similar high-growth B2B company.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Within your first year, you will have:

 - Helped build a repeatable and scalable growth engine for Oscilar Agents.

 - Generated meaningful qualified pipeline while also improving progression of existing opportunities.

 - Identified the audiences, use cases, messages, signals, and channels that work best.

 - Built successful programs across Growth, Sales, BDRs, Product Marketing, and Events.

 - Established rapid feedback loops that turn campaign and market learnings into better GTM decisions.

 - Created repeatable playbooks that can be scaled across the broader organization.

 - Helped make Agents one of Oscilar’s most important growth engines.


WHY THIS ROLE IS UNIQUE

You will have the opportunity to help build the growth engine for a new AI product category while the playbook is still being written.

You’ll operate across the full funnel, work directly with Sales and BDRs, experiment across a wide range of channels, and have significant freedom to test creative ideas.

Most importantly, this role sits at the intersection of execution and learning: launching programs quickly, understanding what works, and using those insights to continuously improve how Oscilar takes Agents to market.


BENEFITS AND OTHER PERKS

 - Compensation: Competitive salary and equity packages, including a 401(k) plan

 - Flexibility: Remote-first culture

 - Health: 100% employer-covered comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance (US)

 - Balance: Unlimited PTO

 - Culture: Family-friendly environment with regular team events and offsites

 - Development: Strong learning and professional development opportunities

 - Impact: Help define how AI transforms risk management at financial institutions

Link: FedEx Announces Expansion of FedEx Fulfillment With Nimble Alliance

Why Join Nimble?

At Nimble, we are committed to building legendary products, a legendary team, and a legendary legacy. Join us and become part of an ambitious, humble, and resourceful culture where your work will leave a lasting impact on the future of robotics and commerce.

Nimble's Core Values:

Be relentlessly resourceful - Challenge conventions and overcome obstacles.

Be legendary - Be the very best and do work that inspires.

Be humble - Prioritize growth, learning, and doing whatever is needed to further the mission.

Be dependable - Take ownership and deliver with high agency.

Role Overview

As a Senior Electrical Engineer, you will design motor controller boards and power distribution boards for our robotic platforms. You will own the work from architecture and component selection through validation and production. You will work with mechanical, firmware, controls, and software engineers to build hardware that performs under real operating conditions.

Key Responsibilities

• Design motor controller boards, power distribution boards, and other high-power electronics for robotic platforms

• Own power-stage architecture, schematic capture, component selection, and PCB layout reviews for MOSFETs, gate drivers, current sensing, protection circuits, and thermal management

• Define grounding, power sequencing, fault handling, and interfaces among batteries, motors, sensors, and compute systems

• Develop drive electronics and interfaces to commutation with control firmware

• Work with firmware, controls, mechanical, and software engineers to integrate and test each system

• Write and run validation plans for efficiency, thermal performance, transient response, fault conditions, EMC/EMI, and environmental limits

• Diagnose power integrity, motor control, thermal, and reliability failures in the lab and on deployed robots

• Take designs through DFM, certification, production testing, and manufacturing ramp

• Drive team’s electrical design best practices

Qualifications

• 4+ years designing power electronics, motor drives, or high-current embedded hardware

• Experience designing motor controller boards, power distribution boards, DC/DC converters, inverters, or related power systems

• Knowledge of power semiconductors, gate drives, current and voltage sensing, magnetics, protection circuits, and control loops

• Experience with thermal analysis, power integrity, grounding, creepage and clearance, and high-current PCB layout

• Proficiency with Altium, OrCAD, KiCad, or a comparable PCB design tool

• Ability to run circuit, power electronics, and thermal simulations to validate designs before hardware testing

• Familiarity with embedded systems and protocols such as SPI, I2C, CAN, and UART

• Lab experience with oscilloscopes, current probes, electronic loads, power analyzers, and thermal cameras

• A record of shipping hardware products to production

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with three-phase BLDC/PMSM motor drives, field-oriented control, regenerative braking, and motor characterization

• Experience with batteries, battery management systems, pre-charge circuits, contactors, fusing, and high-current or high-voltage distribution

• Experience developing high-reliability or safety-critical systems

• Familiarity with DFM, DFA, production testing, and manufacturing processes

jobs.title: Senior/Staff Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT CODERABBIT

CodeRabbit is the leading AI code review platform, trusted by more than 17,000 customers and 150,000 open-source projects, conducting over 2 million code reviews each week. We build the symbiotic partnership between developers and AI that makes shipping fast software safe again, reviewing every pull request, IDE change, and CLI commit so teams can move quickly without breaking things.

 

We are a fast-moving, well-funded company, fresh off a $143M Series C at a $1.5B valuation — building Agentic Change Management, the control layer for software changes created by humans and agents. As AI writes more of the world's code, the bottleneck moves from implementation to judgment and helping human judgment scale is exactly the problem we exist to solve.




SENIOR/STAFF PRODUCT MARKETING MANAGER

CodeRabbit helps engineering teams understand, verify, govern, and ship code; whether the change starts in a pull request, an IDE, a terminal, or an agent workflow. We're hiring a Senior/Staff Product Marketing Manager to own the market story for the full CodeRabbit portfolio: Pull Request Reviews, IDE and CLI Reviews, CodeRabbit Security, Change Stack, platform integrations, and agentic change-management workflows.

This is a senior individual-contributor role. You'll set the narrative architecture that makes a growing suite understandable to developers, technical leaders, security teams, and enterprise buyers, and make sure the story holds up in the product, the field, and in customer conversations.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Lead integrated launches from insight through adoption: message architecture, audience strategy, sales readiness, campaigns, customer education, and post-launch learning.

 - Own portfolio positioning, messaging, personas, and go-to-market strategy. Define how each product earns its place in a single CodeRabbit story.

 - Translate product behavior into clear customer value across reviews, code context, tickets, policies, security findings, and agent-driven change workflows.

 - Lead integrated launches from insight through adoption: message architecture, audience strategy, sales readiness, campaigns, customer education, and post-launch learning.

 - Build the field system behind the story: pitches, demos, evaluation guides, competitive guidance, objection handling, executive materials, and proof for technical buyers.

 - Partner with customers and internal teams to develop credible case studies, benchmarks, usage stories, and evidence that can travel across products and buying stages.

 - Turn competitive analysis into product and GTM decisions, especially around review quality, security, governance, developer trust, and AI-code adoption.

 - Bring structured market and field feedback to Product. Identify recurring friction, missing capabilities, and places where product experience and product story diverge.

 - Raise the standard for technical marketing through hands-on writing, editing, and cross-functional leadership. Mentor other marketers without needing direct-report authority.


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 5+ years in B2B SaaS product marketing, ideally in developer tools, security, infrastructure, AI, or another technical market.

 - A record of leading complex, multi-product launches and changing how customers understand a category or product suite.

 - Technical fluency and credibility with engineers, product leaders, security teams, and developer audiences.

 - Experience supporting both product-led growth and enterprise sales, including trials, evaluations, customer proof, and executive buying conversations.

 - Excellent writing and editorial judgment, with an instinct for claims that need evidence.

 - A rigorous approach to qualitative customer insight and quantitative product or commercial signals.

 - The ability to turn ambiguity into decisions and bring cross-functional partners with you.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

CodeRabbit has a durable, evidence-backed portfolio narrative that customers and teams can use without translating it for themselves. Each launch reinforces the wider product story. Sales and Customer Success can choose the right proof for reviews, governance, security, local development, and agent workflows. Product gets sharper market feedback, and CodeRabbit's message matches the work engineering teams are actually trying to move forward.


Target salary for the role is $200k-$290k. Actual salary will be based on skills, experience, and location.

jobs.title: Senior Software Product Lead, ArsenalOS
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM:

ArsenalOS is the digital backbone of Anduril’s hardware enterprise. It connects the full lifecycle, from concept to build to field feedback, into one operating environment built for speed, traceability, autonomy, and continuous improvement. That environment includes not just the software used to design, plan, and execute work, but also the factory-facing infrastructure that connects operators, machines, test systems, and OT networks into the same adaptive Build Chain. It is not a support function, but rather a strategic investment by Anduril that the operating system of the hardware lifecycle is how we win. It will be one of the mechanisms by which Anduril out-builds, out-adapts, and out-scales the traditional defense industrial base.

ABOUT THE JOB:

The Senior Software Product Manager for ArsenalOS Quality will own the Forge Portal — a net-new platform that enables external stakeholders such as suppliers, partners, subcontractors, and auditors to do business with Anduril and execute workflows at the speed we require. This product sits within ArsenalOS Quality and will start by connecting supplier quality workflows into a seamless operating environment — replacing fragmented tools and manual processes with purpose-built systems designed for how Anduril actually builds.

This is a zero-to-one role. You will build this product from the ground up — from vision through MVP to scaled adoption. You must be able to zoom all the way in to improve how a single quality engineer dispositions a finding, and zoom all the way out to design the systems, data models, and integrations that connect quality execution to manufacturing, supply chain, and sustainment. Every defect we catch earlier, every supplier interaction we accelerate, and every quality workflow we automate helps Anduril build and field critical technology faster.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

• Define and own the product strategy and roadmap for the Forge Portal, with a clear point of view on the what, why, and why now.

• Build Forge Portal from the ground up — define the vision, scope the MVP, ship it, and iterate based on real user feedback and business outcomes.

• Partner with quality engineering, supplier quality, reliability, manufacturing, and supply chain to define and deliver the software that connects their workflows into one coherent operating environment.

• Define the integration strategy between quality systems and adjacent platforms — MES, ERP, PLM, sustainment — ensuring the right data flows to the right people at the right time.

• Work with security engineering on authentication, authorization, and access control — ensuring external stakeholders can interact with Anduril systems safely and at the right level of access.

• Leverage AI and modern tooling to accelerate product development — from prototyping and requirements generation to building intelligent workflows that surface insights, triage exceptions, and reduce manual decision-making.

• Establish metrics and feedback loops that tie product work to measurable business outcomes, e.g., escape rates, supplier response times, cost of quality, inspection throughput.

• Own prioritization, scope, tradeoff decisions, release planning, and execution quality across a cross-functional engineering team.

• Drive adoption so business teams and external partners actually use what you build — and spend less time fighting software and more time ensuring hardware excellence.

• Work in the open: document decisions, communicate roadmap and tradeoffs clearly, and create durable artifacts that align stakeholders and accelerate execution.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

• 7+ years of experience in product management building enterprise or B2B platforms with high complexity, multiple stakeholders, and cross-organizational dependencies.

• Strong domain knowledge in complex operational environments where many different personas with distinct roles and requirements must be orchestrated.

• Experience building net-new products — taking a product from vision through MVP to scaled adoption.

• Experience building or managing B2B platforms where multiple organizations interact through shared workflows and data exchange.

• Experience defining and shipping software that integrates with adjacent enterprise systems such as ERP, MES, PLM, sustainment, procurement, or internal data platforms.

• Demonstrated ability to leverage AI/ML and modern tooling to accelerate product development — from rapid prototyping to intelligent product features.

• You've owned a product end-to-end and can point to the business outcome it drove — not just that it shipped, but what it changed.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly to operators, engineers, business leaders, and executive stakeholders.

• U.S. Person status is required, as this position may need access to export-controlled data.

• Ability to work in-office full time and willingness to travel to operational sites as needed

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

• Experience in manufacturing, quality, aerospace, robotics, defense, or other high-complexity physical product environments.

• Experience with multi-tenant platforms, portal architectures, or systems that serve both internal and external users with differing access and workflow requirements.

• Comfortable producing mockups, wireframes, or interactive prototypes rapidly — whether through design tools, AI-assisted generation, or code.

US Salary Range

$166,000—$220,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. jobs.title: Director of Multifamily Partnerships
jobs.description:
We're looking for a driven, experienced business development leader to build and own Lemonade's multifamily residential channel. You will be responsible for securing strategic relationships with property management companies, asset owners, proptech platforms, and HOA management firms — driving national distribution of Lemonade's renters insurance products at scale.

Multifamily is one of Lemonade's highest-leverage growth channels, and this is a foundational hire to lead it. Reporting to the Head of Partnerships, you'll define our go-to-market approach, sign anchor deals with leading players across the ecosystem, and build the playbook that scales the channel. In year one, you'll be expected to close deals that deliver meaningful revenue, and lay the strategic foundation — this role is equal parts execution and architecture.

We believe two things matter for every leadership role at Lemonade: leadership that sets the bar for excellence, builds high performing teams, and holds them accountable, and strategy that thinks several years ahead and turns ambitious plans into reality. These aren't buzzwords, they're how we actually work.

Our AI-first approach isn't just a tagline either. We're building the future of insurance with AI at the center, and we need people who are genuinely excited to learn and grow alongside these tools.

 


IN THIS ROLE YOU'LL

 - Sign strategic partnerships across the multifamily ecosystem — national property managers, REITs and asset owners, and proptech platforms — to drive national distribution of Lemonade Renters, Pet, Car, and Homeowners products

 - Define and execute our multifamily go-to-market strategy, including partner segmentation, commercial model, and channel playbook, working closely with senior leadership

 - Represent Lemonade at key trade shows and conferences, lead C-level conversations, and build our reputation as the insurance partner of choice in the multifamily space

 - Build and manage a healthy national pipeline across property management, proptech, REIT, and asset owner segments

 - Lead complex, multi-stakeholder deals from first conversation through contract, integration, launch, and ongoing partner performance

 - Grow the team — with potential to inherit a direct report from day one, and a mandate to scale as the channel does

 - Define and track channel KPIs, and bring market insights back to product and leadership to sharpen our roadmap and competitive positioning


WHAT YOU'LL NEED

 - 5+ years of business development, sales, or partnerships experience within the multifamily residential industry — this is a firm requirement

 - A strong existing network across the multifamily ecosystem — property managers, REITs, proptech platforms, and asset owners — that you can activate from day one

 - A proven track record of closing complex, high-value partnerships and building distribution channels from early stages to real revenue

 - Experience as a senior external spokesperson — leading C-level conversations, speaking at industry events, and building brand presence in a market

 - Experience managing and developing at least one direct report, with a player-coach mentality and the ability to scale a team

 - Existing relationships with proptech platforms like Yardi, Entrata, RealPage, or Knock — a major plus

 - MBA or advanced degree — a plus

 - Genuine enthusiasm for AI and a commitment to learning how it can transform the way you work

Unfortunately, we cannot consider applicants from these states: Alaska, California, Colorado, Montana, Hawaii, New Mexico and Puerto Rico.

jobs.title: Founding Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
We're a stealth holding company acquiring and operating software businesses in overlooked, mission-critical industries - the systems that run the physical economy but have been ignored by Silicon Valley. We're rebuilding them as AI-native from the inside out.

We're small, well-capitalized, and moving fast. This is not a research lab. This is a build shop with real customers, real revenue, and real P&Ls.



The Role

You will be the AI engineer. You'll own:

 1. Building the industry-specific GPT: the reasoning layer that encodes the domain expertise of each vertical we operate in.

 2. Embedding AI-native functionality directly into our AI-native system of record: not bolt-on chatbots. Core workflow replacement. Agents that do the job.

 3. Moving legacy systems of record datasets into new ai-native ones: Core workflow replacement. Agents that do the job.

 4. Making it repeatable: Every new company we bring into the portfolio should benefit from the playbook, model stack, eval harness, and infra you build.

 5. Managing AI talent across our operating companies: you'll be a player-coach for the AI engineers embedded at each sub.



Split: 90% building. 10% managing. If that ratio scares you, this isn't your role. If it excites you, keep reading.



What You'll Do…

 - Ship a working domain-specific agent into a live customer environment in your first 30 days

 - Build the eval infrastructure that lets us measure whether these agents are actually replacing human workflows (not vibes)

 - Fine-tune, distill, or route across frontier + open models depending on the economics of each vertical

 - Sit with customers. Watch them work. Instrument their workflows. Rebuild them.

 - Write the AI engineering playbook that every future portfolio company inherits on day one



Who You Are…

 - You are a builder first. You've shipped things people actually use. Alone or as the clear technical lead.

 - You are a forward-deployed engineer. You'll fly to a customer site, sit in their office, and understand the business before you write a line of code.

 - You've been called a 10x engineer and it wasn't in a self-review.

 - You have strong opinions about when to fine-tune vs. prompt vs. RAG vs. agent vs harness and you can defend them with numbers.

 - You've built with the current frontier stack (Claude, GPT, Gemini, open models) in production, not just in a Jupyter notebook.

 - You are allergic to slide decks and comfortable with ambiguity, small teams, and unglamorous industries.



What This Role Is Not…

 - A research role. We ship.

 - A management role. You build.

 - A "Head of AI" title for LinkedIn. You will be in the codebase daily.

 - A place for people who need process, roadmaps handed to them, or a 20-person team to feel productive.

We are focused on building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If you’re excited about this role, but do not meet 100% of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply.

jobs.description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

The Consumer Devices team at OpenAI builds end-to-end hardware and software systems that bring AI into the physical world. We work at the intersection of custom silicon, embedded systems, operating systems, cloud services, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, and product design to deliver reliable, production-ready devices at scale.

Within Consumer Devices, Hardware Engineering eXperience, or HEX, is a new bootstrapped team building the environments, applications, compute, product-data systems, and workflows that let hardware engineers do their work without needing to troubleshoot the machinery underneath.

HEX owns virtual engineering environments, HPC/GPU compute, storage, networking, licensing, MCAD/ECAD/CAE applications, PLM, product data, automation, validation, and support as one connected system.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Staff PLM & Engineering Applications Engineer, you will be one of the first technical builders of HEX and the primary counterpart to the HEX lead.

You will own the engineering-application and product-data side of the hardware engineering experience, with an initial focus on NX, Teamcenter, licensing, parts import, integrations, packaging, validation, and user workflows.

This is not a traditional Teamcenter administration role and not a Corporate IT application-support role. You will take complex, fragile workflows and turn them into reliable engineering systems.

This role is highly hands-on and systems-oriented. You will not inherit a mature environment and support queue. You will help build a fresh one, replacing manual setup guides, tribal knowledge, repeated support issues, and team handoffs with tested automation and reliable workflows.




IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

 - Own the technical architecture, deployment, configuration, integration, validation, and long-term operation of NX and Teamcenter.

 - Build reliable workflows for parts import, product-data migration, metadata quality, BOMs, revisions, lifecycle states, and release processes.

 - Replace manual setup documentation with automated installation, configuration, validation, diagnostics, and recovery workflows.

 - Build tooling around NX, Teamcenter, MCAD, ECAD, CAE, plugins, licenses, and engineering environments.

 - Define and validate the golden path for hardware engineers: access, open, design, save, retrieve, release, simulate, and get help.

 - Partner with mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, simulation, manufacturing, systems, and product-design teams to understand where workflows break.

 - Work with Compute & Infrastructure-focused HEX Engineers so applications, product data, storage, VDI, HPC, and licenses feel like one coherent system.

 - Partner with contractors and vendors while keeping architecture, requirements, validation, acceptance, and long-term ownership inside HEX.

 - Build health checks, regression tests, observability, diagnostics, and support tooling that make failures easy to detect and recover from.

 - Help establish the technical standards, operating model, and engineering culture for the growing HEX organization.




YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU

 - Have deep hands-on experience with Teamcenter, NX, PLM systems, and CAD workflows in a hardware product-development environment.

 - Have owned PLM architecture, data models, integrations, migrations, parts imports, release workflows, and engineering application platforms.

 - Can write automation in Python, PowerShell, Bash, and similar tools.

 - Have experience with packaging, deployment, licensing, validation, and application integrations.

 - Understand parts, revisions, BOMs, configurations, lifecycle states, and change workflows.

 - Can debug across applications, infrastructure, licenses, VDI, networking, storage, compute, and product data.

 - Prefer building durable tooling and automation instead of managing ticket queues.

 - See a four-page setup guide and immediately want to replace it with a tested installer.

 - Are comfortable in a new bootstrapped team where the environment, standards, workflows, and operating model are still being built.

 - Can work directly with engineers, understand their pain, and turn repeated problems into reliable systems.




MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience with Teamcenter Active Workspace, BMIDE, ITK, SOA/REST, and Teamcenter customization.

 - Experience with NX Open, managed mode, customer defaults, templates, licensing, packaging, and upgrades.




PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience with PLM migrations, legacy part imports, data cleanup, ERP integrations, and ECAD integrations.

 - Experience with MCAD, ECAD, CAE/FEA, HPC, VDI/AVD, GPU workstations, and engineering storage.

 - Experience building internal platforms, developer tooling, infrastructure automation, and self-service systems.

 - Experience in complex hardware-development environments, including consumer devices, robotics, automotive, aerospace, or embedded systems.

Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About the team

Anduril’s Maritime Division has assembled a diverse team of experts in software, robotics, artificial intelligence, sensor fusion, and data analysis to create software and hardware solutions that radically evolve the capabilities of our customers. We are fielding the next generation of autonomous systems to tackle the extremely challenging industry demands of maritime operations. Anduril has brought to market a unique, ultra-long-range, full-ocean-depth underwater vessel platform and a completely refreshed maritime vehicle and flexible manufacturing architecture that scales from "small" to "extra-large" vehicle sizes. Today, Anduril is executing on billion-dollar contracts while simultaneously performing Robot-as-a-Service (RaaS) AUV operations.

We are seeking to sustain our early successes with deep investment in an expanded product portfolio. These core products, including Dive-XL, Dive-LD, Copperhead, Seabed Sentry, and other unannounced systems form the backbone of the Maritime portfolio. The core remit of this team is to architect a true system-of-systems that combines and orchestrates disparate sensors and platforms to deliver a coherent effect, enabling the end-to-end execution of a variety of autonomous missions in the maritime domain. If you are passionate about solving problems that have real impact and working on systems that directly contribute to achieving national strategic priorities, we want you to join Anduril’s Maritime Division and help us build the future of defense capability.

About the Job

Software Engineers independently drive the delivery of a variety of software integrated in to our products. This includes autonomy, simulation, data processing, payload integration, and off-board command and control and decision support. We expect Software Engineers to demonstrate end-to-end outcome ownership at the major subsystem or system level. Software Engineers contribute as a technical lead to the rapid architecting, design, delivery, support, and evolution of next generation autonomous platforms through their entire product life-cycle.

What You’ll Do

• Empathize with end-users and drive solutions that balance their needs with external constraints, restrictions and requirements in a multi-stakeholder environment

• Own software enabled solutions that are deployed to customers, optimizing for the delivery of value to the end-user

• Design and implement scalable software that rapidly delivers capability beyond the scope of current platforms, with a clear path for both architecture and capability evolution over time

• Contribute to the design and development of existing software services across Anduril, with the aim of developing components that are re-usable across multiple Anduril product lines

• Develop software that runs on- and off- robotic platforms, using a variety of technologies

• Contribute to the design, implementation and execution of development processes for the initial delivery and subsequent iteration of vehicle and mission software, including full lifecycle testing, monitoring and operation

• Create test and simulation fixtures that operate with both software- and hardware-in-the-loop

• Support vehicle manufacturing and deployment

• Work as a member of a multi-disciplinary engineering team, including as a mentor for Software Engineers from differing backgrounds

• Travel to co-locate with end-users and/or other teams up to 20% of the time

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Robotics, Mechatronics, Computer Science, Engineering, a relevant field, or equivalent experience

• Extensive professional experience working as a Software Engineer with one or more domains and/or technologies of expertise

• Systems and/or application programming skills including algorithms, data structures, concurrency, scaling, testing, infrastructure, software design and system design

• Experience troubleshooting and analyzing remotely deployed software systems

• Capacity to work holistically on software enabled capabilities up and down the software stack and through lifecycle through design, implementation, operation and sustainment

• Capacity to act as the technical owner for a software service, including stakeholder engagement, requirements definition, roadmap management, team co-ordination, design, implementation, sustainment and evolution

• Capacity learn and grow individually, while mentoring junior team members effectively, building team cohesion and capacity

• Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in a role for the delivery of a military mission system

• Experience writing backend services or embedded software in C++, Rust and/or Go

• Experience writing frontend applications using Typescript and React

• Experience with the design, implementation and operation of horizontally scaled cloud technologies

• Experience with the design, implementation and support of embedded software, particularly in the field of robotics

• Experience with modeling and simulation

• Experience with development of high assurance safety critical software

• Experience within the product delivery lifecycle including manufacturing, system acceptance, deployment, and sustainment.

• Familiarity with Systems Engineering concepts

• Desire to learn and grow in to other roles that require experience as a Software Engineer, such as Sr. Software Engineer and/or Staff Software Engineer

• Desire to grow in to a Tech-Lead-Manager role, with responsibility for line management of engineers, in addition to delivery

US Salary Range

$166,000—$220,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

Advanced Practice Provider (NP or PA) - Urology

Join Our Team
At Urology Alliance, we believe our clinicians are at the heart of advancing urological care. Our model is designed to empower providers with the resources, collaboration, and support they need to thrive. Backed by a dedicated operational team, our clinicians can focus on what matters most, delivering excellent patient outcomes and shaping the future of urology together.

Academic Urology & Urogynecology of Arizona (AUUA) – Peoria, AZ

Discover the advantages of Advanced Independent Practice - AUUA - powered by Urology Alliance.

As a member of Urology Alliance (UA), AUUA is supported by the nation’s leading patient-focused, excellence-driven gastroenterology network that is physician-led. This partnership empowers AUUA to deliver superior, individualized patient care by leveraging Urology Alliance’s robust, world-class business and organizational support, ensuring our clinicians can focus on what they do best – providing top-notch care in a successful and dynamic private practice setting.

General Responsibilities:

• Establish working diagnoses and develop treatment plans in collaboration with urologists

• Implement therapeutic interventions and provide appropriate follow-up care

• Refer to the supervising urologist or specialists as needed

• Other duties as assigned

Key Responsibilities:

• Sees new and follow-up patients and provides problem-oriented intervention for their urological conditions

• Assists in care, treatment, and follow-up as needed

• Perform and/or assists in-office procedures, including transrectal ultrasound (TRUS) volume studies, cystoscopies, post-void residual (PVRs) evaluations, difficult catheterizations, post-op voiding trials, and other necessary procedures

• Orders and interprets lab, x-ray, special studies, and clinical procedures, and provides appropriate care and follow-up

• Performs on-call duties for urology

• Evaluates, screens, and counsels’ patients on health maintenance and promotes utilization of community resources

Education & Experience Requirements:

• Master of Science in Nursing (MSN) or PA degree from an accredited program

• Active and valid state medical license

• DEA/DPS license

• Urology experience preferred but not required

• Excellent communication skills (verbal and written)

• Strong leadership and team collaboration skills

Who is Urology Alliance?
At Urology Alliance, our patients are at the center of everything we do. We are committed to providing the highest standard of urological care and delivering an exceptional patient experience at every step. Our clinicians have access to a broad spectrum of advanced urologic expertise, innovative treatment options, clinical trials, and cutting-edge research across the country. This shared knowledge and collaboration empower our providers to achieve outcomes that set the standard in urological medicine.

Patients Come First.
Every decision we make is anchored in strengthening patient care. Our physicians lead with a commitment to quality, access, and outcomes, and our shared infrastructure ensures they have the tools, data, and support to continually elevate care in every community we serve.

A Physician-Led Organization at Every Level.
Our model is built on physician leadership. Through our Physician Executive Committee, Regional Clinical Governance Boards, and Local Head Physicians, clinical decision-making remains with those who deliver care. This physician-led structure, supported by national-scale resources, preserves autonomy while strengthening specialty excellence.

True Partnership That Enables Physicians to Focus on Patients.
Instead of a traditional management model, we operate as a Management Services Organization (MSO). Our national infrastructure, which includes analytics, technology, revenue cycle, compliance, and operational support, reduces administrative burden so physicians can devote their time and expertise to patients. We enable, we support, and we align. We do not manage.

Outcomes Matter.
Our leadership is driven by the measurable value we deliver to physicians, practices, and patients. Our partnership-first approach, combined with data insights and operational strength, has fueled significant clinical, operational, and practice growth. As more top-tier physicians join our specialty-led ecosystem, we continue to expand access and raise the standard of specialty-care nationwide.

Interested in learning more?
We are just a click away. No pressure. Just information and a partnership built for physicians who want to lead the future of specialty care.

Be empowered to make your best next career move!

The Specialty Alliance is a physician-led Management Services Organization (MSO) that supports leading specialty practices with national-scale infrastructure, data, and resources. jobs.title: Senior Learning Designer, Leadership Development
jobs.description:
We're looking for a Senior Learning Designer, Leadership Development Lead to help Lemonade's managers become the kind of leaders people actually want to work for.

On our People team, you'll define what great management means at a company built on autonomy, accountability, and constant change — and then build the experiences, tools, and frameworks that make it real. As AI takes on more operational work, the bar for human leadership rises. This role exists to meet that moment.

We believe three things matter for every role at Lemonade: driven to push through challenges, efficiency that keeps standards high while moving fast, and adaptability that lets you pivot with data and AI insights. These aren't buzzwords, they're how we actually work.

Our AI-first approach isn't just a tagline either. We're building the future of insurance with AI at the center, and we need people who are genuinely excited to learn and grow alongside these tools.



IN THIS ROLE YOU'LL

 - Define what great leadership looks like at Lemonade in an AI-first, autonomous org — then build the frameworks, language, and tools that make it concrete for managers day-to-day

 - Own our Manager Seminars end-to-end: gather feedback, update content, and sunset or redesign learning that no longer fits how we operate — keeping everything practical, immediately applicable, and true to how we lead

 - Partner with Manager Partners and use Manager Effectiveness data to identify skill gaps, then design learning experiences to fill them — with a focus on organizational change, AI-human team dynamics, and coaching in remote and hybrid environments

 - Experiment rapidly with new learning formats — treat each program like a product launch, with clear hypotheses, fast iteration, and honest retrospectives

 - Meet managers where they are by using a variety of formats: self-paced eLearning, podcasts, Slack nudges, live seminars, practical toolkits, and one-page resources

 - Build content managers can use the same day — conversation guides, templates, and reflection prompts that fit seamlessly into meetings and existing workflows

 - Create spaces for peer-to-peer learning through cohort discussions, live seminars, and office hours that surface what great management looks like and help leaders grow from each other

 - Use surveys, usage data, and feedback to track engagement; partner with People Insights to measure whether learning is improving team performance and retention — and evolve the strategy based on what you find


WHAT YOU'LL NEED

 - 4+ years of experience in learning, leadership development, or management training — in-house at a similar high growth company, required

 - Background in people management or close partnership with managers — you've either led a team or worked alongside them closely enough to understand their real challenges

 -  Experience with learning management systems, content creation tools, and data analysis to measure learning impact

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, especially for translating leadership concepts into tools people actually use

 - A collaborative approach with experience working across People, Operations, and Leadership teams

 - Deep understanding of modern management challenges, especially in remote and hybrid environments and AI-integrated workplaces

 - Ability to work remotely 

*Please note that we are unable to sponsor applicants for work visas

Unfortunately, we cannot consider applicants from these states: Alaska, California, Colorado, Montana, Hawaii, New Mexico and Puerto Rico.

Our competitive total rewards package includes comprehensive health & wellness coverage, equity, a 401(k) plan with employer match, 20 paid vacation days, and parental leave. jobs.title: Director of Clearing Risk
jobs.description:
Webull is a leading digital brokerage platform built on next generation global infrastructure. At Webull, we believe that everyone should have an equal opportunity to control their own financial future. Our vision has always been to empower individual investors with the tools and resources they need to succeed financially. This commitment remains at the heart of everything we do. From low-fee trading and robust market data to advanced analytical tools, we are committed to providing a seamless, top-tier trading experience.

About The Role & Team

Webull Securities (US) LLC is seeking a Director of Clearing Risk to own the firm’s day-to-day capital, liquidity, and clearing risk framework. This role is responsible for ensuring that WSUS, as a clearing broker, maintains sufficient capital and liquidity to support current and projected clearing activity under both normal and stressed market conditions.

The Director of Clearing Risk will work closely with the CEO of WSUS, U.S. Chief Risk Officer, CFO, Clearing Operations, Compliance, Treasury, and other senior stakeholders to establish risk limits, monitor exposures, escalate emerging issues, and strengthen management reporting across the clearing risk function. This is a hands-on build role, requiring someone willing to help establish the clearing risk function from the ground up in a growing, self-clearing broker-dealer environment.

In This Role, You Will

• Own the capital, liquidity, and clearing risk framework for Webull Securities (US) LLC, including daily monitoring of net capital, excess net capital, liquidity, and clearinghouse requirements.
• Develop and maintain early warning indicators, risk limits, escalation thresholds, governance routines, and management reporting for capital, liquidity, market, and clearing risk exposures.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Sales – North America Verticals
jobs.description:
Freshworks is seeking an experienced Senior Director of Sales, North America (US and Canada) Verticals to lead our go-to-market execution across three strategic vertical markets: Manufacturing, State, Local & Education (SLED), and Federal/Government as well as Canada.

Reporting directly to the SVP & GM of America’s Sales, this leader will oversee three sales teams and their respective leaders, with responsibility for building and executing the strategy required to accelerate Freshworks' growth within these highly specialized markets.

This is a senior, second- or third-line sales leadership position requiring someone who has successfully led leaders, scaled enterprise SaaS sales organizations, and brings deep experience navigating the unique buying environments, procurement processes, and customer needs within the public sector and other complex vertical markets.

The ideal candidate combines strategic leadership with strong operating discipline. They can set the direction for the business, develop high-performing sales leaders, navigate complex enterprise opportunities, and partner across the organization to turn vertical specialization into a competitive advantage for Freshworks.

What You'll Do

• Lead Freshworks' North America vertical sales organization, with responsibility for teams focused on Manufacturing, SLED, and Federal/Government markets.
• Lead, coach, and develop the sales leaders responsible for each vertical, establishing a high bar for performance, accountability, talent development, and execution.
• Develop and execute a comprehensive vertical sales strategy aligned with Freshworks' broader North America and enterprise growth objectives.
• Own revenue performance across the verticals organization, including pipeline generation, forecasting, deal execution, productivity, and attainment.
• Build a scalable operating model across the three vertical teams while recognizing the distinct customer, regulatory, procurement, and go-to-market requirements of each market.
• Drive Freshworks' continued expansion into larger, more complex enterprise SaaS opportunities and help teams navigate sophisticated, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.
• Serve as an executive sponsor on strategic opportunities, helping teams engage senior customer stakeholders, overcome obstacles, and successfully close transformational deals.
• Establish strong inspection and forecasting discipline across the organization, providing clear visibility into pipeline health, risks, opportunities, and business performance.
• Recruit, retain, and develop exceptional sales leadership and sales talent as the vertical organization scales.
• Partner closely with Marketing, Solution Engineering, Customer Success, Professional Services, Channels & Alliances, Revenue Operations, Finance, Product, and other functions to develop integrated vertical go-to-market strategies.
• Build strong relationships with channel, technology, and ecosystem partners that can accelerate Freshworks' presence within strategic vertical markets.
• Bring market intelligence back into Freshworks, helping Product and GTM leadership understand the evolving needs of Manufacturing, SLED, and Federal/Government customers.
• Represent the verticals organization within the North America sales leadership team and contribute to broader GTM strategy, planning, and execution.

What We're Looking For

• 15+ years of progressive sales experience, ideally within enterprise software or SaaS organizations.
• 8+ years of sales leadership experience, including 5+ years leading managers and operating at a second- or third-line leadership level.
• Demonstrated success building, scaling, and leading high-performing enterprise sales organizations through multiple layers of leadership.
• Significant experience selling into and leading sales organizations focused on SLED and/or Federal/Government markets is required, with a strong understanding of public-sector buying cycles, procurement processes, contracting requirements, and go-to-market dynamics.
• Experience within Manufacturing or other complex enterprise vertical markets is strongly preferred.
• Deep understanding of complex enterprise SaaS sales cycles, including executive engagement, multi-threaded decision processes, procurement, security, legal, implementation, and commercial negotiations.
• Proven track record of consistently delivering against ambitious revenue targets and driving predictable, sustainable growth.
• Experience developing and executing vertical-specific GTM strategies rather than relying solely on traditional geographic or territory-based sales models.
• Strong command of pipeline management, forecasting, territory planning, account strategy, and sales productivity.
• Demonstrated ability to coach and develop experienced sales leaders while creating a culture of accountability, collaboration, and high performance.
• Strong executive presence with the ability to engage credibly with C-suite customers, senior government and public-sector stakeholders, internal executives, partners, and other senior decision-makers.
• Ability to operate effectively in a fast-moving environment and balance long-term strategic thinking with hands-on leadership and execution.
• Strong cross-functional leadership skills and a track record of influencing across complex organizations.
• Experience in a high-growth SaaS environment and/or helping an organization successfully move upmarket is highly desirable.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means building a high-performing, predictable, and scalable North America vertical sales organization that establishes Freshworks as a stronger enterprise partner across Manufacturing, SLED, and Federal/Government.

You will develop leaders who can independently run strong businesses, create greater consistency in pipeline and forecasting, improve enterprise execution, and build repeatable vertical-specific sales motions that can scale with Freshworks' growth.

Most importantly, you will help turn vertical expertise into a meaningful competitive advantage — ensuring our teams understand not only how to sell Freshworks, but how to solve the specific business challenges of the industries and customers we serve.

We're committed to building a workplace that reflects the diverse world we serve. At Freshworks, you'll find inclusive teams, flexible thinking, and opportunities to grow your career - while making work better for millions.

If this sounds like a journey you want to be part of, we'd love to meet you. Let's building something refreshing together.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, RL Environments
jobs.description:
Our mission is to automate coding. The first step in our journey is to build the best tool for professional programmers, using a combination of inventive research, design, and engineering. Our organization is very flat, and our team is small and talent dense. We particularly like people who are truth-seeking, passionate, and creative. We enjoy spirited debate, crazy ideas, and shipping code.


ABOUT THE ROLE

One of our north stars is a future where teams can hire Grok as a remote colleague. Reaching that future requires training our models in realistic, diverse environments that support complex, end-to-end work across domains.

As a Software Engineer on the RL Environments team at Cursor, you’ll build the systems that turn real-world data into high-quality environments and tasks for reinforcement learning. You’ll create dramatically more realistic training environments while owning the shared platforms and quality layers that help us produce trustworthy data quickly and at scale.

This role sits at the intersection of research, data, and engineering. You’ll work closely with ML Platform and research teams to turn company data, Grok Bot interactions, vendor-built tasks, tutor data, acquired data, and synthetic data into training-ready environments. Your work will make high-quality RL data easier to create, validate, discover, and use across our model-training efforts.




WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON

 - Building platforms that allows us to build complex, realistic, and diverse RL environments at scale, that support end-to-end tasks across knowledge-work domains.

 - Designing end-to-end factory that turns massive raw data into useful and realistic environments.

 - Defining and applying consistent quality standards across vendor, tutor, acquired, and synthetic data.

 - Creating self-serve APIs and tooling that accelerate task and environment development for internal teams and external contributors.

 - Partnering across research, platform, and external teams to translate model-capability goals into effective training tasks and environments.
   
   


YOU MAY BE A FIT IF

 - You have strong software engineering fundamentals and experience with data platforms, developer tools, distributed systems, or ML infrastructure.

 - You can turn ambiguous quality standards into concrete, automated checks.

 - You’re comfortable building repeatable pipelines from messy, heterogeneous data.

 - You care about model behavior and can translate capability goals into tasks and experiments.

 - You collaborate well across disciplines and own open-ended problems end to end.
   
   


APPLYING

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 2-3 short technicals. After, we'll schedule an onsite in our office, where you'll work on a small project, discuss ideas, and meet the team.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Access Controls
jobs.description:
About Lucid

At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience.

We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility.

Overview Job Title: Senior Software Engineer, Access Controls

About the Team

The Body Controls team is responsible for many of the vehicle features customers use every day, including access and security, closures, windows, mirrors, lighting, seating, power management, and diagnostics. The team develops and supports software across multiple ECUs and vehicle platforms, ensuring high-quality customer experiences from development through production and service.

This is a highly cross-functional team that works on embedded software development, diagnostics, vehicle integration, supplier management, new hardware bring-up, and production support. The team owns end-to-end delivery of body electronics features across multiple vehicle programs, offering engineers broad technical exposure and significant ownership of customer-facing vehicle functionality.

Responsibilities:

• Develop control systems for vehicle access control features; this includes vehicle lock/unlock, access device authentication, device localization through advanced controls algorithms such as kalman filters and bi/trilateralization.

• Develop requirements and related test cases for access control and other assigned features modeled in Matlab/Simulink.
